jobs.description: **City Research Scientist** =========================== * FIRE DEPARTMENT Posted on 10/30/2026 * Full\-time Location BROOKLYN * No exam required Department Headquarters Inspection Salary range: $87,743\.00 – $110,120\.00 Save **Job Description** ------------------- The Fire Department of the City of New York (FDNY) is the largest Fire Department in the United States and universally is recognized as the world's busiest and most highly skilled emergency response agency. The Department's main goal is to provide fire protection, emergency medical care, and other critical public safety services to residents and visitors in the five boroughs. FDNY members are sworn to serve and protect life and property and the Department works to continually educate the public in fire, life safety and disaster preparedness, along with enforcing public safety codes. Since its inception in 1865, FDNY has helped lead efforts to make New York the safest big city in the nation. This accomplishment requires a steadfast and daily commitment to maintaining the Department's core values. The Bureau of Fire Prevention cultivates a safer city for its citizens, visitors and first responders by preventing loss of life and property damage from fire and other emergencies. We accomplish this 24/7 by identifying fire and life safety hazards; creating, revising, and enforcing the New York City Fire Code; reviewing plans for critical systems designed to protect and alert building occupants; licensing qualified companies to install and service fire protection equipment and systems; certifying individuals to monitor fire safety conditions; and educating individuals and businesses about fire safety. In addition, the Bureau of Fire Prevention is critical partner with the Bureau of Fire Operations (Firefighters) and Bureau of Fire Investigations (Fire Marshals), providing assistance and guidance during post\-fire incidents and investigations; and coordinating with other City agencies on matters concerning fire and life safety. The Bureau consists of Fire Protection Inspectors, lawyers, engineers, explosives experts, and Fire Officers work together to save lives in New York City. The Fire Department, City of New York (FDNY), seeks a full\-time City Research Scientist in the Bureau of Fire Prevention. Reporting to the Director of Performance Management, the City Research Scientist, Level 2, will provide information and data to support evidence\-based decision\-making, lead research aligned with departmental goals, foster external collaborations, develop advanced models and algorithms, ensure research quality, translate findings into practical applications, and mentor within an innovative research environment. CITY RESEARCH SCIENTIST \- 21744 **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- 1\. For Assignment Level I (only physical, biological and environmental sciences and public health) A master's degree from an accredited college or university with a specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological or environmental science or in public health. To be appointed to Assignment Level II and above, candidates must have: 1\. A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full\-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or 2\. A master's degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and three years of responsible full\-time research experience in the appropriate field of specialization; or 3\. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least a master's degree in an appropriate field of specialization and at least two years of experience described in "2" above. Two years as a City Research Scientist Level I can be substituted for the experience required in "1" and "2" above. NOTE: Probationary Period Appointments to this position are subject to a minimum probationary period of one year. **Preferred Skills** -------------------- Preferred Skills Candidate should have an advanced degree in Operations Research, Statistics, Computer Science, Management Science, Economics, Public Policy or a related field with a strong foundation in research methods and statistical analysis. They must be capable of providing expert judgment in applying analytics and be well\-versed in industry best practices, current literature, and advanced analytics in the context of Operations Research. A candidate with the following skills is well suited for the position: Proven proficiency in SQL, Python, or R programming. Routine use of business intelligence visualization software such as PowerBI. Hands\-on experience with statistical, simulation, and optimization tools. Strong logical reasoning and a solid understanding of data requirements for front\-line usage. Expertise in operations research and statistical methodologies, including deployment analysis, resource allocation modeling, systems/operations analysis, simulation and optimization (both linear and nonlinear), predictive analytics (e.g., deep learning), econometrics and time series forecasting. Experience implementing high\-level quantitative research and mathematical modeling initiatives. Candidate should be an exceptional communicator and a collaborative team player who demonstrates a strong willingness to learn and thrive in diverse, multidisciplinary teams. Candidate should excel at clearly articulating analytical findings and offering practical, data\-driven solutions. Additionally, the candidate should possess strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with a focus on delivering exceptional customer service. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** ----------------------------------- As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/. **Residency Requirement** ------------------------- New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview. **Additional Information** -------------------------- The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy. automated tests to verify firmware functionality and reliability. * Collaborate with hardware, software, and research teams to integrate firmware with the broader medical\-device system. *Regulated causes, and implement corrective actions to improve firmware quality and reliability. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of professional experience developing embedded firmware or embedded software. * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for microcontroller\-based embedded systems. * Experience with microcontrollers (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M), hardware peripherals, interrupts, and embedded communication protocols such as UART, SPI, and I2C. * Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or embedded device testing. * Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers. * Ability to read in collaborative software development. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with attention to detail and the ability to independently develop, debug, and test firmware features and jobs.title: Junior DevSecOps Engineer (Python, CI/CD)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will share in operating the automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and secure cloud infrastructure that keep federal systems running. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Expect your first project to put you shoulder to shoulder with engineers, on pipelines a team leans on every day. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Contribute to the Terraform or CloudFormation code that defines infrastructure. * Under senior engineers' guidance, develop and maintain deployment automation and pipelines. * Pitch in on running Docker containers and Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, from orchestration to monitoring and logging. * Wire vulnerability checks, security scans, and policy controls into the delivery pipeline. * Turn repeatable operational tasks into Python scripts, reaching for Bash or PowerShell when those suit better, and close out every finding that comes back. * Take a hand in mapping and implementing National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800\-53 (NIST SP 800\-53\) controls, and automate the evidence that shows compliance. * Bring AI\-assisted tools into your pipeline, testing, and scripting work, and verify every output they produce. Code review sees every change you make, and you walk reviewers through the change and your reasons. That is where you learn what makes a change correct, not just that it runs. You automate the team's manual tasks, and you build your share of a practice that designs security in from the start instead of bolting it on later. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 1\+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, or operations engineering * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline * Practical use of one or more pipeline tools, grounded in a working knowledge of CI/CD concepts * Ability to write scripts in Python (Bash or PowerShell skills a plus) * Familiarity with Docker and containerization, together with the cloud services AWS offers * Exposure to tools that express infrastructure as code, for example CloudFormation or Terraform * A basic understanding of how containers are orchestrated * Experience with the fundamentals of Linux * Knowledge of web applications and application programming interfaces, together with networking concepts and load balancing * Grounding in the principles of cloud security and in practices for delivering software securely * Skill at tracking down and resolving problems in infrastructure and in deployments * Experience generating and reviewing code with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * Exposure to one or more of these areas: Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, NIST SP 800\-53 controls, or Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance * An AWS certification or practical experience delivering production workloads on AWS * A background with security tooling or vulnerability scanning, for example dynamic application security testing (DAST), policy\-as\-code, or static application security testing (SAST) **Who you are** For you, security and reliability belong in the build from the first commit, never in a final gate, and you are eager to grow into an engineer whose automation replaces other people's manual work and leaves an audit trail. When you hit a wall, you ask rather than guess. Feedback is your fastest way forward, and when priorities move, you move with them. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A grounding in cloud fundamentals, networking, Linux, scripting, and delivery automation, and an appetite to dig deeper into security. * Delivery habits in secure configuration, code review, automated testing, and version control, or a willingness to build them quickly. * Clear, plain updates: what you have finished, where you are stuck, and what you need. * The care to hold up where accuracy and auditability cannot slip. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.description: ### ***About Givzey \| Version2\.ai*** *Givzey \|* *Version2\.ai* (http://version2\.ai) *is a fully remote, AI\-native company that created the Autonomous Fundraising category in 2024, when it researched, developed, and deployed the world's first Autonomous AI to address the labor shortage and capacity gap in nonprofit fundraising. VEOs don't just make staff more efficient; they manage donor portfolios independently, freeing human fundraisers to focus their time on the highest\-value relationships while also closing transformational revenue for these organizations.* *VEOs have already generated over $20M in fundraising revenue to date, including individual gifts as large as $100,000, at an opt\-out rate of just 0\.07%. More than 250 VEOs are now deployed across higher education, healthcare, and nonprofit organizations in the U.S. and Canada, including UNICEF USA, Bucknell University, Wake Forest University, and William \& Mary.* *Adam Martel founded Givzey four years ago and leads the company as CEO. ----------------------- * Agentic AI systems that autonomously execute complex, multi\-step business workflows. * AI\-powered product experiences combining LLMs, retrieval, backend services, and human oversight. * Retrieval and knowledge systems that connect AI agents to organization\-specific information. * Backend services, APIs, and tool integrations enabling AI systems to safely interact with production applications. * Evaluation, observability, and testing frameworks that improve the quality, consistency, and reliability of AI behavior. * Orchestration systems and infrastructure supporting scalable, production\-grade AI applications. * Engineering tooling and practices that improve development velocity, software quality, and operational reliability. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Technical Leadership \& Delivery** * Lead small teams of engineers in the design, development, and delivery of complex, high\-impact AI initiatives. * Own the technical execution of projects from initial design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. * Translate ambiguous product requirements into clear technical approaches, actionable engineering tasks, and achievable delivery milestones. * Drive architectural discussions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and establish sound implementation strategies. * Coordinate engineering efforts, challenging technical problems alongsid ted generation architectures. * Strong understanding of production AI challenges, including model reliability, hallucination mitigation, evaluation, observability, latency, and cost management. * Demonstrated commitment to software engineering best practices, including automated testing, code review, CI/CD, system design, and maintainability. * Experience working with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS. * Proven ability to mentor engineers, provide constructive technical feedback, and influence engineering practices. * Strong technical judgment, debugging skills, and the ability to navigate complex systems and ambiguous requirements. * Ability to balance hands\-on engineering contributions with technical leadership responsibilities. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working across engineering, product, and business teams. * Experience operating in fast\-moving environments where ownership, adaptability, and execution are essential. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience with Amazon Bedrock, AWS AgentCore, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, or related AWS services. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, DSPy, Semantic Kernel, or similar agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience building multi\-step autonomous agents that interact with tools, APIs, external systems, or business workflows. * Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks, prompt regression testing, trace analysis, or human\-in\-the\-loop review systems. * Experience with vector databases and semantic retrieval technologies such as OpenSearch, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as LangSmith, jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer — AI-Native Data Platform
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Aarden is a land intelligence platform that helps landowners, investors, and developers figure out what a piece of land can actually be used for, and how to market it. We turn messy parcel, infrastructure, market, community, and ecological data into clear, bankable answers for land\-dependent assets. Our goal is to become the default decision layer for land: helping physical projects start in places where they can be built and supported for decades. We’ve built out a suite of data products to support that goal — pipelines, databases, and AI/ML models that power our maps and AI agents. We have strong product\-market fit, and we're now focused on hardening and scaling our data systems. That’s where you come in. **The Role** ------------ We’re looking for a high\-autonomy senior data engineer to own and evolve two types of assets central to Aarden’s future: our core datasets and the pipeline that keeps them current. The datasets bring together property data, geospatial data, and AI\-derived intelligence to power our insights and products. The pipeline makes it efficient and reliable to refresh, expand, and improve those datasets as our business grows. You’ll be responsible for the quality of the data and the systems behind it, with opportunities to contribute directly to our user\-facing product. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **Own and operate the data platform** * Own the day\-to\-day reliability and operation of our data infrastructure, including S3, Iceberg, Postgres, Lambda, PMTiles, and raster datasets. * Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve pipeline performance, observability, and data quality. * Extend existing pipelines to support new data sources and transformations. * Use automation and AI\-assisted workflows where they make operations more reliable or efficient. **Partner across the team** * Work with product to build datasets that support new features. * Co\-develop intelligence products with the analytics team. * Keep pipeline and dataset documentation useful and current. **Evolve the platform thoughtfully** * Stay current on data and geospatial technologies relevant to our stack. Identify opportunities to improve it, run focused experiments, and recommend changes when the benefits justify the tradeoffs. **You might be a good fit if you have…** ---------------------------------------- **Must\-have** * Owned the operation of one or more production data pipelines for a continuous period of at least 12 months * Experience with relational databases and lakehouse architectures * Strong Python skills; Experience with workflow orchestration (Prefect, Airflow, Dagster, or similar) * Curiosity and excitement about AI and the impact it can have on our ways of working as developers * Comfort working in a git\-based, CI\-friendly workflow * Minimum of 5 years of professional experience **Strongly preferred** * Experience with geospatial data and associated tooling (GDAL, GeoParquet, PostGIS, Apache Sedona, or similar) * Experience working in full\-stack environments, where your work can directly impact the application layer * Comfortable with PySpark or similar distributed data processing * Experience with Apache Sedona or other cloud spatial\-compute platforms * Experience building observability/logging layers for data pipelines (not just app services) * Experience with socioeconomic, property, parcel, real estate, or land data **Nice To have** * Experience using AI agents to improve data architecture in a real production codebase * Experience in real estate/land, energy, forestry, or agriculture tech * Experience in data scraping; ideally via agents. **Our Stack** ------------- **Languages:** Python and SQL. TypeScript/Node is a plus for our Application layer and AWS ingest paths. **Orchestration \& compute** * **Prefect 3** for pipeline orchestration (YAML/config\-driven flows, retries, logging) * **Coiled** for elastic EC2 workers on GDAL\-heavy and batch Python jobs * **Wherobots** (managed Apache Sedona / PySpark) for large\-scale spatial joins, parcel ingest, and lakehouse work **Data lake \& formats:** Apache Iceberg, Cloud\-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), and PMTiles. Queried with PySpark and DuckDB. **Geospatial:** GDAL, rasterio, GeoPandas, and tippecanoe. Large\-scale spatial work runs on Sedona/Spark via Wherobots. **Databases \& serving:** PostgreSQL \+ PostGIS (and pgvector on the app side) as the production store. **Working at Aarden** --------------------- Aarden is a high\-trust, high\-output team. We’re striving to be intentional about our team growth. This allows us to test the outer boundaries of our individual capabilities, while also going deeper on developer tooling and support. You’ll work hard here, and we’ve got your back. Practically, this means you’ll be asked to take on large projects, have a high bar of expectations to meet, and have a strong support system to help you meet that high bar. That support system includes: * **At least 2 in\-person days per week at our office in Capitol Hill \|** We’ve found that while heads\-down time at home is fantastic for task\-related productivity, in\-person time is magic for longer\-form productivity. Our in\-person days are used to plan, troubleshoot, and check\-in with each other on progress and questions. Expect team lunches and whiteboarding. * **Focused ownership in your role \|** The rest of the team is here to help you and cares about the evolution of our data products. With that said, we’ll be looking to you to own your lane, go deep, and own the development of these products. * **Dedicated monthly AI tooling budget \|** We’re in a golden era of AI\-powered developer tooling. We strongly encourage augmenting your output with AI tools, and have a dedicated \& flexible budget for every team member to support that setup. We care about *what* you ship, not *how*. **Details** ----------- * **Reports to:** CTO * **Compensation:** $150,000 \- $180,000 based on skills and experience * **Location / remote policy:** Seattle\-based, able to commute to our office in Capitol Hill Compensation Range: $150K \- $180K

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Epia Neuro is a neural technology company developing intent\-driven systems designed to restore function and independence for people living with neurological conditions. Its platform integrates implantable neural interfaces, adaptive algorithms, and assistive devices to translate neural intent into real\-world action. The company's initial focus is stroke\-related motor impairment, with expansion into cognitive decline and other neurological disorders. **The Role** ------------ We are generating neural and behavioral data at an increasing pace, across preclinical and early human research studies, with clinical studies ahead. We are looking for a neural data scientist to turn that data into rigorous answers. This ranges from characterizing signal quality and decoding performance to exploring what else our data can tell us, such as which movements and behaviors we can extract and decode. You will design and carry out the analyses and build the analysis workflows that let us do this reliably as our data grows. This is a hands\-on, individual contributor data scientist role on our Research team, reporting to the Director of Research. You will work alongside the scientists running our studies, and your work will shape study design, inform our decoding approaches, and contribute to publications. You will also partner closely with our Software team, which owns production code and the software infrastructure used in our studies. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the analysis of our research studies end to end, from analysis strategy and statistical design through figures, readouts, and publications. * Characterize and validate the in vivo recording performance of our neural interface (signal quality, noise, artifacts, and stability), and establish the preprocessing and quality control that downstream analyses depend on. * Develop and evaluate decoding models that relate neural activity to behavior, including those used in closed\-loop study sessions. * Explore neural and behavioral data, including pose estimation and kinematics, to identify new variables and questions worth pursuing. * Build reproducible analysis pipelines and help define data standards across studies. * Work closely with study scientists to shape analysis plans and study design, communicate findings clearly to scientists, engineers, and leadership, and partner with our Software team to hand off research\-grade methods and code. **Qualifications** ------------------ * PhD in neuroscience, neural engineering, biomedical engineering, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related quantitative field, or a Master's degree in one of these fields with 4\+ years of relevant experience in a research\-focused role. * Substantial hands\-on experience analyzing continuous neural time\-series data, ideally field potentials such as ECoG, sEEG, LFP, or EEG. * A strong foundation in neural signal processing, including filtering, spectral analysis (such as band power and time\-frequency methods), artifact handling, and feature extraction. * A solid applied machine learning background, including both supervised and unsupervised methods, particularly with noisy biological data. * Demonstrated ability to independently frame scientific questions, select and defend appropriate methods, and carry analyses through to clear conclusions and actionable recommendations. * Experience aligning neural recordings with behavioral and task data. * Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with a track record of writing reusable, maintainable analysis code and using version control and sound data management practices. * Clear written and verbal communication, and comfort working across scientific and engineering teams. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with human intracranial recordings. * Experience with motor decoding, cognitive\-state decoding, or closed\-loop BCI. * Experience with video\-based pose estimation or kinematic analysis. * Experience building data pipelines or standards shared across studies. * Experience with cloud\-based data processing. **How We Work** --------------- * **We are intentional.** We prioritize and are thoughtful about how we use others' time. * **We care for others.** We prioritize safety both for patients and one another. * **We own outcomes, not just tasks.** Our work demands the highest standards because it impacts real patients and real lives. * **Humility is a strength.** We are honest about what we know and what we don't know. Getting it right matters more than being right. **Location** ------------ This role is based out of the San Francisco Bay Area and is expected to work on site from our Alameda headquarters at least 3 days a week. **Benefits** ------------ Full\-time employees are eligible for the following benefits: * Competitive base salary with equity * 100% of healthcare coverage for you and your dependents * Generous vacation policy * Paid parental leave * Work from our waterfront office in Alameda, CA, with access to collaborative spaces and labs Compensation Range: $140K \- $165K

jobs.title: Senior Industrial Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Industrial Automation Engineer** ========================================= **About the job** ----------------- We’re looking for a hands\-on Senior Industrial Automation Engineer to automate as much of Arxlight’s drone manufacturing process from the ground up. You’ll design and build the automated cells, robotics, fixtures to create a repeatable, high\-yield production line. That spans component prep, subassembly, final assembly, calibration, end\-of\-line test and packaging. There’s no existing automated line or set of standards to inherit. You’ll decide what gets automated first and build it, often while the product design is still changing. You’ll work closely with Manufacturing, Hardware, Test and Supply Chain to find the steps that limit throughput, quality or cost, and replace them with automation that actually holds up on the floor. When a station is down or a new design needs to be production\-ready, you’ll be the one who gets it running, without waiting for a ticket. This role suits someone who likes building machines, writing the code that runs them, and measuring whether they made the line better, and who wants manufacturing to keep pace with a team that moves fast. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Map the end\-to\-end drone build process, identify the steps that limit throughput, quality, cost or safety, and own a prioritized roadmap for automating them. * Develop PLC, motion control, robot and HMI programs, and integrate vision systems, sensors, torque tools and test equipment into reliable, maintainable stations. * Build the software and data layer behind the line, connecting stations to MES, traceability and data collection so every unit's build history, process parameters and results are recorded and easy to analyze. * Automate calibration, end\-of\-line test, firmware flashing and packaging steps, working with Test Engineering to make production test fast and repeatable. * Work directly with Hardware and Manufacturing to drive design\-for\-automation and design\-for\-manufacturing changes, so new drone designs can be built on the line without rework. * Own stations from concept through validation and ramp, including fixture and tooling design, process capability, cycle time, OEE, preventive maintenance, operator training and documentation. * Investigate line stoppages, defects and yield losses, find root causes, and make fixes that stick. **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * 7\+ years of hands\-on experience in industrial automation, controls, robotics, or manufacturing engineering for complex hardware products. * Proven track record designing, building, and commissioning automated assembly stations or production lines, from concept through stable production. * Strong PLC and controls experience (e.g. Siemens, Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Beckhoff or similar), including ladder logic or structured text, motion control, safety circuits, and HMI development. * Hands\-on experience programming and integrating industrial or collaborative robots (e.g. FANUC, ABB, KUKA, Universal Robots), along with machine vision, sensors, pneumatics, and end\-of\-arm tooling. * Strong programming skills in Python or similar languages for station software, data collection, and integration with MES, databases, and hardware communication protocols such as EtherNet/IP, Modbus, OPC UA, serial, or CAN. * Experience designing fixtures and tooling in CAD (SolidWorks, Onshape or similar), and applying machine safety standards and risk assessment to equipment design. * Comfortable working hands\-on on the production floor, building and debugging your own equipment, and moving quickly when the product or volumes are changing. **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience automating the manufacture of drones, robotics, aerospace hardware, consumer electronics, or other complex electromechanical products. * Experience automating electronics and electromechanical processes such as PCBA handling, wire harness and connector assembly, motor and propeller assembly, battery pack assembly, potting, or conformal coating. * Experience with automated calibration and end\-of\-line test for sensors, IMUs, cameras, motors, ESCs, radios, or GPS/GNSS. * Experience with MES, traceability, and manufacturing data systems, and using production data to improve yield, cycle time, and OEE. * Experience with lean manufacturing, line balancing, process capability (Cp/Cpk), PFMEA, and scaling a product from low\-volume builds to high\-rate production. * Experience in a startup or fast\-moving hardware company where you’re expected to build the automation from scratch, not just maintain an established line. Compensation Range: $170K \- $190K

jobs.title: Senior Network Engineer I
jobs.description: **About EverLine** EverLine is a technical services platform for critical infrastructure, offering integrated regulatory, remote operation, and security solutions. Headquartered in Houston, Texas, with offices in Denver, Bakersfield, and El Paso, EverLine partners with more than 200 operators nationwide to deliver energy safely, reliably, and securely. Its technical stack combines three complementary service lines, Advise, Connect, and Secure, delivering increased safety and reliability at meaningful savings versus in\-house or multi\-vendor sourcing. EverLine has maintained a TRIR of 0\.0 and zero OSHA recordables over the past three years, and puts safety and security at the forefront of every action taken on behalf of customers. **About Security \& Resilience** EverLine Security \& Resilience is comprised of industry\-leading experts who have advised and supported critical\-infrastructure operators in advisory, integration, and operations for more than 30 years, across energy including oil, gas, and pipelines, utilities, manufacturing, federal government, and military and defense. The practice operates a U.S.\-based Security Operations Center providing continuous, automation\-driven monitoring and detection with analyst\-led triage and intelligence\-driven threat hunting, purpose\-built for cyber\-physical systems. EverLine Security \& Resilience is a licensed investigative firm and security consultancy in the State of Texas. **Position Summary** The Senior Network Engineer I is an expert individual contributor and technical lead responsible for the design and delivery of complex, secure IT and Operational Technology (OT) network solutions across EverLine's internal and customer environments. Working under the direction of the Director of OT and in partnership with the Network Lead, the Senior Network Engineer I serves as the technical lead on complex, multi\-site or multi\-workstream network projects, resolves ambiguous and undefined technical problems, and contributes to EverLine's network design standards and reference architectures. This role provides technical mentorship to Network Engineer III and below and serves as a primary technical authority for NERC CIP network design within scoped engagements. Typically requires 8\-11 years of progressive network engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on OT experience. **Major Duties and Responsibilities** ***Network Architecture \& Delivery*** * Serve as technical lead on complex, multi\-site or multi\-workstream network builds and upgrades, owning the technical solution from design through implementation. * Design LAN/WLAN/WAN and OT network architectures, including segmentation between IT and OT zones consistent with the Purdue reference model and defense\-in\-depth principles. * Resolve ambiguous, high\-complexity performance, routing, and connectivity issues through advanced root\-cause analysis across OT environments. * Design resilient field\-site connectivity architectures for remote and unmanned RTU/PLC sites, including cellular and satellite failover and industrial firewall/router platforms. * Contribute to and refine EverLine's network design standards, hardening baselines, and reference architectures. ***OT / ICS \& Industrial Networking*** * Architect and validate connectivity for SCADA and industrial platforms (e.g., ClearSCADA/GeoSCADA, Kepware, Ignition) and associated data links (OPC UA, MQTT). * Serve as a subject\-matter resource for industrial networking protocols (Modbus, DNP3, OPC\-DA/UA, IEC 61850\) and their secure implementation. * Guide telemetry and remote\-connectivity design for field devices (RTUs, PLCs, gateways) across electric utility and oil \& gas operations. ***Security \& Compliance*** * Design and review network security controls, including next\-generation and industrial firewalls (e.g., FortiGate, Palo Alto, Cisco, Checkpoint), VPNs, and access control architectures. * Act as primary technical point for NERC CIP network requirements within scoped engagements, including electronic security perimeters (CIP\-005\) and system security management (CIP\-007\), in coordination with management and compliance stakeholders. * Review vulnerability reports, prioritize findings, and direct remediation across engagements. * Lead forensics and remedial action on complex cybersecurity incidents; drive continuous improvement of the organization's cybersecurity posture. ***Leadership \& Documentation*** * Provide technical mentorship to Network Engineer III and below; review and approve designs, configurations, and change requests. * Own the technical relationship on assigned accounts / engagements and participate in scoping and estimation. * Establish and maintain authoritative technical documentation, including reference network diagrams, design records, and runbooks. * Provide senior\-level after\-hours and on\-call escalation support for critical operating situations. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Personal Characteristics** * Bachelor of Science in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and hands\-on experience. * 8\-11 years of You’ll also help build workflows using LLMs and agents to investigate failures, find recurring patterns, and automate repetitive integration work, with reliable checks on the results. **Location:** This is a hybrid role based out of our Long Beach, CA office, with regular in\-person collaboration alongside our go\-to\-market team. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Investigate and resolve customer blockers.** Work with customers and GTM to reproduce failures, inspect design data and logs, and identify the cause. Fix File I/O issues and coordinate with partner teams when a problem crosses system boundaries. * **Ship integration features and fixes.** Own Python changes from design through rollout, including parsers, exporters, and shared representations of boards, schematics, and constraints. Make sound implementation tradeoffs and contribute through code reviews. * **Verify the complete design workflow.** Turn representative customer cases into acceptance checks and regression tests. Validate that design information survives import and that exported results remain usable in the customer’s native CAD tool. * **Turn recurring problems into better tooling.** Improve diagnostics and error messages, automate reproductions, and build agentic investigation workflows. Use evaluations and feedback loops to make troubleshooting faster and more reliable. * **Connect customers’ existing workflows to Quilter.** Build reusable scripts and integrations for design\-data preparation and handoffs. Use repeated customer needs to identify capabilities worth supporting in the shared product. * **Work closely with GTM and engineering.** Help the team prioritize urgent blockers and larger improvements, agree on scope and commitments, and explain findings clearly. Pair with customers, demonstrate fixes, and document workflows they can use independently. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Deep production Python experience, with ownership of maintainable software from design through testing and rollout. * Experience working directly with customers, partners, or technical users to understand a workflow, diagnose integration problems, and deliver working software. * Strong debugging skills across unfamiliar code, files, and structured data. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. What we need now is someone who can turn a stream of real operational problems into agents that work reliably, one after another. ### **What You’ll Do** * Build and ship agents and multi\-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling. * Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them. * Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible. * Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them. * Monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human\-review rates. Fix what breaks and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time. * Ship full\-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them. * Help the rest of engineering adopt the same patterns. Build reusable tools, examples, and short write\-ups that make the next agent faster to build. ### **What You’ll Bring** * 5\+ years of full\-time industry software engineering, with a track record of shipping features to production and supporting them after launch. * Strong TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed. * Hands\-on experience building LLM features in production: tool use, retrieval, structured output, and above all, evaluation. * Experience with an agent framework and observability stack, ideally LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse. If you’ve used something else, show us what you built and how you knew it worked. * You work agent\-first. You’ve built your own tooling around coding agents, such as skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals. * Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan. * A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up. * You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit. * High agency in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup. You find the most valuable workflow to automate and ship against it without waiting for a perfect spec. * BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with document\-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance. * Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products. * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop review tools, or with fine\-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features. ### **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: $175,000 to $200,000 Salary ranges come from independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Plug will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Payments & Fraud
jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- Everyone knows the feeling of opening something unexpected and loving it. IcyBox turns that feeling into a business. We started as a watch commerce and mystery box company and are building a consumer brand people trust and come back to. We move fast, sweat the details, and are still writing our playbook. **Our Values** -------------- * **Move Fast, Build Right:** Ship today, fix tomorrow. * **Own the Gap:** If nobody owns it, we step in. * **Clarity Is a Gift:** Turn noise into decisions and action. * **Trust Over Title:** Follow\-through beats position. * **Say the Real Thing:** Hard conversations happen early. * **Do the Unglamorous Work:** No task is beneath us. **About the Role** We’re hiring a Staff Engineer to own Payments and Fraud. Every IcyBox order runs through systems you’ll work on: checkout, payment processing, refunds and fraud prevention. You’ll set the technical direction, keep fraud losses low, and keep good customers moving through checkout without friction, and make sure finance can trust every number. This role is in person at our New York City office, five days a week. **What You’ll Do** * Implement and own the architecture for payments, refunds and reconciliation in Rust * Build and tune fraud detection, including rules, risk scoring and models * Cut chargebacks, fraud losses and false declines while protecting conversion * Integrate and manage payment providers such as Stripe or PayPal, plus wallets like Apple Pay and Google Pay * Keep our payment systems compliant with PCI DSS and card network rules * Lead the response to payment outages and fraud attacks * Connect with Snowflake and other data analysis platforms * Work with finance, operations and support on disputes, refunds and reporting **What We’re Looking For** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time building payments or fraud systems at scale * Strong backend skills in Rust, or in another typed language plus a clear interest in moving to Rust. * Deep knowledge of card payments: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds and chargebacks * Hands\-on experience building fraud detection or risk systems * Strong backend skills and experience designing reliable, idempotent distributed systems * A track record of leading cross\-team technical projects from design to launch * Able to explain tradeoffs clearly to engineers and non\-engineers **Nice to Have** * Strong PostgreSQL / SQL: schema design, migrations, query performance * Experience in e\-commerce or high\-value goods such as watches, luxury or collectibles * Experience with fraud tools such as Stripe Radar * Experience with payouts and KYC platforms * Machine learning for risk scoring * Chargeback management and dispute representment * Multi\-currency and international payments * Experience using AI coding tools effectively in your daily workflow * Startup or high\-growth company experience Compensation Range: $220K \- $300K

jobs.title: WordPress & AI Developer — Part-Time Remote Contractor
jobs.description: **BURTZ Company LLC** MUST BE LOCATED IN THE STATE OF GEORGIA — NO EXCEPTIONS **DO NOT APPLY IF YOU DO NOT CURRENTLY LIVE IN GEORGIA.** This position is remote, but candidates must currently reside in the state of Georgia. We are specifically looking for a Georgia\-based developer who can work remotely while also being available for occasional in\-person meetings with the founder in the Atlanta/Gwinnett County area. **We are not accepting out\-of\-state applicants, relocation candidates, or agencies.** **Job Type:** Part\-Time Independent Contractor **Hours:** Approximately 10 per week **Location:** Remote — Georgia residents only About BURTZ BURTZ is a growing digital marketing company focused on helping service\-based businesses grow through professional websites, digital advertising, AI, and modern technology. Founded by Ryan Burton, a marketing entrepreneur with more than 30 years of experience and a successful company exit, BURTZ is building a lean, technology\-focused company with an emphasis on quality, efficiency, and collaboration. The Opportunity We're looking for an experienced WordPress Developer to work directly with the founder on website development, improvements, troubleshooting, and ongoing technical projects. This is a hands\-on, collaborative position. We're looking for an individual developer, not an agency. We want someone who enjoys working alongside another technically engaged person, discussing ideas, solving problems, and building great websites together. The founder actively uses Cursor, and one of our immediate priorities is establishing a reliable workflow for collaborating on WordPress websites hosted on WP Engine. We need someone who brings technical expertise, recommends practical solutions, and can help us work more efficiently. The position is approximately 10 hours per week initially, with opportunities for additional assignments and potentially a full\-time position as the company grows. What We're Looking For * **Must currently reside in Georgia and be available for occasional in\-person meetings in the Atlanta/Gwinnett County area.** * Strong professional WordPress development experience. * Solid proficiency with PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. * Experience building and customizing websites using Elementor. * Familiarity with WP Engine or comparable managed WordPress hosting. * Experience using Cursor or similar AI\-assisted coding tools. * Knowledge of GitHub, Git, or comparable version\-control systems. * Ability to independently troubleshoot and solve technical problems. * Understanding of WordPress performance, security, and website optimization. * Strong communication and collaborative problem\-solving skills. * Comfortable working directly with the founder. * Reliable, organized, and capable of completing projects without constant supervision. AI \& Modern Development Tools We embrace modern development practices and AI\-assisted technology. We're particularly interested in developers who actively use tools such as Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable coding assistants to work more efficiently. We value developers who combine solid technical fundamentals with the judgment to review, test, and improve AI\-generated code. You don't need to know every AI application. You should be comfortable learning new tools and incorporating them into your development process when appropriate. How We'll Work Together This is an ongoing working relationship, not a one\-time website project. You'll collaborate directly with the founder on website development, technical issues, new functionality, and improvements. We want someone who brings ideas, provides experienced second opinions, and can handle assignments independently while collaborating closely. An important initial responsibility will be establishing a straightforward development workflow so both the founder and developer can contribute to WordPress projects safely and efficiently. You should be comfortable recommending the right tools, setting up the workflow, and explaining how to use it without unnecessary complexity. We value a practical, collaborative approach rather than overly complicated development processes. Although most work will be performed remotely, we want the ability to occasionally meet in person, review projects, discuss technical strategies, and collaborate face\-to\-face. Working Arrangement * **GEORGIA RESIDENTS ONLY — NO OUT\-OF\-STATE APPLICANTS.** * Primarily remote, with occasional in\-person meetings in the Atlanta/Gwinnett County area. * Approximately 10 hours of work per week. * Flexible scheduling and mutually agreed deadlines. * Direct collaboration with the founder. * Ongoing development and technical support. * Potential for additional hours as business needs grow. Long\-Term Potential We're initially seeking an independent contractor for approximately 10 hours per week. As BURTZ grows, there may be opportunities for increased hours, additional projects, or a separately negotiated full\-time employee position. We're interested in finding someone who can become a trusted, long\-term technical partner. A Note From the Founder I've spent more than 30 years working in marketing, websites, and technology. I enjoy building and improving things myself, and I'm looking for a capable developer who can work alongside me, share technical expertise, and help us move faster. I'm not particularly concerned about fancy titles or perfect resumes. I value people who are knowledgeable, dependable, curious, resourceful, and take pride in their work. If you're an experienced WordPress developer who enjoys solving problems, collaborating, and using modern technology, I'd like to hear from you. How to Apply **IMPORTANT: DO NOT APPLY UNLESS YOU CURRENTLY RESIDE IN GEORGIA AND CAN ATTEND OCCASIONAL IN\-PERSON MEETINGS IN THE ATLANTA/GWINNETT COUNTY AREA.** Please provide: * Your current city in Georgia. * Your professional WordPress development experience. * Examples of websites or custom functionality you've developed. * Your experience with Elementor and WP Engine or comparable hosting environments. * Your experience using Cursor or other AI\-assisted development tools. * A brief explanation of how you would establish a simple, reliable workflow for two people collaborating on the same WordPress website. * Confirmation that you're available for approximately 10 hours per week and occasional in\-person meetings. **We're looking for a dependable, experienced Georgia\-based developer who can contribute immediately and become a trusted long\-term technical partner.** Pay: $40\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 10\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule Experience: * Web development: 5 years (Required) Location: * Georgia (Required) Shift availability: * Day Shift (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: AI and Image Processing Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ASP Health is an early\-stage commercial company working to develop and bring to market novel medical devices. Our first device is used in the operating room to take a biopsy sample, deposit it on a microscope slide, and then dry, fix, and stain the slide for immediate evaluation of the sample adequacy. Our second device is a digital microscope designed to specialize in specific workflows and applications. The device is combined with AI and image processing capabilities to aid in the assessment of the microscope slides. Developing robust software and models with excellent usability will be instrumental to the success of this role. We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer specializing in medical image processing, software development, and AI to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in computer science, mathematics, and engineering, with a focus on developing and optimizing algorithms for image analysis, enhancement, and recognition. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and testing software solutions that process and analyze images of cytology and pathology slides, from image acquisition through AI\-assisted assessment. It will involve collaborating with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, develop innovative solutions, and ensure the highest quality of software deliverables. If you are passionate about image processing and eager to contribute to cutting\-edge projects, we would love to hear from you. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package to full\-time employees that includes health/dental/vision, company\-paid life insurance, optional medical/dependent care FSA, HSA, 401k, and many other benefits. Our team enjoys paid holidays and paid, flexible PTO (paid time off) as well as an adaptive work schedule. **Duties** * Develop, optimize, test, and validate image processing models/algorithms/software. * Create, maintain, and improve image processing systems, libraries, and frameworks. * Work with cytopathologists to design annotation protocols and manage labeled image datasets and annotation workflows, including integration with annotation platforms such as CVAT, data quality auditing, cloud storage, and traceable dataset versioning. * Design model validation studies with appropriate data splits and clinical performance metrics (e.g., sensitivity and specificity for sample adequacy), ensuring consistent performance across sites, operators, stain batches, and devices. * Conduct performance analysis and optimize models for real\-time, on\-device inference (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, embedded GPU), meeting defined latency and reliability targets. * Develop and maintain cloud\-based AI infrastructure (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)), including data storage, compute resources, automated data pipelines, resource optimization, and model deployment workflows. * Develop and maintain production software that integrates AI models into the company's imaging platform, connecting image acquisition, inference pipelines, prediction metadata, image visualization, and clinician\-facing user interfaces. * Build, optimize, and troubleshoot GPU\-accelerated training and inference workflows, including multi\-GPU training, checkpoint/restart functionality, memory optimization, and performance benchmarking. * Design, develop, and maintain production Python applications, including backend services, APIs, and multiprocessing workflows. * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows\-based software applications, including desktop user interfaces, software packaging, installation, and release management. * Implement software engineering best practices, including automated testing, logging, error handling, debugging, version control, and reproducible software builds to ensure reliability and maintainability. * Independently own software solutions across the full application stack, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure system performance, reliability, and scalability. **Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * 3\+ years of experience in a related position. * Strong programming skills in Python and C\+\+. * Experience with medical image processing, specifically microscopy and cytology/pathology (e.g., whole\-slide imaging or digital pathology systems). * Hands\-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for segmentation, detection, or classification using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including with limited labeled data. * Understanding of computer vision techniques. * Experience developing and operating machine learning workflows on cloud infrastructure, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud storage, GPU compute, Python\-based training pipelines, and resource monitoring (e.g., Prometheus). AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. * Experience with software development lifecycle and methodologies. * Experience with version control for code, data, and models (e.g., Git, DVC, MLflow). * Knowledge of signal processing and mathematical modeling. * Experience with GPU programming and optimization. * Experience working in healthcare, medical devices, or biotech. * Knowledge of image preprocessing, compression, and enhancement techniques. * Experience deploying models on edge or embedded hardware (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson). * Eagerness to learn, grow, and take on many challenges and opportunities across the company. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Lead: BioVectra
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- BioVectra, now part of Agilent’s Advanced Therapeutics Division (ATD), is a CDMO producing active pharmaceutical ingredients at clinical\-to\-commercial scale across microbial fermentation, small molecules, plasmid DNA, mRNA, LNP, and sterile fill, operating from Charlottetown, PEI and Windsor, Nova Scotia. This posting is for the BioVectra assignment within Agilent's Operational Excellence (OEx) function. Agilent’s Operational Excellence function builds and embeds the production system on the manufacturing floor. The function exists to convert operational performance into capacity the divisions can sell. The Operational Excellence Lead owns this build across the full value stream, from fermentation through downstream recovery and purification to release\-readiness and leads through depth of expertise with no direct reports. Success depends on influence through the ATD OEX governance model: site leadership owns operating results, while this role owns method, cadence, capability build, and countermeasure discipline. This role works alongside site leadership, not above it. What You Will Do: * Own the production system build across the full value stream at your assigned site or campaigns, from incoming materials through to release\-readiness. Begin each deployment with a structured rapid diagnostic that reads the current state of the production system, daily management, and culture through direct observation, operator interviews, and quantitative evidence, and translate the findings into a sequenced deployment roadmap agreed with site operations and quality leadership. * Build and sustain tiered daily management from Tier 1 through Tier 4, leader standard work, visual performance management, Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC) boards, and clear KPI ownership at the line, with structured escalation that surfaces and counters abnormality the shift it occurs in. * Own and run the kaizen funnel for your value stream: prioritize, charter, and lead kaizen events and workshops that close KPI gaps in titer and yield stability, fermentation reproducibility, downstream recovery and purification yield, right\-first\-time execution, changeover through SMED, and the manufacturing\-to\-quality handoff. * Translate site and business objectives into floor\-level priorities through strategy deployment with defined ownership, milestones, countermeasures, and benefits realization. * Connect operational performance to the outcomes the divisions care about: throughput and sellable capacity, on\-time\-in\-full against client commitments, release cycle time, right\-first\-time, and the inventory, working capital, and cost that follow. Build and maintain a transformation scorecard as the single source of truth for KPI performance, value capture, and countermeasure tracking. * Use MES, electronic batch records, shop\-floor data systems, and analytics where they exist to feed the daily management system and surface process abnormality in real time. Identify where digital and AI tools earn a place in daily work, treating them as enablers of the production system rather than a parallel initiative. * Lead and mentor structured problem\-solving (A3 and PSP) at the Gemba on the real constraints across the value stream, driving teams through root\-cause analysis rather than solving problems for them. * Lead value stream mapping across the batch lifecycle, including the transactional and quality flows where sellable capacity is most often lost, batch\-record review, deviation handling, and client response, then install the daily management and standard work that level the work and shorten time to release. * Partner with Quality to support the operating\-system elements of the release maturity roadmap, from conventional finished\-product testing toward parametric release and real\-time release testing where the process knowledge, client alignment, and regulatory pathway support it; the analytical science, filings, and release strategy belong to Quality, while the process understanding, standard work, and flow architecture belong to OEX. * Coach and develop supervisors, operators, and emerging practitioners in standard work, daily management, structured problem\-solving, and Lean fundamentals, and build the next generation of certified practitioners at all levels. * Be the method owner for the production\-system at your site. Embed standardized ways of working, governance routines, and accountability mechanisms that deliver durable results beyond individual kaizen events. Where leadership owns results and this role owns the method, cadence and countermeasure discipline that produce them. * Anchor to the Biovectra deployment through build and stabilization, embedding deep enough that daily management and standard work hold. As that system matures, contribute to benchmarking and best practice sharing across the North American ATD footprint so hard\-won lessons travel. **Qualifications** ------------- gree in a life science, chemical or biochemical engineering, or related field. * 8\+ years in a GMP or comparably regulated/complex production environment with direct, hands\-on accountability for process performance across the Make value stream, 10\+ years will be helpful. * Demonstrated, hands\-on experience deploying and sustaining a production or business operating system in a line role, whether the Toyota Production System, Lean, or the Danaher Business System (DBS), including strategy deployment, tiered daily management, kaizen, standard work, visual management, and structured problem\-solving. * A track record of delivering measurable, sustained business results through transformation, across safety, quality, delivery, throughput, yield, cycle time, cost, or client performance. * Deep command of structured problem\-solving and root\-cause methodology applied to real process problems, with the credibility to coach operators and influence senior leaders alike. Location, Travel, and On\-site Requirements * This role is US\-based, with significant travel to BioVectra’s sites in Prince Edward Island and Nova Scotia, and across the broader ATD footprint as deployment phases require. * This is a Gemba\-based role. Expect substantial on\-site presence, in the range of fifty to sixty percent depending on deployment phase, including extended periods embedded at a site. It Would Be a Plus If You Also Possess Experience In * A CDMO or contract manufacturing environment. * Certification in Lean, Six Sigma, or TPS, or status as a Danaher Business System Certified Practitioner or Advanced Certified Practitioner (CP / ACP). Certification is welcome but does not substitute for a demonstrated record of building a durable system. **Additional Details** This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely. Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 6, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted. The full\-time equivalent pay range for this position is $146,640\.00 \- $274,950\.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Required Qualifications — Certification • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert certification is required, including successful completion of AZ\-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions and the applicable prerequisite certification. Responsibilities : Azure Repos Administration and Source Control • Administer Azure Repos repositories, repository permissions, branch security, and access controls. • Define and maintain branching strategies, repository standards, and pull request workflows appropriate to the team’s delivery model. • Configure and enforce branch policies, including: o Minimum reviewer requirements and automatically included reviewers. o Pull request build validation and required status checks. o Comment resolution and linked work item requirements. o Permitted merge strategies and restrictions on direct pushes. o Controlled permissions to bypass policies. • Manage pull request completion practices, including squash merges, merge commits, and rebase\-based workflows. • Resolve complex merge conflicts and troubleshoot Git history, tagging, and repository issues. • Establish commit, tagging, and versioning standards; manage large files and repository maintenance where needed. Azure Pipelines and Reusable Templates • Design and create YAML\-based CI/CD pipelines from scratch and maintain existing pipelines. • Implement multi\-stage pipelines covering build, test, package, publish, and deployment activities. • Design and maintain reusable stage, job, and step templates to standardize pipelines across repositories. • Use template parameters, variables, variable groups, conditions, dependencies, and output variables appropriately. • Manage shared template repositories, template versioning, and controlled rollout of template changes. • Configure CI triggers, branch and path filters, scheduled runs, pipeline\-resource triggers, and Azure Repos PR build validation policies. Configure and securely manage pipeline access to repositories, service connections, variable groups, and other protected resources. Cross\-Platform Build Agents • Configure and administer Microsoft\-hosted and self\-hosted build agents and agent pools. • Install, register, configure, and maintain self\-hosted agents on Windows and Linux; support macOS where required. Provision and maintain SDKs, compilers, package managers, build tools, and other agent dependencies. • Configure agent capabilities and demands, service accounts, permissions, and network access. • Troubleshoot agent availability, toolchain incompatibilities, workspace contamination, connectivity, and platform\-specific build failures. • Maintain consistent build environments and appropriate isolation between workloads. Build Automation and Artifact Management • Automate source checkout, dependency restore, compilation, unit testing, static analysis, code coverage, packaging, and artifact publication. • Support the organization’s application build ecosystems, such as .NET/MSBuild, npm/Node.js, Maven/Gradle, or Python. • Configure and administer Azure Artifacts feeds, package permissions, upstream sources, retention, and package versioning. • Manage pipeline artifacts and package feeds appropriately for their respective purposes. • Improve build performance through caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, and agent optimization. • Diagnose failed builds, flaky tests, dependency issues, and differences between developer and CI environments. Release and Deployment Management • Build and maintain deployment stages using Azure Pipelines and Azure DevOps Environments. • Configure approvals, checks, deployment conditions, and environment\-specific configuration. • Promote the same versioned artifacts across development, test, staging, and production rather than rebuilding for each environment. • Collaborate with application and platform teams on deployment validation, rollback procedures, and release troubleshooting. • Maintain release documentation and traceability between source commits, builds, artifacts, and deployments. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior AI Engineer** Apptopia is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join our dynamic, data\-driven team at a high\-growth startup backed by powerhouse investors like Mark Cuban and ABS Capital. We specialize in providing actionable competitive intelligence to investment firms and financial institutions by estimating worldwide downloads, revenues, and active users for every mobile app. We also provide a unique, highly valued product with app user behavior insights. Our actionable app\-store data and intuitive business intelligence tool help companies like Google, Facebook, and top hedge funds make smarter decisions. Apptopia is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to lead our push into LLMs, agentic systems, and AI\-driven product innovation. You'll design and build intelligent systems that combine LLM reasoning, structured data, and tool orchestration—shaping how we use AI across our product and company. **Responsibilities** * You will be a Senior AI Engineer on the Product team where you will work on incorporating LLM powered systems into new data products, advance our existing products and help shape Apptopia's long term AI strategy. * You will spearhead efforts to incorporate LLM powered systems as we bring new finance focused products to market * Design and implement agentic workflows that combine LLM reasoning, structured data, and external tools to accelerate new product delivery * Experiment with multi\-step reasoning systems, RAG, tool orchestration, and emerging paradigms to improve analyst workflows * Design, develop, and implement machine learning algorithms to advance a broad set of use cases including app usage trend forecasting, consumer behavior prediction,, stock price movement estimation, user segmentation * You will take part, and in many cases lead the thought process for improving core modeling efforts: * Identify opportunities to extend existing modeling work into AI\-native systems that integrate predictions, reasoning, and automation * Identify opportunities to augment core datasets with LLM\-derived features, classifications, and insights * Research, identify, and test ensemble methodologies to continuously improve accuracy and coverage in our models used for core app usage estimates * You will be a key thought leader in development of our AI platform and infrastructure: Contribute to the design of internal AI platforms that enable teams to leverage LLMs at scale * Lead rapid experimentation cycles to evaluate new LLM capabilities, architectures, and vendors * Define frameworks for evaluating LLM quality, reliability, and cost\-performance tradeoffs Partner with product and engineering to take ideas from 0* production * Help define best practices for prompting, memory, tool use, and system architecture **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years in data science, ML, data engineering, or applied AI * Experience building production ML systems end\-to\-end * Hands\-on experience with LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, etc.) * Experience with RAG, tool use, or agentic systems * Strong Python \+ experience with APIs and cloud (AWS preferred) * Databricks tooling experience
