jobs.title: Engineering Team Manager
jobs.description: **Summary:** Alpha consults on, designs, installs, and supports large scale broadcast and AV systems for sports and live events, casinos, secondary and higher education, government, and corporate environments. The Engineering Manager leads the Engineering team and is accountable for accurate, timely presales designs; delivery within approved project labor estimates; accurate bills of materials; and complete, accurate final deliverables issued when needed. Success means each handoff equips the receiving team to perform accurate, efficient, timely work while protecting customer commitments and Alpha’s profitability. The manager owns the Engineering employee lifecycle and builds a culture of accountability for downstream success. Teams agree what each recipient needs, when it is needed, and how readiness will be verified; Engineering resolves gaps and learns from downstream results. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Presales design accuracy and timeliness * Own accurate presales packages delivered early enough for Sales Support to prepare complete, accurate quotes and for Sales to negotiate informed deals. Confirm requirements, scope, site conditions, interfaces, and assumptions with Sales and Sales Support. * Provide reviewed architecture, equipment and quantities, labor estimates, scope inclusions and exclusions, dependencies, and priced\-option requirements. Verify technical integrity and quote readiness with Sales Support so quoting does not require avoidable redesign or reconstruction of missing information. * Set handoff dates to allow quoting and proposal preparation time. Resolve material gaps before release and escalate input, capacity, and schedule risks with recovery options. * Delivery within approved project labor estimates * Own coordinated post\-sales design that enables accurate equipment ordering, informed labor assignments, and full, accurate, timely CAD drawing packages. Give each team approved scope, technical decisions, design inputs, work assumptions, and release priorities before its work must begin. * Validate labor estimates with Project Management and delivery leaders. Review actual and forecast completion hours; prevent engineering savings from shifting avoidable effort, delay, or rework to receiving teams. * Track downstream clarification, rework, and delay caused by engineering handoffs; resolve causes and support recovery. Record scope changes and secure baseline approvals without concealing overruns. * Bill of materials (BOM) accuracy * Own complete, order\-ready BOMs with correct equipment, quantities, accessories, licenses, subscriptions, support entitlements, and infrastructure components. Provide clear item identification, approved substitutions, and required release information * Reconcile BOMs with design, scope, drawings, and Procurement needs before release. Coordinate long\-lead decisions and purchasing milestones; communicate revisions and their cost, schedule, and installation impacts to every affected team. * Engineering deliverable accuracy and timeliness * Own complete, accurate, usable engineering packages throughout post\-sales design and final closeout. Agree contents, receiving owner, acceptance criteria, and need dates for Procurement, labor planning, CAD, Installation, Programming Commissioning and Support. * Verify coordinated designs and drawings before execution. Ensure final as\-builts, BOMs, configuration and programming records, test results, operating documents, and support materials reflect the installed system and contract. Confirm readiness and close material gaps promptly. * Engineering team leadership and employee lifecycle ownership * Lead the Engineering team and own all aspects of its employee lifecycle in partnership with Human Resources and the Executive Team. Recruit and hire for technical skill, collaboration and handoff quality. Provide structured onboarding covering the full project lifecycle, receiving team needs and readiness standards. * Set measurable individual objectives for delivery, quality and the usability and timeliness of work received by other teams. Provide regular informal coaching and documented form performance feedback within required company timeframes; recognize achievement, address concerns promptly and effectively and complete corrective actions with Human Resources as needed. * Use team feedback in development plans and promotion\-readiness assessments; build technical and leadership skills, develop successors, and recommend or execute promotions within approved authority. Support employee engagement and retention and coordinate role changes and employee transitions with appropriate knowledge transfer. * Additional essential duties * Establish design and handoff standards with receiving teams, including review checklists, approval gates, revision controls, and response expectations. Review downstream defects, clarification requests, and lessons learned together; verify that corrective actions improve the next handoff. * Prioritize assignments across concurrent projects. Maintain staffing ad skills forecasts, manage departmental budgets and expenses, and allocate resources for contracted work, internal development, and approved research initiatives. * Maintain direct communication across operating departments and with customers. Lead technical discussions and key customer presentations, support new business proposals, and resolve issues through sound judgement and constructive conflict resolution. * Use Q360 and approved document and project systems to maintain accurate BOMs, labor forecasts, assignments, schedules and revision records. Provide leadership with KPI results, major risks, corrective actions, and progress against commitments. * Demonstrate ethical conduct, personal accountability, and Alpha’s values. Lead continuous improvement, support a positive team culture, and perform other duties and projects as assigned. **Required and Desired Qualifications:** * Demonstrated supervisory experience leading engineers and managing client\-facing technical employees * Experience with a systems integrator, consultant, end user, or manufacturer; strong working knowledge of broadcast, audiovisual, and digital signage system design, operation and integration, including audio and video formats and standards. * Demonstrated ability to manage technical project planning, labor estimates, system integration, verification and validation, risk management, design reviews, and engineering quality. * Strong written and verbal communication, organizational, interpersonal, and leadership skills; ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate cross\-functional teams. * Bachelor’s degree in applied engineering, business management, or business communications. Knowledge of CAD as applied to media systems integration projects. * Achieve and maintain relevant industry certifications, such as SBE, CompTIA, or BICSI. AVIXA CTS certification desired, past or current. **Downstream readiness standard** Engineering work is complete when it meets agreed requirements and gives the receiving team the information, decisions, and time needed to perform its next task well. Internal release alone does not establish readiness. At intake or kickoff, agree each handoff’s contents, owner, receiving reviewer, review window, need date, and acceptance criteria. Schedule engineering releases backward from downstream work, allowing time for quotation, ordering, staffing, CAD production, installation, and support preparation. A recipient accepts a handoff when work can proceed without material engineering correction, missing inputs, or avoidable clarification that blocks progress or causes rework. Normal coordination and approved scope changes are distinguished from defects. Log reasons for rejection, blocked hours, rework hours, and correction dates. Engineering owns technical content; each receiving team retains ownership of its professional work and final output. Use the handoff register and project reviews to test whether better inputs improve quote turnaround, order accuracy, CAD completion, labor readiness, and support readiness. These shared outcomes inform corrective action; sales negotiation results and other teams’ productivity are not attributed solely to Engineering.

build, integrate, and deploy AI\-powered workflows and agentic systems from initial discovery through production, with clear owners and success measures. * Create AI\-powered operational intelligence and observability that exposes bottlenecks, anomalies, risks, and actionable insights across fragmented systems and data. * Identify and deliver opportunities to reduce operating costs, increase patterns across companies and develop reusable components, integrations, and deployment approaches that accelerate future projects. * Balance business value, usability, technical feasibility, and responsible data handling when evaluating solutions and emerging capabilities. **We're Excited About You Because:** ==================================== * You have strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of personally architecting, building, and shipping production systems, not just managing delivery or configuring tools. * You have customer\-facing experience in solutions engineering, forward deployment, technical consulting, or a similar role that requires working with varied stakeholders. * You can engage credibly with CTOs and senior business leaders, ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and translate ambiguity into an executable plan. * You understand business operations and economics, can prioritize by potential impact, and measure results beyond technical completion. * You have experience with APIs, enterprise integrations, data flows, orchestration, and practical AI approaches, including models, agents, and multi\-step workflows. * You have demonstrated creative problem\-solving across different customers, industries, or operational environments and can learn unfamiliar businesses quickly. * You are resourceful, pragmatic, and comfortable owning outcomes independently in a fast\-moving environment. * You understand responsible handling of business data, permissions, and system access while partnering with established security and governance teams. * You bring substantial relevant experience; senior engineering depth and stakeholder maturity matter more than a specific title, tenure, employer, or framework. **Base Salary Range** ===================== The target salary range for this position is ($200,000\-$225,000\), and is part of a competitive total rewards package including an annual bonus, employer\-paid benefits, L\&D stipend and incentive pay for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually at minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay. **A Secure Candidate Experience** ================================= All official emails and messages regarding opportunities at ASG, LLC, will come from our alpinesg.com email domain. Please be wary of communications from similar domains that may contain misspellings or slight variations. These could be attempts at phishing or impersonation. ASG will never ask you for sensitive personal information during the hiring process such as social security numbers, banking information or other personal details.

jobs.title: Sr. Data & AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: At AltimateMedical, we improve the quality of life for the individuals and clinicians who rely on our products every day. Our story began with EasyStand, our line of standing devices. Over the years, we have expanded our brand portfolio through both innovation and strategic growth, adding respected healthcare brands including MedicalPositioning, ActiveAid, Therafin, and Leggero. Today, AltimateMedical designs and manufactures differentiated medical equipment across multiple sectors of the healthcare industry. AltimateMedical’s portfolio includes specialty product lines in four main areas: * **Standing** * **Mobility \& Positioning** * **Hygiene, and** * **Diagnostic \& Imaging** Learn more at www.altimatemedical.com As a Granite Partners company, we believe in sharing success and investing in our people. We offer meaningful career growth opportunities, a collaborative and values\-driven culture, and the chance to make a direct impact on the lives of those who depend on our products every day. Our innovative, dynamic, and collaborative culture drives us to develop and deliver high\-quality solutions that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. **Sr. Data \& AI Platform Engineer** **Lead the platform. Shape the future.** *Guide the data and AI strategy that will set a growing medical technology company apart in a competitive market.* Our mission is improving lives with thoughtfully designed medical technology, and data is behind every decision we make. As our Sr. Data \& AI Platform Engineer, you will manage our data and AI platforms, including NetSuite and Domo, and serve as a thought leader who guides our direction, shaping the data foundation, design, and applications that will serve AltimateMedical well and differentiate us in the market. You will oversee both structured and unstructured data and lead data exploration and visualization to uncover patterns, trends, and anomalies, increasingly applying AI and machine learning to accelerate and scale how we discover insights. Working independently, you will use statistical, machine learning, and AI\-based methods to analyze and model the data that drives decisions across the business. **WHY THIS ROLE STANDS OUT** * **Ownership, not tickets.** You will own our data platforms and lead platform projects start to finish, with the independence to choose the right approach. * **Build the foundation for AI.** Bring AI and machine learning into the platform and into production, and help shape where AI and automation go next. * **Work that is seen.** Your insights reach decision\-makers across the business, at a company whose products change lives. * **Room to grow.** A growing portfolio of brands means new data, new questions, and new problems worth solving. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * **Own and evolve our data platforms,** NetSuite and Domo, including integrations, ETL pipelines, data models, and data quality across structured and unstructured data. * **Lead platform and AI projects** from planning through delivery, directing work and partnering with cross\-functional teams. * **Run AI and ML models in production** on the platform, monitoring them for performance and drift. * **Tell the story,** turning complex findings into clear visuals and narratives for audiences of every background. * **Shape the roadmap** with IT and business leaders, spotting where AI and automation fit. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * **Own and evolve our data platforms,** NetSuite and Domo, including integrations, ETL pipelines, data models, and data quality across structured and unstructured data. * **Lead platform and AI projects** from planning through delivery, directing work and partnering with cross\-functional teams. * **Run AI and ML models in production** on the platform, monitoring them for performance and drift. * **Tell the story,** turning complex findings into clear visuals and narratives for audiences of every background. * **Shape the roadmap** with IT and business leaders, spotting where AI and automation fit. **WHAT YOU BRING** * **M.S. in Information Management, Data Management, Computer Science, or a related field** (an advanced certificate may substitute) and 5\+ years of relevant experience. * **Data platform experience:** ETL frameworks, database systems, data modeling and schemas, and data warehousing. * **Working scripting skills** in SQL, Python, and/or R to build pipelines and automate platform work, with good practices like version control and testing. * **Hands\-on AI/ML experience** with real tools; Domo or NetSuite experience is a plus. * **The ability to work independently** and explain technical work in plain language. In office or hybrid role based in either the Minnesota area or Chicago area, with occasional travel to our business locations in Frankfort, IL, Lenexa, KS, and our headquarters in Morton, MN in the scenic Minnesota River Valley, about 100 miles west of the Twin Cities. Days in office are negotiable based on proximity to our MN or IL locations. **Pay range:** **$125,000 \- $140,000, plus annual bonus and profit\-sharing opportunities.** AMHI offers competitive pay, annual bonus and profit\-sharing opportunities, and market\-leading benefits designed to support your wellbeing both at work and beyond. Full\-time team members are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, and life insurance; short\- and long\-term disability coverage; a Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions; a Vanguard 401(k) with employer contributions; generous paid time off, including volunteer time off and paid holidays; and access to the Granite Assistance Fund for support when it's needed most. Part\-time team members may be eligible for select benefits based on scheduled hours and plan requirements. AltimateMedical is an equal opportunity employer. \#LI\-JF1

jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **About Alvarez \& Marsal** Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action\- and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and helping them reach their potential. A\&M is different by design: we give people ownership and impact from day one, fuel development through real opportunity, and provide direct access to leaders who invest in our growth. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact clients and shape our industry. Guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, our collaborative, globally minded environment is why our people love working at A\&M. **The Team** The AI Lab Team sits within A\&M's Global AI \& Knowledge Organization (GAIKO). GAIKO brings together the firm's AI and Knowledge Management capabilities to put trusted, governed AI into everyday consulting work. The Lab's job is to turn repeatable business workflows into scalable agents and AI skills. Many of these workflows run today on Microsoft tools such as SharePoint, Power Platform and Power BI, and the pod reworks them into AI\-first solutions that can be reused across the firm. Others will be built from scratch as internal teams bring new requests. In this role, you'll work closely with the leads of A\&M's business units, the Knowledge Management (KM) and Data team leads, and the AI Skills lead and engineers, product partners and knowledge specialists across GAIKO. Together you'll design and build headless skills and agents: reusable capabilities that work behind the scenes and connect to the AI tools our professionals already use. You'll be the bridge between the business and the build: translating what each business unit needs into working skills and agents, and teaching the rest of the pod to do the same. As the pod's go\-to technical expert for skills and agents, you'll report to the AI Skills Pod lead with technical direction from the Intelligence Layer tech lead. Your work will directly shape how thousands of A\&M colleagues use AI in their work with clients. The team is growing, the work is technically demanding, and priorities will move quickly, so this role requires sound judgment, adaptability, and a willingness to contribute wherever the build needs support. We're looking for a fast builder who can take an idea from prototype to working capability quickly, learn from feedback and keep momentum without sacrificing quality. Just as important, you make the people around you better. You teach, share knowledge openly, step in across workstreams when needed, and adjust quickly when priorities shift. **How You Will Contribute** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of applied AI solutions, from proof of concept to production: problem framing, build, deployment, monitoring and iteration. * Partner with business unit leaders and their teams to understand how they work, translate their needs into skills and agents, and agree clear success metrics. * Work with the Knowledge Management and Data team leads to gather and clarify requirements, and translate them into skill and agent designs. * Partner with our Data Engineering, BIU, and Intelligence Layer teams so that solutions are built on reliable, production\-grade data. * Design, build and operate headless skills and agentic workflows, including multi\-step orchestration, tool routing, retrieval, guardrails, evaluation and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Build and maintain automated skill\-building pipelines (templates, scaffolding, testing and evaluation harnesses, packaging and deployment) so new skills can be created and released quickly and consistently. * Build integrations with large language model platforms and use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to make skills available to approved AI tools and the Intelligence Layer. * Integrate structured and unstructured content from enterprise systems while preserving source permissions, metadata and governance requirements. * Guide the team in assessing current Power Platform and wider Microsoft stack processes, reimagining them as AI\-first workflows rather than one\-to\-one rebuilds, and converting them into, or connecting them to, skills and agents. * Train the wider team on how to build skills, through workshops, playbooks, templates, worked examples and office hours. * Mentor engineers through pairing, code and design reviews and hands\-on coaching, raising the quality bar for skills and agents across the pod. * Apply and help shape engineering standards for skills and agents, working with the Intelligence Layer tech lead, including evaluation, CI/CD, versioning, reproducibility and performance monitoring. * Bring forward recommendations on tools, frameworks and design patterns. Technical decisions are made by the Intelligence Layer tech lead together with the Intelligence Layer lead. * Support responsible AI use, including data privacy, client co pting, evaluation and agentic patterns * Demonstrated track record of designing, building and shipping multiple AI agents and skills into production (examples or a portfolio will be discussed at interview) * Experience building automated pipelines for creating, testing, evaluating and deploying skills or agents at scale * Hands\-on experience with MCP, agent frameworks (for example, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or similar) and reusable skill design * Experience with CI/CD, testing and observability for production systems **Nice to Have** * Experience with the Microsoft stack (SharePoint Online, Power Platform, Fabric/Power BI, Azure), including hands\-on Power Automate and Power Apps experience and the ability to re\-engineer existing flows (strongly preferred) * Experience with SQL and modern data platforms * Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban * Experience in a professional services or consulting environment **Communication, Mentoring and People Skills** * Excellent communicator who explains technical concepts in plain business language and can run discovery sessions with business unit leaders to draw out real requirements * Proven mentor and teacher who has upskilled other engineers or non\-technical colleagues, and enjoys building capability in others * Confident presenting to and facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders * Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships across teams * Bias toward action: builds quickly, ships often and learns through iteration * High ownership and comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities * Sound judgment on when to ship, when to iterate and when to stop **Open Items to Confirm (remove before posting)** * Salary band: $140K to $180K (centered at $160K) is proposed; confirm with Talent Acquisition. Expect strong candidates to land in the upper half given the scope. * Experience requirement: confirm 5\+ years (including 2\+ on LLM or agent systems) is right for the Manager level. * Work arrangement: confirm remote, hybrid, or office\-based expectations. **Your journey at A\&M** At A\&M, professional growth is tied directly to performance, not tenure. Our people take on meaningful, hands\-on work supported by a performance development process that rewards contribution and fosters a culture of meritocracy. Stretch roles, evolving business needs, and firm growth create ongoing opportunities for ownership and building new skills, while direct access to senior leaders provides mentorship and real\-time coaching along the way. We also prioritize your wellbeing through comprehensive benefits and resources. Together, these elements create an environment where high\-performing professionals can continue to grow and advance from day one. Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez \& Marsal Holdings' fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD\&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez \& Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy\-two (72\) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A\&M's benefits programs. The salary range is $140,000 \- $160,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A\&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Alvarez Technology Group (ATG) is a managed technology and cybersecurity services company. ATG also assists organizations with regulatory and cybersecurity compliance, including CMMC readiness and pre\-assessment services for companies working within the Defense Industrial Base. The Cloud Engineer is to focus on Microsoft cloud administration, security engineering, compliance enablement, and Infrastructure as Code. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Cloud Engineer to design, administer, automate, secure, and continuously improve Microsoft cloud environments. This role combines hands\-on Azure and Microsoft 365 engineering with security, compliance, endpoint management, data governance, and DevOps responsibilities. The successful candidate will understand how identity, endpoint management, cloud infrastructure, data protection, security operations, automation, and regulatory requirements work together. They will translate control requirements into repeatable technical configurations, monitoring, documentation, and audit evidence. **Required Qualifications** * Progressive experience engineering and administering Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, including responsibility for production systems. * Advanced hands\-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, privileged access, identity governance, and modern authentication. * Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint security controls. * Experience implementing or operating Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Purview capabilities. * Production experience with Terraform, Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code practices. * Strong PowerShell automation and troubleshooting skills. * Demonstrated ability to translate security or compliance requirements into technical controls and verifiable evidence. * Experience supporting audits, assessments, certification efforts, or regulated customer environments. * Working knowledge of CMMC, NIST SP 800\-171, NIST CSF, CIS Controls or Benchmarks, GLBA, FFIEC guidance, or comparable frameworks. * Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, customers, auditors, assessors, leadership, and nontechnical stakeholders. **Education \& Certifications** Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Candidates should hold multiple current role\-based certifications demonstrating capability across Microsoft cloud administration, security, compliance, identity, and DevOps. Particularly relevant credentials include: * Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate * Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate * Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate * Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert * Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert Additional valued credentials include HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, CISSP, CCSP, CISA, CISM, GIAC certifications, and Cyber\-AB or CMMC ecosystem credentials. Compensation is commensurate with experience, capabilities, and contribution to the company's success, and is negotiated individually. This is an Hourly, NON\-EXEMPT position. Wage range $30/hr to $40/hr.

Customer obsession is part of our company DNA, which has made us one of the world's most beloved brands. We're looking for curious minds who think big and want to define tomorrow's technology. Every day brings exciting new challenges and opportunities for personal growth. jobs.title: Thermal & Mechanical Engineer, Annapurna Labs - AI Silicon Packaging
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- As a member of the Machine Learning Acceleration team you'll be responsible for the design and optimization of hardware in our data centers. You'll provide leadership in the application of new technologies to large scale server deployments in a continuous effort to deliver a world\-class customer experience. This is a fast\-paced, intellectually challenging position, and you'll work with thought leaders in multiple technology areas. You'll have high standards for yourself and everyone you work with, and you'll be constantly looking for ways to improve your products performance, quality and cost. We're changing an industry, and we want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today. Key job responsibilities * Perform finite element simulations and analytical modeling to evaluate assembly, test, and reliability risks for advanced semiconductor packages * Design and execute experiments on materials and packaging or system structures to validate performance and inform design decisions * Develop risk evaluations for future Annapurna packages, providing data\-driven recommendations that shape next\-generation package designs * Collaborate with Quality and Reliability, Package Design, Test, and System Design teams to optimize package architectures and resolve cross\-functional technical challenges * Communicate findings through clear documentation and design reviews, contributing to specifications and trade\-off analyses that guide team decisions A day in the life Your primary focus is ensuring the thermal and mechanical integrity of Annapurna's semiconductor packages. On a given day you might run finite element simulations to stress\-test a new package stackup, then head to the lab to collect experimental data on material behavior under thermal cycling. You'll review results with Package Design engineers, flag risks to the Quality and Reliability team, and refine your models based on real\-world feedback — all while keeping an eye on how your work feeds into the next product generation. About the team Annapurna Labs, our organization within Amazon Web Services (AWS), designs custom silicon and software that accelerates cloud innovation. Within Annapurna, the Packaging team focuses on the thermal, mechanical, and materials engineering challenges that come with pushing semiconductor package performance forward. We work closely with Quality and Reliability, Package Design, Test, and System Design groups to deliver robust, manufacturable solutions at data\-center scale. Our team values collaboration and knowledge sharing. We are investing in advanced packaging technologies to support the growing demands of machine learning and compute workloads, and you will play a direct role in shaping those next\-generation solutions.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent * 5\+ years industry experience in mechanical design of semiconductor\-based systems – silicon, packaging, and system design * 3\+ years industry experience in advanced packaging of semiconductors * Direct experience in designing and testing of test vehicles to assess future packaging architectures and evaluating properties of next\-generation materials * Expertise in optimizing in packaging architectures to meet quality, performance, and cost goals * Industry experience of working with packaging component vendors and ODMs, and internal design teams on cross\-boundary triaging, debugging, and resolving issues across organization * Proficiency with simulation tools such as ANSYS, ABAQUS, COMSOL, FLOTHERM, ICEPACK or equivalent FEA/CFD software **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Experience in advanced packaging metrologies for characterization, and design validation of semiconductor components, packages, and platforms. Hands\-on experience with lab\-based thermal and mechanical measurements, including instrumentation, infrared thermography, acoustic chambers, mechanical stress/strain gauges, power measurement equipment, and thermal test setups for package and system\-level characterization. * Strong understanding of product development lifecycles from concept through high volume manufacturing \- Experience with various types of technologies used for Heatsink solutions, Thermal Interface Materials (TIMs) and liquid cooling technologies \- including cold plate design. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon Lightsail makes AWS accessible to developers and business customers who want to get their cloud stacks running in seconds without the complexity of traditional infrastructure. As a Software Development Engineer II on the Lightsail team, you will build features and services that simplify compute, storage, networking, and website hosting for customers who need things to just work. The team is expanding quickly, adding new capabilities like website hosting and agent hosting, and you will help shape what comes next. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, from understanding customer problems through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. If you are an engineer who enjoys building products you would actually use yourself, and you want to do that at AWS scale, we would like to talk to you. Key job responsibilities Design and build features for Amazon Lightsail's distributed systems, working in Java, Go, JavaScript, and React across both backend services and frontend experiences. Collaborate with partner teams across AWS — including Amazon EC2, Amazon Route 53, Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3\), Amazon DynamoDB, and Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) — to integrate Lightsail capabilities with the broader AWS ecosystem. Own the operational health of the services you build by identifying root causes of production issues and driving permanent fixes, ensuring customers experience reliable performance. Participate actively in design reviews and code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates and mentoring other engineers on writing clean, maintainable code. About the team Amazon Lightsail sits within AWS and has a distinctive mission: make cloud infrastructure simple and approachable for non\-enterprise customers. While we run on the same AWS infrastructure that powers the world's largest workloads, our focus is on removing complexity so developers and small businesses can launch and scale without a steep learning curve. loading, memory planning, quantization, and multi\-device or distributed inference. * Collaborate across model\-serving, framework, compiler, runtime, kernel, and hardware teams to deliver a cohesive, high\-performance AI software stack. * Optimize model execution through graph compilation, operator fusion, precision optimization, efficient attention, and hardware\-specific execution strategies. * standards, benchmarking practices, and performance\-validation processes for the serving platform. * Evaluate, integrate, and contribute to relevant open\-source AI serving and runtime technologies. * C\+\+ and strong experience in C, including concurrent programming, memory management, and systems\-level performance optimization. * Strong understanding of AI inference performance, including jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic's go\-to\-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows. This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first\-party product and revenue data alongside third\-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape * Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear * Help build the canonical layer where key attributes are defined once and mean the same thing everywhere, with clear sourcing logic, provenance, and freshness * Turn data into intelligence: scores, signals, and AI\-generated attributes that help GTM teams prioritize and act, held to the same quality bar as any other source * Deliver that intelligence to the surfaces where teams work, including the CRM, and bring production discipline to how data moves through those systems * Operate what you build as a living system, with observability, data quality, cost, security, and access controls designed in, so problems surface before the field sees them * Partner with the owners of GTM processes such as planning, segmentation, and routing to settle definitions, make clear commitments, and communicate tradeoffs * Make the platform easy for other teams to build on, so work is contributed once and not rebuilt in silos **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Experience as a data engineer or analytics engineer building and operating production pipelines and data models * Strong SQL and Python, and experience with modern transformation and orchestration tooling on a cloud data warehouse * Experience making messy data from many sources usable, including record matching, deduplication, and reconciling conflicting values * Familiarity with go\-to\-market data and the CRM systems it flows through * Judgment beyond the pipeline: weighing data sources, shaping definitions with business partners, and making calls on data quality * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical partners * Regular hands\-on use of AI tools in your engineering work **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or GTM data roles * Experience building a shared data product or platform that several teams depend on and contribute to * Experience with company data such as firmographics, corporate hierarchies, or master data management * Experience using LLMs inside data pipelines and evaluating their output * Hands\-on Salesforce experience, including working at large data volumes * Experience supporting GTM planning processes such as territory design, segmentation, or scoring The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $405,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. The people here at Apple don’t just create products \- they create the kind of wonder that’s revolutionized entire industries. It’s the diversity of those people and their ideas that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do, from amazing technology to industry\-leading environmental efforts. Join Apple, and help us leave the world better than we found it. In this highly visible role, you will have process (TPM) and quality engineering (MQE) responsibility for next generation Apple products. This will require you to lead selection, implementation \& optimization of manufacturing processes and quality planning and deployment. In the TPM responsibility, you will utilize your Engineering experience and work cross functionally with Product Design Engineering and Industrial Design to assess product features for manufacturability, and recommend capable processes and equipment. In the MQE responsibility, you work in tandem with Apple's renowned designers to develop measurement \& metrology technologies, quality control plans, information systems, and manufacturing methods that achieve industry\-leading specifications at massive production scale. We handle a network of supplier factories worldwide, with responsibility for our partners to deliver to bold schedules. Our focus is on elegant execution of extraordinary industrial designs, resulting in products that thrill our customers. **Description** Process Development: Planning, proposing, and leading experiments to produce timely and accurate analyses used to drive design, development, and supply chain decisions. Assessing the suitability of a fabrication technology for a given part design. Planning validation exercises to demonstrate initial feasibility as well as manufacturing capability. Analyzing results of validation exercises and provide technical recommendations. Reviewing progress of development activities at supplier locations and serve as point of escalation for critical process related issues. New Product Introduction: Help to drive process development and capability assessment activities, reviewing part design documentation to ensure alignment with process capability. Assigns specific tasks and work with Apple suppliers to support process development and/or data gathering activities. Set clear goals for results and provide timely reviews of performance throughout program. Establish validation procedures to figure out acceptance of tooling into development builds as well as mass production. Supplier Execution: Review supplier tool design, process flow, equipment selection, DFM, and DOE proposals. Identify shortfalls and corrective actions to ensure design compliance. Work with supplier engineering teams to map out process development exercises, secure resources, and commit to schedules in line with program goals Assess supplier readiness to support build events and production ramp. Identify potential execution issues and provide recommendations to mitigate risk. You will utilize your Quality Engineering background in the following areas: Quality Planning Apply solid understanding of quality control and manufacturing concepts to develop specific Product Quality Plan (PQP) appropriate to program and commodity. Coordinate all Quality Engineering functions for a program, serving as project manager to lead efforts at supplier locations. Actively participate in the program planning and monitoring process assuming responsibility for key deliverables at all milestones. Provide technical direction and guidance to other Quality Engineers supporting the implementation of the PQP. Assess measurability and creatively address concerns directly with stakeholders. Identify and direct studies to implement improvements in measuring method where appropriate. Establish audit procedures appropriate to program and supplier to ensure adherence to Apple quality standards. Implement FAI and Cp/Cpk reviews of mechanical parts. Supplier Quality Management Assists supplier selection process for new products and second sourcing activities supporting qualification/disqualification decisions. Review PQP with supplier and other Apple functional groups to optimize supplier quality programs. Evaluates supplier readiness and adherence to PQP at all development and qualification stages. Monitor each supplier's performance through measurement of production line statistics, company inspections, and audits. Prepare summary of performance and communicate to appropriate management to ensure effective corrective action plans can be promptly executed. At Apple, a Supplier Quality Engineer defines product cosmetic specifications and manufacturing quality control methods. Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication, and evaluation of products. Involvement may begin at any step from product concept to full\-scale manufacturing. Coordinates design requirement review with appropriate engineering/scientific personnel to ensure capability of manufacturing processes. Compiles and evaluates data to determine appropriate limits and variables for process, material, and part specifications. May conceive and plan projects involving definition and selection of new concepts, product inspection technology, and approaches in the processing or development of new or improved processes. Recommends and implements equipment and process modifications to improve production efficiencies, manufacturing techniques and production yields for existing products. Develops and conducts statistical analysis such as Design of Experiments (DOE) and Statistical Process Control (SPC) targeting cause of failure for yield loss and improving quality. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with soft materials (non\-wovens, wovens, knits, leather) and inputs to those materials (yarns, raw materials) is strongly preferred. Experience with mechanical fabricated parts, or adhesives, glues, jigs, fixtures, tooling, injection molding, plastics experience may be acceptable. International experience, particularly in Asia is a plus Must have proven hands\-on mechanical ability. Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills. Domestic and International travel required. Experience with highly cosmetic parts a plus. **Minimum Qualifications** BS in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Engineering Management. 1\+ years experience supporting new product launches from a mechanical, process engineering, quality planning, quality engineering or product development perspective. Experience developing process quality plans, supplier quality audits, and driving corrective actions and failure analysis efforts. Knowledge of mechanical quality and reliability concepts, supplier management, and general manufacturing operations. Requires International travel to supplier sites. **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $112,100 and $169,100, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

jobs.title: Web Developer I
jobs.description: **Why Join Apple?** At Apple Federal Credit Union, we’re more than a financial institution; we’re a community\-focused organization powered by passionate people. With 24 branches across Northern Virginia and a proud legacy of service, we’re committed to improving the lives of our members and the communities we serve. We believe our employees are our greatest asset. That’s why we foster a supportive workplace culture that values inclusiveness, innovation and growth. Whether you’re just starting out or advancing your career, you’ll find opportunities for professional development, mentorship and meaningful impact. **Why Work at Apple FCU** * Recognized as a WTOP Top Work Places (2026\) * Collaborative, welcoming environment with forward\-thinking leadership * Competitive, comprehensive benefits package, including: + Medical, dental and vision coverage + 401(k) with employer match + Paid time off and 11 paid federal holidays + Paid volunteer time to give back + Tuition reimbursement and ongoing training opportunities + Annual TEAM Bonus plan. **Role:** Under general supervision, but following established policies and procedures, the Web Developer is responsible for developing, maintaining and enhancing Apple Federal Credit Union's public web sites and Intranet. Adapts marketing content to a Web\-friendly format, creates and maintains the infrastructure of the content, assists in running the web server software, and other web\-related software. Creates and implements online programs that favorably project the credit union's image and develops and maintains online programs that are competitive and consistent with the goals and objectives set by the President/CEO. Performs duties and responsibilities in accordance with The Apple Way principles, of Team Up, serve With Purpose, Challenge Yourself and Own It. Remains cognizant of and adheres to credit union policies and procedures, and regulations pertaining to the Bank Secrecy Act. Perform other duties as assigned by the AVP, Web Operations. **Essential Functions \& Responsibilities:** * Develops and maintains the credit union’s web portal, ensuring user accessibility with optimum navigation to the site. * Develops the visual design and/or layout of web site artwork, and overall "look \& feel" to enhance user experience and site performance. * Reviews project requests, provides feedback and designs prototype web pages. Works with the AVP of Web Operations to establish direction and schedule for projects. * Develops site expansion and functionality concepts based on credit union’s strategies and objectives. * Updates site as needed (daily, weekly, etc.) with consumer information, surveys, credit union product and service information, forms and applications. * Conducts online technology research: tracks and understands new web technologies. Provides technical guidance in developing service applications. Recommends Internet related policies and procedures. * Customizes web\-based interactive features. * Gathers and reports the monthly site usage statistics to the AVP of Web Operations. * Develops and maintains the graphics, text, and front\-end of Apple FCU’s online banking program. Creates: * Online and Web graphic banners and ads when required. * All electronic forms and applications for the Internet and Intranet. * And maintains documentation of all web projects. * And maintains documentation of all creative work including banners, pop\-ups and graphics library. **Experience:** Minimum 3 years relevant professional experience as a Web Developer. **Education:** College degree in Marketing, Computer Science or Communications preferred. **Interpersonal Skills:** Work involves much personal contact with others inside and/or outside the organization for the purpose of first\-level conflict resolution, building relationships, and soliciting cooperation. Discussions involve a higher degree of confidentiality and discretion, requiring diplomacy and tact in communication. **Other Skills:** Strong coding skills using Microsoft Visual Studio. Technical knowledge of .NET framework and Microsoft SQL Server database. Experience with the Umbraco CMS or coding in a modern headless CMS platform. Knowledge of HTML, DHTML, multimedia applications, including ASP.NET, and JavaScript. Strong initiative and ability to learn new technologies quickly. Ability to work accurately under pressure. Strong planning and organizational skills. Ability to meet deadlines and have strong service orientation skills. **Physical Requirements:** Ability to lift a minimum of 25 lbs. *\*\*\* Apple Federal Credit Union values, encourages, and implements diversity in the workplace.* *As an equal opportunity employer, Apple Federal Credit Union does not discriminate in employment with regard to race, color, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, age, sex (including sexual harassment), sexual orientation, marital status, physical or mental disability, military status or unfavorable discharge from military service or any other characteristic protected by law.* *All selected candidates will be subject to credit and background checks to determine employment eligibility. \*\*\**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Applied Intuition Applied Intuition is a leading technology company specializing in artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, and software\-defined vehicle technologies. The company develops advanced software platforms, simulation tools, and operating systems that help organizations build, test, and deploy intelligent machines. Its technologies support industries including automotive, defense, commercial trucking, construction, mining, and agriculture. Applied Intuition collaborates with leading global automotive manufacturers to accelerate innovation in autonomous driving and next\-generation vehicle technologies. Its mission is to advance Physical AI by bringing intelligence, safety, and automation to machines operating in the real world. About the Role We are looking for a talented and motivated Backend Software Engineer with strong Java development experience to join our engineering team and contribute to building scalable, reliable, and high\-performance software platforms. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain backend services that support vehicle data management, telemetry processing, simulation orchestration, and intelligent software applications. You will work with modern technologies such as Java, Spring Boot, microservices, Apache Kafka, SQL databases, and cloud infrastructure to build systems capable of processing large volumes of data efficiently. You will collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and cross\-functional engineering teams to develop innovative solutions that support the next generation of autonomous and software\-defined vehicles. Key Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot. * Build and enhance microservices\-based architectures to support distributed applications and enterprise platforms. * Develop RESTful APIs and backend services for vehicle data management, telemetry processing, and simulation workflows. * Implement asynchronous and event\-driven processing using Apache Kafka and related messaging technologies. * Work with relational and NoSQL databases to design efficient data models, queries, and storage solutions. * Develop reliable data processing workflows to handle large volumes of vehicle telemetry and simulation data. * Collaborate with frontend, infrastructure, and data engineering teams to integrate backend services with other platform components. * Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications in cloud environments using Docker and Kubernetes. * Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, debugging, and performance optimization. * Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well\-tested code while following software engineering best practices. * Contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) processes to improve development efficiency and software quality. * Identify technical challenges and recommend solutions that improve application performance, scalability, and reliability. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of professional software development experience, preferably building backend applications. * Strong programming experience with Java and object\-oriented programming concepts. * Hands\-on experience with Spring Boot and developing RESTful APIs. * Understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems. * Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. * Familiarity with SQL queries, database design, and data management. * Understanding of multithreading, concurrency, exception handling, and application performance optimization. * Experience with version control systems such as Git. * Familiarity with software testing, debugging, and code quality practices. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced engineering environment. U.S. Work Authorization Requirements * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. * Applicants must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents (Green Card holders). * Applicants must be able to provide appropriate documentation verifying their employment eligibility in accordance with applicable U.S. employment laws. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with Apache Kafka or other event\-streaming and messaging platforms. * Familiarity with Apache Spark or distributed data processing frameworks. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application development. * Experience with Redis, MongoDB, or other NoSQL technologies. * Understanding of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. * Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. * Exposure to high\-volume data processing, vehicle telemetry, simulation platforms, or autonomous systems. * Interest in artificial intelligence, robotics, automotive technologies, or software\-defined vehicles. Equal Employment Opportunity We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to qualified applicants. Employment decisions should be based on relevant qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs, without discrimination on any basis protected by applicable law. **Ready to build what comes next? Apply today and become part of the team advancing the future of intelligent machines.** Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Family leave * Flextime * Paid sick time Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sr. Software Systems Safety Engineer
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. **JOB SUMMARY** Own the safety assurance of the software and AI that run our humanoid robots, from architecture analysis through verification evidence. You will analyze software and AI safety architectures, lead the safety analyses, and assess whether the evidence supports our safety claims. You will draw on IEC 61508\-3, ISO/IEC TS 22440, and deep experience with safety\-critical software systems. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * Collaborate on system\-level risk assessments, allocate risk reduction measures to software and AI elements, and own the breakdown of software\-domain safety requirements into subsystem and element\-level requirements * Analyze and define the software safety architecture, including partitioning and freedom from interference, watchdogs, diagnostics, plausibility and timing monitoring, communication integrity, startup/shutdown behavior, and fault handling * Lead software safety analyses, including software FMEA, fault tree analysis, dependent/common\-cause failure analysis, and timing and resource analysis * Specify safety\-related software behavior, such as monitors, diagnostics, and safe\-state logic, and review software team designs against IEC 61508\-3 requirements for the target SIL / SC * Define the IEC 61508\-3 software safety plan and lifecycle, and assess team conformance through reviews and audits, including existing in\-house, open\-source, and third\-party libraries, RTOS, and middleware * Assess software systematic capability and review verification evidence, including coverage, static analysis, fault injection, and software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test results, for adequacy against safety claims * Apply the AI safety lifecycle (ISO/IEC TS 22440\) to AI/ML\-enabled functions, defining the safety architecture around them, including independence of safety functions from learned components and the safety mechanisms that monitor them * Assess AI/ML safety evidence against the AI safety lifecycle, including data and model assurance, performance limitations, and operational design domain * Own software requirements traceability and the software portion of the safety case, including gap assessments against standards * Support product safety and compliance teams in certification and demonstration of standards conformity **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * Demonstrated experience analyzing and assuring safety\-critical software architectures, including software safety analyses and safety case development * Practical application of the IEC 61508\-3 or ISO 26262\-6 (automotive) software lifecycle, with depth in software safety activities and qualification of existing software and tools, and experience with IEC 62061, ISO 13849, ISO 10218, ANSI/A3 R15\.06, or ISO 25785\-1 as relevant * Strong knowledge of embedded software architectures, including RTOS, mixed\-criticality partitioning, watchdogs, communication buses, and diagnostics * Hands\-on experience with FMEA/FMEDA, FTA, and dependent failure analysis, and with reviewing verification evidence such as fault injection, software\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, and test coverage * Working knowledge of safety for AI/ML\-enabled systems, such as ISO/IEC TS 22440; familiarity with ISO/PAS 8800, UL 4600, or SOTIF preferred * Experience with requirements and traceability tools such as JAMA; familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and static analysis; certification or third\-party assessment experience preferred * Ability to work cross\-functionally and make sound, risk\-based engineering decisions * Experience with common Product Development Processes / Product Lifecycle management including Agile, CMMI, Waterfall, etc. helping teams to deliver to organizational milestones. **EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's Degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field (or equivalent experience); Master's preferred * 8\+ years of relevant engineering experience, including substantial responsibility for safety assurance or analysis of safety\-critical software in complex electromechanical products **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** * jobs.description: **Position summary** ==================== Area Energy \& Electric, Inc. is seeking an Electrical Estimator for our Sidney, Ohio office. The Estimator prepares accurate, competitive bids for commercial and industrial electrical projects, manages the bid process from document setup through vendor pricing and proposal, and supports project managers from award through closeout. The role helps secure profitable work across the markets we serve in western Ohio. **Essential duties and responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- **Bid setup and document review** * Review bid documents, drawings, specifications and addenda to define project scope. * Print, organize and tab electrical specifications and drawings; create estimating and job folders. * Review architectural drawings for wall and ceiling types, and civil/site drawings for fire alarm PIVs and other items missing from electrical drawings. * Set up projects in Accubid, including drawings, systems, bid items, options and addenda. **Takeoff and pricing** * Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for power, lighting, branch circuits, feeders, gear, fire alarm, low\-voltage and site work, including counts of fixtures, receptacles and data devices. * Build complete estimates covering material, labor, equipment, subcontractors, rentals, overhead and profit. * Apply labor units and adjust for job conditions, schedule, crew mix, prevailing wage and project location. **Vendor and subcontractor coordination** * Send the correct specification sections, drawings and schedules to each vendor and subcontractor (for example, fixture and lighting control specs with lighting drawings and fixture schedules), followed by counts once available. * Confirm receipt of bid requests, request material pricing and follow up on quotes before bid day. * Compare and level quotes; confirm scope coverage and exclusions. **Job walks and proposals** * Attend pre\-bid meetings and job walks; review scope, take notes and photos where allowed, and identify risks, constructability issues and value\-engineering opportunities. * Prepare clear proposals with qualifications, clarifications, alternates and exclusions. * Coordinate with our mechanical division on combined electrical/mechanical bids. **Post\-award support and closeout** * Hand off awarded jobs to project managers with a complete estimate, scope summary and schedule of values. * Price change orders and support project managers with budgets, contracts, purchase orders and billings. * Create transmittals for specifications, drawings, submittals and O\&M manuals. * Scan red\-line (as\-built) drawings and transmit O\&M manuals, red lines and warranties to the general contractor. **Ongoing** * Track bid results and historical costs to sharpen future pricing. * Maintain relationships with general contractors, owners, engineers and vendors. * Follow company and customer safety policies and procedures. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Required** * 3\+ years of electrical estimating experience in the commercial and industrial electrical field, or 5\+ years of field experience as a journeyman or foreman with a strong interest in estimating. * Ability to read and interpret electrical, architectural, civil and structural drawings and specifications. * Working knowledge of the National Electrical Code (NEC) and electrical construction methods. * Efficient and detail\-oriented, with strong math and organization skills. * Strong communication, multitasking and prioritization skills; able to manage several bids against firm deadlines. * Valid driver's license. **Preferred** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, construction management or a related field. * Accubid experience. * New construction experience. * Ohio electrical contractor license or journeyman card; jobs.title: Mission Engineer II - Grand Rapids
jobs.description: #### **Join Axon and be a Force for Good.** At Axon, we're on a mission to Protect Life. We're explorers, pursuing society's most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast\-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. **Your Impact** --------------- This isn't a relationship management role. It's an ownership role. Sharp. Adaptable. Unstoppable. As a Mission Engineer II, you'll work directly alongside public safety agencies to turn real operational challenges into working technical solutions. You'll spend time with the people doing the work, understand how the agency operates, identify problems worth solving, and use Axon tools, AI, automation, data, and the broader Axon ecosystem to build against them. Building is the core of the role, but customer needs come first. Because you're embedded with the agency, you'll also become a go\-to technical resource who understands their Axon environment and helps them navigate critical needs when they arise. You may help quarterback an upcoming deployment, coordinate a complex technical issue, or connect the right Axon teams around an agency priority. You won't replace Support, Deployment, Product, or other teams. You'll bring technical continuity, help connect the dots, and use what you learn to identify the next opportunity to build something better. Mission Engineers don't measure success by activity. They measure it by what gets built, what gets used, and what changes because of it. **What You'll Do** ------------------ Location: On Site with travel Reports To: Manager or Senior Manager of Mission Engineering ### **Discover the Mission** * Embed with assigned agencies to understand their mission, people, workflows, systems, and priorities. * Develop broad knowledge of the Axon ecosystem and deeper expertise in the products deployed at your agency. * Work with frontline users, technical teams, and agency leadership to uncover operational friction. * Translate customer problems into clear technical requirements and measurable success criteria. * Identify opportunities for AI, automation, data, and Axon capabilities to improve how the agency operates. * Understand what the customer needs—not simply what they initially ask for. ### **Build With the Platform** * Build applications, dashboards, workflows, automations, and using Axon products and other approved Axon tools. * Apply foundational software engineering concepts including APIs, data structures, scripting, testing, debugging, and version control. * Use AI and AI\-assisted development tools responsibly within Axon's approved development and security environment. * Configure and extend capabilities across Axon's technology ecosystem. * Understand when you can solve the problem yourself and when deeper Product or Engineering partnership is required. * Build with Axon—not around it. ### **Transform Builds Into Outcomes** * Move solutions from discovery into real customer use. * Test and iterate alongside the people who will actually use what you build. * Drive adoption and measure results against agreed success criteria. * Continue improving solutions until they create sustained operational value. * Document successful solutions so they can be maintained, improved, and reused. ### **Be the Agency's Go\-To Technical Resource** * Maintain a consistent onsite presence and deep understanding of the agency's Axon environment. * Lean into critical customer needs when your technical context or involvement can materially improve the outcome. * Help quarterback technical alignment around important deployments without replacing the teams responsible for deployment execution. * Serve as a liaison when complex technical issues require coordination beyond standard Support. * Help customers navigate capabilities across products such as Records, Fusus, AI Era, and the broader Axon ecosystem. * Connect the right resources across Product, Engineering, Support, Deployment, Training, Mission Operations, Mission Success, and Sales. * Continuously ask: What are we learning, what could work better, and what could we build so this is easier next time? * Return to the highest\-value build opportunities once immediate customer needs are addressed. ### **Learn in the Field. If you're excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Important Notes** *The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. scripts for runtime reduction and reporting. * **Soft Skills:** Exceptional problem\-solving and communication abilities. **Compensation and Benefits** The annual base salary range for this position The engineer serves as a key technical authority for infrastructure modernization, incident escalation, system integrations, and cybersecurity efforts. **Work Environment \& Schedule*** Hybrid Location: Combination of remote work and scheduled on\-site support across regional facilities and offices. * Maintenance Windows: Participation in scheduled after\-hours maintenance, system upgrades, and critical incident response duties. * Compliance Culture: Strict adherence to corporate security baselines, audit controls, and federal regulatory compliance workflows.
