projects, and manage Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) host pools and session hosts. * Endpoint Compliance: Implement and maintain Microsoft Intune device management policies, compliance baselines, app deployments, and troubleshoot enrollment issues. **Network Infrastructure \& Security*** Wireless \& Switching: Administer enterprise wireless infrastructure utilizing Aruba technologies and manage the Aruba Central cloud management platform. * Firewall \& Perimeter Defense: Maintain Fortinet firewall infrastructure, security policies, IPSec VPN tunnels, and Azure networking integrations. * Project Delivery*** Server \& Directory Services: Support Windows Server environments, Active Directory optimization, GPO policies, asset inventory, and CMDB record accuracy. * Project Execution: Lead or assist with office buildouts, organizational acquisitions, tenant\-to\-tenant migrations, and vendor coordination. * Operational Support: Perform Tier 2/3 root\-cause analysis, provide scheduled jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy**,** creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. **The Role** ============ CCC Intelligent Solutions Inc. (CCC) is a leading cloud platform for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance economy, creating intelligent experiences for insurers, repairers, automakers, part suppliers, and more. At CCC, we’re making life just work by empowering more than 35,000 businesses with industry\-leading technology to get drivers back on the road and to health quickly and seamlessly. We’re pushing boundaries with innovative AI solutions that simplify and enhance the claims and repair journey. Through purposeful innovation and the strength of its connections, CCC technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. Learn more about CCC at www.cccis.com. The Role: You will build and ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows for our customers. These features automate the routine parts of a claim and guide customers on the rest, so they have to earn that trust with measured accuracy, not a convincing demo. Agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, and privacy and security are design baselines, not review gates. Agentic coding tools are how you move fast. What you add is what they are worst at: system design, security, and hard debugging. You own features end to end.**Key Responsibilities:** ========================= * Ship LLM\-powered features and agentic workflows in Python and TypeScript, from a problem scoped with product managers and data scientists through production traffic, and help set the metrics you will be measured against. * Write the evals, guardrails, and feedback loops that make your features trustworthy, and hold them to explicit token and latency budgets. * Use agentic coding tools every day, and own the review of what they produce: catch the correctness, security, and design problems in generated code before you open the pull request. * Maintain and extend the NLP pipelines that turn unstructured claim data into structured data customers can act on, blending semantic search, classical NLP, and LLMs. * Build and operate durable, event\-driven services in which agents run as steps inside deterministic workflows, with checkpointed model outputs so a retry does not re\-invoke a completed LLM step. * Trace every model call and agent step so a recommendation can be reconstructed and audited, with citations back to the source documents, and wire that tracing into your alerts. * Model and query claims data across relational, document, and graph stores. * Design privacy and security in from the start: tenant isolation, least\-privilege access for agents and their tools, and a clear rule for what data may reach a model provider. * Write a technical design document before any significant change, and use it to get feedback and buy\-in from the team before you build. * Take part in a shared on\-call rotation for the services you build. **Requirements:** ================= * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least one LLM\-powered feature you shipped and then operated in production. * Python and TypeScript: typed, tested, async code in both, and real depth in one. * Evals you have designed for LLM output, plus guardrails you have shipped. * A clear account of how you constrain an agentic coding tool's context and verify its output, from daily use of Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar on production work. * Pipelines that blend LLMs with semantic search and classical NLP: structured output, tool calling, embedding\-based retrieval, and a case where a classical technique beat an LLM. * Services built on message\- or event\-driven architectures, including long\-running workflows with retries, idempotent handlers, and event\-sourced state, plus an LLM or agent step you ran inside one. * Data modeling and development across relational, document, and graph databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Neo4j, including when each type fits and the partition\-key, consistency, and tenant\-isolation calls you made. * Backend services built and operated on Azure or AWS, and exposure to a durable workflow engine such as Temporal or the Durable Task Scheduler. * Technical design documents you have written to get feedback and buy\-in from a team before buildi  code review you can give as well as take. **Even Better if You Have:** * React and TypeScript experience, so you can deliver a full\-stack feature end to end. Chat, streaming, and citation\-heavy AI experiences especially. * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code such as Terraform or Bicep. * Experience with agent frameworks, LangGraph and the Microsoft Agent Framework among them, and with the ways agents reach their tools: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol, command\-line tools, and microservices. * Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Arize, or Braintrust, and with OpenTelemetry\-based tracing. * Experience designing A/B tests for AI features, or what\-if simulations that replay historical claims through a proposed change before it ships. * Exposure to the insurance, claims, or automotive repair domains. **What Success Looks Like:** * In your first six months you ship an LLM\-powered feature, its evals run in CI, and you can name the metric it moved. * When a model migration or prompt change causes a regression, the evals you wrote catch it before a customer does. * You take ownership from concept to production with light direction, asking the right questions early. * You care that things hold up: the services you build survive retries, partial failures, and model migrations without incidents a customer can see. * When something goes wrong in production, the trace tells you which step and which model call, and you can show an auditor the same thing. * Privacy and security reviews of your features find nothing that was not already designed in. * You enjoy the craft, and it shows: engineers pick up your patterns without being told to. * You enjoy the back\-and\-forth that gets a feature scoped, and you can argue a position without needing to win it. * You embrace our ambitious, collaborative, and empathetic values, and you like problems where the answer has to be measured rather than argued. **Interview Policy \& Privacy Notice:** ======================================= A video interview is required for this position. Video interviews are transcribed. Transcriptions are retained and may be reviewed by CCC and our recruiters. Candidates are not permitted to use generative AI or automated assistance during the interviews unless explicitly allowed by the interview team for a specific exercise. Our Job Applicant Privacy Notice is available HERE. **About CCC's Commitment to Employees:** ======================================== CCC Intelligent Solutions understands that our employees play an integral role in our vision to shape a world where life just works. Our team is defined by our values of Integrity, Customer\-Focus, Innovation, Inclusion \& Diversity, Tenacity, and Connection. Through diverse perspectives, purposeful innovation, and the strength of connections, our technologies empower the people and industry relied upon to keep lives moving forward when it matters most. At CCC, together everyone can thrive as we innovate and collaborate, creating employee experiences that just work. We are committed to providing opportunities for our people to make real\-life impacts, advance in their careers, and contribute to CCC’s success. CCC offers competitive compensation and benefits to support you and your families, including: * 401K Match * Paid time off * Annual Incentive Plan Performance Bonus * Comprehensive health insurance * Adoption Assistance * Tuition Reimbursement * Wellness Programs * Stock Purchase Plan options * Employee Resource Groups For more information about our benefits, please check out our careers site. Here, you belong. You are seen, valued, and respected. We celebrate you for who you are and all you bring. Every voice is heard and is important to our success. You can hear what employees have to say about our culture here If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, please contact (800\) 621\-8070\.

jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe is hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the Core Backend team in our Cloud Customer Experience (CCX) organization. Core Backend builds the shared services that every Crusoe Cloud product depends on: quota management, customer notifications, organization onboarding and KYC, and the API framework that sits in front of our backend services. Customers rely on these systems to sign up, get access to the capacity they are entitled to, and hear from us when something changes on their account. Product teams rely on them so they can launch on Crusoe Cloud without building their own quota, notification or onboarding systems. You will lead a team of backend engineers, partner with the team's product manager, and set technical direction for services that sit on the path of every customer request. This is a full\-time, hands\-on management role for someone who has led backend or platform teams, can go deep on distributed systems design, and can weigh requests from many internal teams against one roadmap. **What You'll Be Working On:** * Shared services for product teams: Own the services other Crusoe Cloud teams build on, including quota management, the notification service and the API framework, so a new product can launch without building its own versions of them. * Quota management: Run the system of record for what each organization and project can consume across GPU, compute, storage and networking, along with the request and approval workflows that change those limits. * Customer onboarding: Lead self\-serve onboarding, organization state management and automated KYC, and work with risk and security partners on fraud prevention for self\-serve customers. * Customer notifications: Own the service that sends email, in\-console, webhook and Slack notifications to Crusoe Cloud customers. * Reliability and operations: Set and meet SLOs for the team's services, run on\-call and incident reviews, and move long\-running operations onto durable workflows. * Technical direction: Guide architecture decisions with the team, including API standardization across services and breaking apart monolithic services, and make the tradeoffs between new features and platform work. * Cross\-functional partnership: Work with Product, Customer Success, Security and the other CCX teams (Billing, Identity and Access Management, Client Interfaces and Admin Tooling) to set one roadmap from many requests. * Team building: Hire, mentor and grow engineers, including filling open roles on the team. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * People leadership: 2\+ years managing software engineering teams, including hiring, performance management and career development for engineers at different levels. * Backend engineering: 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend services in Go or another compiled language (Rust, Java or C\+\+). databases such as PostgreSQL, and message queues such as Kafka, NATS or Pub/Sub. * Operations: Experience owning customer\-facing production systems, including SLOs, monitoring and alerting, on\-call and incident response. * Platform mindset: A track record of leading a team that serves other engineering teams, and of setting priorities when several teams need something at once. * Communication: Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs to engineers, product managers and non\-technical partners. * Education: Bachelor's degree minimum. **Bonus Points** * Quota and entitlement systems: Experience building quota, rate limiting or entitlement systems for a cloud provider or multi\-tenant platform. * Onboarding and risk: Experience with customer onboarding, KYC or fraud prevention systems. * Workflow engines: Experience with Temporal or similar workflow engines, or with state machines and reconciliation loops for long\-running operations. * API platforms: Experience building API gateways or API frameworks used by many engineering teams. * AI infrastructure: Familiarity with GPU cloud platforms or AI infrastructure. **Benefits:** * jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **POSITION SUMMARY** ==================== CVS Health is hiring a Senior Security Engineer \- Data Loss Prevention (DLP) to join the Data Security team within Enterprise Technology. This team is responsible for protecting sensitive customer, colleague, and business information across one of the nation's largest healthcare organizations, supporting critical data protection capabilities that enable secure business operations while safeguarding highly regulated information. As a Senior Security Engineer \- DLP, you will play a key role in advancing CVS Health's enterprise information protection strategy through the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of Data Loss Prevention controls across cloud and endpoint environments. This is a hands\-on engineering role that offers the opportunity to work with leading security technologies including Microsoft Purview, Exchange Online, Endpoint DLP, Zscaler, and Palo Alto while helping shape the future direction of the enterprise DLP program. You will collaborate closely with cybersecurity, infrastructure, privacy, compliance, and business teams to solve complex data protection challenges, improve detection accuracy, reduce operational risk, and strengthen security outcomes. The role provides exposure to large\-scale enterprise environments, modern cloud security architectures, automation initiatives, security analytics, and highly visible programs that protect sensitive healthcare and business data. The ideal candidate is a technically curious security professional who enjoys solving difficult information protection challenges, leveraging data and automation to improve security controls, and driving measurable improvements across a mature and evolving cybersecurity program. Success in this role requires strong technical expertise, analytical thinking, engineering discipline, and a passion for protecting critical information assets in a dynamic and highly regulated environment. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** ============================ * Design, implement, and maintain enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capabilities across Microsoft Purview, Exchange Online, and Endpoint DLP environments. * Develop, test, tune, and optimize DLP policies, classification rules, sensitivity labels, and detection logic, including Regex\-based controls, to improve control effectiveness and operational efficiency. * Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to implement technical controls and governance processes that support security, compliance, and regulatory requirements. * Develop operational dashboards, reporting, and analytics utilizing Power BI, Databricks, and related technologies to measure program effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization. * Support incident investigations, operational troubleshooting, automation efforts, and continuous improvement activities across Microsoft Purview, Zscaler, and Palo Alto DLP technologies. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** =========================== * 5\+ years of experience in Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data protection, cloud security, information security, or a related cybersecurity discipline. * Hands\-on expertise designing, implementing, and supporting Microsoft Purview DLP capabilities, including Exchange Online, Endpoint DLP, data classification, sensitivity labeling, and policy tuning. * Proficiency developing and optimizing DLP policies, sensitive information types, content inspection controls, and Regex\-based detection logic to improve coverage and reduce false positives. * Experience with enterprise security monitoring and analytics platforms, including Splunk, Chronicle, or comparable SIEM technologies, along with knowledge of networking, encryption, email security, and SSL/TLS. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure security capabilities and cloud security principles, with proficiency in Python and/or PowerShell scripting to automate operational and engineering processes. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ============================ * Microsoft SC\-400 (Information Protection Administrator) certification. * Industry certifications such as CISSP, Security\+, GIAC, CCSP, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications. * Experience supporting Zscaler, Palo Alto, or comparable secure access and network security platforms with integrated DLP capabilities. * Experience protecting PHI, PII, PCI, or other regulated data types within healthcare, pharmacy, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Familiarity with Microsoft Information Protection (MIP), Insider Risk Management, data governance, privacy regulations, and enterprise information protection programs. **EDUCATION** ============= Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or equivalent work experience (High School Diploma/GED plus 4 years of relevant experience). **BUSINESS OVERVIEW** ===================== Bring your heart to CVS Health. Every one of us at CVS Health shares a single, clear purpose: Bringing our heart to every moment of your health. This purpose guides our commitment to deliver enhanced human\-centric healthcare for a rapidly changing world. Anchored in our brand, with heart at its center, our purpose sends a personal message that how we deliver our services is just as important as what we deliver. Our Heart At Work Behaviors™ support this purpose. jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: The Role: Sr. AI Engineer\- Data Analytics \& Artificial Intelligence The Location: Los Angeles, Orange County, San Diego Make a Difference Where It Matters Most At CalPrivate Bank, we believe banking is personal. We have deep roots in the communities we serve, and our client relationships are built on genuine care, thoughtful problem\-solving, and unwavering integrity. Our solutions\-based service, paired with best\-in\-class talent, sets us apart in the market, but it’s trust that defines who we are. It's our gold standard, the currency we trade in, and the foundation of every decision we make. We’re looking for leaders who want more than a title. We’re looking for team players who want to make an impact. If you're driven to lead with purpose, ready to shape the future and have meaningful impact at a relationship\-centered bank, CalPrivate Bank may be the place for you. Your Opportunity: Sr. AI Engineer The Senior AI Engineer will play a key role in advancing CalPrivate Bank’s data analytics and artificial intelligence capabilities, helping translate data, emerging technologies, and business needs into practical solutions that improve how the Bank operates, serves clients, manages risk, and makes decisions. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role designed for an individual who can operate at the intersection of AI, data, technology, and the business. Working closely with the Bank’s data and technology leadership, this individual will help turn strategic objectives into executable solutions, building the infrastructure, models, tools, and processes necessary to responsibly expand the use of AI and advanced analytics across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with business judgment and a builder’s mindset. They should be equally comfortable developing solutions, evaluating new technologies, improving data architecture, and partnering with business leaders to understand where AI and analytics can create meaningful value. In a growing community bank environment, success will require someone who is resourceful, collaborative, comfortable working across functions, and able to move initiatives from concept through implementation. As CalPrivate Bank continues to grow and invest in its technology and data capabilities, the Senior AI Engineer will help create the foundation that allows the organization to use its information more intelligently and efficiently. This role will support the development of scalable AI and analytics capabilities while helping the broader team successfully execute against its strategic roadmap. The Senior AI Engineer will help identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve access to actionable information, enhance reporting and forecasting, and responsibly incorporate generative AI and machine learning into appropriate business workflows. Just as importantly, this individual will help establish the technical standards, controls, documentation, and governance necessary to ensure these capabilities are reliable, secure, explainable, and appropriate for a highly regulated banking environment. **What You’ll Do** **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI, generative AI, machine learning, data engineering, and advanced analytics solutions that address meaningful business needs across the Bank. * Partner with data and technology leadership to translate strategic AI and analytics objectives into technical requirements, development priorities, and executable solutions. * Build and enhance the Snowflake\-centered data pipelines, integrations, APIs, and architecture required to support analytics, AI applications, and data products. * Develop solutions utilizing large language models and generative AI, including Snowflake Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise search, intelligent document processing, workflow automation, and internal knowledge tools where appropriate. * Design flexible, modular AI architectures that support the evaluation, integration, and substitution of different AI models and providers where appropriate, minimizing unnecessary vendor dependencies while balancing performance, security, cost, and operational complexity. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and vendors and provide thoughtful recommendations based on business value, scalability, security, cost, and regulatory considerations. * Develop prototypes and proofs of concept and successfully transition viable solutions into stable, production\-ready applications, taking ownership through testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Partner with business teams to identify opportunities where AI, automation, or advanced analytics can improve efficiency, reduce manual work, enhance decision\-making, or improve the client and employee experience. * Support the continued development of the Bank’s enterprise data environment, including data quality, accessibility, lin ing to BSA and therefore has the obligation to report suspicious activity to the BSA Officer as appropriate. The employee is responsible for understanding and following the Bank’s BSA/AML policies including elevating suspicious activity to the BSA Officer. Additionally, the employee is required to understand and follow the Bank’s compliance program BSA/AML policies including elevating suspicious activity to the BSA Officer. Additionally, the employee is required to understand and follow the Bank’s compliance program. **Who You Are** ***Experience \& Expertise*** * Advanced experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, applied data science, or a closely related discipline. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience applying modern software and data engineering practices. * Demonstrated experience building and deploying production AI, generative AI, data, and analytics applications. * Hands\-on experience with generative AI technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architectures, AI agents or workflow orchestration, and model/API integration. * Strong hands\-on experience with Snowflake, including data engineering, data pipelines, security and access patterns, integrations, and building production workloads on the platform. Experience with Snowpark, Cortex AI, Cortex Search, Cortex Agents, external stages, streams/tasks, dynamic tables, or related Snowflake capabilities is highly desirable. * Hands\-on experience integrating data and AI solutions with Microsoft Azure, particularly Azure Functions and Azure Storage/Blob Storage. * Strong understanding of data architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, relational databases, data warehouses/lakehouses, and structured and unstructured data. * Experience with modern software engineering and DevOps practices, including Git/GitHub, branching and pull\-request workflows, automated testing, CI/CD, environment management, code review, and controlled production deployment. * Ability to assess business problems and determine when AI is, and when it is not, the appropriate solution. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills with the ability to operate independently while collaborating effectively across teams. * Experience working with sensitive or highly regulated data is strongly preferred; banking, financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry is highly desirable. ***Mindset \& Values*** * You lead with accountability, integrity, and consistency. * You thrive in a collaborative environment where transparency and follow\-through matter. * You model professionalism, calm under pressure, and a solutions\-oriented mindset. * You embrace data\-driven decision\-making while maintaining a client\-first perspective. * You embody CalPrivate’s culture, heart for client, excellence in service, and deep commitment to the Bank and its people. ***Physical Demands**** May require some travel in order to support team, department and initiatives. * Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time. * Ability to physically use a keyboard/mouse * Ability to walk to and from workstations * Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 10lbs and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus **Why CalPrivate Bank?** This isn’t just another bank job. At CalPrivate Bank, you will be part of something bigger. Our day\-to\-day operations and projects don’t just impact a balance sheet, they influence real people, real businesses, and the communities we proudly serve. We are guided by our commitment to relationships, solutions, and trust. And we’re building a team of people who reflect those values in everything they do. If you’re looking for a place where your work will matter, your ideas will be valued, and your growth will be supported, welcome to CalPrivate Bank! Ready to lead with purpose?

jobs.title: Research Scientist - College of Engineering - Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: Carnegie Mellon University is a private, global research university that stands among the world’s most renowned education institutions. With ground\-breaking brain science, path\-breaking performances, creative start\-ups, big data, big ambitions, hands\-on learning, and a whole lot of robots, CMU doesn’t imagine the future, we invent it. If you’re passionate about joining a community that challenges the curious to deliver work that matters, your journey starts here! Innovation. Interdisciplinary collaboration. Complex problem solving. In Carnegie Mellon University’s Department of Mechanical Engineering, faculty members, researchers, and students are revolutionizing focus areas in advanced manufacturing, bioengineering, computational engineering, energy and the environment, product design, and robotics. In addition, they are using their expertise in interdisciplinary research centers across the university. Carnegie Mellon University’s department of Mechanical Engineering is searching for a Research Scientist to join their team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in an interesting and challenging work environment. You will contribute to the department by leading the Safe AI Lab's research program on scenario generation, simulation, and digital twins for embodied AI. The role builds digital twins of industrial work cells and assembly processes, generates safety\-critical and long\-tail scenarios from incident data, standards, and procedural variation, and runs simulation\-based evaluation of robot policies in physics simulators (NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) to produce quantitative safety evidence and sim\-to\-real validation. The position proposes and leads independent research goals within the scope of the lab's projects, coordinates student team members, and publishes at leading venues. **Your core responsibilities will include:** * Build digital twins of industrial work cells and automated assembly processes from CAD, point clouds, and video, and maintain simulation\-ready asset and layout libraries with controlled variation. * Develop scenario generation pipelines that turn incident reports, safety standards, and recorded human motion into simulation scenarios, including procedural generation of long\-tail and safety\-critical cases. * Run simulation\-based evaluation of robot policies (classical, RL, and VLA/VLM controllers): define safety metrics (separation distance, contact speed and force, near\-misses), apply importance sampling to find rare failures, and validate sim\-to\-real transfer on lab robot platforms. * Propose and lead independent research goals within the scope of the lab's projects; coordinate and direct the work of student researchers; co\-write papers, documentation, and progress reports; present at national and international conferences. * Other duties as assigned. Flexibility, excellence, and passion are vital qualities within Carnegie Mellon University. Inclusion, collaboration and cultural sensitivity are valued competencies at CMU. Therefore, we are in search of a team member who is able to effectively interact with a varied population of internal and external partners at a high level of integrity. We are looking for someone who shares our values and who will support the mission of the university through their work. **Qualifications:** * Master’s degree preferred. * 5\-8 years of experience. * Experience with robot simulation (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or game engines), 3D scene and digital\-twin construction, machine learning systems, and research project leadership strongly preferred. A combination of education and relevant experience from which comparable knowledge is demonstrated may be considered. * **Requirements** : Successful background check. * **Joining the CMU team opens the door to an array of exceptional benefits.** **Benefits eligible** **employees enjoy a wide array of benefits including** **comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance** **as well as a generous** **retirement savings program** **with employer contributions. Unlock your potential with** **tuition benefits** **, take well\-deserved breaks with ample** **paid time off** **and observed** **holidays** **, and rest easy with life and accidental death and disability insurance.** **Additional perks include a free Pittsburgh Regional Transit bus pass, access to our** **Family Concierge Team** **to help navigate childcare needs,** **fitness center access** **,** **and much more!** **For a comprehensive overview of the benefits available, explore our** **Benefits page** **.** **At Carnegie Mellon, we value the whole package when extending offers of employment. Beyond credentials, we evaluate the role and responsibilities, your valuable work experience, and the knowledge gained through education and training. We appreciate your unique skills and the perspective you bring. Your journey with us is about more than just a job; it’s about finding the perfect fit for your professional growth and personal aspirations.** **Are you interested in an exciting opportunity with an exceptional organization?! Apply today!** **Location** Pittsburgh, PA **Job Function** Engineering, Research and Project Scientists **Position Type** Staff – Fixed Term (Fixed Term) **Full Time/Part time** Full time **Pay Basis** Salary

jobs.title: Applied Innovation Engineer
jobs.description: PURPOSE The Director of Applied Innovation leads the team that builds, deploys, and runs Central Valley Ag's custom business applications — products such as RouteForge and Gravis, the grower portal, and the applications that follow them. This is a working leadership role. The Director sets direction, develops the team, and also writes code, reviews it, and carries the hardest problems personally. The team is small on purpose and fast on purpose. It uses AI\-assisted development as a normal part of how work gets done, and it is measured on working software in the hands of CVA employees and growers — not on documents, roadmaps, or demonstrations. The Director is accountable for the availability of every application in the portfolio, for the experience of the people who use them, and for equipping CVA's support organization to carry routine support over time. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES * Lead, coach, and develop a team of two: an Applied Innovation Engineer and an Applied Innovation Analyst. Hire into the team as it grows. * Personally design, develop, and review application code. This position ships. * Own the application portfolio roadmap. Run intake with business leaders, set priorities against business value, and decide what the team will not build. * Establish and hold a delivery cadence that puts usable software in front of users in weeks rather than quarters, and report against it. * Own production availability for the portfolio: deployment, release management, monitoring, and incident response. * Establish and enforce engineering practice — version control, testing, code review, release and change management, and documentation. * Establish the team's AI\-assisted development practice: tooling, review standards, guardrails, and the appropriate handling of company and customer data. * Partner with Enterprise Architecture so that applications conform to CVA's architecture, integration, and data standards. * Partner with IT Infrastructure and IT Security on hosting, identity, access management, and secure development practice. * Equip CVA's support organization to support business applications: build the documentation, runbooks, training, and knowledge transfer that let tier 1 and tier 2 support be carried outside this team. Serve as the escalation point. * Hold the boundary with the data organization: Applied Innovation builds the operational applications that run the business, while tools and agents whose purpose is answering questions from CVA's data belong to the Director of Data \& AI Enablement. Partner with that team rather than duplicating it. * Manage vendor relationships, cloud spend, and licensing for the application portfolio. * Report delivery, risk, and portfolio health to the Chief Technology Officer and to business leadership. * Other duties as assigned. SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES **Directly supervises two positions:** Applied Innovation Engineer and Applied Innovation Analyst. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with Central Valley Ag policies and applicable laws, including interviewing and hiring, planning and assigning work, coaching and performance management, and addressing employee concerns. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY All work product created in the course of employment with Central Valley Ag Cooperative — including software, source code, applications, integrations, data models, reports, documentation, designs, processes, analyses, inventions, and any other developments, whether created during or outside normal working hours and whether or not created using CVA equipment — is the sole and exclusive property of Central Valley Ag Cooperative. Employment in this position is contingent upon agreement to CVA's confidentiality, intellectual property, and non\-disclosure terms. QUALIFICATIONS To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE * Seven or more years building and supporting business software, including substantial time in a hands\-on engineering role. * Demonstrated leadership of a team, a product, or a significant delivery effort. Formal management experience is not required where the leadership track record is clear. REQUIRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE * Hands\-on proficiency with a modern application stack — for example TypeScript/JavaScript with React or Next.js, C\#, or Python — and with relational databases and SQL. * Cloud application delivery: deployment, application hosting, identity and authentication, secrets management, monitoring, and cost control (AWS and/or Microsoft Azure). * System and data integration: APIs, file interfaces, and integration with ERP or third\-party platforms. * Judgment on scope. Able to decide what not to build and to ship a narrow first version that earns the next one. * Strong written and verbal communication with non\-technical stakeholders. Able to run an intake conversation with a business leader and leave it with a decision. * Demonstrated ownership of production systems, including release management and incident response. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE * Bachelor's degree in a technology\-related field such as computer science, computer information systems, or management information systems. * Working fluency with AI\-assisted development — coding agents and assistants, prompt\-driven development, and reviewing AI\-generated code to the same standard as hand\-written code. This is how the team works. Strong engineers without this experience who are eager to adopt it will be considered. * Experience in agriculture, commodities, logistics, or a cooperative. * Experience establishing or turning around a small delivery team. PHYSICAL DEMANDS The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to: * Sit and stand for extended periods of time. * Use hands and fingers with dexterity to operate a computer keyboard and mouse. * Occasionally lift and transport computer equipment and peripherals. * Be available for occasional after\-hours work in support of deployments and production issues. * This position may be based at any Central Valley Ag location or worked remotely. Periodic travel to CVA locations is expected for user engagement, onboarding, and team meetings. Central Valley Ag Central Valley Ag is a farmer\-owned cooperative headquartered in York, Neb. CVA has locations in Iowa, Kansas, and Nebraska. CVA is an innovative leader providing products and services in grain, agronomy, feed, and energy. You can find more information about Central Valley Ag by visiting www.cvacoop.com. EOE race/color/sex/sexual orientation/gender identity/disability/veteran **Stay in touch with us on:** LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and Pinterest **Updated:** September 2026

Able to reproduce a problem, find the cause, and fix it rather than work around it. * Clear written and verbal communication with non\-technical users. **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in a technology\-related field such as computer science, computer information systems, or management information systems. * Working fluency with AI\-assisted development — coding agents and assistants, and the judgment to review what they produce. **This is how the team works.** Strong engineers without this experience who are eager to adopt it will be considered. * Experience integrating with an ERP or other system of record. * Mobile or field\-facing application experience. * Experience in agriculture, commodities, logistics, or a cooperative. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. (including .NET and Windows\-hosted workloads) into containerized, stateless, twelve\-factor services that run cleanly on managed platforms, with preview environments, environment\-based configuration, and automated deploys on every merge. * Contribute directly to the codebase by building features, APIs, internal tools, and shared libraries alongside software engineering, participating in code reviews, and raising the bar on testing, code quality, and maintainability. * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines that enable fast, safe, and frequent deployments, including automated testing, preview deployments, progressive rollouts, and reliable rollback, and migrate legacy Azure DevOps pipelines to modern Git\-based workflows such as GitHub Actions. * Develop and maintain monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting systems that provide clear visibility into system health and reduce alert noise. * Participate in and help lead the on\-call rotation; respond to and resolve production incidents, coordinate communication during outages, and drive timely recovery. * Lead blameless post\-incident reviews, identify root causes, and track corrective actions through to completion. * Identify and eliminate operational toil by writing automation, services, and self\-service tooling in languages such as Python, Go, C\#, or TypeScript, treating internal tools as real software with tests, versioning, and documentation. * Conduct capacity planning and performance testing to prepare for growth and high\-traffic events such as major product releases and promotional sales. * Partner with engineering teams on system design, code, and architecture reviews to build reliability, scalability, and observability into new services from the start, and to guide decisions on database, caching, and hosting strategy during platform migrations. * Maintain and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans for critical systems and data. * utilization, comparing legacy Azure spend against Vercel, Render, and similar platforms, and recommending optimizations that balance performance, developer velocity,  als and proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, C\#, or TypeScript/Node.js, with experience writing, testing, reviewing, and shipping production application code, in addition to scripting in Bash. * Experience migrating or modernizing legacy applications and infrastructure, such as moving workloads from Azure or on\-premises environments to managed platforms like Vercel or Render, including data migration, DNS and CDN cutover, and minimizing downtime. * Solid working knowledge of Linux and/or Windows server administration, networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, load balancing, CDNs), and web application architecture. * Experience operating and tuning relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL) in production environments. * Hands\-on experience with observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, or the ELK stack. * Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, distributed systems under pressure and communicate clearly during incidents. * Strong understanding of security best practices for cloud infrastructure and production systems. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document systems clearly and collaborate across teams. * Ownership mindset, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement. **Education \& Experience*** 5\+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, infrastructure engineering, or a related software engineering role. and leading incident response. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Relevant cloud certifications (e.g., jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: About Circular Solutions Circular Solutions, established in 2018, is an established company that has successfully launched its own software platform and is transforming how businesses manage recycling, supply chain data, and regulatory compliance. Our platform, Circular OS, helps organizations verify recycling activity, track materials throughout the supply chain, and navigate emerging Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) regulations. While we have the experience and foundation of an established business, we operate with the speed, flexibility, and small\-team mentality of a startup. Decisions happen quickly, and product priorities evolve as we respond to customer needs and changing regulations. We value execution over bureaucracy and believe great engineers can accomplish extraordinary things with the right tools and autonomy. Website: www.circularsolutions.eco The Opportunity We are looking for a highly motivated, adaptable Lead Full Stack Software Engineer to take ownership of the continued development of Circular OS. **Our priority is speed to market without sacrificing the reliability of the platform.** We need someone who thrives in a fast\-moving environment, embraces new technologies, and can turn concepts into functional software quickly. You will work directly with leadership to translate business needs, product concepts, and prototypes into production\-ready solutions. This is not a role where you will spend months developing a single feature. We are looking for someone who can think independently, solve problems creatively, and continuously deliver meaningful improvements. As the company grows, you will also help shape our engineering practices and future development team. What You'll DoProduct Development \& Execution · Own the development, maintenance, and deployment of Circular OS across the full technology stack. · Rapidly translate product concepts, workflows, and prototypes into functional, production\-ready features. · Prioritize speed to market, delivering incremental improvements rather than waiting for perfect solutions. · Independently identify technical challenges, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical solutions. · Build compelling, functional product demonstrations to support sales and customer engagement. AI \& Emerging Technologies · Leverage AI development tools daily to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and deployment. · Continuously evaluate emerging technologies that can improve development speed and platform capabilities. · Build AI\-powered features, including document extraction, intelligent assistants, automated workflows, and data reconciliation. · Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development and operational processes. Platform Ownership \& Scalability · Manage frontend, backend, database architecture, integrations, and deployment. · Develop scalable systems capable of handling complex regulatory requirements and large datasets. · Maintain strong standards for security, platform reliability, and data integrity. · Support security and compliance initiatives, including ISO 27001\. · Maintain practical documentation that allows future engineers to contribute efficiently. Collaboration \& Adaptability · Work directly with leadership and nontechnical stakeholders to understand evolving business priorities. · Adapt quickly as customer requirements, regulations, and business opportunities change. · Communicate progress, challenges, and tradeoffs clearly. · Take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks. What We're Looking ForTechnical Experience · Strong experience with TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js in production web applications. · Strong backend development skills and experience with PostgreSQL. · Experience working with PostgreSQL, SQL migrations, and modern database tooling; experience with serverless Postgres and modern TypeScript ORMs strongly preferred. · Hands\-on experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, or similar platforms. · Experience designing and implementing automated document extraction and processing systems, including OCR, AI\-powered data extraction, document classification, and structured data validation. · Experience building software that processes, reconciles, and analyzes data from multiple sources. · Experience integrating LLM APIs, automations, and third\-party services. · Ability to independently manage the development lifecycle from initial concept through production deployment. Our Current Technology Stack Circular OS is an existing, production software platform. You should be comfortable working within an established codebase, understanding its architecture, and shipping improvements without unnecessary rewrites. Experience with our core stack is especially valuable. Familiarity with every supporting tool is not required, and we will walk you through the full setup once you join. · **Core:** TypeScript, Next.js, React, and Node.js. · **Data:** PostgreS  · **Ownership:** You take responsibility for the entire product experience, not just the code you write. · **Pragmatism:** You understand the difference between what needs to be perfect and what needs to be delivered. · **Communication:** You can explain complex technical concepts in simple terms and collaborate effectively with business teams. · **Initiative:** You proactively identify opportunities to improve the product without waiting for detailed instructions. **We care more about your ability to execute than the number of programming languages on your resume.** Nice to Have · Experience building supply chain management, logistics, recycling, or enterprise data management software. · Experience developing platforms that track materials, transactions, or assets across multiple organizations. · Familiarity with regulatory compliance, financial technology, or audit\-grade data systems. · Experience building automated data reconciliation, document verification, and reporting workflows. · Experience working at an early\-stage startup or as a founding engineer. · Experience with payments and billing integrations such as Stripe. · Familiarity with ISO 27001 or SOC 2 security frameworks. · Interest in sustainability, recycling, or environmental technology. Why Join Circular Solutions? · **Meaningful Ownership:** Take a leading role in building and shaping a growing technology platform. · **High Impact:** Your work will directly influence our product roadmap, customer experience, and business growth. · **Direct Access to Leadership:** Work closely with decision\-makers without layers of management. · **Modern Development Environment:** Use AI and emerging technologies to maximize development efficiency. · **Flexibility:** Fully remote work environment with collaboration during US Eastern business hours. · **Growth Opportunity:** Play an important role in shaping the future engineering team. · **Competitive Compensation:** Competitive salary with potential for additional long\-term incentives. How to Apply **We want to see what you've built, not just read about your experience.** Along with your resume, please submit examples of previous work or relevant projects you have personally developed and delivered. Examples may include: · Links to live applications, software platforms, or products you have built. · GitHub repositories, technical portfolios, or product demonstrations. · Projects involving AI, automated document extraction, data processing, or workflow automation. · Supply chain, logistics, compliance, or enterprise software projects. · Examples of products or features you have taken from initial concept through production. For each relevant project, please briefly describe: · **Your Role:** What did you personally design, develop, and deliver? · **Technology:** What tools, frameworks, and AI technologies did you use? · **Timeline:** How long did it take to go from concept to a working product? We understand that some projects may be confidential. Public demonstrations, screenshots, walkthrough videos, or descriptions of your contributions are welcome. Our Hiring Process · **Introductory Conversation:** Discuss your experience, development approach, and interest in the opportunity. · **Product Walkthrough:** Show us something you personally built and shipped, including your development process and timeline. · **Leadership Conversation:** Meet with our leadership team to discuss working style, expectations, and long\-term opportunities. What Matters Most We are not looking for someone who simply writes great code. We are looking for someone who can build great products, move quickly, adapt to change, and take genuine ownership of results. If you thrive in an environment where your work goes from concept to production quickly and your contributions have an immediate impact, we would love to hear from you. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Flextime * Work from home Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **About Our Job** ================= With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver. **What We Offer** ----------------- The City and County of Denver offers competitive pay commensurate with education and experience. New hires are typically brought into the organization between $157,385\.00 \- $208,000\.00\. We also offer generous benefits for full\-time employees which include but are not limited to: * A guaranteed life\-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service * 457B Retirement Plan * 140 hours of PTO earned within first year \+ 12 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday, 1 Wellness Day and 1 volunteer day per year * Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date **Location \& Schedule** ------------------------ The City and County of Denver supports a hybrid workplace model. Employees work where needed, at a job site several days a week and off\-site in the field, as needed. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their remote days. In this position you can expect to work on site at least 3 days per week at the **Denver Wastewater Building** (2000 W. 3rd Ave., Denver, CO 80223\). **Who We Are \& What You’ll Do** -------------------------------- The Department of Transportation and Infrastructure (DOTI), through its employees, enhances the quality of life in Denver by efficiently delivering effective, high quality, safe and equitable public infrastructure, and services. For more information, please visit the DOTI website. DOTI’s Commitment to Equity: * DOTI is committed to providing attention and resources to the areas, assets and people of the city with the greatest need. Through equitable contracting, equitable investments, and equitable workforce development. * DOTI’s culture revolves around four key principles: (1\) Invest in Our People, (2\) Operate with Discipline, (3\) Use Data to Drive Decisions, and (4\) Deliver Results. DOTI is seeking an experienced and collaborative leader to serve as the Director of Wastewater Policy. This position will provide strategic direction and leadership for the Policy Division within Denver's Wastewater Enterprise Fund and will be responsible for establishing and coordinating enterprise\-wide policy, planning, asset management, financial programming, regulatory alignment, stakeholder engagement, and long\-range investment strategies. The Policy Division provides overall wastewater program direction and operates at a functional and authoritative level similar to the Wastewater Implementation and Wastewater Operations divisions. The Director will lead a team of approximately 20 employees, including managers, supervisors, professional staff, and consultants, and will provide leadership for Asset Management, One Water, Water Quality, MS4, and Master Planning. The Director will work closely with the Wastewater Enterprise Executive, City Engineer, Core Infrastructure leadership, Wastewater Operations and Implementation Directors, senior DOTI leadership, Department of Finance, regulatory agencies, elected officials, and other internal and external partners and stakeholders to establish a coordinated, sustainable, and forward\-looking approach to management of Denver's wastewater enterprise fund and associated infrastructure. Specifically, as the Engineer Director of Wastewater Policy**,** you will: **Strategic Leadership \& Policy** * Establishes and advances a long\-term vision and multi\-year strategy for the Wastewater Enterprise Fund and associated Policy Division, aligning people, resources, programs, and investments with Wastewater Enterprise, DOTI, and citywide priorities. * Develops and directs implementation of goals, objectives, policies, procedures, work standards, and annual and multi\-year work plans. * Provides overall policy direction and strategic coordination across the Wastewater Enterprise in collaboration with Operations and Implementation leadership. * Advises senior leadership on complex wastewater infrastructure, organizational, financial, regulatory, and policy matters. * Resolves complex and sensitive issues by bringing together technical, financial, regulatory, operational, and stakeholder perspectives. **Asset Management \& Long\-Range Planning** * Provides strategic leadership for the Wastewater Enterprise's asset management program covering wastewater assets including storm drainage, sanitary sewer, waterways, lift stations, buildings, property, bridges, green and related infrastructure. * Establishes asset\-management policies, strategies, and investment frameworks that support long\-term reliability, resiliency, regulatory compliance, and financial sustainability. * Leads long\- ironments. * Strong political and relational acumen with the ability to communicate complex technical and policy matters effectively with elected officials, executive leadership, regulatory agencies, community stakeholders, and technical professionals. * Demonstrated ability to lead managers, supervisors, and multidisciplinary professional teams while establishing accountability and developing organizational talent. * Ability to resolve complex and sensitive issues involving competing technical, operational, financial, regulatory, and stakeholder considerations. * Demonstrated commitment to using data, performance measures, risk analysis, and best practices to inform decision\-making and continuously improve programs and services. **Required Minimum Qualifications** ----------------------------------- * Education requirement: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Architecture. * Experience Requirement: Five (5\) years of experience at the type and level of functional or operational management, which must have included management of licensed engineer or architect supervisors. * Education/Experience Equivalency: No substitution of experience for education is permitted. Additional appropriate education may be substituted for experience requirements. * License/Certifications: Requires a valid Driver's License at the time of application. Requires registration as a Professional Engineer (PE) by the Colorado State Board of Registration for Professional Engineers at the time of application. Or requires registration as an Architect by the Colorado State Board of Registration at the time of application. Registration in another state will be accepted in lieu of this requirement, provided that the applicant has Colorado registration at completion of probation. Licenses and certifications must be kept current as a condition of employment. **To be considered for this position, you must include the following on your job application (upload the attachment(s) to the Resume/CV section on the My Experience tab):** * Resume * Cover letter with details about your public municipal leadership skills experience with Wastewater Policy, and your interest in the role. **Application Deadline** ------------------------ This position is expected to stay open until November 15, 2026\. Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM. **About Everything Else** ========================= **Job Profile** CE2783 Engineer\-Architect Director To view the full job profile including position specifications, physical demands, and probationary period, click here. **Position Type** Unlimited**Position Salary Range** $157,385\.00 \- $267,554\.00**Target Pay** $157,385\.00 \- $208,000\.00/year, based on experience and education**Agency** Dept of Transportation \& Infrastructure**Redeployment during Citywide Emergencies** City and County of Denver employees may be re\-deployed to work in other capacities in their own agencies or in other city agencies to support core functions of the city during a citywide emergency declared by the Mayor. *The City and County of Denver provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, age, or any other status protected under federal, state, and/or local law.* *It is your right to access oral or written language assistance, sign language interpretation, real\-time captioning via CART, or disability\-related accommodations. To request any of these services at no cost to you, please contact* *Jobs@Denvergov.org* *with three business days’ notice.* ***Applicants for employment with the City and County of Denver must have valid work authorization that does not require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the U.S.*** For information about right to work, click here for English or here for Spanish.

Spring 2026 college graduates who will earn a Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Mechanical Engineering or a related field are highly encouraged to apply for this job opportunity. **WHO WE ARE \& WHAT WE DO** The City of Santa Maria is a full\-service city with a Council/Manager form of government with over 700 employees and serves approximately 110,000 residents. The City is located on California’s central coast and covers over 23 square miles, which balances urban and agricultural lands. The Utilities Department is responsible for providing water, wastewater treatment, sewer collection, refuse collection, and disposal services to Santa Maria. The Mission Statement of the Utilities Department is to provide efficient utility services through the use of progressive innovation, excellent customer service, and the wise use of public resources for the long\-term benefit of the community. **SUMMARY** Under the general direction of the assigned supervisor, this position assists in the planning, coordination, analysis, and implementation of various engineering activities. This classification is currently in multiple divisions and departments across the City and may be flexibly staffed at the discretion of the Department Director. Supervision is not normally a responsibility of this classification but may act as lead worker for temporarily assigned employees or special projects. The Engineer I/II position is an Individual Contributor role that provides design and engineering services to ensure City\-owned infrastructure, assets, and facilities are constructed and modified in a functional and safe condition. Their role enables City of Santa Maria residents to enjoy a healthy, safe and pleasant environment in which to live, work and play. **THIS POSITION** The Engineer I/II will support water, wastewater, and capital projects. The successful applicant will work closely with operating managers and engineers to prepare solutions for pressing problems in the water and wastewater industries. The position is expected to have a thorough understanding of pipeline hydraulics, open channel flow, pipeline design, potable water systems, and wastewater treatment plant. This position will have meaningful career growth capability as well as mentorship opportunities from principal engineers and water resource managers serving in the public sector. **IDEAL CANDIDATE STATEMENT** The ideal candidate for Engineer I/II is a motivated individual with a passion for engineering who can support vital water resources projects. This person will play an integral part in developing engineering solutions for water, wastewater, and stormwater systems, and collaborating with various outside agencies to ensure successful project outcomes. Individuals with a degree in civil or mechanical engineering, or those currently in the final stage of their academic journey, are highly encouraged to apply. **IMPORTANT** A valid Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) Certificate issued by the State Board of Registration Civil, Geologist, and Professional Engineers is the minimum qualification for this recruitment. This position: * Performs sub\-professional civil engineering field and office work, including utilizing computer\-aided drafting software to prepare and produce engineering drawings and other computer input. * Participates in the development and administration of the division or section budget. * Consults with and aids other governmental agencies in engineering matters. * Receives citizen complaints and takes appropriate action. * Represents the division or department at conferences and meetings with other departments, agencies and organizations. * Develops written reports, correspondence, change orders, technical memos, applications, permits, and other written information. * Scope of assigned area will depend on departmental structure and is at the discretion of the Director. * Upholds the values of the organization and has strong customer service orientation. knowledge, skills and motivation to improve the quality of their lives and well\-being. The City's Wellness Program includes ergonomic evaluations, flu shots, and Wellness Workshops during lunch and after work. Access to the Paul Nelson Aquatics Center for employee and immediate family members. Access to the Weight room at the Abel Maldonado Community Youth Center for employee and immediate family members. Access to employee discounts and special offers on travel, entertainment, shopping, dining and services. **Mentorship Program** This professional development program of mentoring and job shadowing provides mentees with an opportunity to be mentored by experienced staff with the objective of developing specific skills and knowledge that will enhance the participants' leadership skills and promote professional growth. **Succession Planning** The academies are offered to all employees including those that are not yet in a supervisory role, but are interested in becoming leaders within the organization as well as our executive management team who have an interest in honing their skills and helping to prepare our future leaders. In addition to multiple leadership academies, the City offers quarterly Speaker Series, a corporate Toastmasters club available for City employees, site tours of various departments, and more. **Deferred Compensation** Employees may participate in the City's 457 Deferred Compensation Plan sponsored by either Empower or CalPERS Supplemental Income. The plan enables employees to save salary and earn interest on a tax\-deferred basis. A City match is available based upon representation. The City also provides an IRS approved 401(a) plan sponsored by Empower for managers represented by Non\-Represented Full\-Time Management \& Confidential (NMAC). **Post Employment Health Plan (PEHP)** Based upon your bargaining unit the City may participate in a PEHP plan that will provide reimbursement for out\-of\-pocket cost of qualified medical expenses such as prescription drugs, doctor co\-pays, eyeglasses and cover the reimbursement of medical insurance premiums upon separation or retirement. **Holidays** The City offers seven (7\) paid holidays per year. In addition, based upon your bargaining unit a bank of floating holiday hours is available to be used at the employee's discretion. **Vacation** The City initially offers two weeks of paid vacation per calendar year for all full time employees.
