jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, CBCI
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, CBCI **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Hybrid \- Denver, CO (3 days on\-site per week) **About CloudBees** CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. **About the Role** CloudBees CI helps enterprises build and deliver software with confidence. Built on Jenkins, with a core written in Java and deployments running on Kubernetes, it brings together the challenges of distributed systems, an extensible plugin ecosystem, and the reliability customers expect from critical delivery infrastructure. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction for the CloudBees CI product area and turn that direction into working software. You will lead architecture and execution across teams while staying close to the code: solving the hardest engineering problems, improving an established codebase, and helping other engineers do their best work. You bring deep expertise in Java, Kubernetes, and distributed systems, together with a product mindset. You understand that an architectural decision is only valuable if it improves the customer's experience. You know when to simplify, when to invest in a deeper change, and how to move an established product forward without compromising the workflows customers depend on. Requirements: **What You'll Do** **Shape the technical direction:** * Build a deep understanding of the existing CloudBees CI architecture, Jenkins internals, and customer workloads. Use that evidence to identify the changes that will make the greatest difference. * Define the technical roadmap with engineering and product partners, connecting architectural investments to customer needs and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Lead the design of resilient distributed systems running on Kubernetes. Make tradeoffs around scale, failure handling, compatibility, and operational complexity explicit, and document the reasoning behind key decisions. **Stay hands\-on with the hardest engineering work:** * Write production\-quality Java and own critical refactors, performance improvements, and stability fixes. Lead difficult changes from design through testing, release, and follow\-up. * Diagnose complex JVM and distributed\-system problems, including memory leaks, thread contention, classloading issues, and failures that emerge across components. * Evolve plugin\-based architectures and service boundaries while protecting compatibility and upgrade behavior. Simplify where possible and introduce new abstractions only when they solve a clear problem. **Bring the team with you:** * Earn the trust of an established engineering team. Listen first, explain your reasoning, and build alignment through technical judgment and working code. * Drive initiatives across teams by breaking ambiguous problems into achievable milestones, coordinating dependencies, anticipating risks, and unblocking delivery. * Lead rigorous design and code reviews. Mentor Staff and other senior engineers, share knowledge, and establish engineering standards that teams can apply consistently. **Make quality and customer outcomes the default:** * Strengthen secure coding, automated unit and integration testing, and release practices. Ensure changes are tested against realistic workflows, failure modes, and upgrade scenarios. * Use profiling, metrics, logs, and incident evidence to find root causes and validate improvements. Turn recurring problems into durable fixes and better engineering practices. * Partner with support, product, and engineering colleagues to resolve complex customer issues. Improve the feedback loop from code to customer, removing delivery bottlenecks while maintaining confidence in each release. **What You'll Bring** * 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership at Staff or Principal scope and a track record of delive trong point of view and update it when the data says otherwise. You argue for the best answer regardless of who's in the room, and once a decision is made, you commit to it fully. * **Hard Work** — You own the end result, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same. * **Ship Excellence** — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from. * **Direct Feedback** — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you. **What You'll Get** * The opportunity to shape the technical direction of CloudBees CI, with hands\-on ownership of consequential engineering work. * A global, collaborative team that takes its craft seriously, shares knowledge, and invests in each other's growth. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Pay Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 annually In accordance with applicable law, this represents a reasonable estimated compensation range for this role. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and may be more or less than the amount shown above. Outside of base compensation, CloudBees also offers stock options and variable bonuses. **What CloudBees Offers** * **Time that's actually yours.** Our BEE\-Flexible PTO policy folds vacation, sick time, and personal days into one unlimited plan. Plus paid U.S. holidays and 2 dedicated Bee\-Giving Days to volunteer for a cause you care about. * **Health coverage from day one.** You're eligible on your start date, not 90 days in. Choose from medical, dental and vision options designed to support your healthcare needs. Choose an HDHP plan and we will contribute to your HSA on top of your own pre\-tax contributions. * **Real money toward your future.** Invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) company match, offering both pre\-tax and Roth options to help you reach your financial goals. * **Protection we pay for entirely.** We fully fund your Life and AD\&D, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability protection. Plus our Employee Assistance Program is fully covered too. * **Support for your headspace \- literally.** All Bees have access to a company\-sponsored Headspace account. Plus, a dedicated Care Concierge service in the U.S. so you never have to decode a benefits question alone. * **A home office that works.** A stipend every month toward your work\-from\-home setup in addition to the opportunity to work (hybrid for Denver, CO employees) in an office with your peers. * **Upside when we win.** Base salary is the floor. Our bonus plan rewards for the goals you deliver and the growth we drive together. * **People who sweat the craft.** A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth. * **A global, collaborative team** that lives by our values: Customer Obsessed, High Agency, Truth Seeking, Hard Work, Ship Excellence, Direct Feedback. **EEO Statement** CloudBees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business need, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this position. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Software Forward Deployed Engineer - Cincinnati
jobs.description: ### **About CoLab** At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life\-changing products to market years sooner. We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster. Proudly based in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018\. Since then we've raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi\-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250\+. ### **About the Role** We're hiring a Software Forward Deployed Engineer to embed within our strategic customers and deliver on high\-impact, technically complex customer projects. You'll own delivery of key customer initiatives, working closely with our customer success, product, design and engineering teams, as well as leadership team stakeholders to remove blockers and deliver results. Unlike a traditional software development role, FDEs must manage significant ambiguity, external team dynamics, and timeline pressure. If you like working directly with customers and shipping code to solve real, complex user problems with a high level agency and autonomy, then you will thrive in this role. ### ### **What You'll Do** * Own delivery of strategic customer projects, from technical discovery through to production deployment and success measures * Build and deploy complex system integrations, backend services, and data pipelines * Interface with enterprise systems, including data lakes, identity management and access controls solutions, and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions * Stand up CoLab integrations and organize incoming data to enable use in features like AutoReview and Operator * Collaborate directly with customers to understand needs, propose solutions, and guide adoption * Develop targeted solutions that meet the specific Customer's requirements whilst ensuring solutions are designed and developed with our broader customer base in mind. * Bring your extensive knowledge of our Customer's requirements back to the development team for learning. ### **Our Ideal Candidate** * You're based in Cincinnati and are comfortable working on site with our customers * You've delivered complex technical solutions for projects where requirements were not clearly defined * You write clean, production\-grade code in a variety of languages and consider yourself language agnostic * You're comfortable working in unfamiliar environments \- both technically and organizationally * You've worked with enterprise systems (e.g., data lakes, IdP, PLM, ERP, etc) * You can break down ambiguity, sequence work, and adjust scope without losing momentum * You're confident leading deeply technical conversations with customer engineering or IT teams * You care about delivering outcomes, not just writing code * You have a "go figure it out" mindset and can roll with the punches when things shift ### **Bonus Experience** * Prior work embedding within customer environments as part of enterprise SaaS deployments * Experience building or integrating AI\-powered features * Familiarity with manufacturing or engineering data, processes, or systems * Experience with API\-first products or developer platforms ### **Extra Details** * This is a full\-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes, base salary and stock options * Includes extended health benefits, unlimited vacation, and 401k matching * This is and on site role based in Cincinnati, Ohio. ### **Equity Note** Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification \- your potential is what matters most to us.

jobs.title: AI Security Engineer (PhD)
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Flexible Contract (Remote) **Job Summary:** We are hiring PhD\-level AI Security Engineers for a contract project that tests whether frontier AI models can handle real security work. You will create hard tasks from your field that a leading AI model cannot solve, then review where and why it fails. **What you will do** * Create command line tasks based on real security problems. Examples: * Find and patch a vulnerability in a real codebase, such as memory corruption, an injection flaw, or an authentication bypass. * Analyze a suspicious binary and report what it does, how it persists, and how to detect it. * Audit a cryptographic implementation and fix misuse of keys, nonces or randomness. * Investigate logs or a packet capture to reconstruct an intrusion and identify the root cause. * Harden a misconfigured service, container or CI pipeline. * Find and fix a weakness in an ML system, such as a poisoned dataset, an unsafe model loading path, or a prompt injection hole in an agent. * Build each task’s environment, including the code, data and dependencies, and write a reference solution. * Write automated tests that check whether a solution is correct, with consistent results on every run. * Run your task against a leading AI model, review its attempt, and adjust the task until the model fails because the problem is truly hard, not because the instructions are unclear. **Who we are looking for** * A PhD in computer science, security, machine learning, engineering or another STEM field. PhD candidates and students are welcome to apply. * Hands\-on experience in security, such as vulnerability research, reverse engineering, applied cryptography, malware analysis, secure systems or AI/ML security. Ten or more years of experience is ideal. * At least one publication, academic or professional (for example a paper, CVE write\-up, conference talk or technical advisory). * Comfort with Python, the Linux command line, Docker and Git. * Familiarity with tools such as Ghidra, gdb, Wireshark or similar analysis tooling is a plus. * Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow is a plus. * Experience with experimental design, benchmarking or testing AI systems is a plus. * Peer review experience, or experience building technical tests, CTFs or assessments, is an advantage. * Able to work independently in a remote setting and explain technical findings clearly. **Why Cobalt AI** * **Advance frontier AI where it counts.** Apply your expertise to the data frontier labs cannot get any other way, where your reasoning directly shapes how the next generation of models solves technical problems. * **Grow professionally.** Expand your influence through evaluation projects, advisory roles and research collaborations, while deepening your understanding of how frontier models are trained and assessed. * **Work with a top\-tier network.** Collaborate with researchers and engineers from leading institutions and labs on high\-impact, flexible work. * **Set your own schedule.** Flexible 10 to 40 hour weeks that fit around your current role and your life. * **Competitive pay.** Paid per accepted task, with higher rates for consistently strong work. Education: * Doctorate (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Cloud Application Developer
jobs.description: **About the role** We are seeking an experienced **Cloud Application Developer** to support the modernization of enterprise applications and the migration of Microsoft Power Platform solutions to Azure cloud\-native applications. In this hands\-on role, you will assess existing Power Apps and Power Platform applications, define future\-state architecture and migration approaches, and design and develop scalable cloud\-native applications using Microsoft Azure, React, .NET, REST APIs, microservices, Azure Cosmos DB, and Azure SQL. You will work closely with application, infrastructure, security, and architecture teams to drive application modernization, technical design, development, migration, deployment, and production readiness. **In this role, you will** Assess existing Power Apps and Power Platform applications, documenting architecture, application components, integrations, dependencies, data flows, security, and deployment approaches, and define future\-state migration strategies for Azure cloud\-native solutions. jobs.description: SUMMARY The Power Platform and AI Specialist scopes, designs, delivers, and supports Power Platform and AI solutions for managed services and project\-based client work. WHAT ARE THE QUALIFICATIONS I NEED TO HAVE? * 3 to 5\+ years of experience delivering Power Platform, business intelligence, or Microsoft 365 solutions in a consulting, managed services, or client\-facing role. * Strong hands\-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI, including Power Query, DAX, and data modeling. * Working knowledge of Copilot, AI use cases, and intelligent automation, including readiness, adoption, and governance considerations. * Experience gathering requirements, scoping work, and preparing estimates for client\-facing or internal projects. * Ability to explain technical concepts in plain language to business users and client stakeholders. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple client requests at the same time. WHY SHOULD YOU WORK HERE? * Be part of a growing, technology\-driven organization where people and service excellence are at the core of what we do. * Opportunity to make a direct impact on the employee experience, from first impression through onboarding and beyond. * Collaborative and supportive team environment that values accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. * Exposure to a fast\-paced, client\-focused business that encourages learning, adaptability, and professional growth. * Ability to contribute to meaningful HR projects and help shape scalable processes as the organization continues to grow.

jobs.title: Critical Operations Engineer II (Day) (VA1)
jobs.description: **Description** **About CoreSite:** CoreSite is a leading colocation data center company providing the space, power, cooling and connectivity that businesses rely on to operate and grow. Our data centers bring dozens of organizations together under one roof, supporting the technology and services that keep our world connected. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, bringing the expertise, ideas and commitment that power our business and help our customers succeed. With a culture built on collaboration, ownership, and operational excellence, CoreSite is a place to make an impact. **Critical Operations Engineer II:** As a member of the Data Center Operations team, the Critical Operations Engineer II (COE II) is responsible for operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting critical data center electrical, mechanical, cooling, and fire/life safety systems to ensure the highest levels of reliability and uptime. The COE II applies advanced knowledge of critical facility systems, including understanding system interdependencies and the operational impact that changes to one system may have on others. COE II supports customer infrastructure projects and collaborates with technicians, vendors, and customers to drive operational excellence, resolve issues efficiently, and continuously improve processes and performance. In addition, the COE II provides technical guidance, mentorship, and on\-the\-job training to team members while promoting adherence to established operational procedures, safety standards, and best practices. The position also performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned. * We are currently hiring for the Day Shift (6:00am \- 2:00pm) Tues \- Sat **What You'll Do:** **Critical Facilities Operations:** * Operate, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot mission\-critical electrical, mechanical, and life safety systems to ensure uptime and reliability. * Perform facility inspections, respond to abnormal conditions, and document findings. * Track, trend, and analyze system performance; utilize CMMS to manage work orders and maintenance. **Electrical Systems:** * Support electrical distribution from utility and generator switchgear through UPS and customer load. * Maintain and coordinate work on generators, switchgear, UPS, STS, ATS, PDUs, transformers, and power circuits. jobs.title: Senior Engineer - ML Operations
jobs.description: **Bring more to life.** At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Our 60,000\+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology. Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference? At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we’re committed to hiring and developing from within. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Senior MLOps Engineer is responsible for owning significant parts of the machine learning and agentic AI lifecycle that powers Danaher’s next generation of AI\-driven products and automations. You will take models and AI agents from experimentation to reliable, scalable production. In this high\-impact role, you will design and operate the pipelines, serving infrastructure, orchestration, and observability that let data scientists, engineers, and business teams build and run ML models and agentic workflows with speed, reproducibility, and rigor. You will partner with teams across Danaher’s operating companies to turn promising AI prototypes into governed, production\-grade agentic automations that run efficiently at scale on shared compute. This position reports to the Senior Director, Data and AI Platform and is part of the Chief Information Officer (CIO) Office located in Washington, DC and will be fully remote. **In this role, you will have the opportunity to:** * Own the end\-to\-end ML and LLM lifecycle and deployment: experiment tracking, model and prompt registries, versioning, lineage, and reproducibility (e.g., MLflow, Weights \& Biases); design and operate model serving for batch and low\-latency online inference, including LLM inference, with autoscaling, GPU efficiency, and performance optimization (batching, quantization, caching). * Partner with engineering and business teams to productionize agentic workflows and automations: turn agent prototypes into scalable, repeatable, reliable services using orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, Airflow, Prefect, etc) with containerized, sandboxed execution, secure tool and data integrations (e.g., MCP), and support for many concurrent users and workflows without contention. * Implement CI/CD, evaluation, and observability for ML and agents: automate the path from code to validated production through testing, offline and online evaluations, guardrails, and safe deployment patterns (blue/green, canary); monitor model and agent quality, drift, latency, token usage, and cost; implement tracing, automated alerting, and feedback loops using observability tools (e.g., OpenTelemetry). * Drive compute and cost efficiency for AI workloads: GPU and accelerated\-compute scheduling, quota and utilization management, LLM provider/gateway routing and rate limits, and driver/CUDA image hygiene, partnering with the platform team to maximize value from contended, high\-demand resources. * Build self\-service ML and agent tooling and provide technical leadership: develop golden paths and reusable templates that let teams build, evaluate, deploy, and monitor models and agents without deep infrastructure expertise, treating AI enablement as a product; set MLOps and LLMOps standards and best practices while staying hands\-on with architecture and delivery. The essential requirements of the job include: * Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years of software, ML, or infrastructure engineering experience, including hands\-on MLOps/LLMOps and a track record of taking ML models or AI agents into production at scale. * Strong experience with ML and LLM lifecycle tooling: experiment tracking, evaluation, observability/monitoring, model registry, versioning, lineage, and reproducibility (e.g., MLflow, Weights \& Biases, Langfuse). * Strong experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), including scaling GPU and inference workloads, and with a major cloud platform (Azure preferred) and its AI services (e.g., Azure ML, Azure AI Foundry), using IaC and CI/CD for ML. * Proficiency in Python (and familiarity with Bash) for automation, tooling, and pipeline development. **Travel, Motor Vehicle Record \& Physical/Environment Requirements:** * Ability to travel – up to 10% **It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:** * Building and operating agentic systems in production, including multi\-agent orchestration, tool calling, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and agent security practices such as sandboxing, permission setting, and prompt\-injection defenses. * Operating ML or AI systems in a regulated environment (GxP, SOX, or HIPAA), including model traceability, audit evidence, and AI governance controls. * High\-performance LLM serving and AI gateway platforms (e.g., vLLM, TGI, Triton, LiteLLM) or serverless GPU compute platforms. Danaher offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info. At Danaher, we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Danaher can provide. The annual salary range for this role is $180K\-$220K. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future. This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay. jobs.title: Partnerships Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **About Dust** ============== **Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.** With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%\+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. **We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.** We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026\. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50\. **The Role** ============ We're looking for a Partnerships Solutions Engineer to help build the technical foundation of Dust's partner ecosystem in the US. You'll work closely with our Partnerships, Sales Engineering, Product, and partner teams to turn relationships into repeatable solutions and customer outcomes. You'll help partners develop AI offerings on Dust, establish the frameworks to deliver them successfully, and build the technical capabilities to bring those solutions to market. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of AI, technical implementation, and go\-to\-market strategy. **What You'll Do** ================== **Build partner offerings** * Collaborate with consulting and technology partners to develop packaged AI solutions and service offerings built on Dust. * Translate partner expertise and customer workflows into reusable agent templates, demos, and solution blueprints. * Help identify compelling use cases that partners can take to market and replicate across customers. **Develop repeatable delivery frameworks** * Create practical implementation playbooks covering discovery, solution design, deployment, and customer onboarding. * Build reusable technical assets and reference architectures that help partners deliver Dust\-powered solutions more efficiently. * Work with partner delivery teams to establish the skills and processes needed to implement solutions independently. **Enable partners technically** * Lead technical workshops, solution design sessions, demos, and proofs of concept with strategic partners and customers. * Help partners understand Dust's capabilities, integrations, APIs, and MCP ecosystem. * Equip partners with the knowledge and materials to confidently position, demonstrate, and deliver Dust. **Drive cross\-functional execution** * Partner with Sales Engineering, Product, and Engineering to address technical blockers and improve partner solutions. * Bring feedback from partner implementations into product and integration priorities. * Work with Partnerships to support joint opportunities and identify where repeatable solutions can drive pipeline and adoption. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * Experience in Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, Forward Deployed Engineering, or a similar customer\-facing technical role. * Hands\-on experience building AI applications, agents, automations, or enterprise software integrations. * Strong understanding of MCPs, APIs, technical architecture, and connecting business systems and workflows. * Ability to translate customer problems into practical technical solutions and repeatable implementation approaches. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical teams, consultants, and business stakeholders. * A builder mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, able to prioritize, and motivated to create repeatable processes from scratch. **Nice to have** * Experience working with consulting partners, systems integrators, or technology alliances. * Familiarity with MCP, LLMs, and modern AI tooling. * Experience developing partner solutions, implementation playbooks, or packaged consulting offerings. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Partners can confidently demonstrate and implement Dust\-powered solutions. * Partners have repeatable offerings and delivery frameworks they can use across multiple customers. * Successful implementations translate into reusable assets, faster delivery, and less reliance on Dust's internal teams. * Partner\-led opportunities and deployments increase as the ecosystem matures. **Location** ============ We're prioritizing building our team with an in\-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office\-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. **Why Dust** ============ The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. *Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.* **Learn how we think and work.** * Our product constitution, *a story about our mission* * Your Next Co\-Worker Isn’t Human, **Stanislas Polu**, VivaTech 2026\. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. * Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, **Gabriel Hubert**, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026\. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Compensation Range: $240K \- $300K

jobs.title: Research Engineer – Robotics & Embodied AI
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers, including Andrew Dai, who was previously a leader on Gemini. Our team currently consists of 20 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised $55M in seed funding from Striker Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and NVIDIA. We are tackling some of the hardest problems in artificial intelligence, and we are growing fast. **About the Role** ------------------ As a foundation model company, Elorian aims to empower robotics developers through advanced visual reasoning, spatial understanding, and high\-quality robotics data solutions. We are looking for researchers and engineers with a background in robotics who want to apply their domain expertise to foundation\-scale AI. Instead of focusing solely on isolated robot hardware or narrow policies, you will collaborate closely with our core foundation model research team to infuse physical\-world priors into our models, address real\-world robotics challenges, and develop foundational capabilities that generalize across a broad spectrum of robotics applications. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Develop Visual \& Spatial Intelligence for Robotics:** Advance and evaluate visual reasoning, 3D spatial understanding, and physical affordance capabilities directly within our multimodal foundation models to support downstream robotic perception and control. * **Architect Robotics Data Pipelines:** Design scalable data pipelines—including data collection, teleoperation and trajectory annotation, automated quality assessment, and evaluation frameworks for multi\-modal robotic data. * **Explore Foundation\-Driven Embodied Reasoning:** Investigate and implement novel approaches to robotic task planning, hierarchical reasoning, and decision\-making powered by multimodal foundation models and Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) architectures. * **Bridge Foundation Models \& Robotics Applications:** Collaborate closely with core foundation model researchers and robotics partners to identify real\-world bottlenecks, evaluate model capabilities, and build impactful foundational AI solutions for the robotics ecosystem. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * Strong background in robotics (research or engineering), with first\-hand experience in robotic perception, planning, control, or robot learning. * Genuine excitement to transition robotics domain knowledge into large\-scale deep learning, multimodal architectures, and foundation model research. * Solid experience with machine learning and hands\-on familiarity with modern LLMs, multimodal foundation models (VLMs), or transformer architectures. * Strong research and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate open\-ended, complex technical challenges. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with robotics simulation environments (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) for large\-scale data generation, policy evaluation, or model pre\-training. * Experience with robotics datasets, trajectory annotation, task decomposition, and benchmark evaluation for physical systems. * Experience applying, fine\-tuning, or developing LLMs, VLMs, or Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models for robotics problems. * Background working with real\-world robotic systems (manipulation, navigation, or autonomous agents) and understanding the practical limits of deploying policies to physical hardware. * Deep expertise in robotic planning, 3D spatial reasoning, affordance modeling, or embodied intelligence.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Applications
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ We are a well\-funded, early\-stage AI research and product lab focused on building the next generation of frontier multimodal AI models. Founded by former DeepMind researchers—including Andrew Dai, previously an engineering leader on Gemini—our mission is to push the frontier of visual and multimodal intelligence. Our first model, Glimpse, launched publicly in October 2026\. Our team currently consists of 25 world\-class scientists and engineers. We raised a $55M seed round led by Altimeter Capital, Menlo Ventures, Striker VC, and NVIDIA. We are tackling foundational problems in artificial intelligence and translating cutting\-edge multimodal research into scalable, real\-world systems. **About The Role** ------------------ As a **Software Engineer – Applications**, you will build the engineering bridge between our core multimodal research and real\-world production deployments. This is an engineering\-first, high\-impact role where you will design and implement reference architectures, production\-grade integration frameworks, developer SDKs, evaluation harnesses, and bespoke end\-to\-end applications powered by Glimpse. You will sit at the intersection of product engineering, model evaluation, and customer architecture. Working directly with founders, early enterprise partners, and our internal research team, you will turn complex multimodal requirements into robust, high\-performance systems and feed real\-world constraints directly into our model roadmaps. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * **Architect \& Build Production Integrations:** Design, build, and deploy low\-latency, scalable application architectures integrating Glimpse into complex enterprise data pipelines and high\-throughput workflows. * **Develop Reference Systems \& Tooling:** Create open\-source reference implementations, production\-ready demo applications, developer tooling, and SDK components that establish the standard for building on Glimpse. * **Build Evaluation \& Benchmarking Infrastructure:** Design and implement rigorous evaluation pipelines and benchmarking harnesses to systematically test Glimpse against other frontier multimodal models on diverse, real\-world visual datasets. * **Debug Across the Stack:** Systematically isolate and resolve bottlenecks across application pipelines, data ingestion layers, model inference APIs, and prompt/orchestration logic. * **Partner Technically with Early Adopters:** Serve as the core technical architect for engineering teams at design\-partner companies, guiding technical discovery, proof\-of\-concept development, and deployment to production. * **Influence Model \& Platform Roadmaps:** Translate real\-world application failure modes, edge cases, and performance requirements into prioritized specifications for our core research and model infrastructure teams. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * **Strong Core Engineering:** 5\+ years of experience building and shipping high\-performance, production software in Python (and ideally TypeScript or Go/Rust). You write clean, maintainable code and can speak deeply to your architectural decisions. * **Hands\-on LLM/Multimodal Application Engineering:** Experience building complex systems beyond basic API calls—such as agentic workflows, structured tool\-use frameworks, model evaluation pipelines, or orchestration layers for vision\-language models. * **Model Understanding \& Evaluation:** Hands\-on experience evaluating, fine\-tuning, or benchmarking ML models. You can systematically differentiate between model failure modes, pipeline errors, and data\-quality issues. * **Full\-Lifecycle Ownership:** A builder mindset with a bias for shipping quickly. Experience as a founding engineer, startup core contributor, or forward\-deployed engineer is highly valued. * **Systems \& Data Architecture:** Familiarity with modern cloud architecture, API design, vector/multimodal indexing, streaming protocols, and handling high\-volume image/video data pipelines under tight latency and cost constraints. * **Clear Technical Communication:** Ability to communicate complex architectural tradeoffs clearly to both internal research teams and external engineering leaders. **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Prior experience at a foundation model provider, AI developer platform, or ML infrastructure company. * Direct experience building multimodal applications in vision\-heavy verticals (e.g., robotics, industrial automation, manufacturing, geospatial, medical imaging, or media production). * Experience developing public developer APIs, open\-source AI tooling, or developer ecosystems. **Logistics** ------------- * **Location:** On\-site in Palo Alto, CA * **Employment Type:** Full\-time * **Compensation**: $250,000 – $400,000 \+ significant equity \+ comprehensive health insurance and perks

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organisation services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in\-vitro diagnostic products. In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. In 2021, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6\.72 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years. **Job Description** We are seeking a highly motivated AI/ML Engineer to support the development of Generative AI\-based digital tools and platforms in a pharmaceutical R\&D environment. The successful candidate will join the Automation and Robotics team, focusing on designing, prototyping, and implementing AI\-driven solutions for pharmaceutical applications. This role provides hands\-on experience with machine learning (ML), large language models (LLMs), automation, and data engineering, contributing to next\-generation digital tools that accelerate innovation in the pharmaceutical industry. **Responsibilities** * Develop and maintain knowledge graphs and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems for scientific data. * Design, prototype, and deploy AI\-driven solutions for chemical process optimization. * Implement AI/ML models for predictive analytics and decision support in chemical synthesis. * Build robotic control systems to orchestrate workflows using modular lab equipment. * Create new applications leveraging the Jupyter framework for web\-based tools. * Integrate and visualize experimental data within applications where applicable. * Develop and maintain Python\-based pipelines for data acquisition and workflow automation. * Collaborate with scientific stakeholders to refine requirements and iterate on prototypes. * Work with APIs, databases, and internal data pipelines for seamless integration. * Document code and workflows in compliance with internal best practices and quality standards. **Qualifications** * Education: BS with 5\+ years of experience OR MS in Computer Science or related field (or expected graduation before start date). * Proficiency in Python, Jupyter Notebook, Dataiku DSS, and REST APIs. * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG). * Familiarity with RDKit for cheminformatics applications is preferred. **Additional Information** * Position is **Monday\-Friday, 8\-5\.** Overtime as needed. **On\-site role based in Groton, CT** * May be requested to work on weekends, overtime, and holidays based on business needs * Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Groton, CTare encouraged to apply. * Excellent full\-time benefits, including comprehensive medical coverage, dental, and vision options * Life and disability insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid vacation and holidays * **\#LI\-EB1** * Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship **Eurofins USA PSS Insourcing Solutions is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.**

jobs.title: Exhibit Engineer/Senior Exhibit Engineer (Part-Time)
jobs.description: * We are hiring for either an Exhibit Engineer or Senior Exhibit Engineer depending on experience. Text in *italics* is specific to the Senior Exhibit Engineer position. **SUMMARY** Exhibit Engineers are the primary staff responsible for exhibit design and production. Although exhibit designs will come from many sources and fabrication may be accomplished in coordination with other staff or entities, exhibit engineers ensure the functionality, reliability, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness of each exhibit. Exhibit engineering at the Exploratorium emphasizes the design and building of interactive exhibits with complex mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems within design, budget, and schedule to fulfill the needs of the project. Exhibit engineers are also expected to be knowledgeable of current technologies and professional standards and to have an active role in the maintenance and improvement of existing exhibits, design practices, and documentation standards. *The Senior Exhibit Engineer position differs from the Exhibit Engineer position in its emphasis on self\- direction and independent design and production of high\-quality exhibits.* **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** * **Execution**: + Consistently deliver high\-quality exhibit engineering across a number of projects under the direction of project leadership. + Create exhibit designs that fit into budget and schedule, meeting regular milestones. + Produce complete sets of design documentation including: part and assembly drawings, bills of materials, electronics and wiring schematics, maintenance manual pages and assembly instructions. + Provide support to Production Management and project teams as needed in regards to purchasing efforts, including occasional management of subcontractor and vendor relationships. + Design and fabricate basic tooling/fixtures for manufacturing. + Participate in off\-site installations, maintenance trips, and de\-installations. + *Consistently deliver high\-quality exhibit engineering across a number of projects with minimum supervision.* + *Facilitate technical aspects of off\-site installations, maintenance trips, and de\-installations.* + *Provide support as needed to Project Management with regards to off\-site logistics and client relations.* * **Solutions/Idea Generation**: Regularly implement a wide variety of practical and innovative engineering strategies. Work to find creative ways to bring new and appropriate technologies into our current system. * **Facilities Work/Institutional Support**: + Contribute to general museum operations, including shop and/or lab maintenance, exhibit maintenance, material ordering and stocking, and equipment upkeep. + Share design and engineering techniques with other Exploratorium staff. + Provide technical advice to help production staff order and build exhibits; promote quality, efficiency, and decreasing costs. + Maintain current library of exhibit designs by managing design revisions, photographing design details, and organizing design information. + Collaborate with design, engineering, and production staff, to find efficient ways to create exhibits. + *Teach design and engineering techniques to other Exploratorium staff.* * ***Flexibility:*** *Adapt to project constraints with proactive solutions. Work comfortably and productively on a range of projects from rough, in\-house prototypes to highly\-finished, turn\-key client projects.* * ***Judgment:*** *Make timely exhibit engineering decisions. Show strong creative discernment and good discipline around choice of forms, materials, and processes.* * Other duties as assigned **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * BA/BS degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, preferably in engineering or design. * Basic shop knowledge: wood, metal, and plastic fabrication; prototyping and fabrication of exhibits using appropriate production methods; follow safety standards. * Basic experience with Autodesk Inventor essential plus working knowledge of AutoCAD, Wiki\-based platforms, MS Word \& Excel. * *Minimum five years’ prior exhibit engineering experience.* * *Two years’ Exploratorium experience preferred.* * *Advanced shop knowledge: wood, metal, and plastic fabrication; prototyping and fabrication of exhibits using appropriate production methods; uphold safety standards.* * *Advanced experience with Autodesk Inventor essential, plus working knowledge of AutoCAD, wiki\- based platforms, MS Word \& Excel.* * *Demonstrated ability to work on multiple projects and problems simultaneously with minimal supervision.* * *Talent for collaboration and effective teamwork, and demonstrated ability to work with people at all levels of an organization.* * Ability to effectively communicate ideas and concepts through hand sketching, basic drawing skills preferred. * Comfortable taking direction and mentoring from senior shop staff, senior engineers, and project leadership. * Ability to adhere to budgets and timelines for individual exhibits and projects, and to proactively communicate expected variances. * Sense of value and efficiency as expressed in effectiveness of solutions, use of materials, and personal time management. * Interest in science and teaching a plus. * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds short distances. Able to move from place to place; bend, stretch, grasp, reach, kneel and twist. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENT** *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* * This position is based in San Francisco, California with staff expected to work onsite a certain number of days per week based on department requirements * Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds short distances. Able to move from place to place; bend, stretch, grasp, reach, kneel and twist. **APPLICATION DEADLINE** This position is open until filled **HOW TO APPLY** This is a **regular, part\-time (30 hours per week), non\-exempt, union position** that includes benefits. The starting range for this role is $42\.65 to $45\.15 *(Senior role $47\.74 to $50\.53\)*. This range represents steps 1\-3 on a 6 step union pay scale. Please, no phone calls in regards to this job. **Please include a cover letter with your application. Applications submitted without a cover letter will not be considered for review.** To apply, please visit the Exploratorium job page. The Exploratorium is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and values diversity, inclusion and respect. We welcome and strongly encourage applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential! **The Opportunity** The myFICO Scores B2C Software Engineering team is hiring an Applied AI engineer to own the quality, safety, and performance of our AI\-powered consumer features. As myFICO expands its AI\-powered product features, this role combines Python and Java backend engineering with hands\-on LLM experience to own how our assistants are prompted, evaluated, guarded, and improved. You will treat AI quality as something we measure and build the tooling our analysts and QA engineers rely on. **What You’ll Contribute** * Own the system prompts, tool descriptions, and evaluation prompts behind Personalized Credit Insights and the AI chat assistant, improving them using production evidence. * Build and grow the evaluation framework: turn production failures into test cases, run regression suites before every prompt or model change, and report results the business can trust. * Measure and improve LLM\-based evaluator reliability by comparing against human\-labeled data and tracking precision, recall, and agreement over time. * Design, tune, and monitor guardrails, including input and output classifiers, PII redaction, prompt\-injection defenses, and financial\-advice compliance rules defined with Legal and Compliance. * Lead model upgrades by re\-running evaluations, comparing quality, cost, and latency, and shipping safely through A/B tests. * Reduce cost and latency with prompt caching, model routing, and context management. * Build tools for Conversation Analysts and QA engineers, such as transcript viewers, labeling workflows, and dashboards. * Partner with Analytics, Legal, and Compliance on fairness and bias evaluation of AI outputs. * Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, with the judgment to review and refine their output. **What We’re Seeking** * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with demonstrated professional software engineering experience, strong Python, and the ability to read and contribute to Java (Spring Boot) microservices. * Proven experience building and operating LLM\-powered applications in production, including prompt design, tool calling, structured outputs, and streaming. * Demonstrated experience building evaluations for LLM systems: test sets, regression suites, and LLM\-as\-judge approaches, including measuring evaluator quality against human labels. * Working knowledge of Amazon Bedrock or a comparable managed LLM platform, and AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and DynamoDB. * Proficient SQL and comfort analyzing production data in a data warehouse such as Amazon Redshift. * Production ownership, including code review, CI/CD, release management, and on\-call support, within Agile/Scrum teams. * Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain evaluation results and tradeoffs to product, legal, and executive stakeholders. * Experience with guardrail tooling, LLM security testing, RAG and retrieval evaluation, fairness and bias evaluation, model migrations, observability tools such as Datadog, BI tools such as Tableau, or regulated domains (FCRA, ECOA, UDAAP, CFPB guidance) is a plus. **Our Offer to You** * An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others. * The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences. * Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so. * An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie. * The targeted base pay range for this role is: $105,000 to $165,000 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience. **Why Make a Move to FICO?** At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks! jobs.title: Backend Engineer, IoT Architecture & Migration
jobs.description: **About Fellow** ---------------- We believe that the act of making should be meaningful and fulfilling, done with intention and precision. Fellow makes beautifully functional tools for any kitchen, designed in San Francisco and used around the world. When the simple motions of life become small moments of joy, that's Everyday Magic. We are seeking a **Backend Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services for our IoT platform. ***This role is based in our San Francisco, CA office and requires regular in\-office presence in accordance with company policy.*** **Who You Are** --------------- Fellow is seeking a **Backend Engineer** to design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable backend services for our IoT platform. A successful candidate will possess excellent backend engineering fundamentals paired with hands\-on experience simplifying and unifying a connected\-device backend architecture. From real\-time connectivity through staged migration. This is a rare opportunity to help redefine the backend architecture for physical products used in kitchens around the world. You will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing our backend systems and IoT infrastructure, and will serve as the connective tissue between our hardware devices, mobile application, and cloud backend. You bring strong technical judgment, a high engineering bar, and the operational instincts to ship reliable systems. We are looking for someone who can drive technical decisions independently while remaining agile and pragmatic, collaborating closely with teams across Shenzhen and the United States. This is a hands\-on technical role. You'll set the architectural direction for our simplified, unified backend platform, and you'll also roll up your sleeves to build, pilot, and migrate it yourself. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Architecture Simplification:** Design and implement a simpler, unified backend architecture for Fellow’s connected products, with reusable service boundaries and common patterns across devices. * **New\-Product Pilot:** Establish a new connected product as the production pilot for the desirable architecture, validate it, and turn successful patterns into the foundation for existing and future devices. * **Real\-Time Connectivity:** Build reliable, low\-latency, bidirectional communication between devices, mobile applications, and backend services using WebSocket, queues, or other appropriate protocols. * **IoT Platform Scope:** Use AWS IoT Core primarily for staged OTA delivery. * **Data and ML Enablement:** Build backend data collection and orchestration pipelines that support product analytics, continuous improvement, and future ML development. * **Visibility and Diagnostics:** Improve operational visibility and control through structured logging, metrics, tracing, KPIs, alerting, and auditable device and service diagnostics. * **Concurrency and State:** Design state\-management and concurrency controls that prevent or contain race conditions across devices, clients, and cloud services. * **Staged Migration:** Plan and execute staged migrations for existing products; avoid direct cutovers that would cause service disruption. * **Reliability and Cost:** Improve database and service reliability, infrastructure automation, disaster recovery, deployment safety, and cloud cost efficiency. * **Collaboration:** Work closely with firmware, mobile, product, QA, manufacturing, and backend teams across Shenzhen and the United States. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of backend engineering experience using TypeScript/Node.js and Python, with strong experience in NestJS, Express, or comparable frameworks. * Experience designing and operating connected\-device or IoT backend systems in production. * Strong experience with real\-time and event\-driven communication, including WebSockets, REST, queues, and state synchronization. * Hands\-on AWS experience with services such as ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, S3, RDS/PostgreSQL, and AWS IoT Core. * Strong PostgreSQL and data\-system skills, including schema design, query performance, indexing, capacity planning, backup, restore, and lifecycle management. * Experience with observability, incident response, structured logging, metrics, tracing, service KPIs, and debugging distributed systems. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, automated quality gates, staged rollout, rollback, and production change control. * Strong understanding of cloud and IoT security, including IAM/RBAC, PKI/TLS, secrets, device identity, and certificate lifecycle. * Ability to collaborate effectively with US team. **Preferred Skills**: * Experience establishing a new product as the pilot for a reusable multi\-device platform architecture. * Experience with factory provisioning, certificate injection, device identity, manufacturing validation, or supplier\-facing engineering workflows. * Experience building telemetry, data collection, orchestration, or feature pipelines that support ML development and continuous product improvement. * Familiarity with on\-device software, embedded systems, firmware workflows, hardware debugging, or device log collection. * Experience operating global or China\-region cloud infrastructure and supporting services across geographic boundaries. * Experience with cloud\-cost optimization, FinOps, service consolidation, and reducing operational complexity. * Experience with secure remote diagnostics, controlled support tooling, and customer\- or factory\-facing operational dashboards. * Experience designing safe staged migrations from complex or legacy architectures without interrupting existing services. **Why You’ll Love This Role** ----------------------------- * A creative, fast\-moving environment where ideas turn into action. * Competitive compensation including employee equity plan * Generous paid time off plan * 401k with company contribution after 6 months of employment * Medical/dental/vision insurance * Better Yourself Wellness credit \& Better Your Community donation matching * Monthly Fitness Stipend * Summer Fridays * Paid Parental Leave * Generous discount on Fellow products * Best coffee anywhere The salary range for this position is **$200,000 \- $230,000 plus bonus \& equity**. We intentionally publish salary ranges to promote transparency and set clear expectations. Final compensation is determined based on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills, expertise, scope of previous work, demonstrated impact, and internal equity. As a result, not every candidate will be hired at the top of the range. *Our highest goal at Fellow is creating a safe, inclusive, and rewarding environment where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and thrive. We are committed to building diverse teams and strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, people of color, LGBTQIA\+ individuals, people with disabilities, members of ethnic minorities, foreign\-born residents, and veterans to apply.* *Fellow is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $230K

jobs.title: IT Security Engineer
jobs.description: At First Fidelity Bank, people matter, including our customers, our communities, and especially our employees. We are looking for talented, service\-minded individuals who want to grow their careers in a supportive, relationship\-focused environment. Our team members are essential to our success, and we invest in them through training, development, and opportunities to advance. One of our core values is providing a caring place to work where people enjoy coming to work, build lasting relationships, and feel proud of the difference they make every day. ***This is not a remote position. It is on\-site in Oklahoma City.*** SUMMARY Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the IT Security Engineer supports the Bank with the development, implementation, and maintenance of a strategic and comprehensive enterprise\-wide Information Security/Cybersecurity Program designed to ensure proper protection of the Bank’s data, systems, information assets, intellectual property, and the Bank’s reputation. **PRIMARY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES** *Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.* * Under the guidance and direction of the Chief Technology Officer, oversees the management and operations of information security and cybersecurity tools, documentation, standards, and processes to ensure an operating environment that is effective, sound, secure, sustainable, scalable, and compliant with Bank policies and regulatory requirements. * Provides information and cyber risk guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls and security policies and procedures. Monitors developments and trends in information security and cybersecurity and formulates strategy accordingly. * Works with key individuals throughout the organization to develop business cases for new security projects and risk assessments of existing and planned information systems. Supports a proactive culture to align activities and measurement with internal policy and regulatory requirements. * Fosters collaborative and cooperative working relationships with security stakeholders, including IT team members, executive leadership, operations, business lines, risk management, and internal audit. * Prepares and presents accurate and timely information in response to audits and regulatory exams. Develops effective relationships with the internal audit department. * Provides support and collaborative mentorship to the IT team on information security and cybersecurity matters. Supports IT team members on escalations of security incidents by providing subject matter expertise and guidance. * Provides leadership and technical and administrative support for the bank’s disaster recovery and business continuity program and implements appropriate and effective controls to mitigate identified risks and threats. * Responds to potential threats such as phishing, malware, and network attacks with a detailed written assessment, including timelines, to assist in the determination of whether it is necessary to declare a security incident. * Under the direction of the Chief Technology Officer, leads incident response to security events with a high degree of personal accountability. Utilizes incident response procedures and workflows for triage, analysis, notification, escalation, containment, remediation, and reporting. * Monitors access to all systems and maintains access control profiles on the network and systems. Tracks documentation of access authorization to all IT resources. * Installs, modifies, enhances, and maintains data system security software and performs application/network penetration tests and firewall auditing. * Supports improved security awareness, including awareness and development of controls and detection solutions to address malware, cybersecurity, and advanced or persistent attacks. * Supports a continuous monitoring framework by effectively reporting the Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Control Indicators (KCIs). * Assists with penetration testing, results analysis, recommendations, remediation planning and implementation, and reporting. * Provides after\-hours and weekend analysis on an as\-needed basis outside of general working hours. * Other duties as assigned by the Chief Technology Officer. Regular and reliable attendance is a requirement of the job. **EDUCATION \& CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, business administration, or related technical field. * Preferred Certifications (CISSP, CISM, GSEC, CISA, etc.) **KNOWLEDGE \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** Experience and working knowledge of: * 3\-5 years of combined work experience in networking/infrastructure/security, ideally in companies of different sizes with experience working in different roles with different technologies and products. * 3\-5 years of experience working with Linux (Debian), Active Directory, Windows desktop and server operating systems. * 3\-5 years of experience in host\-based security, malware prevention, data loss prevention, digital forensics, security information and event management systems. * 2\-3 years of experience implementing and managing firewalls and network intrusion systems, specifically Fortinet products including FortiGate, FortiManager, and FortiAnalyzer. * 2\-3 years of experience working with cloud\-based solutions such as Microsoft 365, AWS, and Azure. * 2\-3 years of experience in vulnerability management of on\-premise, cloud, and SaaS\-based information systems and enterprise applications. * Knowledge of common security principles, concepts, and methods (authentication, authorization, single sign\-on, network segregation, DMZ, Zero Trust, defense\-in\-depth, penetration testing, and sandboxing, etc.) * Knowledge of cloud provider security and protection techniques which would include security assessments and the application of enterprise security strategies, etc. * Understanding of regulations and guidance issued by the regulatory bodies overseeing banks and financial services organizations, such as the FDIC, FFIEC, PCI DSS, GLBA, and SOX. **OTHER REQUIREMENTS (SKILLS, ABILITIES, CHARACTERISTICS)** * Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing. Highly proficient in communicating security\-related concepts to technical and non\-technical staff, acting as a bridge between IT and business process owners. * Strong project management aptitude and demonstrated professionalism in managing multiple projects and resources effectively. * Detail\-oriented with a sense of urgency and commitment to positive results. * Ability to troubleshoot programs. Must be a critical thinker who can handle complex problems and find solutions. * Strong work ethic with the ability to manage a large workload within tight deadlines. * Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, prioritize, and meet project deadlines. * Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with executive leadership, peers, managers, vendors, and contractors. * Ability to exercise sound judgment in evaluating situations and in making decisions. * Highly committed to continual learning and maintaining knowledge of emerging technologies and security controls. * Ability to work well within a team as well as independently with minimal oversight and direction. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:** None **WORKING CONDITIONS:** Normal office working environment AA/EOE/D/V/MEMBER FDIC
