jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: (Atlanta, Full\-time, Hybrid) \- **Must reside in the Atlanta area** Fisher Phillips, a premier international labor and employment law firm is seeking an experienced **AI Security Engineer** to design, implement, and continuously improve security controls for enterprise artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI systems. This role is responsible for securing AI platforms, models, data pipelines, integrations, agents, and supporting cloud and SaaS environments throughout the AI lifecycle. **Position Summary** The **AI Security Engineer** will serve as a hands\-on security specialist and trusted technical partner to cybersecurity, IT, data, application, privacy, compliance, and business teams. The ideal candidate combines security engineering experience with practical knowledge of AI/ML technologies, cloud security, secure development, threat modeling, and risk\-based decision\-making. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Security Architecture \& Strategy** * Design and maintain security architecture for generative AI, machine learning, AI\-enabled SaaS applications, agents, APIs, and supporting cloud services. * Establish security standards, reference patterns, and guardrails for AI development, deployment, integration, and use. * Perform security reviews and threat modeling for AI solutions, including model access, data flows, retrieval\-augmented generation, plugins, tools, agents, and third\-party integrations. * Evaluate AI technologies, models, vendors, and services to ensure security and privacy requirements are incorporated into design and implementation. **AI/ML Platform \& Application Security** * Implement controls to protect AI platforms, model endpoints, APIs, orchestration layers, vector databases, development environments, and supporting cloud infrastructure. * Assess and reduce risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, insecure tool use, excessive agency, model supply\-chain compromise, and unauthorized AI usage. * Partner with application and platform teams to embed secure development, testing, secrets management, logging, and vulnerability remediation into AI solutions. **Data, Model \& Identity Protection** * Apply least privilege, strong authentication, service identity, privileged access, and lifecycle controls to AI platforms, models, agents, and workloads. * Protect training, grounding, prompt, output, and telemetry data using data classification, encryption, DLP, access controls, and appropriate retention practices. * Review model and agent permissions, data access, connectors, and tool integrations to identify excessive privileges, unsafe trust relationships, and unintended data exposure. **AI Security Engineering \& Monitoring** * Implement and optimize security controls for AI systems, including model gateways, content filtering, runtime guardrails, API security, cloud security, SIEM, DLP, and monitoring. * Develop detections and response procedures for AI\-related misuse, policy violations, data leakage, anomalous model activity, and compromised integrations. * Automate security validation, testing, monitoring, and enforcement using Python, PowerShell, APIs, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, or orchestration tools. **Governance, Risk \& Collaboration** * Partner with compliance, privacy, legal, data, and business stakeholders to align AI security controls with policies, client expectations, governance requirements, and organizational risk objectives. * Develop documentation for AI security standards, architecture decisions, threat models, control designs, risk exceptions, and remediation plans. * Support AI risk assessments, incident investigations, tabletop exercises, and reviews of emerging AI threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques. * Communicate AI security risks and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). * 5\+ years of security engineering, application/product security, cloud security, software security, or related cybersecurity experience. * Hands\-on experience securing generative AI and LLM systems, including RAG, agents, model/API integrations, and enterprise AI platforms. * Experience with threat modeling, secure design/SDLC, application/API security testing, IAM, secrets management, and security logging/monitoring. * Proficiency in Python or another programming/scripting language; experience with APIs, automation, CI/CD, or security tooling. * Knowledge of AI threats and mitigations, including prompt injection, data leakage/poisoning, model extraction, insecure tool use, excessive agency, and AI supply\-chain risk; familiarity with cloud AI services. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, abuse\-case analysis, or security evaluations of LLM, RAG, and agentic systems. * Experience with vector databases, model gateways, LangChain/LlamaIndex, MCP, and major cloud AI services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI. * Familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF; experience with IaC, policy\-as\-code, containers, or CI/CD security is a plus. * Relevant security, cloud, or AI certifications; experience in a law firm, professional services, regulated industry, or client\-service environment is preferred. **Key Competences** * Strong hands\-on security engineering, coding, and analytical problem\-solving skills * Strong threat\-modeling and adversarial thinking for AI, LLM, RAG, and agentic systems * Ability to translate AI use cases and emerging risks into secure, practical technical controls * Strong automation skills using scripting, APIs, and modern engineering workflows * Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous\-learning mindset **Why Join Us** At Fisher Phillips, we recognize that exceptional talent is the foundation of our success, enabling us to deliver outstanding service to both our internal and external clients. Joining our team means collaborating in a professional yet dynamic environment that leverages cutting\-edge technology. Our leadership is committed to fostering your professional growth and providing opportunities to challenge yourself in meaningful ways. We believe in rewarding talent with more than just a competitive salary. Our comprehensive benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) with profit sharing, generous paid time off, and holidays. Your well\-being is our priority. We offer 24/7 telehealth services, a variety of wellness programs, and additional optional benefits designed to support your unique lifestyle. At Fisher Phillips, you’ll find a workplace that values your health, happiness, and continued professional development. To learn more about our firm, visit us at www.fisherphillips.com. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Fisher Phillips is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants, regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including related medical conditions), gender, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, age, disability, or any other protected status, in compliance with all applicable laws. The statements in this position description are not necessarily all\-inclusive. Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned, and requirements may vary from time to time. **Relocation costs are not covered. We are only accepting direct applicants; third\-party recruiters or agencies will not be considered. No phone inquiries, please.**

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: It is an exciting time to join Fisher Investments! We are expanding our Generative AI capabilities to support our international growth. We are looking for a Software Engineer who will design, build, and improve advanced AI applications using large language models, GPU‑accelerated computing, and modern API frameworks. **The Opportunity:** The Software Engineer will architect, implement, and improve production\-ready generative AI systems, working closely with AI leads, ML engineers, and platform teams. You will develop solutions powered by LLMs, context engineering, and GPU\-accelerated frameworks, using Azure, Databricks, graph databases, and scalable microservices to deliver high\-performance, secure applications integrated with enterprise systems. You will report to the AI Team Leader, Technology Innovation. **The Day\-to\-Day:** * Design, develop, fine\-tune, and deploy generative AI models into scalable production environments * Build and maintain APIs and microservices using FastAPI to expose AI capabilities enterprise wide * Collaborate with the AI Infrastructure team to architect robust LLM pipelines, including training workflows and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems * Integrate AI solutions into enterprise applications using secure, cloud\-native architectures and best practices * Build and operate data ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines using Databricks, Delta Lake, Auto Loader, and Workflows to support AI applications and retrieval systems * Integrate graph databases into AI applications to model relationships and support graph\-enhanced RAG and hybrid retrieval solutions * Ensure AI models are explainable, reliable, and compliant with regulatory and internal governance standards * Monitor and improve application and model performance using evaluation frameworks, observability tools, and iterative improvements to prompts, retrieval, context, and model configuration **Your Qualifications:** * Minimum of 6\+ years of experience building data‑driven software solutions * Minimum of 3\+ years of hands\-on AI development experience. * Proficiency in Python, with practical experience building applications using LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architecture. * Demonstrated experience with generative AI models, including multimodal models. * Hands\-on experience developing and deploying AI applications using Azure Foundry, Docker, Kubernetes, and GPU\-backed compute. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * Experience fine\-tuning, evaluating, and deploying models using Azure\-managed AI services and compute resources * Familiarity with agent frameworks and experience deploying AI agents with tool integration, appropriate permissions, and operational safeguards * Experience building graph\-enhanced RAG and hybrid retrieval solutions using graph databases such as Neo4j, Stardog, or Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin * Experience deploying models with low latency and high throughput, using frameworks like vLLM and other GPU model deployment tools * Hands\-on experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing workflows for generative AI application * Experience with distributed training, GPU optimization, and large\-scale model frameworks (CUDA, RAPIDS) **Compensation:*** $130,000 \- $185,000 base salary per year in the state of WA. New hires should expect to start at the lower end of the range depending on experience * Eligible for a discretionary bonus based on firm and individual performance **Why Fisher Investments:** We work for a bigger purpose: bettering the investment universe. We take great pride in our inclusive culture, our learning and development framework customized for every employee, and our Great Place to Work Certification. It's the people that make the Fisher purpose possible, and we invest in them by offering exceptional benefits like:* 100% paid medical, dental and vision premiums for you and your qualifying dependents * A 50% 401(k) match, up to the IRS maximum * 20 days of PTO, plus 10 paid holidays * Family Support programs including 8 week Paid Primary Caregiver Leave, $10,000 fertility, family forming, and hormonal health assistance, and back\-up child, adult, and elder care * This is an in\-office role. Based on your role, tenure, and performance eligibility you may have the opportunity to participate in our hybrid work from home program. This program is subject to change. FISHER INVESTMENTS IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. You will be responsible for the delivery of analytical, machine learning and AI solutions. Summary: We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled AI/ML Engineer to contribute to cutting\-edge research and development within our team. This role offers a unique opportunity to work on challenging projects, collaborate with experienced researchers, and gain practical experience in the application of AI/ML techniques to real\-world problems. The successful candidate will be involved in all stages of the machine learning lifecycle, from data preprocessing and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and deployment. A strong theoretical foundation and hands\-on coding experience are essential. Responsibilities: * Design, develop, and implement AI/ML models and algorithms to solve complex problems. * Perform data preprocessing, cleaning, and feature engineering to prepare data for model training. * Train, evaluate, and tune various machine learning models. * Develop and maintain robust and efficient code using Python and relevant libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn). * Document code, experiments, and results clearly and concisely. * Collaborate effectively with other engineers within the team. · Ability to work within an agile development model working closely with a product manager and other engineers. The minimum requirements we seek: * Bachelor’s Degree in related field (e.g. Data Science, Predictive Analytics, Statistics, Marketing Analytics, Applied Mathematics, IT) * 3\+ years of experience of analytical methods and their proper application * 3\+ years of experience using AI/ML, data science software (e.g., Python\-based tools) * **MUST HAVE experience using Gen AI technologies**. * Experience using Cloud Platforms and AI Platforms. Our preferred requirements: * Working knowledge of GCP. * Expertise in open\-source data science technologies such as Python, R, Spark, SQL. * Conceptual understanding of data pipelines and MLOps You may not check every box, or your experience may look a little different from what we've outlined, but if you think you can bring value to Ford Motor Company, we encourage you to apply! jobs.title: Robotics Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **About the team:** The Fleet Operations Team drives uptime and operational performance across Formic's growing fleet of deployed robotic systems. Working inside live manufacturing environments, the team diagnoses issues, restores production, and continuously improves system reliability at scale. Fleet Operations operates at the intersection of robotics, controls, and real\-world factory execution, ensuring Formic's automation delivers consistent, measurable performance across diverse industrial applications. **About the role:** As a Robotics Field Service Engineer, you are the front line of technical ownership across Formic's deployed robotic cells. You will diagnose failures, restore systems to production, perform preventative and corrective maintenance, and represent Formic directly within customer facilities. This is a hands\-on, high\-accountability role in uptime\-critical environments. Success requires strong troubleshooting discipline, calm execution during production interruptions, and structured documentation. Your work directly impacts fleet performance, customer satisfaction, and long\-term system reliability. **In this role, you will:** * Perform preventative, corrective, and predictive maintenance on robotic manufacturing cells * Respond to remote and on\-site escalations, diagnose root causes, and restore systems quickly * Provide hands\-on technical support to customer operators and maintenance teams * Log service activity, asset updates, and spare part requirements in CMMS * Coordinate field scheduling and support with customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders * Monitor system performance remotely using Formic dashboards and fleet tools * Document service work, root cause analysis, and follow\-up actions with clarity and precision * Identify recurring failure patterns and escalate systemic risks for broader improvement * Build professional, trusted relationships with plant managers and site personnel * Operate with strict adherence to safety standards, including LOTO and industrial compliance * Participate in RCA sessions, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives * Continuously expand technical depth across robotics, controls, networking, and industrial systems **What makes you a great fit:** * 3\+ years of hands\-on field service experience supporting robotic or industrial automation systems * Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, PLC, or robotic control systems * Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and pneumatic drawings * Experience using CMMS platforms to track and report maintenance activity * Comfortable with local travel up to 80% and overnight travel up to 50% * Clear written and verbal communicator capable of producing structured service documentation * Demonstrated commitment to safety and disciplined field execution **Bonus points if you have:** * Experience with 6\-axis robot brands such as FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, ABB, or Universal Robots * Familiarity with palletizing, case packing, pick\-and\-place, or conveyor systems * Experience in food, beverage, packaging, CPG, or other high\-speed manufacturing environments * Prior customer\-facing field experience * Spanish language proficiency **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don't confuse activity with results. * **Seek Truth:** You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You're willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer. * **Made of Rubber:** You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit. * **One Formic:** You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person's merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to careers@formic.co. **AI Use:** At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. We use AI\-powered tools in some interviews to help our teams evaluate candidate responses, but all final hiring decisions are made by humans. You can learn more about how AI is used in our recruitment process by reviewing our AI Hiring Disclosure linked here.

jobs.title: Data Engineering & Architecture Manager
jobs.description: Overview: We are looking for a Data Architecture Manager to help lead Electric Boat’s transformation toward a modern, scalable, AI‑ready data ecosystem. This is not a role focused solely on creating data models or maintaining existing data structures. Instead, we need a leader who can bridge our current environment and our future state—someone who understands how to work within a complex legacy landscape while designing and implementing a modern data foundation that supports analytics, AI, automation, and next‑generation applications. This position requires a forward‑thinking architect who can balance pragmatism with innovation: knowing when to modernize, when to integrate, and when to redesign—while ensuring stability for mission‑critical operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable navigating a large enterprise, influencing across organizational boundaries, and translating business goals into practical, actionable technology and architecture decisions. **Key Responsibilities:** **Enterprise Data Architecture \& Strategy** * Develop and evolve the enterprise data architecture strategy in alignment with business and technology objectives. * Define target\-state data architecture and practical transition paths from current to future\-state environments. * Establish architecture principles, standards, patterns, and governance that promote scalable, consistent, and secure data solutions. **Build the Foundation for AI and Advanced Analytics** * Define the data architecture required to support the organization’s AI and machine\-learning strategy. * Help establish trusted, accessible, well\-governed data that can be effectively used by analytics and AI teams. * Partner with data science, AI, product, and business teams to understand emerging data requirements. * Evaluate new technologies and architectural approaches for data platforms, AI, real\-time data, data products, and analytics. * Help ensure that data is discoverable, appropriately governed, secure, and usable across the enterprise. **Lead and Develop a Team** * Build, lead, and mentor the Data Architecture team, advancing EB’s modeling, ontology, integration, and metadata capabilities. * Provide clear direction while empowering architects and engineers to solve complex problems. Qualifications: **Required:*** Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering * Significant experience in data architecture, enterprise architecture, data engineering, or a related technology discipline. * 8\+ years of experience in IT, data\-focused technical roles, or enterprise systems. * 4\+ years of supervisory experience * Experience partnering across enterprise, solution, application, infrastructure, security, and AI architecture domains. * Experience developing enterprise data strategies and multi‑year technology roadmaps. * Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security **Preferred:*** Experience with modern data platforms, data lakes/lakehouses, streaming architectures, APIs, and event‑driven architectures. * Experience supporting AI/ML, generative AI, or advanced analytics initiatives. * Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, master data, and information management. * Experience with semantic layers, ontology development, or enterprise modeling. * Experience working in complex, highly regulated enterprise environments. * Experience with cloud‑based data platforms and modern data architecture patterns. * Experience defining target‑state architectures and building transition roadmaps.

jobs.title: Enterprise AI Engineering & Platforms Manager
jobs.description: Overview: Electric Boat is accelerating its deployment and adoption of artificial intelligence with a tremendous opportunity to use modern technology and AI to transform how we operate. To support this transformation, we are seeking an Enterprise AI Engineering \& Platforms Manager — a deeply technical leader who can bridge the gap between **what is possible with AI today and what can** **actually be** **deployed, integrated, secured, operated, and scaled in a large enterprise.** We are looking for a hands\-on technology leader who understands AI, stays current with the rapidly evolving AI landscape, and knows how to make practical technology decisions. The successful candidate will help define our enterprise AI technology direction while also getting into the details of architecture, infrastructure, platforms, integration, security, data, deployment, and operations. This position will also drive platform governance, cost management, lifecycle management, tool selection, and enterprise alignment to ensure consistency, trust, and responsible adoption of AI. You will also play a critical role in cultural transformation — partnering across the enterprise to enable broad adoption of new AI technologies. **Key Responsibilities** * **Architecture \& Strategic Leadership****.** Contribute to enterprise AI strategy and roadmap to become an AI\-enabled enterprise. Translate business needs into scalable AI platform requirements. * **Architect** **the enterprise AI foundation.** Define and support implementation of the platforms, infrastructure, architecture, and engineering capabilities required to deploy AI at enterprise scale. This includes the compute, cloud, networking, storage, data, identity, security, observability, and operational capabilities required to support AI workloads. Develop patterns for using foundation models, agentic systems, RAG, AI applications, machine learning, and other emerging technologies within our enterprise environment. Understand the realities of a large legacy environment and develop practical approaches for integrating modern AI capabilities without requiring the entire technology ecosystem to be rebuilt first. * **Lead AI platform** **and service** **engineering.** Establish reusable platforms, services, APIs, tooling, and deployment patterns that enable teams across the business to build and consume AI capabilities safely and efficiently. * **Evaluate rapidly changing technology.** Stay current on developments in AI models, agent frameworks, AI infrastructure, inference technologies, developer tools, and the broader AI ecosystem. Separate meaningful advances from hype. Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine where and how they can create real business value * **Create technology standards and guardrails.** Establish practical enterprise patterns for model selection, security, data usage, deployment, governance, monitoring, and lifecycle management. Develop AI\-related standards and best practices. * **Enterprise Cultural Transformation****.** Champion and drive AI adoption across the enterprise. * **Team Leadership and Talent Development.** Attract, develop, and lead highly capable engineers and architects while creating a culture of responsible innovation, engineering rigor, and delivery. Qualifications: **Required:** ============= * Bachelor’s of Science degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Data Science * 8\+ years of experience with cloud platforms, enterprise infrastructure, APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, networking, identity, security, and observability. * 4\+ years of supervisory experience * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI/ML/LLM solutions into production. Experience taking AI or machine learning solutions from experimentation through production deployment and ongoing operations. * Experience leading enterprise\-scale technology initiatives. * Experience leading highly technical engineering or architecture teams. * Experience working inside Department of War (DoW) or Defense Industrial Base (DIB) security environments **Preferred:** ============== * Deep understanding of the latest AI platforms, models, frameworks, and AI architectures and what they can do. * A strong understanding of data architecture and the role of high\-quality enterprise data in successful AI implementations. Skills: * Strong communication skills and the ability to explain highly technical concepts to both engineers and senior business leaders. * Strong understanding of the infrastructure required to run AI in a large enterprise environment.

jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. In this role you will design, prototype, implement, ship and support highly performant and inspiring user experiences with your team. We are looking for creative problem solvers and diverse thinkers, people who care about culture as well as customers and features. We believe that how we do things is as important as what we do. Big vision, a common purpose, passion for quality, curiosity, dedication, and investment in fun and collaboration are what lead to great results. Great products reflect the teams that build them. jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager, Product Growth
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the Role:** We're hiring a product minded, hands on, technically strong Tech Lead Manager to help establish and lead our Product Growth engineering function. This is an opportunity to shape a new growth engineering capability at a pivotal moment for Glean as we expand the reach and impact of our Work AI platform. You will work at the intersection of product engineering, data, experimentation, and applied AI to help more people discover, adopt, and continuously engage with Glean. This is a high impact, full stack leadership role for a software engineering leader who can guide architecture, partner deeply with product, design and data science, and grow a strategically important team. The Product Growth team owns the end\-to\-end experiences that help users discover Glean, get to value quickly, build lasting habits, and expand their use of the product. This includes the journey from invitation and first sign\-in through activation, onboarding, engagement, re\-entry, and broader adoption across teams and functions. The team works across key entry points and touch points—including login and setup flows, the home page, navigation, desktop and browser experiences, in\-product education, lifecycle communications, and product\-led expansion—to make Glean easier to discover, understand, and use regularly. **You will:** * Define technical direction and lead execution for product growth initiatives across Glean’s user\-facing experiences. * Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Applied AI to identify and prioritize opportunities that increase product awareness, adoption, activation, and engagement. * Lead a team of full\-stack engineers in building thoughtful, measurable experiences that help users realize value from Glean more quickly and return to the product more frequently. * Use product data, customer insights, behavioral analysis, and experimentation to understand growth opportunities and make informed technical and product decisions. * Help establish a strong experimentation and measurement foundation, including clear hypotheses, success metrics, instrumentation, experiment design, analysis, and iteration. * Own projects end to end, from identifying a user or customer problem through technical design, implementation, launch, measurement, and follow\-through. * Stay close to the code and architecture, contributing directly where needed, reviewing designs and code, debugging complex issues, and maintaining a high technical bar. * Bring strong backend and systems leadership to the team while partnering effectively across the full stack and user\-facing product experience. * Collaborate with engineering teams across Glean to deliver cohesive experiences and build scalable foundations for growth. * engage with users and customers when useful to understand their needs, identify friction, and ensure that growth initiatives solve meaning  the team grows, hire, coach, and develop engineers; establish effective engineering practices; and create an environment of ownership, learning, and high\-quality execution. **About you:** * 8\+ years of software engineering experience building production distributed systems or cloud‑native applications. * 1\+ years of engineering management experience of a full stack team * BS/BA in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * You are a product\-forward software engineering leader with experience building and shipping user\-facing products, preferably in B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or other high\-engagement software. * You have a strong track record of execution and can lead a group of engineers through ambiguity, make sound technical decisions, and deliver meaningful outcomes. * You have partnered effectively with Product Managers, Designers, and Data Scientists to define problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver measurable product improvements. * You are highly analytical and comfortable using data to understand user behavior, evaluate opportunities, define success metrics, and assess experiment results. * You have demonstrated experience with product growth, experimentation, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, or other data\-driven product optimization work. * You have a strong understanding of customer needs and enjoy building products that users discover, adopt, and use regularly. * Experience building or working with agentic AI products, large language model applications, machine learning systems, or AI\-assisted product experiences is a plus. **Location:** * This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office) **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard base salary range for this position is $250,000 \- 300,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, or a specialized field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP, etc.), or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience maintaining and repairing semiconductor fabrication equipment. * 5 years of experience with photolithography, vacuum/plasma tools, or packaging equipment (e.g., wire bonders). * Ability to work in a cleanroom environment wearing full Personal Protective Equipment (PPE). ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field (e.g., Optics, Sensors, Audio/DSP). * Experience with Etch (ICP/RIE) and Deposition (PVD/Evaporation) systems, including high\-vacuum technology, RF power supplies, and toxic gas delivery systems. * Experience with electro\-mechanical measurements (oscilloscopes, generators, calipers, etc.) and CAD software (KiCad, Solidworks, AutoCAD). * Proficiency in troubleshooting vacuum, pneumatic, mechanical, electrical, and software systems, ideally down to the component level. * Ability to read complex schematics (electrical, pneumatic, P\&ID) and perform component\-level repairs on electronics, robotics, and vacuum sub\-systems. **About the job** ----------------- As a part of the Equipment Engineering team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation and sustainability of the manufacturing equipment utilized in the production of high\-quality quantum devices in a dependable and efficient manner. In this role, your mission involves equipment Installation and qualification, bear the responsibility for the proper installation and qualification of new equipment, ensuring it aligns with the required specifications and standards. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * 265000\-331000 $265K – $331K • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2\.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About the role** Most therapists who join Headway bring their own clients, through referrals, directories, their own websites, and word of mouth. The Provider\-Sourced Clients (PSC) team builds the products that help providers fill their caseload and run their whole practice on Headway. We're building growth tools providers actively use: AI agents that answer and convert patient inquiries, tools that make moving an existing caseload to Headway effortless, marketing tools for clinicians who aren't marketers, and routing that gets every patient to the right provider in our network. jobs.title: Subsurface Utility Engineer
jobs.description: Job Title **Subsurface Utility Engineer (SUE) – Licensed Professional Engineer (PE, Illinois)** Position Summary We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated **Subsurface Utility Engineer (SUE)** with an active **Professional Engineer (PE) license in the State of Illinois** to lead and support utility engineering, utility coordination, and subsurface utility investigations for transportation, infrastructure, municipal, and private development projects. The successful candidate will oversee SUE investigations in accordance with **ASCE 38 Utility Damage Prevention Standard**, manage field and office personnel, provide engineering analysis and quality assurance, and coordinate with clients, utility owners, contractors, and project stakeholders. This position requires strong technical expertise in utility engineering, project management, and utility risk mitigation throughout planning, design, and construction phases. Essential Duties and Responsibilities * Lead and manage Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) projects from planning through completion. * Direct utility investigations utilizing Quality Levels D, C, B, and A in accordance with ASCE 38 standards. * Review and certify utility mapping, engineering analyses, utility conflict matrices, and utility risk assessments. * Prepare and oversee utility design reports, utility relocation recommendations, and utility coordination documentation. * Perform engineering review of geophysical survey data, utility records research, test hole data, and utility mapping deliverables. * Coordinate with public and private utility owners, municipalities, transportation agencies, and project teams. * Provide quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) for utility engineering deliverables. * Support transportation, highway, bridge, aviation, rail, water, wastewater, and municipal infrastructure projects. * Manage project schedules, budgets, staffing requirements, and client communications. * Review plans and identify potential utility conflicts and associated construction risks. * Develop utility conflict resolutions and utility relocation strategies. * Prepare technical reports, specifications, cost estimates, and engineering recommendations. * Participate in business development activities, proposal preparation, and client presentations. * Mentor junior engineers, utility coordinators, and SUE technicians. * Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, local, and client standards and regulations. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Geomatics, Surveying Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. * Active **Professional Engineer (PE) license in Illinois**. * Minimum **7\-10 years** of experience in Subsurface Utility Engineering, utility coordination, utility design, civil engineering, or related infrastructure services. * Thorough knowledge of: * ASCE 38 Utility Damage Prevention Standard * Utility Quality Levels (QL\-A, QL\-B, QL\-C, QL\-D) * Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) * Electromagnetic utility locating methods * Utility coordination and conflict resolution processes * Experience with transportation and infrastructure projects involving IDOT, municipalities, counties, or other public agencies. * Strong understanding of underground utility systems including: * Water * Sanitary sewer * Storm sewer * Natural gas * Electric distribution and transmission * Telecommunications and fiber optic systems * Proficiency with AutoCAD Civil 3D, MicroStation, GIS, and related engineering software. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites. Preferred Qualifications * Experience working on Illinois Department of Transportation (IDOT) projects. * Utility Coordination Certification or related credentials. * Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. * Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering teams. * Familiarity with permitting and utility relocation agreements. * Experience utilizing GIS platforms and utility asset management systems. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities * Strong leadership and project management capabilities. * Advanced technical understanding of utility engineering and infrastructure design. * Excellent problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution skills. * Ability to interpret engineering drawings, utility records, and survey data. * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. * Strong client relationship and stakeholder management abilities. * Commitment to safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. Physical Requirements * Ability to conduct field investigations at construction sites and utility locations. * Ability to walk uneven terrain and work outdoors in varying weather conditions. * Ability to occasionally lift up to 25 pounds. * Ability to perform site visits, utility inspections, and project meetings. Reporting Structure **Reports To:** Engineering Manager / Director of Utility Services **Supervises:** SUE Project Managers, Utility Coordinators, Utility Designators, CAD Technicians, and Field Personnel Compensation and Benefits * Competitive salary commensurate with experience. * Annual performance bonus opportunities. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) with company match. * Professional development and licensing support. * Paid time off and company holidays. * Continuing education reimbursement. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * AD\&D insurance * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Opportunities for advancement * Paid time off * Paid training * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: ### **About the Role** We are looking for a driven, passionate, and self\-motivated Full Stack Developer to help drive the future of our AI platform in a fast\-paced, high\-impact environment. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end feature development, architect scalable systems, and collaborate with a talented global team to deliver daily value to thousands of users worldwide. If you bring a can\-do mindset, enjoy tackling complex technical challenges, and thrive on transforming ambitious product visions into real\-world impact, we want to hear from you! **Who are we at Houzz Pro?** Houzz Pro is an all\-in\-one, AI platform for the Build and Design industries. Our solution streamlines business operations for pros of all sizes by centralizing financials, project management, lead tracking, client communication dashboards, and actionable business insights into one unified space. **Learn more about us**: https://pro.houzz.com/pro ### **What You’ll Do** * **End\-to\-End Ownership**: Lead the planning, architecture, and execution of complex full\-stack features from initial concept through production deployment. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Partner closely with Product, UX, and global engineering teams to align technical solutions with business priorities and user needs. * **Architectural \& System Excellence**: Design resilient microservices and backend architectures with an emphasis on data integrity, high availability, and asynchronous processing. * **AI\-First Workflow**: Leverage state\-of\-the\-art AI tooling across the full software development lifecycle—from design and prototyping to implementation, testing, and debugging. * **Quality \& Performance**: Champion engineering best practices through robust unit/integration testing, CI/CD automation, and real\-time observability using modern monitoring tools. * **Mentorship \& Standards**: Drive code review standards, elevate engineering practices, and mentor team members across cross\-functional projects. ### **At a Minimum, We’d Like You to Have** * 5\+ years of professional experience in Full Stack software development, building and scaling SaaS applications. * Strong expertise with our core stack: Node.js, React, GraphQL, Microservices architecture, and PostgreSQL (or equivalent relational databases). * Hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to generate, refactor, and test full\-stack code. * B.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent. * Solid grasp of service\-oriented design patterns, backend asynchronous processing, and relational database design/optimization * Proven track record of designing and building complex, integrated enterprise or SaaS systems. * Proven experience working with AI platforms and integrating AI solutions into production systems. ### **Ideally, You'll Also Have** * Direct experience working on financial software, fintech, online payments, billing/subscription management, or accounting integrations (e.g., Stripe, QuickBooks, Plaid). M/F/Disability/Veterans \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Be Who You Are and Do What You Love at Houzz** **About Houzz** When founders Adi and Alon remodeled their home, they were frustrated by the lack of resources and inspiration to help them articulate a vision and select the right pro to make it a reality. So they built Houzz. Reasonable accommodation can be provided to enable people with disabilities to perform the described essential functions.* While performing the responsibilities of the job, the employee is required to talk and hear. * The employee is often required to sit and use their hands and fingers, to handle or feel. * The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, reach with arms and hands, climb or balance, and to stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl. * Employees must be able to lift 50lbs without assistance. May be asked to lift to 80lbs with assistance of machinery or helper. * Vision abilities required to perform this job include close vision. * The employee may be occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts and vehicles. * The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet to moderate. * The passage of employees through the work area is average and normal. * This position is a high security position and may pose a risk of exposure to criminal elements. jobs.title: Senior Staff Full-stack Engineer, Global Payments Network
jobs.description: Posted Date 10/29/2026 Description Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer, Global Payments Network Capital One has grown from a promising credit card startup into a Fortune 100 company. Our businesses span Card, Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, and Financial Services, backed by an Enterprise Services group that is Capital One's digital and technology backbone. Within that enterprise, the **Global Payment Network (GPN)** is one of the company's most ambitious builds: the unification of three legacy networks — Discover Network, PULSE, and Diners Club International — into a single, modern payment network. Rather than three separate acceptance footprints, three separate data models, and three separate operating teams, GPN is being rebuilt from a clean sheet so that a card issued anywhere on the network works everywhere on the network. This is the kind of ground\-up platform build most engineers only read about — a chance to define how data moves through one of the largest payment networks in the world, not maintain what's already there. **What You'll Do:** The **Senior Staff Full\-stack Engineer (IC)** for GPN will be responsible for architecting and delivering the real\-time and batch data infrastructure that every other team on the network builds on — ingestion, streaming, the canonical data model, and the catalog and metadata layer that gives the network a single source of truth. This role sits at the cross\-section of Core Network, Fraud/AML, Analytics, and the Modeling teams building on top of this data, and offers the rare opportunity to define how a payment network's data platform gets built from the ground up rather than inheriting one. A deep understanding of distributed systems, real\-time streaming architecture, data modeling at scale, and cloud infrastructure is required. This is a highly visible and influential individual\-contributor role, with no direct reports, that requires a combination of deep technical skill, setting vision and architecture, and effective partnership across engineering, data science, product, and risk. **Key Responsibilities:** * Architect the real\-time, event\-driven data pipelines that move authorization, transaction, settlement, and fraud\-relevant events across the network with the latency and exactly\-once delivery guarantees a payment network requires — this is not a dashboard\-refresh pipeline, it is infrastructure fraud and risk decisioning will run on. * Define the canonical data model that reconciles three legacy schemes — each with its own merchant hierarchies, participant identities, and transaction semantics — into one shared model, with legacy formats translated at the network's edge only, never propagated inward. * Design and build the catalog and metadata layer (schema registry, lineage, data contracts, access policy) that gives every downstream team — fraud models, analytics, canonical modeling — one trustworthy source of truth instead of each team reverse\-engineering its own. * Set the technical architecture and standards for streaming, storage, and low\-latency serving at network scale, and serve as an evangelist for data standardization both internally and with the partner teams building on this platform. * Operate as the deep technical authority and trusted advisor across the data engineering function, reimagining what a modern, portable data platform should look like — favoring open, well\-understood components over one\-off tooling, so the platform is something new engineers can reason about on day one. * Partner directly with Fraud/AML, Analytics, and Canonical Modeling leadership so your architecture directly unblocks their roadmaps rather than trailing behind them. * Mentor and raise the technical bar for engineers across the organization, acting as a force multiplier on a brand\-new network build without owning a reporting chain of your own. **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering) * At least 9 years of experience in all of the following: + Software engineering and solution architecture + Enterprise architecture and design patterns + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture **Preferred Qualifications:** * Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Software TypeScript and SPA frameworks) + Designing and building distributed HPC and ML systems + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture * Deep experience designing event\-driven, real\-time streaming architectures at scale (e.g. Kafka, Flink, or equivalent) * Experience with distributed storage, catalog, and metadata/lineage systems (e.g. Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures) * Experience designing canonical  signing and building distributed HPC and ML systems + Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture * Deep experience designing event\-driven, real\-time streaming architectures at scale (e.g. Kafka, Flink, or equivalent) * Experience with distributed storage, catalog, and metadata/lineage systems (e.g. Iceberg, data lakehouse architectures) * Experience designing canonical or shared data models that unify disparate or legacy systems Experience architecting high\-availability, low\-latency distributed systems in a regulated, high\-stakes domain (payments, fraud, financial transaction processing, or similar) * ***Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this The flow runs from alert or case intake through agent investigation and evidence gathering, analyst review and decision, and escalation and SAR support, to management reporting. Each demo is tailored to the client's products, channels and existing detection estate. * Ability to explain clearly how Financial Crime agents differ from rules\-based and ML detection. Agents investigate and adjudicate inbound alerts rather than originate them. Deterministic rules and workflow govern routing and coverage, and every agent finding traces back to source data and documents. * Understanding of entity resolution and entity validation in financial crime. This covers matching customers, counterparties and related parties across sources, establishing ownership and control structures, and how entity data quality affects screening and investigation outcomes. * Ability to design and present a solution architecture for a Fincrime OS deployment. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Fulfillment
jobs.description: **We're transforming the grocery industry** At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table. **Instacart is a Flex First team** There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work. **Overview** ------------ Instacart’s Enterprise AI organization builds intelligent products and platforms that help transform the grocery industry. Our teams apply machine learning, optimization, and software engineering to solve complex problems for customers, shoppers, retailers, brands, and internal partners. We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy production machine learning systems that create measurable business impact. You will work across the full lifecycle of machine learning products, from problem formulation and data development through experimentation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This role is ideal for an engineer who combines strong machine learning expertise with excellent software engineering fundamentals. You will collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, platform engineers, and business partners to translate ambiguous opportunities into reliable, scalable solutions. The work will be fast\-paced and highly collaborative, with opportunities to solve challenging problems at significant scale and see your systems used in the real world. **About the Job** ----------------- * Design, implement, and deploy machine learning models and services that support high\-impact Enterprise AI products and business initiatives. * Own the full machine learning lifecycle, including problem formulation, data preparation, feature development, model training, offline evaluation, experimentation, production rollout, and ongoing performance monitoring. * Build reliable, scalable, and maintainable software in Python and related technologies, applying strong practices for testing, profiling, code review, documentation, and operational readiness. * Partner with product, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to define success metrics, prioritize work, and deliver solutions that improve customer and business outcomes. * Develop and operate machine learning services on cloud infrastructure, with appropriate monitoring, alerting, observability, and safeguards for production performance and reliability. * Use experimentation, statistical analysis, and causal or counterfactual evaluation techniques to assess model quality and guide launch decisions. * Help shape technical direction through design reviews, architecture discussions, and thoughtful evaluation of modeling approaches, infrastructure choices, and tradeoffs. * Contribute to a strong engineering culture by sharing knowledge, mentoring teammates, improving development practices, and participating in operational support for critical services. This is a fast\-moving environment where priorities, data, and business needs can evolve quickly. Success requires comfort with ambiguity, pragmatic prioritization, sound technical judgment, and a willingness to move between strategic problem\-solving and hands\-on implementation. **About You** ------------- You bring a strong foundation in machine learning and software engineering, along with the ability to communicate clearly and work effectively across disciplines. You take ownership from idea through production, are motivated by measurable impact, and enjoy solving challenging problems with practical, scalable solutions. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Five or more years of professional experience developing and deploying machine learning models or systems in production. * Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience writing production\-quality code with automated testing, profiling, debugging, and code review practices. * Experience with the complete machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, deployment, and production monitoring. * Experience building and operating machine learning services or data products in a cloud environment such as Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services. * Experience with containerized services and production software development practices, including Docker, continuous integration, monitoring, alerting, and incident response. * Demonstrated ability to work with product, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver measurable outcomes. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. * Experience designing machine learning systems for large\-scale, high\-throughput, or low\-latency applications. * Familiarity with distributed data processing, streaming systems, feature stores, or real\-time feature computation. * Experience with model serving, orchestration, and machine learning platforms such as Kubernetes, Airflow, Spark, or comparable technologies. * Experience designing simulation, experimentation, or counterfactual evaluation frameworks for machine learning and decision systems. * Proficiency in a performance\-oriented language such as C\+\+, Java, or Go. * Experience mentoring engineers, leading cross\-functional projects, or setting technical direction for machine learning initiatives. * Experience working in e\-commerce, marketplaces, logistics, retail, advertising, or another domain involving complex and evolving business constraints. \#LI\-Remote Instacart provides highly market\-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here. Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here. For US based candidates, the base pay ranges for a successful candidate are listed below. CA, NY, CT, NJ $207,000 \- $218,500 USD WA $198,000 \- $209,000 USD OR, DE, ME, MA, MD, NH, RI, VT, DC, PA, VA, CO, TX, IL, HI $190,000 \- $200,500 USD All other states $173,000 \- $182,500 USD

jobs.title: CPU Physical Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Are you interested in building the next generation of high\-performance, power\-efficient CPUs? Join Intel as a **CPU Physical Design Engineer** and begin your career working on advanced processor technology. In this early\-career role, you will work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to the physical design and verification of CPU designs from RTL to GDSII. You will gain hands\-on experience with industry\-standard EDA tools and develop expertise across physical design areas including synthesis, floorplanning, place and route, clock implementation, static timing analysis, power optimization, and physical verification. As part of the CPU Physical Design team, you will collaborate with engineers across logic design, architecture, circuits, and design automation while developing the technical expertise required to solve increasingly complex CPU design challenges. **What You’ll Do** **Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:** * Implement physical design and verification flows for custom CPU designs, ranging from RTL synthesis to GDS generation, custom and memory designs. * Perform verification and signoff processes such as formal equivalence verification, layout verification, reliability verification, and timing/power integrity analysis. * Collaborate with logic, architecture, circuit, and design automation teams to identify opportunities for design improvements and optimize product\-level parameters such as power, frequency, and area. * Build and refine physical design methodologies and automation workflows to streamline the design process. Work closely with EDA vendors to enhance tool capabilities for high\-speed, low\-power CPU design. * Behavioral traits that we are looking for: * **Learning agility and curiosity:** Eager to learn new technologies, tools, and CPU physical design methodologies. * **Problem solving:** Approaches technical challenges analytically and works through problems in a structured manner. * **Collaboration:** Works effectively with others and values different technical perspectives. * **Initiative and ownership:** Proactively seeks information, asks thoughtful questions, and takes responsibility for assigned work. * **Communication:** Clearly communicates technical ideas, questions, results, and challenges. * **Attention to detail:** Demonstrates accuracy and quality when analyzing technical information and completing engineering tasks. * **Adaptability:** Able to learn and grow within a fast\-paced technical environment as design requirements and priorities evolve. Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life. * See Intel Benefits for more details. **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Requirements listed would be obtained through a combination of industry relevant job experience, internship experiences and or schoolwork/classes/research. **Note:** **For information on Intel’s immigration sponsorship guidelines, please see** **Intel U.S. Immigration Sponsorship Information** **Minimum Qualifications and Experience** : Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field with 3\+ years of relevant experience. Or a Master's degree in the same field with 1\+ years of relevant educational or work experience. Your experience described above must be in one or more of the following: * Experience with at least one successful tape\-out using advanced technology nodes. * Experience with industry\-standard EDA tools such as Synopsys and/or Cadence for physical design flows. implement enrichment, business rules, and reusable patterns for consistency across projects. * Enable multiple compute engines \- SQL, Spark/PySpark, Spark SQL, and KQL \- against shared datasets to support diverse analytics scenarios. * Prepare governed data products and reusable datasets for BI, advanced analytics, and AI use cases, including retrieval\-ready data patterns when relevant. * Establish data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, testing, and monitoring; troubleshoot failures and continuously improve pipeline resiliency. * Optimize transformations, query performance, and pipeline execution to meet client service level and cost objectives. * Implement logging, metrics, and operational runbooks, and support deployments, cutovers, and hypercare as needed. * Design and implement security, governance, and compliance controls, including access, least privilege, data protection, and lineage across Azure and Fabric. * Facilitate workshops and communicate architecture tradeoffs, partnering with client stakeholders, architects, analysts, and BI developers to deliver trusted datasets. * Produce clear consulting deliverables, including design documents, diagrams, implementation guides, and enablement materials, to support adoption and a smooth handoff. Requirements: **Required Qualifications** * Experience designing and delivering modern analytics platforms using lakehouse and/or data warehouse patterns on Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric, including client\-facing delivery. * Strong SQL skills with experience building transformations and dimensional or analytical models. * Hands\-on experience with Spark (PySpark/Spark SQL) and/or KQL for data engineering and analytics workloads. * Experience applying software engineering practices to data solutions, including modular design, source control, automated testing, code review, and technical documentation. * Experience building reliable data pipelines, including orchestration, scheduling, error handling, and automated monitoring. * Knowledge of data quality practices, including validation, reconciliation, testing, incident triage, and root\-cause analysis. * Working knowledge of Power BI, including semantic modeling concepts, to support end\-to\-end analytics delivery; Power Apps experience is a plus. * Understanding of security and governance concepts for data platforms, including access controls, least privilege, compliance, and lineage. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to present recommendations, align stakeholders, and manage expectations in a client environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct experience with Microsoft Fabric components \- OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory in Fabric, and Real\-Time Analytics/KQL databases \- including platform administration, capacity planning, and standards. * Experience with Azure services commonly used in data platforms, such as Azure Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, ADLS Gen2, and Key Vault. * Working knowledge of Azure architecture fundamentals across identity, networking, storage, monitoring, resiliency, and cost management. * Familiarity with AI\-enablement patterns \- such as preparing governed enterprise data for Azure AI Search or Microsoft Foundry, retrieval\-augmented generation, or agent\-based solutions—is valued. Deep agent application development experience is not required. * Experience implementing CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code, including environment strategy and release management for data solutions. * Familiarity with semantic modeling and BI enablement patterns, including Power BI datasets, self\-service analytics, and governance guardrails. * Current Microsoft certifications relevant to the role are valued, especially Microsoft Certified: Fabric Data Engineer Associate (DP\-700\), Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL\-300\), and, for broader architecture responsibilities, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\). As the winner of The Best Places to Work Award for five consecutive years, we know what it takes to care for our employees and clients. **Interlink Advantage** We are the premier Microsoft Cloud consulting company based in Mason, OH. We are a team of trusted experts who know how to navigate the intricacies of Microsoft's technologies, guiding and educating clients to avoid overspending on tech licenses while optimizing their tools. At Interlink, we believe working in an innovative, fun, and collaborative environment is key to success. Get to know us and our company culture more at: http://www.interlink.com/about\-us/company\-culture. *Interlink Cloud Advisors is an equal\-opportunity employer.
