jobs.title: AI Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** Interra Health is a fast\-growing healthcare technology company transforming how providers and patients navigate the prescription journey. Formed through the merger of DoseSpot, Arrive Health, and pVerify, Interra Health delivers trusted eligibility, real\-time coverage and pricing insights, prescribing tools, and pharmacy transparency at the point of care—helping providers make informed decisions and patients access the right medications with greater clarity and affordability. Backed by strong market momentum and a bold vision for the future of connected care, Interra Health offers the chance to join an innovative, mission\-driven team working at the intersection of software and healthcare to reduce friction, improve access, and make the healthcare experience better for everyone. Interra Health is expanding its use of artificial intelligence and machine learning across a fast\-moving, highly regulated healthcare market. As an AI Security Engineer on the Security Engineering team, reporting to the Lead Security Engineer, you will help secure the models, data pipelines, and AI solutions. This role is hands\-on and technical: you will assess AI systems for vulnerabilities, build guardrails against risks like prompt injection and data leakage, and partner with Engineering and Data \& Analytics to bake security into how AI is designed and shipped. You will independently assess and resolve AI security risks across multiple workflows, escalating complex or high\-impact issues to senior security leadership as appropriate. The right person is genuinely curious about how AI systems can fail, and wants to build the guardrails before something goes wrong, not after. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Lead security assessments of AI/ML models, data pipelines, and AI\-enabled applications, identifying vulnerabilities such as prompt injection, model inversion, data poisoning, and adversarial inputs * Partner with Data \& Analytics and Engineering to embed security requirements and threat modeling into the AI development lifecycle, from data collection through model deployment * Build and maintain guardrails, monitoring, and detection controls for AI systems in production, flagging anomalous model behavior and unauthorized data access * Conduct security reviews of third\-party AI tools, APIs, and vendors, such as LLM providers, before they are integrated into Interra Health * Lead incident response for AI\-related security events, including investigating suspicious model outputs or unexpected data exposure * Design and advise on standards for the secure, responsible use of AI, including data handling practices for training and inference * Test and validate access controls, encryption, and data segmentation for AI systems * Use AI tools to accelerate security testing, code review, and threat research, while modeling responsible AI use for the broader engineering organization * Stay current on the evolving AI threat landscape and translate emerging risks, such as jailbreaks and model\-supply\-chain risks, into practical mitigations * Document findings, risk assessments, and remediation plans clearly for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **WHAT YOU'LL BRING** * Bachelor's degree and 5\+ years in security engineering or application security, including hands\-on experience securing AI/ML systems or LLM\-based applications * Deep knowledge of AI/ML security risks (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, adversarial ML, and data poisoning) and proven ability to test for and mitigate them * Hands\-on experience with security tooling, including SAST/DAST and vulnerability scanning, and comfort scripting in Python or a similar language * Understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and how AI/ML workloads are deployed and secured within it * Clear communicator who can translate technical risk into terms non\-security stakeholders understand * Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, post\-merger environment where systems, priorities, and structures are still evolving **NICE TO HAVE** * Experience securing systems in a regulated healthcare or life sciences environment (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) * Familiarity with LLM security frameworks and tools, such as MITRE ATLAS, Garak, or promptfoo * Security certifications such as OSCP, GCIH, or CISSP * Experience red\-teaming or penetration\-testing AI/ML systems specifically **Pre\-Employment Drug Screening:** This position is subject to a pre\-employment drug screening, where permitted by applicable law. Any required screening will be conducted after a conditional offer of employment and in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. **Benefits \& Perks:** \- **Competitive compensation** \- **Remote\-first** Work from anywhere in US. We also provide a one\-time home office stipend to set up your workspace, plus a monthly Wi\-Fi reimbursement. **\- Flexible work** Flexible scheduling and core collaboration hours (10:00 AM – 3:00 PM ET), giving you space for both deep work and real life. \- **Company\-wide offsite** We invest in connection—join us for an annual offsite to collaborate, build relationships, and have some fun together. \- **Time off that you’re expected to use** Flexible PTO designed for real recharge, plus 17 company holidays, paid sick leave, and paid parental leave. \- **Comprehensive health coverage** Choose from multiple medical plan options with significant company premium contributions, along with dental (including orthodontia) and vision coverage for you and your family. Includes company contributions to HSA/FSA accounts (based on plan selection). \- **Financial wellness** 401(k) with company match to help you plan for the future. *Interra Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *Interra Health is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.* Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $165,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Solutions
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The AI Solutions \& Transformation team builds the engineering backbone that turns Intuit's commercial strategy into production AI systems — the agentic pipelines, creative tooling, and automation that let the business move at the speed AI now demands. As Principal, you own the engineering organization behind that work: you lead the broader product development team, and you're accountable for the technical direction, delivery quality, and growth of everyone building inside this team. This is not a maintain\-the\-roadmap role. The AI landscape this team builds against changes every quarter — sometimes every month — and the job is to build a team that treats that as normal rather than disruptive: ship something real, learn fast from what the model, the tooling, or the business actually needs, pivot without drama, and build again. You'll be the person who decides what's worth doubling down on, what gets killed, and how a group of engineers and engineering leads keeps shipping enterprise\-grade AI solutions while the ground underneath them keeps moving. You'll report into GBSG Commercial organization, and you'll work in close, daily partnership with the AI Solutions product management team, who own the product bets this engineering organization builds against. That means part of the job is translating between two worlds: you need enough technical depth to set direction, make build\-vs\-pivot calls, and earn credibility with your engineers — and enough business fluency to turn product management's priorities into a technical roadmap, and explain what the team is building, and why it matters, in terms a commercial, brand\-first audience immediately understands. **Responsibilities** ### **Lead the engineering organization** * Manage and grow a team of engineering contractors and FTEs to leading the product development squads building the team's AI systems. * Set the technical direction and engineering quality bar across the full AI Solutions \& Transformation portfolio. * Own the build\-pivot\-kill calls: decide where the team doubles down, where it cuts losses, and where it re\-architects as new models, tools, and business priorities emerge. * Build the org's structure and capacity plan so it can run multiple concurrent AI initiatives without you being the bottleneck. ### **Own delivery and impact** * Be accountable for the delivery, reliability, and quality of the AI systems your organization ships into production for the commercial business. * Turn ambiguity into an execution plan: take loosely defined, fast\-changing product priorities from the AI Solutions product management team and convert them into a staffed, sequenced build plan for your team. * Establish the operating cadence — planning, prioritization, and review — that keeps a fast\-iterating AI team shipping rather than thrashing. * Serve as the escalation point for technical, delivery, or resourcing issues that need a group manager's judgment and authority to unblock. ### **Partner across the business** * Partner day\-to\-day with the AI Solutions product management team as your primary counterpart — translating product priorities into a staffed technical roadmap, and surfacing technical tradeoffs, risk, and pivots back to them in terms they can act on. * Represent engineering to brand and other cross\-functional partners on progress, risk, and the pivots the team is making and why. * Build trust with non\-technical stakeholders by communicating clearly, not just correctly. ### **Build the practice** * Establish engineering practices suited to rapid AI iteration: fast experimentation, clear criteria for scaling or killing a bet, and reusable infrastructure so each new capability ships faster than the last. * Set the hiring bar and run the interview loop for engineers and engineering leads joining the team during a period of rapid growth and change. * Coach and develop the managers and leads on your team, including Ashton and Jaga, and own their performance and career growth. **Qualifications** **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time leading engineering managers or leads (Group Manager / Senior Manager level), not just individual contributors. * Hands\-on technical depth in modern AI and agentic systems — LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration and tool use, prompt engineering * A track record of shipping production AI systems, not demos or proofs of concept, under real delivery pressure. * Demonstrated comfort with fast, repeated iteration: building something, learning it's wrong, pivoting without losing the team's momentum, and building again. * Experience managing engineering within or adjacent to a commercial, brand, or marketing organization, with the ability to translate business and brand goals into technical execution. * Strong stakeholder management and the judgment to partner with senior, non\-technical executive leadership. * Experience scaling a technical practice: hiring, leveling, interview loops, and engineering standards. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Preferred** ------------- * Experience building enterprise\-grade AI solutions: RAG pipelines, multi\-agent systems, content generation, compliance/QA automation, or similar agentic tooling. * Background in fintech, SaaS, or brand/creative technology. * Experience leading a team through a significant strategic or organizational pivot. * Experience managing managers specifically, rather than only a team of individual contributors. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: San Diego $247,500 \- $335,000

jobs.title: Staff AI Scientist (Fintech Risk AI/ML)
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **The team** ------------ Money Movement Risk AI/ML is a team of AI scientists and ML engineers in Intuit's Fintech Risk organization. Our models decide, in real time, whether money moves for small businesses on QuickBooks: card and ACH payments, money coming in, money going out, when funds are released, and how long a payment is held. Every decision has two failure modes. Approve the wrong transaction and Intuit takes a fraud or credit loss. Decline or hold the right one and a small business waits for money it has already earned. Our job is to push both down at the same time. Our mandate: **AI touches every money movement risk decision.** That covers deciding (authorize, fund, release), acting on the decision (queue, investigate, hold), and accounting for it (expected loss). **The role** ------------ You will be the technical owner of one money movement risk capability: its models, its evaluation, its production health, and its business outcome. You will design, train, validate, and ship the models yourself, and you will set direction for the scientists and engineers who build with you. This role is for an AI producer. You will build new models from first principles and put them in front of live money. It is not a role for wiring an existing LLM into a product surface. **What you will work on** ------------------------- Depending on fit and team needs, you will own one or more of these areas: * **Authorization risk.** Real\-time fraud and loss models that approve, decline, or step up card and ACH transactions, for both money coming in and money going out. * **Funding and settlement risk.** Models that decide when funds are released and how long payments are held or delayed, so good customers get paid faster and risky payments are caught before money leaves. * **Balance and account\-level money risk.** Risk on stored balances and on the accounts behind them, as more money stays inside Intuit. * **Day\-1 risk for new money products.** Risk decisioning that is ready when a new payment or funding product launches, often with almost no labeled history. * **Agentic money movement.** Transaction risk for payments and money actions initiated by AI agents and assistants: agent identity, consent, and intent. * **Risk\-ranked queueing.** Ranking cases for risk operations by dollars at risk, so analysts spend time where the loss is. **Responsibilities** **What you will do** -------------------- * **Own outcomes, not just models.** Define success in loss, approval rate, hold rate, and time\-to\-funds. Ship models that move those numbers, and own them in production. * **Solve the hard statistics of risk.** Delayed and noisy labels (chargebacks and returns arrive weeks later), extreme class imbalance, and selection bias from models whose decisions shape their own training data. Use holdouts, reject inference, and counterfactual evaluation to measure what actually happened. * **Build for adaptive adversaries.** Detect fraud rings, account takeover, and new attack patterns with graph, sequence, and anomaly\-detection methods. Test models against attackers who probe, retry, and adapt. * **Make models production\-grade.** Partner with ML engineers on real\-time features, low\-latency serving, automated retraining, and monitoring for drift, data quality, and loss. * **Turn Intuit's data into an advantage.** Build reusable, versioned features and labels from transaction, account, and network data that other models on the team can build on. * **Set the evaluation bar.** Establish offline and online evaluation, experimentation, and adversarial testing standards for your area. * **Lead across functions.** Work with risk policy, product, engineering, risk operations, and finance. Explain trade\-offs between loss and friction in plain terms and drive decisions. * **Raise the team.** Mentor senior and early\-career scientists and engineers, lead design and model reviews, and help hire. **Qualifications** **What you bring** ------------------ **Required** * 8\+ years building and deploying ML models in production, including significant work in fraud, payments, credit, or another adversarial or financial\-risk domain. * MS or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * A track record of owning models that made real\-time, high\-stakes decisions, with measured business impact. * Deep expertise in gradient\-boosted trees, deep learning, and anomaly detection, plus the statistics to validate them: calibration, imbalance, delayed labels, and selection bias. * Strong Python and SQL, and hands\-on large\-scale feature engineering with Spark or similar. * Experience shipping models with ML engineers: real\-time features, serving, retraining, monitoring. * Sound experimental judgment in a risk setting: A/B tests, holdouts, and their limits when attackers can exploit them. * Clear communication with risk, product, and business leaders. **Preferred** * Payments risk experience: card and ACH authorization, funding, chargebacks, returns, or settlement. * Graph ML or network analysis for fraud rings and collusion. * Sequence or representation learning on transaction and behavioral data. * Experience building or evaluating LLM and agentic systems, especially for risk or operations. * Model risk management and explainability in a regulated financial\-services environment. * Experience leading a technical area across teams and mentoring scientists. **Why join** ------------ * **Your work moves real money.** Your models decide whether small businesses get paid, and how fast. * **Hard problems.** Millisecond decisions, adaptive attackers, labels that arrive weeks late, and models that shape their own training data. * **Full ownership.** Scientists here own their models from problem framing to production. Nobody hands you a spec. * **An AI\-native risk org.** We are building toward AI making every money movement risk decision, and this role helps define how. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: ITHAKA's mission is to expand access to knowledge and education around the world. Our services — JSTOR, Portico, and Ithaka S\+R — enable people everywhere to learn, to grow, and to overcome barriers to education. In carrying out our mission, as employees we feel a deep responsibility to members of our community and to each other, and we are committed to building and sustaining a culture where everyone can thrive. **Level** --------- Depending on experience and qualifications, ITHAKA is open to considering candidates in the following levels: **Lead Level, Lead** Software Engineer: * Expected to bring strong technical skills and adaptability, with opportunities to grow into leadership or more autonomous roles. * Focuses on hands\-on contributions and learning through collaboration on challenging projects. * 5\+ years of experience **Principal level,** Principal Software Engineer**:** * Expected to lead with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of complex initiatives and driving innovation. * Will mentor other engineers, contributing to their growth and the team's overall expertise. * Plays a key role in shaping strategic goals and optimizing workflows for scalability and impact. * 12\+ year of experience **The Role** ------------ ITHAKA is looking for a Lead / Principal Software Engineer to lead the technology vision for JSTOR's Business platform team for Books and Royalty Payments. As part of ITHAKA, JSTOR helps researchers, educators, students, and lifelong learners around the world discover and engage with trusted scholarly knowledge. In this role, you'll shape the future of the books on JSTOR. As the senior technical leader for backend engineering, you'll remain an active technical contributor while combining hands\-on engineering with long\-term architectural leadership. You'll define and evolve the backend architecture, distributed systems, search platform, APIs, data pipelines, and engineering practices that power scalable, reliable experiences across JSTOR. You'll influence technology direction across multiple engineering teams, mentor other engineers and technical leaders, and apply strong product thinking to align backend strategy with user needs, product vision, business priorities, system quality, and long\-term platform health. **Responsibilities** -------------------- ### **Technology Strategy \& Architecture** * Define and drive the multi\-year backend technology strategy and architectural roadmap for the Books and royalty payment platforms, aligning engineering investments with user needs, product strategy, organizational priorities, and long\-term platform goals. * Lead architectural decisions across multiple engineering teams, building alignment through technical leadership and influence rather than formal authority. * Evaluate emerging backend, AI, and distributed systems technologies, translating them into pragmatic recommendations that improve products, platforms, developer productivity, scalability, and maintainability. * Apply product thinking to balance long\-term platform evolution with near\-term product delivery, making thoughtful tradeoffs across user impact, business value, engineering quality, reliability, operational complexity, developer productivity, and cost. * Drive architectural consistency across teams through shared technical direction, engineering standards, and reusable platform capabilities. ### **Backend Platform Engineering** * Lead the architecture and evolution of ITHAKA's royalty payment and fulfillment backend platforms: the distributed services, APIs, batch and scheduled processing, and data integrations behind JSTOR's books and archive licensing. * Design, build and improve highly available ordering and digital book fulfillment systems using Java, Spring Boot, Maven, MySQL (Flyway, stored procedures), and Redis, with attention to schema design, query performance, idempotency, scalability, resiliency and observability. * Drive practical use of AI in engineering and operations: AI\-assisted development and code review, anomaly detection on order and payment flows, and LLM\-assisted support and diagnostics. * Adopt organization\-wide strategies for analytics, experimentation, observability, service reliability, and platform operations that enable continuous product improvement. * Define engineering health metrics and platform success measures, such as order SLA attainment, error and recovery rates, end\-to\-end latency, and reconciliation accuracy, to guide long\-term technical investment. * Improve backend quality, developer experience, platform reliability and operational excellence. ### **Technical Leadership \& Innovation** * Lead by example through hands\-on engineering, architecture, and operational excellence on complex backend, partner, and platform challenges. * Build reusable services, frameworks, tooling, platform capabilities, and engineering practices that improve developer productivity, software quality, and delivery effectiveness. * Mentor e d architecture documents that led to adopted decisions. * Track record of owning the architecture of systems where correctness has direct financial consequences, such as order management, billing, payments, royalties, or revenue systems. * Deep practical experience with consistency in distributed and integrated systems: idempotent processing, deduplication, outbox and event\-driven patterns, reconciliation, and recovery from partial failure. * Experience incrementally improving a production platform while it continues to serve the business, such as moving business logic out of the database or batch jobs, or decomposing and consolidating services. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems (CRM, Finance, tax engines) and with external partners through file\-based and API\-based contracts. * Demonstrated ability to define and drive reliability programs with measurable outcomes, including SLOs, operational metrics, and incident practice. * Preferred: domain experience in publishing, digital content licensing, royalty or rights management, or revenue operations. **Work Authorization and Sponsorship** -------------------------------------- ITHAKA is not currently considering candidates who require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) to work in the United States. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- At ITHAKA we believe in openness and fair pay. Part of living those values is our commitment to clarity about salary ranges, so candidates know what to expect. The starting salary for the lead level position ranges from $129,076 to $161,345 per year and the starting salary for the Principal level position ranges from $148,437 \- $185,547 per year. Starting pay may vary with job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. At present, our total compensation package for benefits\-eligible employees includes medical, dental, and vision plans, an employer\-paid 10% retirement contribution, paid parental and caregiver leave, 22 days of paid time off, 11 paid holidays, up to 12 paid sick days, wellness benefits, and more. Please note that ITHAKA, at its discretion, may make changes to its benefits programs from time to time. **Work for ITHAKA** ------------------- We are committed to our organizational values of belonging, evidence, speed, teamwork, and trust. We take seriously the need for everyone to feel welcome. Belonging is one of our core values, and it shows in our vibrant culture. People from a wide range of backgrounds work at ITHAKA, and we believe that unique perspectives help us realize new insights and build better solutions. We want to work with people who are passionate about ideas like these and who wish to contribute their perspectives and talents to ITHAKA's mission. We enthusiastically welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and credentials. We want to hear your story and include your perspective in the transformative work we aim to do. Learn more about Working at ITHAKA. **Apply Now** ------------- Although ITHAKA has physical offices in New York and Ann Arbor, Michigan, our employees are distributed across the continental United States. At this time, we're not considering candidates who are unable to work and reside in the continental U.S. Candidates may apply by submitting an application online through our career site, if you have any questions about your application, please contact us at careers@ithaka.org. ITHAKA is committed to providing reasonable accommodations, if there's anything we can do to accommodate any portion of the application or hiring process, please contact us at accommodations@ithaka.org. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to identity or other status protected by law. We invite you to read our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement. ITHAKA cares about your privacy, learn more about our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Senior Full\-Stack Java Engineer will architect, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications while driving cloud modernization initiatives. This role bridges robust legacy architectures—including enterprise batch systems, server\-side web platforms, and mainframe integrations—with cloud\-native microservices on AWS. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in Java/Spring and Oracle database persistence with modern event\-driven architectures, automated test pipelines, and AI\-assisted development workflows. **Work Environment** -------------------- **Salary**: $95\-$100K **Role Type**: Remote **Experience Level**: 7 years Java experience, 3 years Full Stack experience **Program Context** =================== **Background and Introduction** Customer Inquiry and Claims Response System (CICRS) is used by the indemnity claims process to provide customers with an efficient means of settling their claims and service refunds. Provides an efficient process for settling indemnity claims and service refunds for insured mail, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. CICRS is designed to pay or deny indemnity claims against the Postal Service when there is loss or damage to insured articles in the mail stream. Once a claim is received into the CICRS system, the claim data is processed, and a determination is made to pay or deny the claim within 2 days. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Full\-Stack \& Batch Engineering:** Architect and deliver resilient RESTful APIs, batch processing services, and web user interfaces using Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and established web frameworks (Struts, JSP, jQuery). **Cloud \& Microservices Modernization:** Deconstruct and migrate monolithic/legacy application components into event\-driven microservices utilizing Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS native services (EC2, ECS, SQS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB). **Mainframe Integration \& Migration Strategy:** Collaborate cross\-functionally with mainframe engineers, enterprise architects, and Java teams to design data contracts, migration plans, and real\-time/batch integration patterns. **Test Automation \& Quality Engineering:** Build and enforce comprehensive automated testing suites across the software lifecycle, utilizing Playwright for end\-to\-end and functional testing, alongside unit, regression, and performance frameworks. **DevOps \& Continuous Delivery:** Maintain and optimize CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins and Git; deploy and operate containerized applications across cloud infrastructure. **Modern Tooling \& Productivity:** Accelerate delivery velocity and maintain code consistency using cutting\-edge developer tooling, specifically GitHub Copilot and VersionOne for Agile lifecycle management. **Qualifications** ================== **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Must expertise in building RESTful API Applications with promises of high throughput, strong resilience, and secure controls * Must be expert in web page development, including Struts, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSP, HTML, JQUERY, CSS, JSON, etc. * Must expertise in Java, including J2EE, Spring framework, and Struts to maintain and expand current applications. * Must expertise with Kubernates, containerized micro\-services, event\-driven application with Kafka. * Must experience in writing functional tests with automation testing framework, like Playwright **Required Experience** * **7\+ years** of professional Java software development experience, including at least **3 years** in full\-stack engineering. * Proven track record architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise web applications and high\-throughput batch systems. * Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle database design, complex SQL query development, and ORM persistence using Hibernate within the Spring Framework. * Solid background in cloud engineering, deployment automation, and DevOps workflows on AWS. * Comprehensive experience implementing test jobs.description: **King Abdullah University of Science and Technology: Postdoc Positions: Physical Science and Engineering Division (postdoc): Energy Resources and Petroleum Engineering (Postdoc)** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ### **Location** King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) ### **Open Date** Jun 29, 2022 ### **Description** Geological Carbon Storage (GCS) is an important geo\-solution to mitigate the increasing global carbon emission in order to meet the goal of Paris Climate Agreement. For the purpose of GCS management, numerical simulators with coupled physics (flow/reactive/geo\-mechanics/thermal) have been developed and often applied to predict the long\-term fate of the injected carbon dioxide to ensure its secure containment. The prohibitively high computational cost of such simulations necessitates the development of efficient and robust surrogate models for general GCS modeling tasks, especially when inverse modeling tasks require high\-frequency evaluations of forward models, in order to quantify the uncertainties of rock and fluid properties in the subsurface formations. Therefore, the objectives of this research project include two aspects: (1\) based on the cutting\-edge technologies from deep learning, computer vision or physics\-informed machine learning, develop robust surrogate forward models to predict the coupled physical process of GCS, such that we can efficiently forecast the spatial\-temporal patterns of the subsurface response variables, e.g., pressure, saturation, minerals etc.; (2\) integrate the surrogate forward models with a Bayesian inverse modeling framework to achieve real\-time or near\-real\-time uncertainty quantification, such that we can efficiently resolve the uncertainties rising from rock and fluid, and thus improve our understanding about of GCS systems. ### **Qualifications** **Education:** A Ph.D. degree in computational mathematics, reservoir/petroleum engineering, machine learning or closely related fields. The candidate must have completed all Ph.D. requirements by commencement of the appointment and be within 5 years of completion of the Ph.D. **Minimum Job Requirements:** (1\) Experience in computational subsurface flow and transport modeling (2\) Experience with code development (3\) Publications in refereed journals and record of successful research in a collaborative team environments **Desired Qualification:** (1\) Experience with Python (2\) Experience in scientific machine learning, deep learning and computer vision (3\) Experience in CCUS modeling with numerical reservoir simulators such as CMG, Eclipse, MRST or TOUGH\-React (4\) Experience in inverse modeling and uncertainty quantification ### **Application Instructions** Applications are sought for a one\-year postdoc position (extendable) and will work closely with an industrial partner. The position will include a competitive salary based on the candidate’s qualifications; benefits include medical and dental insurance, free furnished housing on the KAUST campus, annual travel allowance to visit home country, annual paid vacation, and other generous benefits. The successful applicant will be affiliated with the Ali I. Al\-Naimi Petroleum Engineering Research Center (ANPERC) at KAUST. ### **Application Process** This institution is using Interfolio's Faculty Search to conduct this search. jobs.description: **King Abdullah University of Science and Technology: Postdoc Positions: Physical Science and Engineering Division (postdoc): Material Science and Engineering (postdoc)** -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ### **Location** King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) ### **Open Date** Jun 03, 2026 ### **Deadline** Dec 03, 2026 at 11:59 PM Eastern Time ### **Description** **Postdoctoral Research Positions in Colloidal Quantum Dots for Infrared Photodetectors** The FuN Lab at KAUST has made significant advances in III–V colloidal quantum dots (CQDs) and extended\-SWIR PbS materials for high\-performance infrared photodetectors and imaging systems. We invite applications for two postdoctoral positions focused on next\-generation SWIR and room\-temperature MWIR photodetectors based on III–V, Ag₂Te, and related CQDs. The project aims to establish a materials\-to\-device platform using InAs\-, InSb\-, Ag₂Te\-, and extended\-SWIR PbS/PbSe\-based CQDs, with emphasis on surface reconstruction, ligand engineering, precursor chemistry, energetic band alignment, low\-trap\-density CQD solids, and novel infrared photodetector architectures. The first position focuses on CQD synthesis and surface chemistry, including solution\-phase ligand exchange and thin\-film engineering. The second position focuses on novel infrared photodetector architectures incorporating metasurfaces and optical\-field manipulation for high\-performance SWIR and exploratory room\-temperature MWIR detection. Candidates should hold a PhD in chemistry, materials science, electrical engineering, applied physics, or a related field, with expertise in colloidal nanocrystal synthesis or optoelectronic device physics. Experience in III–V CQDs, infrared photodetectors, surface spectroscopy, thin\-film processing, or low\-noise optoelectronic measurements is highly desirable. This position focuses on the chemical control of III–V CQD surfaces. The researcher will develop surface\-reconstructed, low\-trap\-density CQDs and ligand\-exchanged CQD inks for infrared photodetectors. The central goal is to understand and control how precursor reactivity, surface stoichiometry, ligand engineering, and electronic passivation determine charge transport, recombination, band alignment, and photodetector performance. **Key Objectives** * Establish surface reconstruction strategies for InAs, InSb, and SWIR/MWIR\-active CQDs to suppress trap states and improve electronic quality. * Build ligand libraries for electronic passivation, controlled doping, and improved interdot coupling. * Develop solution\-phase ligand exchange processes for stable III–V CQD/nanorod inks. * Control precursor reactivity, nucleation, growth, alloying, and shell formation. * Determine energetic alignment between CQD films and charge\-transport layers. * Correlate surface chemistry with optical, electronic, and photodetector properties. **Responsibilities** * Synthesize III–V CQDs using air\-free colloidal methods. * Design and optimize precursor chemistry for InAs\-, InSb\-, Ag₂Te\-, and PbSe/PbS\-based nanocrystals. * Perform surface reconstruction and ligand\-exchange studies. * Develop solution\-processed CQD inks with controlled ligand density and colloidal stability. * Characterize CQD surfaces using XPS, UPS, FTIR, NMR, TEM, XRD, absorption, PL, and time\-resolved PL. * Fabricate CQD thin films and evaluate morphology, conductivity, trap density, and stability. * Study band alignment between CQDs and charge\-transport layers. * Work closely with the device\-focused postdoc to connect surface chemistry with detector performance. * Prepare manuscripts, contribute to grant reports, and present results at scientific meetings. **Successful candidates are expected to:** * Work independently while contributing to a collaborative research program. * Maintain rigorous experimental records and reproducible protocols. * Develop mechanistic understanding beyond empirical optimization. * Publish in high\-impact journals in materials chemistry, nanoscience, and optoelectronics. * Mentor graduate students and contribute to a strong laboratory culture. * Communicate results clearly in manuscripts, presentations, and group meetings. ### **Qualifications** * PhD in chemistry, materials science, nanoscience, or a related field. * Strong experience in colloidal nanocrystal synthesis. * Demonstrated expertise in air\-free synthesis and Schlenk/glovebox techniques. * Experience with ligand exchange, surface passivation, or nanocrystal surface chemistry. * Familiarity with optical and structural characterization of semiconductor nanocrystals. * Strong publication record in nanomaterials, colloidal quantum dots, or optoelectronic materials. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team. **Preferred Experience** * Direct experience with III–V CQDs, especially InAs, InSb, or alloyed III–V nanocrystals. * Experience with solution\-phase ligand exchange. * Knowledge of trap\-state analysis, surface reconstruction, and electronic passivation. * Experience with XPS/UPS\-based surface and energy\-level analysis. * Experience preparing CQD thin films for photodetectors, LEDs, or solar cells. ### **Application Instructions** We will only accept applications through Interfolio. Submissions by email to the PI or any team member will not be considered. ### **Application Process** This institution is using Interfolio's Faculty Search to conduct this search. jobs.title: Client Technical Solutioner
jobs.description: **Who We Are** At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities. **The Role** **Customer Technical Solution Engineer** ---------------------------------------- At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage, and modernize the mission\-critical technology systems that the world relies on every day. Our technical solutioning and engineering teams sit at the leading edge of this mission, turning complex enterprise challenges into resilient, high\-value technical outcomes. As a Customer Technical Solution Engineer, you will combine the outcome\-driven strategic leadership of a solution architect with the hands\-on building power of a forward\-deployed engineer. You will take technical ownership across the entire engagement lifecycle, guiding solutions from the first customer conversation to a validated production outcome. You will operate directly with customer executives, architects, and engineering teams across both pre\-deal strategy and post\-signature delivery. In this role, you will move seamlessly between strategic architecture workshops, rapid prototyping, commercial solution modeling, and live implementation environments to ensure technical decisions deliver real business value. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Solution Discovery and Architecture** * Work directly with customer business and IT leaders to uncover core objectives, technical pain points, and strategic priorities. * Translate complex and ambiguous business problems into clear technical solution hypotheses and actionable architectures. * Design resilient, secure, scalable, and operationally viable enterprise architectures using Kyndryl offerings, intellectual property, and partner capabilities. * Present and defend key architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and business outcomes before customer executive teams and technical specialists. Align technical solution blueprints directly with measurable business outcomes and long\-term customer success. * **Hands\-On Prototyping and Engineering** * Build working prototypes, minimum viable products, and proofs of value to validate architectural assumptions and accelerate decisions. * Design, integrate, and deploy REST APIs, automation workflows, and modern cloud applications using Python, Linux, and container platforms. * Develop and implement practical AI\-enabled workflows, agentic solutions, and intelligent automation to solve enterprise integration challenges. * Collaborate directly in code alongside customer and internal engineering teams to resolve complex technical hurdles quickly. Incorporate customer feedback rapidly into technical builds to iterate and evolve solutions toward production readiness. * **Commercial Solutioning and Risk Management** * Translate technical architectures into practical, deliverable, and commercially viable solutions. * Define solution scope, resource plans, delivery assumptions, and cost cases to support profitable deal structures. * Identify and mitigate technical, architectural, and delivery risks prior to contractual commitment. * Support solution defense and commercial negotiations alongside sales and account leadership through contract closure. Ensure all proposed architectures strike the right balance between cutting\-edge innovation, cost efficiency, and delivery feasibility. * **Production Deployment and Industrialization** * Stay engaged beyond the design phase to assist consulting and delivery teams with deployment and live environment validation. * Test and verify critical architectural integrations in customer production environments to confirm performance and stability. * Gather operational insights and client feedback to refine and optimize deployed systems. * Transform bespoke customer implementations into repeatable architecture patterns, code assets, and accelerators. Mentor fellow architects and engineers, sharing field lessons to continuously enhance Kyndryl service offerings and go\-to\-market strategies. * **Who You Are** --------------- You are an adaptable technical leader who thrives at the intersection of enterprise architecture, hands\-on software engineering, and strategic consulting. You are not satisfied with designing systems only on paper; you take pride in testing ideas with real code and seeing your solutions run reliably in live customer environments. You bring a strong growth mindset, eager to master new technologies, build agentic systems, and expand your skills across modern platforms. You are deeply customer\-focused, ensuring that every engineering choice delivers tangible business value and operational stability. Open, borderless, and naturally inclusive, you partner comfortably across disciplines, practices, and global teams, creating  * Knowledge of designing architectures for cloud environments, hybrid infrastructure, and integrating diverse systems * Experience supporting sales efforts by collaborating with account teams, preparing sales materials, participating in customer presentations, and contributing to proposal development * Experience leading solutions through the complete lifecycle from pre\-deal ideation through production implementation and operational handover * Certifications in major hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud) * Technical certifications in Kubernetes (CKA or CKAD) or enterprise AI systems Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * The compensation range for the position in the U.S. is $156,360 to $296,880 based on a full\-time schedule. Your actual compensation may vary depending on your geography, job\-related skills and experience. For part time roles, the compensation will be adjusted appropriately. The pay or salary range will not be below any applicable state, city or local minimum wage requirement. There is a different applicable compensation range for the following work locations: California (San Francisco Bay Area): $187,560 to $356,280 California (All Other): $171,960 to $326,520 Colorado: $156,360 to $296,880 Massachusetts: $156,360 to $326,520 New York City: $187,560 to $356,280 Washington: $171,960 to $326,520 Washington DC: $171,960 to $326,520 This position will be eligible for Kyndryl’s discretionary annual bonus program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Kyndryl’s applicable plans. You may also receive a comprehensive benefits package which includes medical and dental coverage, disability, retirement benefits, paid leave, and paid time off. Note: If this is a sales commission eligible role, you will be eligible to participate in a sales commission plan in lieu of the annual discretionary bonus program. Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. **Being You** Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single\-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way. **What You Can Expect** With state\-of\-the\-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well\-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company\-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non\-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed. **Get Referred!** If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.description: ***Lead with Purpose, Unlock Your Team’s Passion*** At LPL, people leaders hold the key to the employee experience — shaping culture, driving performance, and guiding individuals to new heights. Because when that happens, we all win – clients, LPL, and most importantly our, employees. If you're ready to lead with intention and discover what’s possible, LPL Financial invites you to apply today. **Job Overview:** As an AVP, Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, cloud\-native applications, including solutions that incorporate **AI and Generative AI capabilities**. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, building modern user experiences, APIs, microservices, and AI\-enabled workflows that solve business problems. This role requires strong software engineering fundamentals along with hands\-on experience leveraging **LLMs, AI services, and agentic technologies** within enterprise applications. **Responsibilities**: * Design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack applications using modern front\-end frameworks such as **React or Angular** and back\-end technologies such as **C\#, Java, or Python**. * Build and integrate **AI/GenAI capabilities** into enterprise applications using LLMs, APIs, AI services, and agentic workflows. * Design and implement **RESTful APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native services**, integrating applications with AI models and enterprise data sources. * Develop solutions utilizing concepts such as **prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings/vector search, tool/function calling, and AI agents**, where appropriate. * Partner with product owners, architects, business analysts, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical and **AI\-enabled solutions**. * Write clean, secure, maintainable, testable code and participate in code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and engineering best practices. * Evaluate and leverage AI\-assisted development tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar tools** to improve development productivity and code quality. * Troubleshoot application and AI\-integrated production issues, perform root cause analysis, and improve application reliability, performance, and observability. * Mentor engineers and contribute to technical direction, engineering standards, and the responsible adoption of emerging AI technologies. **AI \& GenAI Engineering Expectations** * Hands\-on experience integrating **LLMs or Generative AI capabilities into applications**, rather than solely using AI productivity tools. * Experience working with enterprise AI services or platforms such as **AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Amazon SageMaker, or comparable technologies**. * Understanding of **prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases/search, function/tool calling, and agentic AI patterns**. * Ability to develop and integrate AI services through **APIs, SDKs, and microservices** within existing enterprise applications. * Understanding of **AI security, privacy, responsible AI, model evaluation, observability, and production considerations**. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools such as **GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar platforms**. **What are we looking for?** ---------------------------- We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work. **Requirements:** ----------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum of 7 **years of progressive software engineering experience**, with strong hands\-on full\-stack application development experience. * Strong development experience with a modern front\-end framework such as **React or Angular** and at least one back\-end language such as **C\#, Java, or Python**. * Demonstrated experience designing and developing **APIs, microservices, and cloud\-native applications**, preferably within AWS. * **Hands\-on experience integrating AI/Generative AI capabilities into software applications**, including experience with LLM APIs/services and familiarity with RAG, prompt engineering, vector search/embeddings, or AI agents. **Core Competencies:** ---------------------- * Experience with **AWS**, including services supporting modern application and AI architectures such as Bedrock, Lambda, API Gateway, EKS, and related services. * Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases and familiarity with **vector databases or semantic/vector search**. * Experience with **Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and DevOps practices**. * Understanding of enterprise AI considerations including **security, privacy, responsible AI, model evaluation, monitoring, and production reliability**. * Financial services experience is preferred. * Experience in the financial services industry is a plus. \*\* This is a **hybrid role**, requiring onsite presence at our **Charlotte/Fort Mill or NYC/Midtown** office **2–3 days per week**, as much of the team and leadership are based there. **Pay Range:** $140,500\.00 \- $234,100\.00### Actual base salary varies based on factors, including but not limited to, relevant skill, prior experience, education, base salary of internal peers, demonstrated performance, and geographic location. Additionally, LPL Total Rewards package is highly competitive, designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play – such as 401K matching, health benefits, employee stock options, paid time off, volunteer time off, and more. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that LPL has to offer! **Company Overview:** LPL Financial Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: LPLA) is among the fastest growing wealth management firms in the U.S. As a leader in the financial advisor\-mediated marketplace(6\) , LPL supports over 32,000 financial advisors and the wealth management practices of approximately 1,100 financial institutions, servicing and custodying approximately $2\.3 trillion in brokerage and advisory assets on behalf of approximately 8 million Americans. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. At LPL, independence means that advisors and institution leaders have the freedom they deserve to choose the business model, services, and technology resources that allow them to run a thriving business. They have the flexibility to do business their way. And they have the freedom to manage their client relationships, because they know their clients best. Simply put, we take care of our advisors and institutions, so they can take care of their clients. For further information about LPL, please visit www.lpl.com. Join the LPL team and help us make a difference by turning life’s aspirations into financial realities. Please log in or create an account to apply to this position. Principals only. jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer/Business Analyst
jobs.description: Description: **Job Type** Full\-time **Description** *NOTICE: JOB APPLICANTS LIMITED TO DC, MD, OR VA RESIDENTS. POSITION IS HYBRID.*This position requires candidates to be local to the Washington, DC metropolitan area. Applicants must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of our headquarters and be able to meet the position's onsite work requirements. *Be part of Lafayette Federal Credit Union, recognized by USA Today as a Top Workplace for three consecutive years (2024–2026\)* We are expanding and looking for exceptional talent to support our members and contribute to our reputation as an employer of choice. Be a key player in our mission to become the premier financial partner for our community. Your skills and dedication are essential to our success. Build the Future Workforce of Lafayette Federal Credit Union Exceptional organizations are built by exceptional people. At Lafayette Federal Credit Union, we believe our future success depends on our ability to attract, develop, engage, and retain outstanding talent. As we continue to grow, invest in our people, and strengthen our organizational capabilities, we are creating a new leadership opportunity to help shape the future of our workforce. We believe the future of work will be driven by people who embrace curiosity, continuous learning, and responsible innovation, supported by technologies – including artificial intelligence – that enable our employees to work more effectively, make better decisions, and deliver exceptional experiences for our members. We're looking for leaders who see AI not as a replacement for people, but as a tool that empowers people to do their best work. **Why Lafayette Federal** **Our Difference**: Lafayette Federal Credit Union is not only a great place to bank, but also a great place to build a career. We have received national recognition, including placement on Newsweek’s America’s Best Banks list, a five\-star rating from Bauer Financial, and recognition by S\&P Global among top\-performing credit unions. **Our Culture**: Lafayette Federal values inclusion, diversity, high performance, teamwork, and community. Every employee brings a unique set of skills, and we share a commitment to serving our members and giving back through charitable activities throughout the year. It is a collaborative, mission\-driven environment where strong ideas and thoughtful leadership can make a lasting impact. **Our Opportunities**: Professional development, training, and certification are priorities for our employees. We support career growth and provide opportunities for advancement within the financial services industry, helping talented people continue to grow while doing meaningful work for our members and communities. **The Opportunity** Help turn dependable data into actionable insights. This role will help Lafayette Federal maintain a reliable data platform while evolving the capabilities that support reporting and analytics across business units. You will help us answer important questions: * How do we keep data pipelines and reporting systems available and reliable? * How do we bring core banking data, APIs, and flat files into OneLake? * How do we maintain consistent data models across loans, deposits, and general ledger domains? * How do we enable dashboards and ad hoc analysis that support business users? * How do we identify data anomalies and improve the platform’s future\-state architecture? This position offers the opportunity to contribute to the technical foundation and analytics capabilities that support teams across the organization. **What You Will Lead** Platform Ownership \& Maintenance You will maintain and strengthen Lafayette Federal’s data platform by: * Ensuring high availability and reliability of data pipelines and reporting systems built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. * Implementing monitoring for pipeline failures, performance issues, and data anomalies. * Contributing to the data platform roadmap and future\-state architecture. Data Engineering \& Integration You will support the flow and structure of data across the organization by: * Ingesting data from core banking systems, APIs, and flat files into OneLake. * Maintaining and evolving data models across business units, including loans, deposits, and general ledger domains. * Supporting reliable data pipelines that enable scalable analytics. Analytics Enablement You will help business users turn data into insights by: * Partnering with business users to support dashboards and ad hoc analysis. * Developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using Tableau or similar business intelligence tools. * Supporting the reporting and analytics needs of leadership and business stakeholders. Organizational Partnership Success in this role requires strong collaboration across the organization. You will work at the intersection of data engineering, platform operations, and business analytics, translating business needs into practical data solutions and fostering effective relationships with technical and business stakeholders. You will work alongside: * The SVP of Finance \& Accounting to support department priorities and carry out related duties as assigned. * Business users and leaders across the Credit Union to maintain data models and support dashboards, reporting, and ad hoc analysis. * Technical stakeholders to support reliable platform operations, data integration, and continuous improvement. As directed by management and/or the SVP of Risk Management, you will complete all annual mandated training applicable to your position accurately and on time, including Bank Secrecy Act, Anti\-Money Laundering, OFAC, Cybersecurity, Diversity \& Anti\-Harassment, and Fair Lending requirements. **Why This Role Matters** Reliable platforms keep data moving. Well\-maintained data models and accessible analytics help teams put that data to work. This role brings those capabilities together. If you are looking for the opportunity to strengthen a modern data platform, partner across business units, and support meaningful insights, we would love to hear from you. **Pay** $91,325\.0400 $114,156\.3000 \- Annually depending on experience and qualifications Requirements: **Who You Are** * You are both technically focused and business\-minded. * You understand that a data platform is more than a collection of pipelines—it is a foundation for reliable reporting and scalable analytics. * You are comfortable collaborating with technical stakeholders and helping business users translate their needs into data solutions. * You build sound relationships, communicate effectively, and can influence, motivate, and train others while handling sensitive information with care. * Most importantly, you value dependable data and the practical insights it enables. **What You'll Bring** * Five to eight years of similar or related experience. * A bachelor’s degree, or formal industry\-recognized certifications considered equivalent to a bachelor’s degree, such as qualifying information technology certifications. * The ability to maintain and evolve a data platform built on Microsoft Fabric and Azure. * The ability to support data engineering and ETL workflows that ingest core banking data, APIs, and flat files into OneLake. * The ability to maintain and evolve data models across business units, including loans, deposits, and general ledger domains. * The ability to develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Tableau or similar business intelligence tools. * The ability to monitor pipeline reliability, performance, and data quality and contribute to continuous improvement. * Strong relationship\-building, communication, influencing, and training skills to support technical and business stakeholders. **What We Offer** * Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits * Retirement savings and employer contributions * Generous paid time off * Professional development and continuing education opportunities * A collaborative, mission\-driven culture * The opportunity to help shape the future of an organization with a proud history and an exciting future Lafayette Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity and E\-Verify Employer. EOE/AA/Disability/Veteran

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description: **What is special about Lighthouse?** Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. You bring deep eDiscovery and data\-pipeline expertise, a proven track record of owning a complex platform roadmap, and the ability to lead and coach other product managers through influence. You combine long\-range strategic thinking (what we build, and why) with hands\-on product judgment, and you make the cross\-pillar trade\-offs that a connected data flow requires. You are a trusted advisor to senior leadership and raise the standard of product craft across the organization, starting with how we write specifications and run discovery and prioritization. Have demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, architecture, technical program management, operations, consulting, marketing, sales, and customer success, to ensure alignment and successful execution of product initiatives. Have demonstrated ability to align stakeholders at every level, including where you do not hold formal authority. **What will this person do?** * Own the product strategy and roadmap for the pillar (collections, intake, processing, and the data platform), meeting market needs while optimizing revenue, margin, and market share. Work with those partners to resolve trade\-offs and investment levels. * Answer the cross\-cutting questions that span the pillar's four areas and its neighbors, such as how legacy capabilities evolve and how data platform decisions shape every other pillar's roadmap and align requirements with the teams affected. * Lead the product managers in the pillar as a team lead without line management: set priorities and quality standards, coach and mentor, give structured feedback to their managers, and take part in hiring and onboarding. * Raise the bar on product management craft: set the standard and templates for specifications and requirements documents, discovery, prioritization, success metrics, and launch readiness; review and coach on specifications; and prove the practices in the pillar before extending them across the organization in partnership with Product Management leadership. Measure improvement over time, including feedback from the Engineering and Architecture teams who build from the specs. * Lead product specifications (Market and Product Requirements Documents) for the most strategic initiatives, competitive intelligence, and engagement of necessary cross\-functional resources. * Develop business cases for new products and major platform investments, including cost structure, ROI, and build, buy or integrate decisions. * Set AI product strategy for the pillar, deciding which AI capabilities to build, buy or integrate for processing and data workflows, and champion AI\-augmented product management workflows across the team. * Partner with Engineering leadership on platform architecture, scalability, reliability, security, and cost, and drive continuous communications among Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Consulting, Marketing, and Sales disciplines. * Define and report the KPIs for the pillar (for example throughput, time to ready, quality, reliability, unit cost and adoption), use them to adjust the roadmap, and present data, recommendations, and strategy to executive leadership. * Engage directly with enterprise clients and delivery teams to understand how data is collected, ingested, and processed in practice, and translate that into product direction. * Participate in joint activities with the marketing organization including portfolio planning, brand strategy, customer and competitive research, and marketing communications. Represent Lighthouse in client advisory boards, industry forums, and partnerships, with tradeshow support and participation as needed. **Bring your passion and together we will shine. It would a ity to lead, coach and develop product managers without formal authority, and to influence and align stakeholders at every level, including partners outside the reporting line. * Strategic AI leadership: sets AI product strategy for a portfolio, makes build, buy or integrate decisions, and understands model lifecycle trade\-offs (validation, deployment, drift) as well as AI governance and regulatory trends. * Strong technical background with the ability to evaluate architectural trade\-offs and engage engineers and architects on design decisions. * Proven strategic planning ability and strong business and financial acumen (including understanding of return on investment, cost structures, and budgets), with a track record creating end\-to\-end business plans and models that support profitable growth. * Experience managing executive expectations and presenting strategy and KPIs to executive teams and enterprise clients. * Surfaces risks early and clearly, owns outcomes rather than activity, and brings grit, a preference for action and a collaborative, service\-minded approach. * Performs other related duties as requested. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree a plus. * 10\+ years of demonstrated success in product management, including experience leading or mentoring other product managers (formal people management not required), and a track record of owning the full product lifecycle from concept to launch across multiple products. * Deep experience in eDiscovery, legal technology, or enterprise data platforms, including long\-range product strategy (2–3\-year horizons) and navigating platform migration or convergence. * Demonstrated experience introducing product management practices, including specification standards, in an established team and sustaining their adoption. * Experience with product management in a service business, and Product Management certification, a plus. **Work Environment and Physical Demands** * Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table. * Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting. * Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends). jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Research Engineer, Pre-Training Data
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ San Francisco **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- Research \& Engineering Overview **About Liquid AI** ------------------- Spun out of MIT CSAIL, we build general\-purpose AI systems that run efficiently across deployment targets, from data center accelerators to on\-device hardware, ensuring low latency, minimal memory usage, privacy, and reliability. We partner with enterprises across consumer electronics, automotive, life sciences, and financial services. We are scaling rapidly and need exceptional people to help us get there. **The Opportunity** ------------------- You'll join the Pre\-Training Data team, which decides what Liquid Foundation Models learn from: which data we source, filter, synthesize, and mix, and in what order. Public data sources are plateauing, so model quality increasingly depends on purpose\-built datasets and on knowing which data changes actually help. We treat data as a research problem, not an infrastructure problem. You'll work alongside our pre\-training researchers on a small team, run the experiments that settle data questions, and build the pipelines that carry the answers into training runs. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We need someone who: * **Thinks like a researcher, ships like an engineer:** You build the pipelines and you make the model\-facing calls about what goes into them. You don't hand off either half. * **Leads with a hypothesis:** Before changing a dataset, you can say what it should do to the model, what you'll measure, and what could fool you, such as contamination or a noisy benchmark. You hold views on pre\-training pitfalls, and you test them. * **Owns problems end to end:** You take ambiguous work from open question to shipped result with little direction or process, do the unglamorous parts that get it there, and don't care whose job it was. **The Work** ------------ * Source web\-scale and public datasets, and build the pipelines that filter, deduplicate, and decontaminate them * Design data mixtures and curricula for pre\-training and midtraining, and decide what goes into each run * Build synthetic data generation systems using LLMs, structured prompting, and distillation to cover what web data can't * Run proxy experiments and ablations to measure what each data change does to model quality, and decide what scales up * Build evaluation sets you can trust, and keep data lineage clear enough that any training run can be traced and reproduced **Experience \& Capabilities** ------------------------------ **What you'll need:** * Deep, hands\-on pre\-training data work you did yourself: web\-scale sourcing and curation, synthetic data generation, mixing and curriculum design, deduplication and decontamination. This is where depth matters most. * The ability to reason from a data decision to its effect on training: how data interacts with model size, architecture, and training dynamics, why more data can hurt, and which changes matter as models scale * Experiments you designed to test data changes, such as baselines, scaling ladders, small\-scale proxies, and held\-out loss, with a clear account of what a change did and why * Production data pipelines you built and owned, not only research prototypes * Solid ML fundamentals: you've trained, evaluated, and iterated on models in Python (PyTorch preferred) * 3\+ years of relevant experience with an M.S., 1\+ year with a Ph.D., or 5\+ years with a B.S. **Helpful, not required:** * Distillation, long\-context, or architecture\-specific data strategy * Designing evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for pretrained models * Data work across both pre\-training and post\-training * Small, efficient models or on\-device deployment * Startup experience, or a track record of connecting model work to product needs **What Success Looks Like (Year One)** -------------------------------------- * You own a critical pre\-training data pipeline end to end * Data systems you built or improved have measurably moved model performance * You've identified and integrated at least one external dataset that moved the needle **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Upstream of every model:** Pre\-training data shapes every Liquid Foundation Model. On a small team, the mixtures, filters, and synthetic data you build go straight into the models we ship. * **Compensation \& Equity:** Competitive base salary plus equity, so you share in what we build. Final offers reflect skills, experience, and location. * **Time Off:** Unlimited PTO, plus company\-wide Refill Days, long weekends when the whole company rests together. * **Health \& Wellbeing:** Comprehensive health coverage, with details varying by location. * **Paid Leave:** Paid leave for pregnancy, parenting, medical needs, and caring for family.
