jobs.title: Sales Enablement and Operations Lead
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like — and we're just getting started. We build AI that handles complex, high\-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot\-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do. We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex\-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds — which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes. Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia — many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters. If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact — this is the place. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring our first Sales Enablement \& Operations team member. Our go\-to\-market team is growing fast (AEs, a new BDR team, demand gen, and a GTM Engineer), and the systems, processes, and knowledge that got us here were built by founders on the fly. This role exists to turn that into a real operating engine: one where every rep ramps quickly, knows exactly how to tell the Lorikeet story, and spends their time selling instead of fighting the CRM. You'll own training, operations, and process not just for sales, but for our Forward Deployed team too. We sell into regulated, high\-stakes businesses, and our buyers are sharp. A Head of Support at a telehealth company wants to know how the AI handles a compliance edge case; a fintech CX leader wants proof it won't get someone's money stuck. Our reps need to go deep on product, industry, and objections, and you'll be the person who makes sure they can. You'll sit at the centre of sales, marketing, product, and our Forward Deployed team, and you'll own both sides of the job: the *enablement* (onboarding, playbooks, messaging, coaching) and the *operations* (CRM, pipeline hygiene, forecasting, reporting, tooling). **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Own onboarding and training for every new GTM and Forward Deployed hire. Design a ramp program that gets AEs, BDRs, and Forward Deployed team members confident in front of customers in weeks, not quarters * Build and maintain the sales playbook: ICP and personas, discovery frameworks, qualification criteria, objection handling, competitive positioning, and vertical\-specific plays for fintech, healthtech, marketplaces, and delivery * Turn product launches and customer wins into enablement: talk tracks, demo flows, case studies, and battlecards reps actually use * Own the CRM as the source of truth: pipeline stages, required fields, deal hygiene, and the automations that keep it clean without nagging * Run the pipeline and forecasting cadence with sales leadership: weekly pipeline reviews, dashboards, and the metrics that tell us where deals stall and why * Manage the GTM tool stack (CRM, sequencing, call recording, enrichment, etc.) and decide what we add, cut, or build ourselves * Partner with our GTM Engineer to build AI\-powered workflows with Claude Code: deal summaries, call insights, account research, automated CRM updates, rep coaching * Use call recordings and win/loss data to spot patterns, coach to them, and feed what you learn back into product and marketing * Support territory planning, quota setting, and comp plan mechanics as the team scales **You might be a fit if you:** ------------------------------ * Understand what it takes to sell, whether from a sales role yourself or from working closely alongside reps in enablement or ops (ideally in B2B SaaS) * Have experience building an enablement program from the ground up * Are equally at home running a training session and building a pipeline report. You like both the people side and the systems side * Get genuinely annoyed by messy data and broken processes, and fix them rather than work around them * Can take a complex, technical product and make it simple for reps to explain (and for buyers to understand) * Are already using AI to automate parts of your work and want to go much further (bonus points if you've built something for yourself or your team) * Are comfortable owning things end\-to\-end without a playbook, because you'll be writing it * Earn trust with reps by making their lives easier, not by adding process for its own sake **Nice to have:** experience selling into or enabling teams that sell to customer support / CX leaders, or into fintech, healthcare, or other regulated industries. **What's unique about this opportunity?** ----------------------------------------- **A culture that's genuinely different.** Low ego, high trust, no tolerance for talented jerks. We work efficiently, keep hours flexible, and actually mean it — because life outside work matters. We're committed to building a diverse team and actively encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds. We care far more about user obsession and eagerness to learn than traditional credentials. **A front\-row seat to building something meaningful.** We're Series A and moving fast. You'll have real scope to shape the product and the company — not just execute someone else's vision. **Performance recognized in real time, not on a calendar.** Promotions happen when you're ready — leadership meets every six weeks specifically to identify and recognize strong performers, so you're never waiting for an arbitrary review window to move up. **We're AI\-native, and we'll make you AI\-native too.** Every person at Lorikeet uses AI in their day\-to\-day work (current favourite: Claude Code), with unrestricted access and no usage limits. You'll leave with skills that matter for the next decade of work. **Twice a year, the whole company flies to Hawaii.** Headquartered in Sydney, with teams spanning the US and UK — which means getting everyone in the same place is something we invest in seriously. We spend the time hacking on ideas, building things together that wouldn't otherwise exist, and making memories that remind you why you joined a startup in the first place. **A recruitment process built on respect, not hoops.** We keep it simple: a couple of informal chats to share our story and hear yours, followed by a paid \~two\-day work trial. The work trial is genuinely the best part — you'll work on real problems alongside the actual team, get a true feel for how we operate, and we'll both come out of it knowing whether this is the right fit. No trick questions, no take\-homes that disappear into a void. Just real work, done together. If you're from an underrepresented background and don't tick every box, please reach out anyway. We know firsthand that diverse teams perform better, and we're proud that our team reflects a broad spectrum of identities and lived experiences.

jobs.title: Transport Engineer
jobs.description: About Us: MTS Quanta, a **Quanta Services, Inc.** (NYSE: PWR) company, has a rich history spanning over a century, providing transportation and logistics solutions. Our current mission is focused on expanding this legacy to encompass specialty logistics for infrastructure contractors across various sectors. jobs.description: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Join the DRAM Technology Development team at Micron to influence the future of memory technology. Based at the NY CREATES Albany NanoTech Complex, we create breakthrough innovations that drive future DRAM scaling! Our work involves sophisticated patterning, novel materials, new device architectures, and High\-NA EUV lithography. You will work with leading equipment suppliers, research institutions, and Micron’s global development teams to solve difficult semiconductor technology problems and guide the strategic direction of memory technology! **Position Summary** -------------------- As a DRAM Pathfinding \& Process Integration Engineer, you will lead early\-phase technology investigation and process integration for next\-generation DRAM architectures. You will define structural, electrical, and manufacturability requirements for future memory technologies and translate these requirements into coordinated process solutions. Collaborating with device engineering, lithography, dry etch, thin films, CMP, metrology, modeling, and manufacturing teams, you will assess technology options, speed up learning, and lower technical risk before concepts move into formal development programs. We partner with NY CREATES and strategic ecosystem collaborators to assess new process technologies and build innovative solutions that allow future DRAM scaling beyond standard roadmaps. This role supports the build and deployment of AI\-enabled solutions that accelerate engineering learning, improve data interpretation, and enhance technology decision\-making. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Technology Pathfindin**g * Lead investigation of upcoming DRAM technology concepts, materials, and process architectures. * Assess innovative scaling approaches supported by High\-NA EUV and sophisticated patterning technologies. * Develop learning plans and technology evaluation approaches that speed up development decisions. * Develop key knowledge that impacts Micron's future memory technology roadmap. **Advanced Process Coordination** --------------------------------- * Develop and integrate novel process flows enabling next\-generation DRAM technologies. * Establish structural, electrical, reliability, and design\-rule criteria for advanced memory architectures. * Lead process improvement efforts across lithography, etch, films, CMP, metrology, and device engineering teams. * Balance performance, manufacturability, yield, reliability, and cost objectives. **High\-NA EUV Development** ---------------------------- * Partner with lithography and process development teams to enable future High\-NA EUV patterning solutions. * Evaluate process interactions affecting pattern fidelity, overlay performance, stochastic defectivity, and yield. * Identify integration needs for upcoming DRAM scaling approaches. * Work together with suppliers and research partners to evaluate emerging lithography capabilities. **Data Analytics \& Learning Acceleration** ------------------------------------------- * Build and complete DOE plans and technology learning experiments. * Analyze electrical, defectivity, metrology, reliability, and yield data using sophisticated statistical methodologies. * Leverage AI\-assisted analytics and modeling techniques to accelerate process learning. * Communicate technical findings, risks, tradeoffs, and strategic recommendations to technical and business leadership. **Ecosystem Teamwork** ---------------------- * Work directly with NY CREATES, equipment suppliers, and strategic research collaborators. * Lead technical discussions involving future technology requirements and capability development. * Support joint development activities while safeguarding Micron intellectual property. * Influence investment and development priorities through technical leadership. **Technology Transfer** ----------------------- * Support the transition of successful pathfinding concepts into technology development and production. * Drive alignment between development, integration, and manufacturing organizations. * Document critical learning, technical assumptions, risks, and recommendations. * Ensure strong technology preparedness for upcoming DRAM generations. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Master's degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years of semiconductor industry experience in process integration, process development, device engineering, or advanced R\&D. * Strong understanding of memory technologies including DRAM, NAND, SRAM, and emerging memory architectures. * Extensive knowledge of semiconductor device uppliers, and research partners. * Play a key role in advancing Micron's long\-term technology leadership strategy. **About the Albany Group** -------------------------- The Albany team supports Micron’s High\-NA EUV and next\-generation memory pathfinding within the NY CREATES research ecosystem. The organization links Micron’s technology\-development priorities with the people, tools, operating systems, suppliers, and partner capabilities needed to complete experiments safely, efficiently, and with high\-quality learning. This role offers the opportunity to develop the operating foundation for a strategic development site and directly give to Micron’s future DRAM technology roadmap. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who lives and breathes Azure Cosmos DB and knows how it is implemented underneath. Your mission is to make throttling disappear from Microsoft's AI plugin registry with fast, surgical, high\-ROI changes. Success is objective: throttling goes away, reliability goes up, and latency goes down, even as scale grows. You will see the results in days, not quarters. We are the Agent Tools and Lifecycle team in Microsoft's Copilot, Agents and Platform (CAP) organization. We build the service behind the AI plugin registry. Admins use it in the Microsoft 365 admin center to govern the plugins (skills, connectors, and agents) that extend Microsoft Copilot, and users discover and use those plugins across products such as Copilot Chat, Cowork, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. The registry is a core part of Microsoft's AI architecture, alongside Work IQ, and Copilot experiences across Microsoft depend on it. If you use an AI solution from Microsoft, you likely are working with our service. Come join us at the center of AI transformation at Microsoft! As a hands\-on individual contributor, you will be the technical leader for the AI plugin registry's Azure Cosmos DB tier. Our catalog of plugins and agents, and the entitlements and policies that decide who can use them, live in Cosmos DB in data centers worldwide, including sovereign clouds. Traffic keeps growing as the registry expands to experiences such as Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Foundry. Experience working on the internals of Cosmos DB or a comparable database, such as MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, and an understanding of the hardware and network limits that make them throttle, are especially valuable. Our global reach means 24/7 on\-call service. This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities*** Cut request unit (RU) consumption to make throttling go away, fast. Start with the queries that use the most RUs, where we see room for 50–90% reductions: turn cross\-partition and fan\-out queries into point reads from Cosmos DB or Azure Blob Storage, batched reads, or single\-partition queries, and tune indexes. * Pick work by return on investment. Ship several targeted fixes in parallel, each within days, and measure each one in production. Take on a larger redesign only when the data shows smaller fixes cannot get there, and deliver it in steps that each pay off. * Fix hot partitions and size limits at the source: partition keys, document design, indexing policies, and API contracts that give high\-traffic calls the keys they need for point reads. When data has to move, migrate it with zero downtime across all environments, including sovereign clouds. * Decide what belongs in Cosmos DB. Move large, binary, unbounded, or rarely queried content to Azure Blob Storage or other storage, weighing latency, availability, and data\-residency needs. * Remove redundant and sequential database calls on our busiest paths with batching, request coalescing, and caching, and use retry budgets, load shedding, and graceful degradation so database pressure does not turn into failed requests. * Work with product management and the teams that call us to give each caller a throttling budget. Find callers that request the same unchanged data again and again, help them cache on their side, and lower the budgets of the heaviest callers over time. * Make success measurable: own the telemetry, dashboards, and alerts, RU use per API and per caller, partition skew, availability, and latency. Set targets, show the effect of every change, and spot limits before we hit them. * Raise the bar through AI: write AI skills that review designs and code for Cosmos DB mistakes, find high\-RU queries, and show engineers how to fix them, so your expertise scales across the team. Use agentic tools to build and validate fixes faster, following Responsible AI practices. Mentor engineers and represent us with the Azure Cosmos DB product group. * Serve as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) in our 24/7 on\-call rotation, lead data\-tier incident response, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes. **Qualifications** ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or l field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. * 4\+ years of experience building or operating large\-scale distributed databases, such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, including partitioning, indexing, and query performance. * Experience finding and fixing throttling, hot partitions, or resource\-heavy cross\-partition queries in production databases. * Experience building or improving the internals of Azure Cosmos DB, or of a comparable distributed database such as MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, in areas such as partitioning, replication, storage engines, query execution, indexing, or rate limiting. * Deep, hands\-on Azure Cosmos DB expertise: what drives the RUs each operation uses, physical partitions and splits, hierarchical partition keys, indexing policies, point reads and ReadMany versus cross\-partition queries, change feed, consistency levels, multi\-region accounts, autoscale, SDK (software development kit) retries, and diagnosing errors. * Track record of making throttling go away quickly, raising availability, and cutting tail latency in production, with targeted, high\-ROI changes and before\-and\-after measurements to prove it. * Deep understanding of why distributed databases throttle, from per\-partition throughput and storage limits to hardware, network, and replication overhead, and how to design data models that stay within those limits. * Experience moving large or rarely queried content from a document database to Azure Blob Storage or comparable object storage, and serving it with point reads. * Experience with zero\-downtime data migrations and re\-partitioning on live production systems. * Experience designing rate limits, quotas, and noisy\-neighbor isolation for a multi\-tenant platform, and getting partner teams to cache on their side. * Proficiency in C\# and .NET, and experience with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Service Bus, Azure Cache for Redis, and API (application programming interface) Management. * Understanding of modern AI technologies, including generative AI and foundation models, and experience writing AI skills and using agentic tools to engineer faster. year. jobs.title: Senior Power and Thermal Architect
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology and amazing people. Today, we're harnessing the boundless possibilities of AI to build the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brain of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Accomplishing unprecedented goals calls for imagination, inventiveness, and exceptional talent from around the world. As a NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, encouraging environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world. NVIDIA designs the silicon behind AI, accelerated computing, and graphics. Power and thermal architecture decisions sit behind every watt of performance and every degree of thermal headroom! We are the Silicon Co\-Design Group (SCG). We are hiring a Senior Architect to scout the research and industry landscape, identify emerging system\-level co\-design ideas in power and thermal, and drive them across teams into product differentiation across NVIDIA's roadmap. This role shapes system, platform, and datacenter feature/behavior, and partners with teams across Nvidia. SCG scope spans across architecture, design, software, operations, platforms, and productization. **What you'll be doing:** * Architect next\-generation system, platform, and datacenter\-level power and thermal co\-design solutions. Scan internal research, academia, standards bodies, and silicon, memory, packaging, and platform partners for what is emerging. * Build the product differentiation case for each candidate idea, performance, power, reliability, schedule, cost, and brainstorm what is worth pursuing. * Lead end\-to\-end co\-design from concept to product. Drive alignment across architecture, VLSI, software, platform, packaging, and operations teams to land selected technologies in production. * Shape innovation across workload\-aware power and thermal controls, closed\-loop platform telemetry, datacenter\-class power compliance, platform\-scale energy buffering, advanced cooling intercepts, and emerging memory co\-design. * Maintain a living intercept pipeline. Track candidates, productization status, decision gates, and product axes. Brief SCG and broader NVIDIA leadership on what is next. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend & Integrations, TypeScript)
jobs.description: **Software Engineer (Backend \& Integrations, TypeScript)** **Role Overview** At Neurotrack, our mission is to transform the diagnosis and prevention of Alzheimer’s and related diseases by giving people direct access to the most effective, most broadly available, scientifically validated digital assessments and therapeutics to prevent cognitive decline. You’ll be a backend engineer on our API platform, working closely with our Director of Engineering. We run several REST APIs on serverless AWS Lambda, backed by DynamoDB, all written in TypeScript. You’ll help us build them, run them, and keep them healthy, and you’ll give the team real depth on the systems our products depend on. We also run a rich portfolio of integrations with our healthcare customers: SFTP file exchange on AWS, HL7 interfaces, and our Partner API. Integrations will be your first focus. You’ll learn each of these approaches in detail: the steps, the options, and the trade\-offs. Then you’ll work hand in hand with our Customer Success team and with customers’ technical teams to pick and refine the right approach, build it, test it, and see it through to go\-live. **How We Work** * **Fast and together.** We live in Slack. We help each other throughout the day, keep each other unblocked, and regularly surprise ourselves with how fast we can go. * **AI\-native.** We practice spec\-driven development and use Claude for much of the execution, with humans in the loop at all the right steps. * **Quality and privacy first.** Our product is Software as a Medical Device, and we operate under a Quality Management System. Our commitment to quality, privacy, and the people we serve shapes how we build. **Key Responsibilities:** *APIs \& Platform* * Design, build, and extend features across our TypeScript REST APIs on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB. * Design and document APIs with OpenAPI so they’re reusable across current and future products. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions. * Instrument and monitor services with Datadog, and help triage, diagnose, and fix production issues. *Customer Integrations* * Own customer integrations end to end: scope them with Customer Success and the customer, configure or implement them, test them, and take them live. *AI\-Supported Development* * Write specs, collaborate with Claude to execute them, and review the results with care. * Keep work and knowledge current in Jira and Confluence. **Qualifications:** *Required:* * 5\+ years as a software developer, with significant backend API experience. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js. * Hands\-on AWS experience; Lambda, DynamoDB, and serverless architectures are a strong plus. * Experience with GitHub Actions and with designing APIs using OpenAPI. * Comfort working directly with customers and partners on technical integrations. * Solid grounding in software design: clean architecture, domain\-driven design, design patterns. * Experience using AI coding tools in your day\-to\-day work, or real eagerness to work that way. * A focus on quality and collaboration, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-moving environment. *Preferred:* * Healthcare integration experience (HL7, FHIR, SFTP\-based data exchange). * Experience with Auth0 and Datadog. * Experience in a regulated environment (medical device, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or similar). **Working at Neurotrack** * Location: Remote (US) * Schedule: Full\-time * Travel: Minimal * Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD), equity options, unlimited PTO, and a wellness account. At Neurotrack, you’ll be part of a mission\-driven team committed to improving lives through better brain health. You’ll work with innovative technology, collaborate with passionate colleagues, and make a real impact on the systems and integrations that connect our platform to the healthcare organizations we serve.

jobs.title: Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description: **Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture** ============================================== Remote – Western US (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred) **Why Us** NewRocket is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and a Claude Select partner, helping enterprises reimagine how work gets done with ServiceNow and AI. We work with public and private sector organizations, including some of the world's biggest brands, to simplify processes, remove complexity, and turn the promise of AI into measurable business outcomes. We are *"Raising the Bar"* in delivering technology's promise to create new kinds of experiences for our customers. Our Core Values: Excellence, Creativity, Integrity, Teamwork and Empathy ***\#ExCITE***. At NewRocket, these values guide everything we do: they are the foundation of our culture and define how we ***Go Beyond*** for our clients. **The Role** **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture to be the technical leader on our client engagements, working alongside our forward deployed engineers as they build and deploy agentic AI inside complex enterprise environments. This is a billable, client\-facing consulting role. Large enterprises don't run on one system. They run on decades of layered platforms: ERP backbones like SAP and Oracle, service and workflow platforms like ServiceNow, CRM, HR and finance suites, custom integrations, data warehouses, and the identity and security controls that hold it all together. Agentic AI only creates value when it can work safely inside that landscape: reading the right data, taking the right actions, respecting approvals and access controls, and leaving an audit trail that satisfies IT, security and compliance. On each engagement, you're the person who understands that landscape. You map the client's systems, translate their business goals into the architecture and requirements agents need, and lead the forward deployed engineers through it as they build, so workflows make it out of pilot and into the client's production environment. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Lead engagements technically.** Serve as the senior technical leader on client engagements, setting architecture direction and guiding the forward deployed engineers who are building alongside you. * **Map the client's system landscape.** Quickly get to grips with each client's environment, including ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, custom systems and the integrations between them, and turn it into a clear picture the engineering team can build against. * **Translate business processes into agent\-ready requirements.** Work with client process owners to break down workflows like incident resolution, procure\-to\-pay, order\-to\-cash and employee onboarding into the tasks, data, decisions, permissions and human approval points an agent must handle. * **Design how agents connect to systems of record.** Define the integration approach for each engagement: APIs, integration platforms, event streams, MCP and tool\-calling layers, and data access patterns. * **Get workflows into production.** Navigate the client's environments, change management, release processes, testing, monitoring and support handoff so agentic workflows move from pilot to production. * **Clear the path with security and governance.** Design identity and access models for agents (service accounts, least privilege, delegated authority), audit logging and controls, and win sign\-off from client CISOs, risk teams and auditors. * **Advise senior client stakeholders.** Act as a trusted architecture advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and platform owners, and identify where agentic workflows can expand into new use cases. * **Strengthen the practice.** Turn what you learn on engagements into reusable blueprints, integration playbooks and readiness assessments, and share field insight with our product and engineering teams. **What you bring** ------------------ * 7 to 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture or technical leadership roles within large, complex enterprise software environments. * Deep hands\-on knowledge of at least two major enterprise platforms, such as ServiceNow, SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), Oracle (Fusion, E\-Business Suite, OCI), Salesforce or Workday, including their data models, APIs, extension frameworks and upgrade constraints. * Strong grounding in enterprise integration: REST and SOAP APIs, middleware and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite or similar), event\-driven architecture, and master data management. * Practical experience with AI or automation in production, such as LLM\-based applications, agentic workflows, RPA or intelligent automation, and a clear point of view on where agents fit and where they don't. * Proven track record moving enterprise systems from design to production, including environment management, SDLC and change control, testing, monitoring and operational support. * Solid understanding of enterprise security and governance: identity and access management, SSO and OAuth, role\-based access, audit, and regulatory requirements such as SOX, GDPR or HIPAA. * Client\-facing consulting experience, such as at a Big Four firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG), Accenture or another global systems integrator or enterprise software vendor's professional services team, including working in a billable delivery model and advising executive stakeholders in plain business terms. * Experience serving as technical lead for engineering teams on delivery engagements, guiding engineers who are building while staying hands\-on enough to unblock them. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Location and travel** ----------------------- * You must live in the Western United States, in the Mountain or Pacific time zone. * You must be willing to travel up to 75% to client sites. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, or platform certifications (ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect, SAP or Oracle architect certifications). * Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use and function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation and agent evaluation methods. * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks). * Experience working alongside forward deployed engineering teams, or in a similar embedded delivery model. * Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, public sector or manufacturing. * Public thought leadership: talks, writing or published reference architectures on enterprise AI. **What success looks like** --------------------------- This is a billable, client\-facing consulting role. You'll be embedded on customer engagements alongside our forward deployed engineers, serving as the architecture lead who helps the team navigate complex enterprise system landscapes. * **Engagement delivery:** You consistently meet billable utilization targets and are the go\-to architect on our most complex client engagements. * **Landscape mastery for the team:** On each engagement, you quickly map the client's system landscape (ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle and the integrations between them) and give forward deployed engineers a clear path through it: where the data lives, which APIs and controls apply, and who owns what. * **Production outcomes:** Agentic workflows you architect reach the client's production environment, with sign\-off from their IT, security and risk teams. * **Client trust:** Clients see you as a senior advisor, leading to engagement extensions, expanded scope and referenceable outcomes. * **Repeatable delivery:** Patterns, integration playbooks and readiness assessments from your engagements are reused across the practice, making each new deployment faster. **We Take Care of Our People** NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, citizenship, military, or Veteran status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact hr.us@newrocket.com.

jobs.description: Staff Software Test Engineer Location: Austin, TX, United States Category: Technology Job ID: 3351 Apply Now Description Staff SDET — Consumer Quality Enablement Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. About the Role We have an exciting opportunity for an innovative Staff Engineer in Test to join our RDC team. The charter for this team is to build and deliver innovative solutions across the real\-estate ecosystem that deepen relationships with industry players, consumers, and brokers/agents. This role is part of Quality Enablement team. Consumer Quality Enablement is a platform team — not embedded in any single product squad but responsible for the quality infrastructure that serves the entire Consumer Engineering organization: 30\+ scrum teams, 400\+ repositories, and five surfaces (Web, iOS, Android, Backend Services). We operate as Quality\-as\-a\-Service. Our job is to build systems, frameworks, and tooling that make it easier for product engineers to ship with confidence — without requiring a dedicated QA resource on every team. We govern, audit , create paved path and enable engineers with tools , process, framework , reporting and governance What You'll Do As a Staff SDET on Consumer Quality Enablement, you are the technical backbone of how we build, evolve, and enforce quality infrastructure at scale. You own the design and delivery of the test frameworks, AI\-powered tooling, and quality\-gate systems that the broader engineering org depends on. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage people directly, but you will set technical direction, establish standards, and pull other engineers — inside and outside the team — toward higher\-quality practices. What You'll Own AI\-Powered Quality Tooling * Evolve the Genesis AI test\-case generation platform — coverage expansion, prompt engineering, model selection, accuracy measurement. * Build and maintain the AI RCA (Root Cause Analysis) pipeline that surfaces incident and test\-failure context automatically. * Develop the Test Fix Agent: automated triage, flakiness detection, and patch suggestion for failing tests in CI. * Define the evaluation harness and quality metrics for all AI tooling — precision, recall, engineer adoption. Test Framework Infrastructure (Paved Path) * Own the "Paved Path" for Web (Playwright\-based) and Mobile (Appium/iOS XCUITest/Android Espresso) — the opinionated, zero\-config test setup that product teams clone to get started. * Define the layered testing contract: unit integration E2E thresholds per surface. * Build and maintain shared test utilities, fixtures, data factories, and environment\-management tooling. * Integrate with CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI) so quality gates run reliably on every PR with no manual setup from product teams. Quality Gate Enforcement Platform * Design and operate the quality\-gate system: code coverage gates, PR review gates, build stability gates. * Build enforcement tooling that moves gates from advisory to blocking — with clear escalation paths and override controls that don't silently waive standards. * Instrument and surface gate compliance metrics (repos gated, gate\-fail\-merge rate, PR coverage trends) so engineering leadership has a live quality signal. * Drive SonarCloud configuration hygiene: quality profiles, branch rules, coverage ingestion, and gate\-scoring across all 100\+ repositories. Quality Observability * Define and own the quality metrics taxonomy: escape rate, main\-branch stability, attestable coverage (vs. reported), review depth, incident detection ratio. * Build dashboards and alerting so EMs and leads get a team\-level quality picture without manual data collection. * Partner with the incident management process to close the loop from production incident root cause coverage gap remediated test. Technical Leadership * Author and maintain the quality engineering standards playbook for Consumer Engineering. * Run architecture reviews for test infrastructure decisions in product squads. * Mentor senior STEs and SWEs on test design, framework usage, and quality patterns. * Represent Consumer Quality Enablement in cross\-functional engineering forums (release, platform, architecture). What We're Looking For * 8\+ years of software development or SDET experience with at least 3 years at staff/senior staff scope. * Production\-quality engineering skills: you write code that ships to a shared platform, not scripts that live in a test folder. * Deep experience with at least two of: Playwright/WebdriverIO, XCUITest, Espresso — and a clear framework philosophy, not just syntax familiarity. * Experience designing test frameworks from the ground up — including fixture management, test data strategy, environment isolation, and parallelization. * Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and how quality gates integrate into merge workflows. * Familiarity with AWS services used in CI/CD and data pipelines (Lambda, S3, Bedrock) — enough to own the infrastructure your tooling runs on. * Experience with contract testing (Pact or equivalent) and API\-level quality tooling for microservice or GraphQL architectures. * Hands\-on experience building and evaluating LLM\-powered applications, including eval harness design, production model integration, test\-generation quality measurement, and regression prevention across model upgrades. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, code review, observability, and reliability for internal platforms. * Ability to influence without authority at scale — your platform serves hundreds of engineers; you write docs, run office hours, and make it easy to do the right thing. * Experience in a platform/enablement team that served multiple product squads. * Familiarity with SonarCloud, Xray, or other quality gate and test management tooling. * Python and TypeScript fluency (our AI tooling stack and web test stack respectively). * Prior work building quality metrics systems — escape rate, flakiness rates, coverage trends — not just dashboards but the data pipelines behind them. * Mobile app testing experience across both iOS and Android platforms * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Nice to Have * Prior experience in Performance testing for Native apps * Performance and Load testing basic understanding Success in this Role Success here is not measured by test count or coverage percentage alone. It is measured by whether the engineering organization ships with more confidence. The challenge isn't finding bugs; it's building systems that catch the right bugs at the right time automatically. * You think at the system level, not the ticket level. * You don't need to be an expert in all of it — but you need to be genuinely curious about all of it. * You are as comfortable in a data pipeline as you are in a test framework. * You solve problems top\-down. * You are a force multiplier, not a ticket\-taker. * You are comfortable with ambiguity and willing to get your hands dirty. * You learn fast, form hypotheses, ship something small, and iterate. * You are the kind of engineer who makes the team around you better. * You give direct technical feedback. You write things down. * You make it easy for product engineers to do the right thing without asking. jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations. Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI\-assisted solutions and 30\+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other. The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it. This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- **NuBrain** — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30\+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful. **New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale**. As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally. **Canonicalizing what already exists.** Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds. **Deciding the shape of the answer.** Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Architect and build the systems design at Nu runs on — increasingly agentic ones. * Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable. * Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function. * Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow\-up. * Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you. * Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade\-offs legible to people who don't read code. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **An outstanding, deeply experienced AI engineer.** This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on, and recent years working with AI models on things like token consumption, rate limiting, response latency, MCP servers, and other modern AI engineering challenges. **A track record architecting UX systems.** Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front\-end infrastructure used by many teams. **A love for design that shows up in your work.** Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them. **Agentic systems that help design scale.** Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role. **A protagonist.** You'll serve a 260\-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project. **Evidence you've shipped.** Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio. ### **Backgrounds that tend to fit** * Design systems and UI platform engineers at design\-led product companies. * Engineers at design tooling companies. * Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public. * Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design\-led product. ### **What this role is not** * Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar. * Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core. * Not customer\-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function. * Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.) Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Onto Innovation is a leader in process control, combining global scale with an expanded portfolio of leading\-edge technologies that include: 3D metrology spanning the chip from nanometer\-scale transistors to micron\-level die\-interconnects; macro defect inspection of wafers and packages; metal interconnect composition; factory analytics; and lithography for advanced semiconductor packaging. Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient. **Job Summary \& Responsibilities** We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Inspection Business Unit (IBU). Whether you are launching your career or bringing years of deep expertise, what matters most is how you think: we need someone who can hold a global, system\-level view of a complex inspection platform—optics, mechanics, electronics, and software—and then zoom into any layer to get into the weeds when a problem demands it. Because AI coding agents can now generate and refactor code effectively, the critical skill we are seeking is the ability to maintain an accurate mental model of a complex system consisting of optics, electrical, and mechanical subsystems, and effectively map customer problems to the right technical solutions. **Key Responsibilities** Responsibilities will be scoped to your experience level; early\-career engineers will focus on the foundational items while senior engineers will take on broader ownership and leadership. Systems Thinking \& Problem Decomposition * Build and continuously refine an accurate mental model of the full Onto inspection platform—optics, motion, electronics, image acquisition, and software stack. * Translate customer problems and application requirements into well\-scoped engineering tasks by reasoning across subsystem boundaries. * Agility to zoom from system\-level architecture down into any specific areas: databases, algorithm performance, hardware, data flow, GPUs, GUIs, etc. * Participate in New Product Development (NPD) alongside hardware engineers, application engineers, Technical Project Managers, and Program/Product Managers. * Algorithms \& Software Engineering * Apply machine learning, image processing, computer vision, mathematics, and optics to develop algorithms integrated into Onto inspection platforms. * Develop or contribute to optical imaging modeling/calibration and/or image segmentation, classification, and detection algorithms. * Write, test, and debug software to ensure high\-quality, reliable operation; optimize for performance and scalability. * Perform or lead (based on experience) requirement analysis, detailed software design, production code development, and associated test plans. * Participate in design/code reviews collaborating with systems engineers, software developers, and other technical staff. * Leverage AI coding agents to accelerate implementation, while maintaining ownership of architecture decisions, design integrity, and code quality. * Continuous Learning \& Collaboration * Stay current with academic research and industrial practices in machine vision inspection, image processing, machine learning, and AI\-assisted engineering. * Document software designs, system\-level rationale, development processes, and troubleshooting steps. * Support teammates and, at senior levels, provide technical mentorship—especially in systems thinking. * Contribute to improving the team's development workflows and tooling, including AI\-assisted practices. * Must be able to travel internationally to customer sites at least 20% of the time, with additional travel as business needs require. **Qualifications** * PhD, MS, or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field. * Doctorate degree with 0\+ years related experience; or Master's degree with 0\+ years related experience; or Bachelor's degree with 0\+ years related experience. * Demonstrated ability to reason about systems at multiple levels of abstraction—from high\-level architecture down to implementation details. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills; able to articulate complex system behavior clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Competency (or demonstrable coursework) in at least one numerically focused environment such as Python or MATLAB, including linear algebra, image processing, and/or machine learning libraries. * Competency (or demonstrable coursework) in at least one compiled or production language used in large\-scale software systems, such as C\+\+, C\#, or Java. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in semiconductor inspection, machine vision, robotics, or similar highly technical domains where hardware/software co\-design is essential. * Track record of diagnosing cross\-subsystem issues that span optics, electronics, firmware, and application software. * Experience effectively using AI coding agents (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Aider, or similar) to accelerate development. * Experience with software development methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, or Kanban. * Experience with version control and CI/CD practices. * Experience debugging complex multi\-threaded software environments. * Familiarity with embedded systems, hardware communication protocols, and/or real\-time constraints. **Level Typical Experience** **Expectations** SWE I New grad / 0–2 years Builds foundational system understanding, executes well\-defined tasks (often AI\-assisted), learns to validate outputs against system constraints. SWE II 2–5 years Owns features end\-to\-end, decomposes cross\-subsystem problems, effectively directs AI agents for implementation, and contributes to design. Senior SWE 5\+ years Drives architecture and technical direction, holds the authoritative mental model of the system, leads cross\-team problem\-solving, mentors the team in systems thinking and AI\-augmented workflows. Why Join Onto Innovation? At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well\-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting\-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized. **Compensation \& Growth** * Base Salary Range: $115,200\.00 \- $172,800\.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long\-term incentives tied to both company and individual success. Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future: Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential \- without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team. Important Note on Export Compliance For certain positions requiring access to technical data, U.S. export licensing review may be necessary for applicants who are not U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, or other protected persons under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).

jobs.title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer, Data Center Equipment
jobs.description: Compute \- US \- Remote **About the Team** OpenAI and its capital and technology partners are building a global network of data centers for demanding AI workloads. The Infrastructure Quality team sets and verifies qualityance requirements for equipment across that network. We work with manufacturing partners, general contractors, engineers, and operations staff from supplier qualification through commissioning. Together, we verify that equipment arrives ready for installation, startup, and long\-term service. **About the Role** As a Manufacturing Quality Engineer, you will oversee the quality of data center equipment at supplier factories. You will use production data, audits, and test results to identify systemic, recurring, or safety\-related issues and work with suppliers to address them through Closed Loop Learning (CLL). You will work with suppliers and internal teams to define inspections and factory tests for each type of equipment. You will coordinate issue resolution before shipment and manage deviations across multiple suppliers and project sites. **Key Responsibilities** **Manufacturing Monitoring and Supplier Improvement** * Manufacturing monitoring: Work with Manufacturing Operations to monitor production progress, quality controls, inspection results, and test readiness. Flag emerging risks and coordinate a response with suppliers. * Product and process audits: Audit products and processes during and after production against engineering requirements, critical\-to\-quality (CTQ) characteristics, approved procedures, and quality standards. Document findings and track corrective actions to closure. * Manufacturing coordination: Agree on production checkpoints and inspection and testing requirements with suppliers, engineering, sourcing, supply chain, commissioning, and quality teams. Escalate risks to equipment acceptance or delivery. * Manufacturing scorecards: Develop supplier and product scorecards with Manufacturing Operations. Review audit findings, test results, recurring defects, and open issues with suppliers to prioritize improvements. * Drive continuous improvement: Lead the CLL process with suppliers. Track root cause analyses and corrective and preventive actions in a shared register. Verify that each action addresses the underlying problem before closing it. **Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)** * Standardize requirements and formats: Develop product\-specific FAT requirements and standard test formats with equipment suppliers and OpenAI’s engineering, commissioning, quality, and Manufacturing Operations teams. * Define critical quality requirements: Document the CTQ characteristics each test must verify in an OpenAI\-accepted format. Use CLL findings to revise FAT procedures so future tests check for known failure modes. * Ensure auditable supplier records: Require suppliers to retain test results and make them available for OpenAI audits. * Manage documentation and revision control: Review final FAT records and audit reports for each piece of equipment and maintain a controlled revision history. * Conduct periodic supplier audits: Check that suppliers follow approved test procedures and that their records accurately reflect the tests performed. **Factory Witness Testing (FWT)** * Align checklists and stakeholders: Develop standard FWT checklists with OpenAI subject matter experts, installing contractors, and the construction management team. Agree on requirements before testing begins. * Manage documentation and reporting: Collect and review final witness test reports and supporting records from participants. * Before shipment, confirm that each witness\-test issue is resolved or covered by a documented deviation. Log systemic, recurring, or safety\-related findings in the CLL tracker and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions with the supplier. **Deviation Management** * Assess short shipments and missing or failed tests in partnership with Manufacturing Operations. * Coordinate supplier support to resolve issues at the project site. * Document each deviation and track the agreed actions through closure. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical, or industrial engineering. * At least 10 years of data center industry experience spanning quality engineering and project management. * Experience coordinating FAT and FWT with suppliers and resolving equipment quality issues. * Ability to develop test checklists, define CTQs, review test results, and maintain auditable quality records. * Experience monitoring supplier production, auditing products and processes during and after production, and using scorecards to improve supplier and product quality. Experience managing controlled documents and deviations. * Ability to coordinate supplier schedules and plan inspections and tests across multiple pieces of equipment. * Ability to communicate quality requirements and coordinate decisions across suppliers, engineering, commissioning, sourcing, supply chain, manufacturing, operations, quality, and construction teams. * Willingness and ability to travel approximately 40–60% of the time to supplier manufacturing facilities and data center project sites. **Preferred Skills** * Technical knowledge of data center infrastructure, including mechanical, electrical, and controls systems. * Experience in supplier performance management for mission\-critical facilities. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Quality Manager, or Quality Auditor. * PMP or equivalent project management certification. * Experience in industrial or high\-volume manufacturing environments. **About OpenAI** OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology. **Compensation** $165K – $290K \+ Offers Equity The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factorsance\-related bonus(es) for eligible employees, and the following benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, with employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts * Pre\-tax accounts for Health FSA, Dependent Care FSA, and commuter expenses (parking and transit) * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Paid parental leave (up to 24 weeks for birth parents and 20 weeks for non\-birthing parents), plus paid medical and caregiver leave (up to 8 weeks) * Paid time off: flexible PTO for exempt employees and up to 15 days annually for non\-exempt employees * 13\+ paid company holidays, and multiple paid coordinated company office closures throughout the year for focus and recharge, plus paid sick or safe time (1 hour per 30 hours worked, or more, as required by applicable state or local law) * Mental health and wellness support * Employer\-paid basic life and disability coverage * Annual learning and development stipend to fuel your professional growth * Daily meals in our offices, and meal delivery credits as eligible * Relocation support for eligible employees * Additional taxable fringe benefits, such as charitable donation matching and wellness stipends, may also be provided. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, In Store Offerings
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Why we’re looking for you** In store is Owner’s big initiative — we started as the best way to help local businesses win online, and realized in store channels can be a crucial accelerant to that. We’ve kickstarted this effort by building and launching the Owner POS, Kitchen Display System and Kiosk all in less than a year. We’re hiring a product leader to support across our in store offering end\-to\-end — a PM who wants to run and build a business line (product \+ operating model), and who is excited to be forward\-deployed. You’ll spend meaningful time in the field building relationships with sophisticated restaurant groups, and you’ll turn that signal into a scalable product \+ operating model. Our ambition is to scale our point of sale and kiosk business lines past $100M\+ ARR. **The impact you'll have** * **Shift restaurant software from outputs to outcomes.** Build experiences that synthesize what matters, explain why it matters, recommend the next best action, and make it easy to act. * **Own the core operator experience across mobile and desktop.** Bring together the workflows restaurants rely on every day, including orders, guest issues, operational settings, business performance, and growth opportunities, into a cohesive product experience. * **Build personalized business guidance.** Show restaurants the value Owner is driving, identify the highest\-impact opportunities, and deliver the right recommendation across product, email, SMS, customer success, and AI agent experiences. * **Scale unified guest and order management.** Help restaurants monitor, manage, and resolve reviews, support requests, forms, order issues, and operational exceptions quickly. * **Productize best\-practice playbooks into simple actions.** Turn proven operator and customer\-success workflows into personalized recommendations, one\-tap actions, and safe automation. * **Earn trust in AI\-assisted execution.** Design the permissions, confirmations, evaluation loops, rollback paths, and failure handling needed for restaurants to trust Owner with increasingly important work. * **Operate forward\-deployed.** Spend meaningful time with restaurant owners and teams — in restaurants, in kitchens, over text, and alongside our support and success teams — to understand what actually happens day to day. Turn that proximity into sharper product priorities, better AI behavior, and products that feel like real leverage for operators. * **Lead through ambiguity.** Align product, design, engineering, data, AI, customer success, and operations around the highest\-impact operator outcomes. **What we’re looking for** * **5\+ years of product management experience, or equivalent building experience**, with a track record of shipping high\-impact products. * **Forward\-deployed customer obsession.** You build conviction by getting close to the work: visiting restaurants, observing live workflows, texting with operators, shadowing frontline teams, and understanding how work actually gets done before deciding what to build. * **AI product instincts grounded in real operations.** You think in loops — signals decisions actions learning — and care deeply about quality, trust, and iteration. * **Excellent product judgment and taste.** You can reduce cognitive load, simplify messy workflows, and design products that feel obvious to busy, non\-technical users. * **Technical depth and strong engineering partnership.** You can reason about systems, data flows, integrations, permissions, reliability, and tradeoffs. * **Bias toward outcomes over features.** You know how to connect product work to customer and business impact, not just launches. * **Strong prioritization and execution.** You can balance speed, correctness, and long\-term maintainability in a fast\-moving environment. * **Cross\-functional leadership.** You can align opinionated stakeholders, create clarity from ambiguity, and keep teams moving. **Compensation and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $220\- $240K, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote\-first workplace, unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond. \#LI\-AB1

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer
jobs.description: **Why this role matters** Hail doesn't give notice. When a storm hits, thousands of claims come in within a few hours, wherever it lands. Our technology has to work at that moment, so every customer is handled fast. You are the person who makes sure it does. **Your part** Build and run HailCare Pro, our claims and repair platform for hail damage, used on five continents, including in the US, Brazil, Spain, South Africa and Australia. Most of your time goes into HailCare Pro integrations and product support; you'll also support our Colibri hail scanners on the software side and help improve them. You'll work fully on\-site in our Lewisville office for the first 4 weeks (2 with our US team, 2 with the scanner team), then hybrid, about half the week in the office, with occasional travel to scanner stations, alongside our COO and our development partner in Germany. Early in your first months, you'll also spend a few weeks with our development team in Berlin to get to know the team and the codebase. Why we're hiring now: Claim seasons are starting in Brazil, Spain, South Africa and Australia, and our US season starts February 1\. jobs.description: **POSTING DEADLINE** This position is posted until filled. **DEPARTMENT** Department: DOC Engineering **PREFERENCES** **About DOC Engineering** PNM¿s Distribution Operation Center (DOC) Engineering team supports the operational systems used to monitor and control the electric distribution system, manage outages, and improve operational reliability. DOC Engineers work closely with Distribution Operations, field personnel, technology teams, and system vendors to configure, test, troubleshoot, maintain, and improve these systems. This position will support the phased deployment of PNM¿s new Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS), along with ongoing operational system support. Responsibilities will evolve throughout the deployment, from configuration, data validation, and testing to commissioning, production support, and implementation of additional capabilities. Later releases will introduce advanced applications such as integrated volt/VAR management (IVVM), fault location, isolation, and service restoration (FLISR), distributed energy resource management systems (DERMS), and wildfire\-related operational functions. DOC Engineering will have a continuing role in validating system performance, supporting operators, and expanding the use of these capabilities. The position will be filled at the Engineer I, II, or III level based on the selected candidate¿s qualifications and experience. Assignments, independence, and technical responsibility will be appropriate to the engineering level. The initial assignment will emphasize the functional area described below, with cross\-training and opportunities to support other SCADA, OMS, and ADMS functions as team needs evolve. Training, mentoring, and hands\-on participation in deployment will develop familiarity with PNM¿s systems, configurations, and operational practices. In addition to day\-to\-day system support, these positions will emphasize proactive engineering, using operational data and system analysis to identify improvement opportunities, recommend changes, and evaluate results. **Position focus** This position focuses on the Outage Management System (OMS) within PNM¿s ADMS. The engineer will work with other DOC Engineers, Distribution Operations, Schneider Electric, and other technical teams to support the applications, data, workflows, and interfaces used to detect, predict, track, and support restoration of electric distribution outages. Primary responsibilities include:* Configure and maintain OMS application settings, outage\-processing rules, workflows, code lists, and operator views. * Validate outage detection, prediction, and restoration processing against expected operational behavior. * Investigate data and interface issues involving the distribution network model, Geographic Information System (GIS), Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), Customer Information System (CIS), and field mobility systems. * Develop and execute functional, integration, acceptance, and regression tests; document results and coordinate defect resolution. * Distinguish application\-configuration issues from source\-data, network\-model, interface, and software defects. * Support cutover, production troubleshooting, controlled configuration changes, software updates, and technical documentation. This role will involve deploying, evaluating, and improving additional OMS and related ADMS capabilities, including switching management, field crew coordination, storm response, and wildfire\-related operational functions. The engineer will analyze outage records, restoration timelines, network\-model and interface data, and operator feedback to identify recurring problems and opportunities to improve outage prediction, restoration support, data quality, and operational workflows. The role will also support validation of how advanced applications, including FLISR, interact with outage processing and restoration workflows as their deployment expands. These responsibilities will combine ongoing production support with proactive analysis, configuration improvements, and evaluation of operational results. **Relevant experience** Electric\-utility OMS experience is required. This should include hands\-on experience with OMS configuration, testing, troubleshooting, or application support, along with an understanding of distribution outage\-management processes. Experience with Schneider Electric¿s EcoStruxure ADMS, particularly its OMS functionality, is preferred but not required. Experience with other electric\-utility OMS platforms is also relevant. Additional desirable experience includes distribution network connectivity, GIS and AMI integrations, customer\-system interfaces, field crew workflows, databases, SQL, and data analysis tools.**JOB DESCRIPTION** **Engineer I** Salary: DOE Personnel in this job title may be covered by NERC CIP cyber security standards. Comfortable working in and around high voltage (up to 345kV) electrical facilities and equipment.
