jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About this role:** Samsara's cloud\-connected sensor platform collects observations about the world in near real\-time. Samsara builds an extensive set of products, including battery\-powered, wireless sensors, Linux\-based IoT gateways, and Internet\-connected dashcams. These devices are the building blocks Samsara uses to construct enterprise solutions for a wide range of verticals, including commercial fleet management and industrial monitoring. Through a unique integration of sensor data such as GPS, acceleration, temperature, video, and more, we enable our customers to gain greater insights into operations, identify and eliminate inefficiencies, and react to alerts all in near real\-time. As a Firmware Engineer at Samsara, you will develop software that runs on millions of devices, deployed by our industrial and enterprise customers. You'll tackle challenges including evaluating and selecting hardware components, bringing up new hardware platforms and sensors, building systems to gather data and detect meaningful events, and structuring recorded data to allow efficient analysis across thousands of devices while providing deep insights into individual events. We use C for our MCU\-based platforms, Golang for embedded applications on Linux\-based gateways and backend services, Google protocol buffers to structure data, and various AWS technologies to process and store data. Experience with these exact technologies is not required. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. *Click here**to learn more about Samsara's cultural philosophy.* **In this role, you will:** * **Shape the hardware, not just the code that runs on it.** Sit in reviews with our electrical engineers and help choose the right SoC, amount of flash/RAM, and combination of sensors, then prove those choices out on prototypes that reach real customers in months, not years. * **Be the first person to make a new board do anything at all.** Bring up new platforms and prototypes from virgin silicon: configure I/O, get SPI, I2C, UART, BLE talking, debug system init, validate the design, and turn unproven hardware into a product. * **Build the layers everything else depends on.** Peripheral drivers, secure bootloaders, device firmware updates, as well as the core management layers like power and connectivity, that determine whether a device in the field quietly recovers on its own or becomes an RMA. * **Chase every microamp.** Design protocols and hardware management for battery\-powered sensors and gateways where the gap between good firmware and great firmware is measured in years of device life. * **Work with the people who ship the whole product.** Partner with product, full\-stack, mobile and quality engineers so the data your firmware produces arrives intact and useful as it lands in the hands of dispatchers, fleet managers, and technicians who depend on it every shift. * **Raise the bar for the engineers around you.** Your designs, reviews, and instincts help raise the ceiling for the whole tea  **OTA and device firmware update at fleet scale** \- A/B partitions, rollback, and the discipline of never bricking a device you cannot physically reach. * **Embedded Linux on the gateway side** \- Yocto or Buildroot, kernel drivers, device trees. * **CAN and J1939 work on commercial vehicles**, including reverse\-engineering data bus parameters across makes and models. * **Python and Bash for tooling**, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test automation. * **You've been on the factory floor** \- You have an understanding of the processes behind the mass production and quality assurance of electronics. You have a track record of fixing production show stoppers. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

training needs * Assists in developing and delivering appropriate training programs * Fosters teamwork and camaraderie toward common goals, while working alongside engineers in a leadership role * the maintenance and repair of facilities by staff and vendors * Inspects facilities for performance verification and quality control * Exchanges information with management staff about operations and special projects * Participates in minor remodeling of facilities by estimating labor, material, and equipment requirements and coordinating staff to perform the work and participating in doing the work * Coordinates approved vendors/contractors * Coordinates workloads with grounds and custodial staff and provides leadership to campus engineering and other facilities staff * Ensures integrity of maintenance supplies and equipment inventory * Exchanges information with administrators, management, and other staff on engineering operations and special projects * Ensures facility compliance with applicable codes, regulations, and standard operating procedures * Reviews blueprints for new construction and remodeling for compliance with standard operating procedures, materials, finishes, and potential conflicts * Coordinates work effort of other staff to ensure prompt accomplishment of projects * Assists in the preparation and management of the engineering discretionary budget * Uses a computer and computer software to communicate with constituents, document procedures, protocols, and other relevant communication * Enters, modifies, and retrieves data related to maintenance schedules, equipment and supply usage and inventory, and other data; tracks expenses, estimates special projects, creates schedules, and obtains information * Performs other related duties as assigned infrastructure systems, including: structural, building envelope, roofing, building monitoring, control, access controls, life safety, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, telecom/datacom, interior floor/wall/ceiling, and vertical transportation systems * Basic electrical, carpentry, welding, and mechanical principles and procedures * Computer applications including Word, Excel, Access, Project, PowerPoint, Outlook, AutoCAD, and the internet **Skill in:** * Exceptional organizational and communication skills and attention to detail * Managing discretionary budgets * Handling emergency situations * Understanding and giving verbal and written instructions and directions * Assessing engineering staff abilities, organizing workloads and schedules * Communicating respectfully and effectively with people at various levels within and outside of the organization who are diverse in their academic, socioeconomic, ethnic, neurodivergent, and LGBTQIA\+backgrounds * Reading and comprehending complex instructions, blueprints and directions, and Material Safety Data Sheets * Assessing completed work for standard of quality **Ability to:** * Exercise caution and ensure compliance with all mandated CAL/OSHA safety provisions in the course of work * Oversee the maintenance engineering operations of a college campus * Perform heavy labor * Perform routine technical functions in the repair and maintenance of college campus buildings and infrastructure systems * Work independently under minimum supervision and prioritize jobs * Use required tools and equipment skillfully and safely * Keep/maintain work records in an organized manner * Follow instructions * Obtain a forklift certification Job Requirements:* Graduation from high school and completion of a recognized journeyman program in building maintenance or an equivalent combination of education and experience * Successful experience of increasing responsibility in a complex facilities environment that has included work with a variety of building and infrastructure systems, tools, and vehicle and equipment installation, maintenance, and repair * Demonstrated cultural competence, sensitivity to, and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, ethnic, neurodivergent, and LGBTQIA\+ backgrounds of community college students, faculty, and staff * Skill in training and directing the work of others * Skill in budget management * Skill in the use of a variety of software to prepare spreadsheets, correspondence, and other written materials * Demonstrated skill in reading, comprehending, and following complex oral and written instructions * Successful completion of coursework, a seminar, or workshop on supervision or management from an acceptable institution within six months of assuming position * Possession of a valid California Driver's License (or the ability to obtain one) and the ability to drive a motor vehicle on campus and to off\-campus locations * Possession of a adaptability; manual dexterity; operating electrical and mechanical equipment; good memory; standing for long periods; walking; ability to sit at a workstation and use a computer for periods of time while performing office\-related functions; interacting with individuals and small groups; demonstrated skill in reading and comprehending complex instructions; possession of a valid California Driver's License and the ability to safely drive a motor vehicle in the performance of assigned tasks, in order to perform the essential functions. **Benefits:** Benefits include paid holidays, The District pays all or a portion of monthly medical plan premiums (depending on the coverage) and pays all of the monthly dental and vision plan premiums for employees and eligible dependents. jobs.title: Software Engineer I
jobs.description: **Build What's Next in Aerospace** For nearly a century, Simmonds Precision has been helping shape the future of flight from our home in Vergennes, Vermont. Today, our technologies are trusted across hundreds of commercial and military aircraft platforms worldwide, helping aircraft operate safely, reliably, and efficiently. At Simmonds Precision, we design and manufacture advanced sensing, monitoring, fuel management, and precision control technologies that solve some of aerospace's most demanding challenges. Behind every solution is a team of talented people who bring together engineering expertise, advanced manufacturing, craftsmanship, and a drive to innovate. When you join Simmonds Precision, you're not just taking the next step in your career, you're contributing to technology that takes flight around the world. Whether your expertise is in engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, or business support, there's an opportunity to make your mark. Find your next opportunity where precision meets possibility—and build your career in aerospace with Simmonds Precision. **What You Will Do** As a Software Engineer, you will leverage cutting\-edge development workflows to build the precise, intelligent, and secure software powering tomorrow's Monitoring and Actuation Systems. While ensuring the reliability of our existing production software, you will actively innovate—engineering next\-generation, mission\-critical solutions trusted in the world's most demanding environments. Your focus will center on two core product lines: * Health Usage Monitoring Systems (HUMS): Empowering aircraft operators to analyze fleet conditions, predict emerging mechanical anomalies early, and optimize maintenance schedules with high accuracy and confidence. * Aircraft Actuation Systems: Transforming control inputs into deterministic, high\-precision movement across flight control surfaces. You will support varied rotary/linear architectures, AC/DC power frameworks, and fly\-by\-wire system compliance. You will join our Next Generation Engineering Team—a collaborative unit of innovators and aviation enthusiasts redefining modern HUMS and actuation technologies. We balance deep technical rigor with a dynamic, fast\-iterating startup energy. This is an environment built for hands\-on experimentation with cutting\-edge tools to shape the future. **What You Will Learn** * Develop and optimize embedded flight\-software for safety\-critical systems used in commercial aircraft and military platforms. * Write high\-performance, deterministic code and conduct debugging and validation using simulation tools. * Collaborate closely with systems engineers, hardware teams to deliver integrated solutions that meet stringent aviation safety, performance, and certification requirements. * Implement and support AI\-assisted onboard features. * Conduct debugging and validation using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, hardware debuggers, simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) environments. * Ensure compliance with aviation safety standards such as DO\-178, and adherence to secure coding and cyber\-resilience practices. * Participate in flight\-test operations, lab testing, and simulation runs to evaluate system performance under real\-world and mission\-critical conditions. **Qualifications You Must Have** * Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) major obtained by start date. * Experience may be obtained through on\-the\-job experience, research, coursework, or projects. **Qualifications We Prefer** * Prior internship, co\-op, or work experience. * An emphasis on strong collaboration and communication skills, with a desire to achieve world class abilities to work within dynamic teams to solve challenging problems. * Basic understanding of aircraft operational fundamentals is highly desirable, as the role involves executing flight test scenarios to validate system functionality and performance. This hands\-on work will enable the candidate to directly contribute to the advancement of next\-generation aerospace technologies. **Why Join Simmonds Precision?** At Simmonds Precision, you won't just be filling a position, you'll be developing skills in an industry where precision matters. You'll have the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals, gain hands\-on manufacturing experience, and contribute to products used in demanding aerospace applications. **Compensation \& Benefits** Great work deserves great rewards—and benefits that support you both at work and beyond. Our comprehensive total rewards package is designed to help you stay healthy, build financial security, enjoy time away from work, and continue growing throughout your career. * **Health \& Wellness:** Take care of yourself and your family with comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, HSA and FSA options, and convenient access to an onsite cafeteria and fitness center. * **Invest in Your Future:** Enjoy competitive pay, an annual bonus opportunity, and a 401(k)\-retirement plan that includes up to a 4% company match plus an additional annual employer contribution starting at 3%. Company\-paid life and disability insurance provide additional financial protection and peace of mind. * **Time to Recharge:** We believe time away from work matters. Enjoy four weeks of vacation, plus five additional paid days during our annual holiday shutdown, paid sick leave, and paid maternity and paternity leave—giving you more time for the moments that matter. * **Grow Your Career:** Keep building your skills and advancing your career with up to $20,000 in annual tuition reimbursement, along with ongoing professional development and learning opportunities. * **Benefits Beyond the Basics:** Choose from additional programs designed to make life a little easier, including supplemental insurance, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), legal services, identity theft protection, discounted auto and home insurance, and pet insurance. Your career is more than a paycheck. Join a company that invests in your health, your future, your growth, and your life outside of work. Shift: First Shift Compensation: $57,200\-108,800/year

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Component Development
jobs.description: We're looking for a Mechanical Engineer who is as comfortable in a shop, lab, or manufacturing area as they are behind a computer. Our team develops the equipment, processes, and technologies that enable SEL's future manufacturing capabilities. Success in this role comes from curiosity, practical problem solving, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves and turn ideas into working solutions. We value engineers who enjoy working with their hands as much as they enjoy working at a computer. Whether your experience comes from designing and building machines, machining parts, restoring equipment, fabricating projects, working in manufacturing, or developing products from concept through implementation, we want engineers who are motivated to solve real\-world engineering problems. One project might involve designing and building prototype manufacturing equipment, while the next could involve developing tooling, evaluating new materials, automating a process, or scaling a promising technology toward production. If you enjoy solving challenging problems and seeing your ideas become reality, we'd like to talk with you. As a Mechanical Engineer, a typical day might include: * Design and develop tooling, fixtures, manufacturing equipment, and prototype systems. * Create mechanical designs and assemblies using CAD software. * Develop, build, test, and improve prototype equipment and manufacturing processes. * Design experiments and evaluate materials, processes, and manufacturing concepts. * Troubleshoot equipment, processes, and mechanical systems to identify root causes and implement improvements. * Work closely with technicians, operators, suppliers, and engineers from other disciplines to solve challenging technical problems. * Support automation, process improvement, and manufacturing capability development projects. * Perform mechanical analysis, tolerance studies, and design\-for\-manufacturability evaluations. * Create and maintain bills of materials, engineering documentation, test reports, and work instructions. * Qualify components, materials, and suppliers. * Develop test plans, conduct testing, analyze results, and communicate recommendations. This job might be for you if: * You have a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering. * You possess strong mechanical aptitude and enjoy building, troubleshooting, and improving physical systems. * You have experience with part and assembly design. * You are comfortable working in both engineering and manufacturing environments. * You enjoy solving practical problems and implementing solutions. * You can effectively communicate technical information through writing, documentation, and presentations. * You enjoy learning new technologies and tackling unfamiliar challenges. Additional experience that may help you succeed in this role includes: * Manufacturing equipment design. * Tooling and fixture design. * Automation, pneumatics, or motion control systems. * Machining, fabrication, or welding. * Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA). * Process development and continuous improvement. * Materials evaluation and testing. * Experimental design and data analysis. * Thermal, structural, or vibration analysis. * SolidWorks or similar CAD software. * Personal technical projects, fabrication experience, automotive projects, machining experience, maker activities, or other hands\-on technical pursuits. What makes someone successful in this role? Successful engineers on the Component Development team are curious builders. They are comfortable moving between engineering analysis and hands\-on implementation. They enjoy developing prototypes, running experiments, gathering data, and iterating on designs until they work reliably. The most successful engineers in this role combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical experience and a desire to learn. They take ownership of problems, collaborate effectively with others, and are motivated by creating technologies and manufacturing capabilities that can have a lasting impact on SEL's future. **Competitive pay. Superior benefits. Inspiring work.** People are at the core of our company and we hire employee\-owners. We welcome you to learn more about how we support employees. * We’re 100% employee owned. Retirement benefits include an employer funded stock ownership plan (ESOP) and personal 401(k) options. * We offer top tier medical, prescription, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. * We recognize the importance of a healthy life balance and offer: 10 paid holidays, annual vacation accrual starting at 12 days, 9 paid sick days, and paid family and medical leave that covers 90% of your pay. * We foster growth and development of our employees through avenues such as STEM courses, apprenticeships, tuition assistance, and engineering development programs. * Ask our team about other benefits including wellness, fertility, adoption, and flexible spending benefits. **Pay Range Data:** **$89,400 \- $134,100 annually \- Mechanical Engineer** Our compensation ranges are based on the responsibilities of the role. Starting pay is determined individually and considers factors such as relevant experience, skills, knowledge, and training. Candidates may be considered at different levels based on their background. As a result, pay may vary to align with the level of the role. **Communication with Applicants** We communicate with all applicants. If you do not receive a response about your application, please check your SPAM filter or reach out to us at careers@selinc.com. SEL is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Vets/Disabled.

jobs.title: Technical Lead
jobs.description: We're Looking for an experienced Technical Lead! **About the Company:** Security Benefit is a leader in the U.S. retirement market with more than $75 billion in assets under management. We offer opportunities to thrive, innovate, and make an impact. As part of our team, you’ll play a key role in driving the future of the U.S. retirement industry. Security Benefit is a PLACE where we promise to help our customers To and Through Retirement®. We’re proud to have been recognized as one of the best in the business: * Named to Ward’s 50 list of top\-performing life\-health insurance companies * Recognized on list of Ingram’s Top 100 Private Companies in the Kansas City area in 2025 **About the Role:** Security Benefit's Firm \& Advisor Onboarding (FAO) and Annuity \& Mutual Fund Custodial (AMFC) teams own how firms and advisors get onboarded, how business is submitted through our eApp platforms (Firelight/Affirm, AnnuityNet/AN4\), and how transactions and replacements settle through DTCC and our custodial partners. Wirehouse onboarding and new product launches to DTCC digitization and custodial data quality. As the Technical Lead for both teams, you operate within Security Benefit's Customer Centric Delivery Model (CCDM): the Product Manager or Platform Lead owns the “what” — product and platform outcomes, the roadmap, and quarterly planning — and you own the “how” — technical architecture, Enabler Epics, feasibility, and engineering quality that make that roadmap achievable. This is a technical leadership role, not a delivery\-ownership role. You partner closely with the Product Manager / Platform Lead, Business Systems Analyst, and Delivery Manager on both teams, but the roadmap, quarterly planning accountability, business stakeholder relationships, and delivery facilitation belong to them, not to you. You will occasionally write code — to prototype a solution, evaluate a vendor capability, or step in on a hard problem — but your primary output is sound architecture, Enabler Epics that create the runway for business work, technical feasibility assessments, and engineering quality across both teams. The Technical Lead position reports to the Senior Manager, Platform Engineering and can be based out of our home office in Topeka, Kansas, our Overland Park, KS office or remotely for the right candidate. We work a hybrid schedule, offering flexibility to work both remotely and on\-site. * Architecture \& Design Decisions. Own technical architecture and design decisions across the eApp platforms (Firelight/Affirm, AnnuityNet/AN4\), DTCC transaction networks, and Security Benefit's internal onboarding and custodial platforms, ensuring solutions adhere to the technology architecture and standards set by the platform organization. * Enabler Epic Creation \& Sequencing. Partner with the Product Manager / Platform Lead to decompose Initiatives into Epics — providing sizing estimates and creating the Enabler Epics that establish the architectural runway for Business Epics. * Technology Evaluation \& Vendor Technical Partnership. Own technology evaluation and governance for both teams' tools and integrations — partnering with the Platform Lead on any enterprise\-wide platform decisions — and serve as the primary technical partner with eApp, DTCC, and other vendor engineering teams. * Technical Debt Advocacy. Identify technical debt across both teams and advocate for it, partnering with the Product Manager or Platform Lead on how it gets sequenced into the roadmap. * Code Quality \& Engineering Standards. Set engineering standards for both teams, conduct code reviews, and guide technical implementation decisions throughout each Iteration. * Technical Feasibility \& Risk Management. Assess technical feasibility from Portfolio Flow intake through delivery — flagging technology opportunities or constraints early and confirming feasibility before an Initiative is approved. * Backlog \& Iteration Participation. Attend Backlog Refinement and Iteration Planning to validate feasibility and add technical acceptance criteria, validate technical quality at Iteration reviews, and resolve technical blockers that impede the team. * QPE \& Quarterly Cadence. Finalize the Enabler Epic list ahead of Quarterly Planning (QPE), provide sizing estimates for Business Epics, and present and advocate for Enabler Epics at QPE — confirming that Enablers which must precede Business Epics are correctly sequenced. * Cross\-Team Technical Consultation. Surface technical dependencies and architecture risks at Cross\-Team Sync, and consult with other Tech Leads on cross\-team architecture, standards, and shared infrastructure. * Mentorship. Mentor engineers across both teams through code review, pairing, and technical coaching, and serve as the go\-to technical resource. * Occasional Hands\-On Development. Engage in hands\-on development on an occasional basis — prototyping, spikes, or unblocking a team on a hard problem — while keeping the majority of your time on architecture, feasibility, and engineering quality. **What We’re Looking For:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience. * Minimum 8 years of experience in software engineering or technical leadership, including significant prior hands\-on development experience — you understand the craft deeply even though this role is not primarily a coding role. * Demonstrated experience owning technical architecture and design decisions for vendor\-built or third\-party platforms and their integrations. * Experience creating and sequencing Enabler Epics (or an equivalent technical work breakdown) that establish the architectural runway for business\-facing work. * Experience assessing technical feasibility and managing technical risk across the full project lifecycle, from early discovery through delivery. * Track record of identifying and advocating for technical debt remediation, and partnering with a Product Manager or Platform Lead on how it gets sequenced. * Experience setting engineering standards, running code reviews, and guiding implementation decisions for a team. * Experience serving as the primary technical partner to vendor engineering teams (for example, a platform or system\-of\-record vendor). * Familiarity with DTCC transaction networks and processes (for example, Replacement Processing / RPL, Attachment API, Carrier\-to\-Carrier replacement, scheduled releases) a strong plus. * Experience with eApp / point\-of\-sale platforms for annuities (for example, Firelight, AnnuityNet) a strong plus. * Experience partnering with a Business Systems Analyst on the technical accuracy of requirements. * Working knowledge of full\-stack, cloud\-native architecture (TypeScript / React, REST integration, SQL / data, AWS) sufficient to guide design decisions and speak credibly with engineers and vendors, even if you are not writing production code day\-to\-day. * Insurance, annuity, retirement, or custodial / transfer\-of\-assets domain experience strongly preferred: familiarity with firm and advisor onboarding, eApp submission, and DTCC\-based settlement and replacement processing. * Comfort collaborating directly with external vendor and distributor engineering teams as a technical peer. * Experience operating within a scaled agile or product / platform operating model (for example, SAFe or a similar Portfolio → Product/Platform → Team flow structure) a plus. * Financial services or other regulated\-industry experience preferred. Why Choose Security Benefit? When you join our team, you’re not just getting a paycheck — you’re getting a career path full of growth opportunities, plus a robust benefits package that puts your well\-being first. Here’s what you can expect as a full\-time Security Benefit associate: * Competitive salary and annual incentive bonuses to reward your contributions. * 33 days of paid time off (including PTO, holidays, Volunteer Day, and days of significance). * Paid parental leave after 90 days of service. * Comprehensive medical, dental \& vision insurance. * 401(k) with company match, plus Profit Sharing \& Savings Plan. * Short\- and Long\-Term Disability Insurance to give you peace of mind. * Flexible Spending Accounts for medical and dependent care. * Life Insurance to protect your loved ones. * Educational assistance to support your career development. * Associate assistance programs for your personal and professional well\-being. Ready to Make an Impact? Apply today by visiting our career page to submit your resume. We’re excited to meet you! Security Benefit is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: UX Designer Engineer
jobs.description: **About Seek Now** ================== Seek Now is transforming property inspections through technology, data, and human expertise. We deliver faster, smarter, and more reliable insights to insurance carriers and single\-family rental markets through an expanding ecosystem of digital products. Our technology connects field professionals, property data, artificial intelligence, and operational workflows. We're building software that simplifies complex processes, improves accuracy, and creates meaningful experiences for the people who rely on it every day. As our platform evolves, we're investing in thoughtful, high\-quality product design to ensure every experience feels intuitive, cohesive, and purposefully crafted. **The Opportunity** =================== We're looking for an experienced UX Design Engineer who combines exceptional design instincts, strong product thinking, and the technical ability to bring ideas to life. You'll work directly alongside our Lead Product Designer to shape the experiences, interactions, and design systems behind Seek Now's growing product ecosystem. This is a hands\-on role for someone who thrives at the intersection of design and engineering. You'll move comfortably between Figma, interactive prototypes, React components, and close collaboration with frontend developers. We're looking for someone with a strong point of view, exceptional attention to detail, and the confidence to challenge ideas constructively. Someone who understands that great products emerge through thoughtful exploration, iteration, collaboration, and careful execution. You'll contribute to product direction, help establish scalable design patterns, and take ownership of complex experiences from early concepts through production. We also value curiosity about emerging technologies, particularly AI\-assisted design and development tools, and the judgment to recognize where they genuinely improve how we work. **What You'll Do** ================== **Product Design \& User Experience** ------------------------------------- * Collaborate with the Lead Product Designer, Product Managers, and engineers to design intuitive, high\-quality experiences across our web and mobile products. * Own design initiatives from initial concepts and user flows through high\-fidelity interfaces, interactive prototypes, and implementation. * Translate complex business requirements and operational workflows into clear, approachable user experiences. * Design responsive layouts, sophisticated interactions, and polished interfaces that account for accessibility, usability, and real\-world conditions. * Apply strong visual design principles across typography, spacing, hierarchy, color, motion, and interaction. * Participate in design reviews, provide constructive feedback, and advocate for exceptional user experiences. * Communicate product concepts and design decisions through compelling presentations, storytelling, and functional demonstrations. **Design Engineering \& Prototyping** ------------------------------------- * Create interactive, high\-fidelity prototypes using Figma, React, HTML, CSS, and modern frontend technologies. * Translate design concepts into functional experiences that demonstrate real interaction behavior. * Build, maintain, and refine reusable UI components in code. * Collaborate closely with engineers to ensure production implementations accurately reflect design intent. * Contribute component\-level code when appropriate to improve implementation quality and consistency. * Understand technical constraints and work collaboratively to develop thoughtful solutions. * Help reduce friction between design and development through clear specifications, reusable patterns, and strong communication. **Design Systems \& Component Architecture** -------------------------------------------- * Help maintain, evolve, and scale Seek Now's shared design system across multiple products. * Create and document reusable components, variants, interaction states, and responsive patterns. * Establish consistency between Figma components and their implemented counterparts. * Ensure components account for accessibility, usability, different platforms, and meaningful interaction states. * Identify opportunities to improve design system organization, documentation, and developer adoption. * Balance shared design principles with the unique functional and visual requirements of individual products. * Help establish standards that improve consistency, quality, and scalability across our product ecosystem. **Innovation \& AI\-Assisted Workflows** ---------------------------------------- * Explore and apply AI\-assisted tools to improve design exploration, prototyping, development, and documentation. * Experiment with emerging technologies that enhance creative problem\-solving and product development. * Help evolve efficient, repeatable workflows that maintain high standards for design quality. * Stay informed about developments in UX, fron oss\-platform behavior. * Demonstrated experience collaborating with frontend engineers to bring designs into production. * Experience using AI\-assisted tools for design, prototyping, documentation, or development. * Ability to independently manage complex design challenges while collaborating effectively with a cross\-functional team. * Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills. * Strong product judgment and the ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, and business objectives. * A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and the confidence to offer constructive feedback and challenge assumptions. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience designing B2B SaaS, enterprise applications, property technology, insurance products, or operational workflows. * Experience with complex mobile\-first workflows and field\-facing applications. * Familiarity with React Native development, Tailwind CSS, Xcode, and modern frontend tooling. * Experience with platforms such as Atlassian, Pendo, or Userpilot. * Experience using AI\-assisted development environments such as Codex or Claude Code. **What Makes Someone Successful Here** ====================================== We're looking for someone who brings more than technical proficiency. **Craftsmanship.** You care about the details. Typography, spacing, interactions, and visual consistency matter because you understand their impact on the overall experience. **Ownership.** You're comfortable taking a problem from ambiguity to execution. You make decisions, communicate your reasoning, and move work forward independently. **Technical Curiosity.** You enjoy understanding how things work and aren't afraid to open a code editor to turn an idea into something functional. **Product Thinking.** You consider the complete experience, understand the people using the product, and recognize how individual design decisions affect the larger ecosystem. **Collaboration.** You enjoy working alongside other talented people, exchanging ideas, challenging assumptions, and finding stronger solutions together. **Adaptability.** You're comfortable learning new tools, exploring emerging technologies, and refining your approach as products and workflows evolve. **Communication.** You can articulate your ideas clearly, explain the reasoning behind your decisions, and present your work confidently to engineers, Product Managers, and leadership. **Why You'll Love It Here** =========================== ### **Meaningful Ownership** You'll have the opportunity to shape real product experiences and influence decisions that affect our growing technology ecosystem. ### **A True Design Partnership** You'll collaborate directly with our Lead Product Designer, sharing ideas, solving complex problems, and helping establish a strong design practice across the organization. ### **Design That Reaches Production** Your work will move beyond concepts and prototypes into products used by real people solving real\-world problems. ### **A Culture of Exploration** We're investing in emerging technologies, evolving workflows, and new approaches to product development. You'll have room to experiment, contribute ideas, and help determine what comes next. ### **Room to Grow** As our products and design practice expand, you'll have opportunities to take ownership of entire product experiences, lead initiatives, and help shape the future of design at Seek Now. **Let's Build Something Great** =============================== We're looking for someone who takes pride in their craft, enjoys solving difficult problems, and believes thoughtful design can make complex technology feel effortless. If you're passionate about creating exceptional experiences, enjoy working across design and engineering, and want to have a meaningful impact on the products you build, we'd love to meet you. Bring your portfolio, your curiosity, and your point of view. Join Seek Now and help shape what's next in property technology.

assets required for testing. **Analytics, Reporting, and Documentation** * Maintain analytics and tag management implementation in GA4 or an equivalent platform, ensuring events, conversions, and backgrounds. **Marketing Collaboration and Campaign Support** * Participate in marketing planning to advise on feasibility, timeline, and technical requirements for upcoming campaigns. * Support jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ServiceTitan runs the businesses behind the trades: jobs, trucks, technicians, equipment, contracts, payments, warranties, compliance obligations, and customer history. That operational context is our advantage. We are building Agent OS to turn that context into safe, observable, production\-grade agent work. Agent OS is the shared runtime, context, memory, action, trust, and evaluation layer behind role\-specific AI experiences across Atlas, office, field, voice, mobile, and future product surfaces. This is not a collection of chatbots. It is the platform that lets agents help contractors run their businesses with the right evidence, permissions, approvals, and audit trails. You will help build the core engineering primitives behind that platform: agent runtime, typed tools, context and memory assembly, trust and approval flows, evaluation infrastructure, and production observability. You are not building one agent for one product surface. You are building the platform that product teams use to build many agents safely. You will work on a small, senior AI platform team and partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Data Platform, Atlas, and domain engineering teams. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Agent runtime and workflow execution:** Build the runtime for role\-specific agents, tool use, delegation, pause/resume, durable checkpoints, retries, and failure recovery. Agents must resume safely without losing state or duplicating side effects. * **Typed tools and action contracts:** Build deterministic controls around non\-deterministic reasoning: governed reads, proposed writes, precondition checks, business invariants, scoped permissions, idempotency, audit trails, and rollback. * **Context and memory systems:** Build tenant\-scoped context assembly, retrieval, freshness controls, provenance, transcripts, artifacts, tool results, and replayable evidence. ServiceTitan systems of record stay authoritative; memory provides context and coordination. * **Trust and approval infrastructure:** Build human\-in\-the\-loop gates, approval thresholds, reversibility, tenant policy enforcement, and audit history for financial, contractual, dispatch, warranty, and compliance\-sensitive workflows. * **Evaluation and observability:** Build offline and online evals, scenario libraries, simulation, trajectory review, regression detection, cost and latency telemetry, and autonomy promotion gates. * **Reusable capability platform:** Help product teams package prompts, tools, context requirements, policies, evals, rollout controls, ownership, and rollback into governed capabilities for owners, CSRs, dispatchers, technicians, managers, and back\-office teams. * **Model and inference architecture:** Make practical tradeoffs across latency, cost, quality, structured outputs, caching, fallback behavior, provider choice, and model routing behind a shared platform layer. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design and implement core Agent OS platform services. * Write production code and review implementation details from other engineers. * Build reliable APIs, workflows, tools, and services for agent execution. * Inspect traces, debug failures, and improve production behavior. * Design evaluation scenarios and regression suites for agent workflows. * Work through real agent failure modes: stale context, wrong tool calls, missing permissions, unsafe actions, poor retrieval, latency spikes, and cost regressions. * Partner with domain teams to turn agent use cases into reusable platform patterns. * Help define platform contracts for tools, actions, approvals, context, memory, evidence, and evaluation. * Contribute to technical direction while staying grounded in what can ship quickly and safely. * Communicate clearly with engineers, product managers, architects, security partners, and engineering leadership. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform (DevEx)
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ServiceTitan is building the Developer Platform for enterprise\-scale SaaS. DevEx is a newly formed, lean, highly agile team (3–4 people) building AI\-enabled platform infrastructure — pioneering AI\-assisted development tools and coding agent runtimes (like Codex) to help engineering teams operate at “AI speed.” This is a Staff Software Engineer role per ServiceTitan's engineering leveling framework: 10\+ years of experience, Advanced Engineer level, working across squad(s)\-scale, large or potentially distributed systems. **What You'll Build** * **AI\-Native Tooling**: Components of the agent orchestration layer and harness that let coding agents operate reliably inside ServiceTitan's systems. * **Environments**: CDEs, on\-demand provisioning, mocking, and data seeding. * **Build \& CI/CD:** Build parallelization, remote caching, test\-splitting, secure and progressive rollout pipelines. * **Developer Portal:** Golden Paths, scaffolding, and service/API catalogs. * **Guardrails \& Compliance:** Automated linting, security scanning, and policy\-as\-code embedded in workflows. **What You'll Do** * **Nature of Work:** Make core architectural decisions and design systems within your area; lead investigations and guide deep\-level refactoring; demonstrate knowledge across multiple domains (agent runtimes, build infra, environments) and know how to glue distributed systems together. * **Delivery:** Write code and set the standard others emulate — full rigor on testing for scale, resiliency, performance, and security. Roadmap large tracks of work with reliable estimates and help the team hit its commitments. * **Independence \& Decision Making:** Make technical decisions across a large area of the platform and resolve in\-depth needs without needing to be told how. * **Ownership:** Be the go\-to SME for at least one major piece of the DevEx platform (e.g., the agent harness, or the CDE provisioning layer) — recognized by the team as the person who owns it. * **Leadership:** Mentor engineers in technical design and architecture; participate in interviewing and hiring recommendations for the team. * Partner with the Principal Engineer/EM to turn multi\-quarter strategy into sequenced, shippable slices of infrastructure. **What You'll Bring** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with recent (last 6–12 months) hands\-on platform or DevX work. * Direct, hands\-on experience with AI/agent tooling beyond process automation or code\-review assistance — this is the line that separates a real Staff\-level DevEx candidate from a strong platform generalist. Concretely, we're looking for: a primary dev environment built around a coding\-agent app (e.g., Codex, Claude Code) that you run on both desktop and mobile, agent sessions you keep running continuously rather than one\-off, and the ability to speak in depth about orchestrating more than one agent against real work — not just occasional prompt engineering or asking an agent to draft a spec from a brief. * Experience shipping CI/CD pipelines, build systems, internal developer portals, or test automation platforms in production, at a scope consistent with “large, potentially distributed systems.” * Practical fluency with containerization/orchestration (Kubernetes/Docker) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). * Comfort operating independently on a small team — you're expected to see and plan around disruptions, not just react to them. **Preferred Experience** * Some direct exposure to coding\-agent\-runtime work, even partial — the strongest differentiator against other Staff\-level platform candidates. * Experience where AI\-agent adoption was a team or org push you helped drive, not just something you did solo — and where the work is current (roughly the last 3 months), not a project you haven't touched in over a year. * Experience with compliance\-sensitive workflows, change management systems, or policy engines. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us. **Use of AI Technology:** We use technology, including automated and AI\-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer\-nominated awards, and more. * **Holistic health and wellness benefits:** Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical. * **Support for Titans at all stages of life:** Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more. At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role is Zone 1: $198,200 USD \- $297,400 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WA Zone 2: $185,300 USD \- $277,900 USD Applicable for: All other US locations. International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes an annual bonus, equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real\-time, event\-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on. Solace is the leading real\-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real\-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees. So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work! **About the Role** Solace is building Solace Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka® (SSK), by the creators of Nisshi. SSK builds on Nisshi Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka®, an open\-source project licensed under Apache\-2\.0\. Both implement the Apache Kafka® protocol and separate compute from storage. Stateless Protocol Engines scale out by adding more, and data is stored in object storage rather than on local disks. Other systems depend on this platform, so writes must remain correct under heavy concurrent load. The work covers wire protocols, storage engines, and the coordination problems that arise in keeping order and consistency across stateless engines. The team focuses on scale, security, latency, and robustness, and tunes for tail latency, throughput, and cost per byte; object storage sets its own floor on latency. You will own pieces of the data path end to end, working in Rust. Part of that work takes place in public, in the Nisshi repository. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core data\-path components: request handling and storage, for a system that must hold strict ordering guarantees under load. * Implement and evolve Apache Kafka® wire\-protocol handling: parsing, framing, versioning, and backward compatibility with Apache Kafka® client libraries. * Build and harden storage engines: offset and sequence coordination, compaction, retention, and correctness under concurrent access. * Diagnose difficult defects: races, consistency edge cases, and security or robustness issues that surface only under real concurrent load. * Profile and tune throughput and latency against measured production numbers. * Work with the open\-source community on Nisshi: review, discuss, and contribute. **What You’ll Bring to the Role** One of the Following, at a Deep Level: * Hands\-on experience building a high\-throughput, log\-based streaming or messaging system, such as Apache Kafka® or a comparable platform: wire protocols, client/server compatibility, and the internals of a system that can’t lose data. * Deep experience with a database’s internals: storage engine, write\-ahead\-log or commit\-log design, replication and consensus, or query execution. Any flavor counts (relational, graph, document, or otherwise). If you’ve solved these problems inside a database, you understand the ones we’re solving. Both Paths Also Need: * Strong systems\-programming fundamentals (Rust, C\+\+, Go, or Java). * A track record of owning hard technical problems end to end, from design through production. * Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, across time zones. Preferred: * Production experience in Rust. * Working knowledge of the Apache Kafka® protocol, client libraries, and ecosystem. * Hands\-on experience working on the internals of a system like Apache Kafka®, Redpanda, Pulsar, WarpStream, NATS JetStream, or Solace Event Broker. * Experience running one of these systems at production scale. * Experience with security hardening, fuzzing, or performance engineering of network services. **Why You’ll Love Working at Solace** At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes. * **Work with brilliance** – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry. * **Balance matters** – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around. * **Hybrid\-first** – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered. * **Values\-driven** – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience. * **Growth mindset** – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast. * **Customer Obsessed** – We’re proud of our world\-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it). * **Keep it fun** – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time. * **Creative culture** – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!). **At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.** To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills. Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions. **Let’s Talk** Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you. Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you. Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted. At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us! \#LI\-NM1

jobs.description: ### **Information Technology Services \- ITS** #### **State of Idaho Opportunity** Applications will be accepted through 11:59 PM MST on the posting end date. **Summary:** Information Technology Services (ITS) is a team of dedicated professionals providing core technology and cybersecurity services to agencies statewide, enabling state employees to better serve Idaho's citizens. Information Technology Services is seeking an Application Development Manager (Information Technology Manager Level II) to lead a team of software engineers responsible for building and modernizing Idaho’s next generation of enterprise applications. jobs.description: **Field Service \& Electrical Engineer** Steelhead, Inc. \| San Antonio, TX **Compensation:** $90,000–$120,000 annually, depending on experience Travel: 30–50% \| Employment: Full\-time Love troubleshooting machinery? Enjoy electrical design? We should talk. Steelhead, Inc. designs and manufactures automated water bottling and water treatment equipment for customers throughout North America and internationally. We’re looking for a hands\-on Electrical Engineer who enjoys solving problems, working with industrial machinery, and seeing equipment come to life. This isn’t a position where you’ll spend every day behind a desk. You’ll split your time between designing and improving electrical systems at our San Antonio facility and traveling to customer sites to install, commission, and troubleshoot equipment. We’re especially interested in someone who is naturally curious, enjoys technical challenges, and takes pride in getting complicated machinery running properly. **What You’ll Do** Field Service \& Troubleshooting * Install, commission, and troubleshoot automated bottling and water treatment equipment. * Diagnose electrical, controls, instrumentation, and electromechanical problems. * Troubleshoot motors, VFDs, sensors, valves, pumps, and industrial control systems. * Work directly with customers to resolve technical issues, both remotely and on\-site. * Support equipment startup, testing, and operator training. * Travel approximately 30–50%, primarily throughout North America. Electrical Engineering \& Controls * Design electrical control systems for new and existing equipment. * Develop and modify electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and control panel layouts. * Select electrical components, instrumentation, and automation hardware. * Support PLC/HMI troubleshooting and system improvements. * Assist with PLC programming and modifications based on experience. * Collaborate with mechanical engineers, production technicians, and field service personnel to improve equipment reliability and performance. Water Treatment Technology * Learn the fundamentals of reverse osmosis, filtration, ozone, UV disinfection, and industrial water treatment. * Support troubleshooting and improvement of water treatment equipment. * Assist with developing equipment operating sequences and controls narratives. * Develop an understanding of how electrical controls, instrumentation, and water treatment processes work together. *Prior water treatment experience is not required. We’re looking for someone interested in learning.* **What We’re Looking Fo**r Required Qualifications * Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, or equivalent hands\-on industrial automation experience. * Experience with industrial electrical systems and troubleshooting. * Ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical schematics. * Working knowledge of industrial control panels, motors, sensors, VFDs, and instrumentation. * Strong mechanical aptitude and practical problem\-solving skills. * Comfortable working independently with customers and equipment in the field. * Willingness to travel 30–50%. * Strong communication skills and a customer\-focused attitude. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Siemens or Allen\-Bradley PLCs. * PLC/HMI programming or troubleshooting experience. * AutoCAD Electrical or similar electrical design software. * Experience with industrial automation, packaging equipment, or process machinery. * Familiarity with pumps, valves, fluid handling, or water treatment equipment. * Experience developing equipment operating sequences or controls narratives. The Right Personality Matters The ideal candidate is someone who: * Genuinely enjoys troubleshooting and figuring out how things work. * Likes working with both their hands and their head. * Is comfortable moving between engineering design and the manufacturing floor. * Enjoys traveling, meeting customers, and solving real\-world equipment problems. * Takes ownership of problems and follows through until they’re resolved. * Is curious about new technologies and willing to learn. **Why Steelhead?** Steelhead offers the opportunity to work on complete industrial systems rather than just one small part of a machine. You’ll be involved in electrical design, manufacturing, equipment testing, customer installations, and ongoing improvements. You’ll work directly with an experienced engineering and technical team while developing expertise in industrial automation and water treatment technology. If you’re an electrical engineer who loves troubleshooting machinery and wants a position with variety, responsibility, and hands\-on challenges, we’d like to hear from you. To apply: Submit your resume and a brief description of the types of industrial equipment and control systems you’ve worked with. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $110,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Retirement plan Location: * San Antonio, TX 78221 (Preferred) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user\-friendly, cost\-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention. Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps \- the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile. **About the Role** We're growing our world\-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a **Principal Engineer, Agentic AI** to join our Core Platform Team Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100\-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a **high\-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch**. We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic\-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI\-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today. We're looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are "all in" on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results. **Why Steer?** * **True Ownership:** You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high\-velocity teams. * **Hyper\-Growth \& Vision:** We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space * **Freedom to Innovate:** You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product. * **AI\-First \& Agentic Culture:** We are refactoring our teams to be agentic\-first. We prioritize high\-level problem\-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows. **What You'll Do** * **Technical Strategy \& Ownership:** Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools. * **Architectural Vision:** Lead the design of reusable full\-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance. * **Adaptive Development:** Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless. * **Customer\-Centric Engineering:** Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve. * **Code Excellence:** Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep\-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization. * **Modern DevOps \& Agentic Infrastructure:** Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI\-integrated, agentic\-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows. **What You Have** **Must Have:** * 7\+ years of professional experience building complex, web\-based SaaS products. * **The "All\-In" Mindset:** A deep commitment to Steer's mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast\-paced environment. * **AI \& LLM Integration:** Hands\-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development. * **AI in Production:** Proven experience deploying AI\-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production\-grade infrastructure. * **AI\-Driven CI/CD:** Hands\-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI\-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration). * **Database Expertise:** Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization. * **Exceptional Communication:** The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership. **Nice to Have:** * Familiarity with our current stack: **.NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.** * Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation). * Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early\-stage startup environment. * Experience building or integrating with **Claude marketplace plugins** (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations. **Interview Process** * **Initial Screen** — 30 min with Lead Recruiter * **Hiring Manager Interview** — 60 min with the Head of Engineering \& Product * **Technical Interview** — 60 min with a Principal Engineer * **Collaborative Interview** — 30 min with Lead Product Manager **What We Offer** * **Equity Options:** Own a piece of the company's success. * **100% Remote:** Work from anywhere in the US. * **100% Employer\-Paid Medical Insurance.** * **Flexible PTO:** With a 15\-day minimum. * **FSA, HSA, and 401k options.** * **Learning Stipend \& WFH Equipment:** Everything you need for a world\-class home office. * **Innovative Culture:** A seat at the table to jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Quality Engineer** Position Type: Full\-time, Exempt, Salary Reports to: Manufacturing Quality Director Supervisory Responsibility: None Location: Jacksonville, Florida **Company Summary** Stellar Energy is a trusted provider of turnkey liquid\-to\-chip cooling solutions for the world’s leading data center and industrial manufacturing customers. As computing demand and industrial processes continue to grow, modern facilities require cooling infrastructure that can scale quickly, efficiently, and reliably. Our modular approach enables high\-volume production while maintaining the flexibility to customize each solution. From Central Utility Plants to Coolant Distribution Units, Stellar Energy delivers scalable cooling infrastructure designed to support the rapid expansion of data centers and mission\-critical industrial operations. Backed by deep engineering expertise and large\-scale manufacturing capability, Stellar Energy helps customers deploy critical infrastructure faster and with confidence. **Summary Objective** The Quality Engineer is responsible for providing quality support during design, procurement, manufacturing, and test activities on Stellar Energy projects.
