Some occasional local day travel or overnight travel may be necessary. **Required Education and Experience.*** Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or technical field from an accredited University. * Minimum of 5 years of experience in industrial QA/QC or similar projects working experience. * Certified ISO 9001 internal auditor, familiar with ISO 9001:2015 systems. * Familiarly with process control, Lean, SPC tools, Six Sigma, etc. **Preferred Education and Experience*** QMS Auditor trained. * Familiar with selection and technical requirement of general mechanical equipment including pumps, chillers, cooling towers, heat exchangers, etc. **Work Authorization** Must be authorized to work in the USA. **Benefits Summary** We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, and work\-life balance:* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (multiple plan options; preventive care covered at 100% in\-network) * Health Savings Account (HSA) with company contributions * 401(k) with company match (100% match up to 3% \+ 50% match up to 6%) * Company\-paid life insurance and AD\&D coverage * Short\-term and long\-term disability coverage options * Supplemental benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage * Wellness programs, including incentives up to $300 annually and a no\-cost weight management program * Virtual healthcare options, including $0 virtual visits in many cases * Additional voluntary benefits including legal services and pet insurance * Competitive PTO plan for exempt and non\-exempt employees *Stellar Energy Americas Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. jobs.title: Service Innovation & Development Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company:** Sungrow North America is a leading provider of renewable energy solutions, specializing in the development and manufacturing of photovoltaic inverters and energy storage systems. The company offers a comprehensive range of products and services designed to optimize the performance and efficiency of solar power installations. Sungrow North America aims to provide sustainable and reliable energy solutions to meet the growing demand for clean power and is known for its commitment to innovation, high\-quality standards, and exceptional customer service. **The Position:** The Service Innovation \& Development Engineer is a hybrid position based in the Sungrow Houston, TX office, reporting to the Service AI Agent product owner within the Strategic Expert team. The Service Innovation \& Development Engineer is an intelligent agent with Sungrow domain knowledge, deployed in Sungrow's company business software platforms including Microsoft Teams. Today it tracks and escalates unanswered field requests, answers technical questions from archived Q\&A, and identifies spare parts from photos using OCR, image embeddings, catalog retrieval and LLM\-based evidence checking. The developer owns the codebase end to end (design, implementation, deployment and operation) and leads the next wave of integrations with Sungrow business systems. This is a hands\-on role on a small team, working directly with the field service engineers who use the tool every day. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, test and ship features for the Service AI Agent (Node.js/TypeScript, Microsoft Teams SDK, Azure Bot Framework) across the full stack: Teams ingress, request lifecycle, background workers, retrieval and data layer. * Own the production stack: PostgreSQL schema and knex migrations (pgvector, pg\_trgm), the Python SigLIP image\-encoder worker, public ingress (Cloudflare tunnel today, Azure App Service as the target), and the deployment runbooks. * Extend the spare\-parts identification pipeline: OCR of board labels and barcodes, hybrid retrieval (identifier, text\-embedding and image\-similarity), LLM evidence comparison, company part\-number validation and the human confirmation and learning loop. * Build integrations with Sungrow business systems: PLM 3DEXPERIENCE (parts and BOM), iQMS (serial\-number trace and as\-built records), SharePoint via Microsoft Graph, and the Airtable spare\-parts inventory; later, controlled write\-back for ordering and repair workflows. * Deliver structural\-part PDF drawing matching and BOM linkage, the next planned work package. * Build the real\-data evaluation harness: expert\-labelled test sets, regression suites, accuracy and latency comparisons; use the results to adapt OCR and retrieval models. * Operate the service: monitoring and Application Insights telemetry, incident response, catalog and data refreshes, and permission hygiene (Teams RSC scopes, Graph app roles, Key Vault secrets). * Manage LLM and embedding usage (OpenAI API): prompt and model\-version changes, cost and latency tracking, content\-minimization and data\-handling rules. * Write and maintain design documents, deployment runbooks and user guides for field engineers. * Coordinate with Sungrow HQ R\&D and IT in China on API access, authorization and data sources. * Set coding standards, CI and the release process; review and mentor the part\-time developer on the team. * Gather feedback from field service engineers and the Strategic Expert team, prioritize the backlog with the product owner, and deliver in staged rollouts. * Other duties as assigned. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ\-204 Developer, AI\-102 AI Engineer) desired but not required. * Solar, battery, power\-electronics or industrial\-service domain experience desired. * 3 plus years of professional software development, including 2 plus years with Node.js/TypeScript in production. * Experience building bots or integrations on Microsoft Teams and Azure Bot Framework (or a comparable messaging platform), and with Microsoft Graph and Entra ID app registrations. * Strong SQL and PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations (knex or similar) and query tuning; vector search (pgvector) a plus. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar): prompt design, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation and evaluation. * Working Python for ML inference services (PyTorch, transformers, image preprocessing), enough to maintain and extend the SigLIP encoder worker. * REST API design and integration, OAuth2 and token handling, retries and error handling. * Git, automated tests (vitest or similar), CI, Docker, and Linux/macOS server operation. * Must possess effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with field engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * English Language Proficiency required. * Mandarin Chinese Proficiency desired but not required (coordination with HQ R\&D). **Travel:** * Up to 10% (Sungrow service and training centers and customer sites for user feedback and field testing). **Work Location and Status:** * Contract role based out of Houston, TX. * No visa/legal sponsorship. **Compensation:** * Compensation commensurate with experience * Competitive benefits package and employee programs * Strong personal and company growth opportunities *For candidates in the states of California, Colorado, New York and Washington, the anticipated annual base salary for this role is between $75,000 \- $105,000 This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. The base salary offered is dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to job\-related skills, qualifications, experience, education, location, or other factors related to the role.* ***Sungrow is an equal opportunity employer. Due to strong interest in this role, Sungrow will only reach out to those candidates who best meet the requirements of the position. Thank you for your interest in Sungrow.*** \#LI\-LV1

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Sustainment is an AI\-native software platform that helps US\-based manufacturers easily find and work with the critical suppliers they need to build and manage their supply chains. Our vision is to reimagine American manufacturing as a hyperconnected, secure, and resilient ecosystem of local and regional suppliers who can more easily connect, interact, and do business with the industry and government customers that rely on them. We are a dual\-use technology platform that supports both DoD and commercial customers in pursuit of our vision. **The Role** ------------ We are hiring a Product Designer (or Senior Designer) to continue to progress the overall user experience of the Sustainment platform, which provides Supplier Relationship Management, Supply Chain workflows, and Supplier Intelligence to some of the world's most innovative manufacturers. Our team works at the forefront of AI\-driven design with human creativity and design expertise setting the standard. You will report to the VP of Product and work as an equal partner with product and engineering. We are also open to hiring at the Senior Product Designer level. If you have more experience, see the Senior Product Designer section below for the added scope and qualifications. Everyone applies to this one posting, and we will set the level based on your experience and interviews. **What You Will Own** --------------------- * Delivery of user experience and visual design across all Sustainment products * Consistent development and use of our AI\-driven prototyping and design system and shared patterns across the areas you work on. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Work with product management and engineering to deliver exceptional design based on the functional needs of the user * Plan and run user research with manufacturers and suppliers: interviews, rapid prototype tests, and clear synthesis of what you learned. * Produce clear UX artifacts, from journey maps and interaction models to high\-fidelity UI built on our design system. * Use AI model\-driven design tools, such as Claude, to generate UI and working prototypes from our design system, test ideas fast, and put concepts in front of users early. * Design data\-dense procurement screens and AI\-assisted decision flows that keep users in control and keep trust high. * Write design specs that cover edge cases, and stay involved through QA and launch. * Present your designs and rationale to the team, and give and receive critique. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 3\+ years of product design experience, ideally on B2B SaaS products. * A portfolio that shows shipped work and how you moved from problem to solution. * Experience designing complex, data\-dense interfaces for business users. * Hands\-on experience with AI model\-driven design and prototyping, using tools such as Claude to turn a design system into working UI. * Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to take a rough problem to a shipped design. * Strong collaboration and communication skills with engineers and product partners, and the ability to explain your decisions with clear rationale. * Craft across interaction design and visual design, held to a consistently high bar. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience at an early\-stage company. * Background in procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or operations software. **Senior Product Designer** --------------------------- At the senior level, everything above applies, plus the following. ### **Additional Responsibilities** * Own end\-to\-end design coherence across the platform, so the product feels like one system and not a set of features. * Own the information architecture and reusable patterns that connect the core workflows. * Set the long\-term design vision for how buyers and suppliers use the platform, including AI\-assisted decision making, and get it reflected in the roadmap. * Set the research agenda and run a steady research cadence that shapes product priorities. * Present designs and rationale to company leadership. * Strengthen the design system so AI models can build from it reliably, build a strong critique culture and research habits, and mentor other designers as the team grows. ### **Additional Qualifications** * 5\+ years of product design on B2B SaaS products, with clear ownership of major workflows or product areas. * A portfolio that shows end\-to\-end workflow thinking, product leadership, and measurable shipped outcomes. * Strength in system design: information architecture and reusable patterns that hold up across a whole product. * A record of leading work from rough problem framing to shipped product, and of persuading leadership and influencing the roadmap. * Experience mentoring designers or raising the design practice on a team. **Location** ------------ This is an on\-site role at our Austin, Texas office. We are hiring candidates who live in the Austin area. Sustainment offers a competitive benefits package for full time employees including medical, dental, vision, paid time off, company holidays, and 401K matching. Sustainment is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected class. jobs.title: Staff Robotics Software Engineer, Perception & AI
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking for a Staff Robotics Software Engineer, Perception \& AI to join our Perception team within our Mobile Robotics organization. Your job will be to develop robust, production\-grade 3D perception systems for mobile robots while building intelligent agents and automated workflows that improve how perception data is labeled, validated, and used to drive future autonomous behaviors. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role with ownership spanning sensor processing, algorithm development, validation, and fleet deployment. You will help scale reliable collision avoidance across a growing robot fleet while advancing AI\-driven automation that reduces manual engineering effort. **What we do** The Collision group within the Perception team develops and deploys real\-time vision, LiDAR perception, collision avoidance, and intelligent autonomy capabilities for industrial mobile robots operating in live distribution environments. The team turns multi\-sensor data into reliable perception and collision\-prevention decisions, with a focus on maintaining safe robot movement while reducing false stops and improving fleet throughput. The team is also expanding these capabilities across new robot platforms and more demanding environments, including chilled and freezer structures. **What you'll do** * Architect, implement, optimize, By working closely with other Flagship app teams and cross\-functional partners you will help to enhance and redefine the Target Guest experience. **Same Day Delivery Team:** The Same Day Delivery team powers one of Target’s most dynamic and rapidly growing fulfillment experiences. We build and scale the technology that enables guests to shop online and receive their orders in as little as a few hours—seamlessly connecting digital convenience with the ease of local stores and Shipt’s delivery network. Our Android engineers craft intuitive, high\-performance mobile experiences that bring this promise to life, helping millions of guests get what they need, when they need it. We work in close partnership with product, design, and backend teams to deliver reliable, innovative solutions at scale. **Drive Up/Pickup team:** The Drive Up team builds and supports the Android experiences that power Target’s convenient, store\-based order pickup journey. Our products connect guests with store team members throughout the fulfillment process, from order placement and pickup readiness to guest arrival, parking spot selection, order handoff, and post\-pickup updates. These experiences are used at significant scale and play an important role in helping Target deliver a fast, convenient, and dependable shopping experience. Our Android applications are developed primarily with Kotlin and modern Android technologies, including Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Flow, Jetpack libraries, and a layered, testable architecture. The team works with distributed backend services and APIs to support real\-time order and fulfillment updates, guest notifications, location\-based functionality, and communication between guests and store teams. We focus on building responsive user experiences that remain reliable across different network conditions, device configurations, and store environments. Android developers on the team contribute throughout the software development lifecycle. This includes participating in technical design, implementing new features, writing unit and UI tests, improving application performance, monitoring production behavior, and resolving issues that affect guests and store operations. We use modern engineering practices, automated CI/CD pipelines, code reviews, observability, and incremental delivery to maintain a high\-quality mobile platform. You will collaborate closely with Android and iOS engineers, backend developers, product managers, designers, QA engineers, data partners, and store operations teams. Together, we solve complex technical and operational problems while improving the reliability, maintainability, and usability of the Drive Up experience. This is an opportunity to work on customer\-facing Android applications with meaningful business impact and a broad range of mobile engineering challenges. **As a Senior Android Software Engineer on the Flagship mobile team you will:** * Own development, testing, and quality of new features in collaboration with product and design partners * Keep abreast of technology trends and advances in mobile technologies * Research, evaluate, and provide objective feedback on technologies * Inform innovative design with relevant technology insights * Develop fully functional prototypes to objectively test against hypotheses * Be able to produce clear and concise technical deliverables for internal and external use * Innovate constantly and maintain a technical edge Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. jobs.title: Performance Engineer - IMSA
jobs.description: **Job Description** Porsche Penske Motorsport is looking for a qualified Performance Engineer to join our team. This role will serve as a vital member of our shop based and travelling racing organization as we race two Porsche 963 prototype sportscars in the International Motorsport Association (IMSA) with our manufacturer partner Porsche. This position will include extensive travel both domestic and internationally throughout the year. Time periods of two weeks away from the home base is expected. This position is available at our facility in Mooresville, North Carolina. The Performance Engineer directly contributes to the performance of our race cars by working with the race engineers, engineering staff, team personnel, as well as independently to identify, test, organize, analyze, validate and communicate areas of improvement and ways in which these improvements can be realized. Using data, research, internal and external resources as well as other staff, the performance engineer role will develop items and help to understand and optimize configurations that will aid in the performance of the race car. The qualified person will be organized, self\-motivated, and able to work with minimum supervision and under extreme pressure to make quick, calculated decisions. A strong inter\-personal and communication skillset is required along with an exceptional team mentality. **Role and Responsibilities:** ============================== * Utilize data software to collect, analyze, visualize, and share time series data from multiple sources. * Use or program tools to analyze, predict and simulate potential gains. * Understand and work with simulation tools to validate and confirm potential gains in performance from development areas. * Model and modify vehicle dynamics parameters to improve performance. * Interpret and optimize suspension systems including 7\-post\-rig testing. * Support the Race Team in tire performance optimization and tire management before, during and after the event. * Ensuring mandatory tire reporting is completed on time and to a high standard. * Expand and guide development of tire performance tools, analysis methods and infrastructure in collaboration with the Race Team and Porsche Motorsport Tire Engineering * Support the PPM/PAG Simulation Group for tire model correlation activities. * Understand, interpret and report aerodynamic performance and implement aerodynamic testing principles in testing, simulation and race events. * Develop high confidence results based on test plans developed specific to a particular goal and validate various testing results with testing data. * Assist Strategy Engineer with pre\- and post\-event analysis tasks covering data and competitor information. + Comfortable with live strategic decision making. * Assist with live strategy analysis and support during races. Run and monitor strategy options using HH Timing, including input parameterization such as base lap times and tire degradation curves. **Qualifications and Education Requirements:*** Bachelor’s degree in engineering * At least 6 years of experience in an engineer role, specifically: + Expert level data analysis – 6 years’ experience with multiple data software. + Expert in vehicle dynamics – 4 years’ experience working with suspension systems. * Proficient in computer software i. e. WinTax, HH Database and Timing, MATLAB and Microsoft Suite * High level motorsports experience in tire performance and strategy optimization. + Experience with Michelin tires is preferred. + Experience with empirical and physical tire models and the determination of model parameters. * Strong understanding of performance\-related aspects of vehicle\-tire interaction. * Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences including drivers. * Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines with minimal errors. * Persistent, open\-minded, resilient team personality with a strong solution\-orientation.

jobs.title: AI Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Your Role:** As an AI Security Engineer on Tenable's Information Security team, you will help shape and mature our approach to securing AI both within Tenable's products and across the enterprise. AI introduces a new class of risk at the intersection of application security, cloud risk, and data governance, and you will be on the front lines of defining how we assess, test, and address it. You will apply hands\-on AI engineering experience alongside product security and application security skills to design security controls for AI systems, lead assessments, and help engineering teams ship AI features securely. You will establish security standards for responsible AI use, influence decisions across the organization, and build tooling that raises our security posture. This role is ideal for a practitioner who has spent time building or tinkering with AI systems, looking under the hood of model internals, and wants to channel that experience into a security specialty. **Your Opportunity:** * Design, implement, and maintain end\-to\-end security controls across the AI/ML lifecycle. * Assist in the implementation of robust security guardrails, controls, and boundary mechanisms for Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open\-source models. * Continuously monitor the AI landscape for novel vulnerabilities and attack techniques, applying deep engineering experience to proactively defend enterprise AI deployments. * Assist in developing security reference architectures for AI deployment patterns, including MCP servers and agentic AI workflows and harnesses. * Deploy controls to ensure model integrity, governance, and proper access control across models and feature stores. * Build AI\-driven tooling to strengthen cybersecurity posture across identity, incident management, vulnerability management, third\-party risk, and emerging AI threat vectors. * Perform AI safety, security assessments, threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks. * Collaborate with software engineers, and product teams to integrate security best practices into AI development, training, validation, and deployment processes. * Create security guidance, documentation, and training for internal engineering and development teams; develop metrics that drive desired security behaviors and outcomes. * Assist in researching emerging trends in AI security and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tenable's AI initiatives. **What You'll Need:** * 2 or more years of professional experience in information security or application security, with at least a demonstrated interest on securing AI/ML systems. * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field preferred. * Awareness of AI\-specific security threats, including adversarial ML, data poisoning, prompt injection, model inversion, model evasion, and inference attacks. * Knowledge of data security principles, including encryption, masking, and tokenization. * Knowledge of SSDLC, DevSecOps, and security testing practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and threat modeling. * Knowledge of application security architecture best practices and patterns, including modern web applications, Docker, and microservices. * Ability to work cross\-functionally across engineering, product, and business teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly translate complex AI security risks for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to lead projects with end\-to\-end ownership. * Self\-motivated and effective working independently and across distributed teams. **And Ideally:** * Hands\-on experience with AI red teaming, adversarial prompt testing, or LLM security assessments. * Basic coding experience in Python and/or Go. * Experience with frameworks \& libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow or similar. * Strong understanding of the ML/AI lifecycle and the security risks associated with each stage. * Experience with application security assessment tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, Tenable WAS, etc.) * Knowledge of cloud security platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP including AI/ML\-related services. * Security certifications: CISSP, CSSLP, SANS GIAC, CEH, or AI\-focused security certifications are a plus, but not necessary. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MS1 *We're committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable \- through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. If you need a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact* *Recruiting@Tenable.com* *for further assistance.* **Tenable Data Consent Statement** Tenable is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal data. Depending on your location, one or more of the following notices may apply to you: General Applicant Privacy Notice California Applicant Privacy Notice EU/EEA/UK Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Equipment Engineer, Optimus Battery
jobs.description: **What to Expect** Tesla is seeking an Equipment Engineer to operate, sustain, and optimize advanced manufacturing equipment and leading\-edge technologies for Optimus Battery pack production. The battery pack provides energy storage for Optimus. You will own equipment performance — uptime, reliability, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) — on automated stations and lines in a high\-volume factory. The strongest candidates have a high aptitude for learning and adapting quickly, with a strong background in at least one of the following disciplines: PLC programming, 6\-axis robots, Python scripting, SCADA, mechanical design and analysis, vision systems, or electrical testers. You will constantly apply critical thinking and structured problem\-solving on automated equipment while developing skills outside your primary expertise. The ideal candidate is hands\-on, data\-driven, and comfortable mentoring Maintenance and Controls through extended downtime in a fast\-paced production environment. This role supports 24/7 production operations, including remote or on\-site support during escalations, and flexible hours during launch, ramp, and critical downtime events as business needs require. **What You'll Do*** Support 24/7 operations either remotely or on site during escalations, and flexible hours during launch, ramp, and critical downtime; provide timely, accurate troubleshooting to protect rate and yield * Troubleshoot equipment issues efficiently and implement countermeasures and continuous\-improvement projects to reduce downtime and efficiency loss, partnering in real time with Process, Quality, Controls, Production, and Maintenance * Provide hands\-on support and mentorship to Maintenance and Controls teams to resolve extended downtime situations * Program, teach, and troubleshoot industrial 6\-axis robots (Fanuc) for applications such as material handling and dispense on Optimus Battery lines * Commission, troubleshoot, and optimize motion\-control systems with VFDs and servo motors (PowerFlex, Kinetix, SINAMICS/SiMotion, Lenze, LTI, Itoh Denki, or equivalent) * Diagnose equipment failures, identify root causes, and develop strategies to mitigate or eliminate the frequency, severity, and impact of failure modes across electrical, mechanical, industrial networks, and controls systems * Own and present station\-level and line\-level metrics; jobs.title: AI Harness Junior Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The **AI Harness Junior Engineer** is a hands\-on individual contributor responsible for building, integrating, and operating AI\-enabled capabilities within The Clearing House's Information Security program. The role will work directly with advanced AI models, security tools, cloud environments, and development platforms to improve vulnerability discovery, threat analysis, secure development, and remediation. This position will help translate emerging AI capabilities into practical security solutions by developing AI harnesses, integrations, automation, and repeatable workflows. The engineer will partner with Information Security, Technology, Cloud, and Development teams to test new capabilities and move successful use cases into secure, controlled operational use. **About The Clearing House:** The Clearing House Payments Company L.L.C. is a bank\-owned industry utility that shapes the payments landscape and provides infrastructure for safe, reliable, and efficient payments. We see an economy where everyone is connected and a future where modern payments make life easier. The Clearing House operates four payment systems: a high\-value wire\-transfer system (the CHIPS® network), the country’s first and largest instant payments system (the RTP® network), an automated clearinghouse network (the EPN® network), and a check image exchange network (the Image Exchange Network). its ECCHO® business line. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Engineering \& Integration** * Build and maintain AI harnesses and workflows that connect advanced AI models with security tools, data, source code, and cloud environments. * Develop integrations using APIs, Python, and other automation technologies to incorporate AI into existing security processes. * Build workflows that allow AI models to securely interact with approved tools and data while maintaining appropriate access controls and human oversight. * Test and evaluate new AI models, tools, and techniques for potential cybersecurity applications. * Help transition successful AI prototypes into repeatable and supportable operational capabilities. **Security Automation \& Vulnerability Management** * Develop AI\-enabled workflows to identify, analyze, validate, prioritize, and support remediation of security vulnerabilities. * Use AI to analyze infrastructure, application code, configurations, and security findings for potential vulnerabilities and attack paths. * Develop automation to accelerate vulnerability validation and remediation while maintaining appropriate human review. * Support repeated and continuous analysis of systems and code rather than relying solely on point\-in\-time security assessments. * Help measure improvements in vulnerability coverage, remediation speed, and operational efficiency. **Threat Analysis \& Security Operations** * Develop AI\-assisted capabilities supporting threat hunting, alert investigation, threat modeling, and security analysis. * Integrate AI capabilities with security telemetry and existing security platforms to help analysts investigate and understand security events. * Work with security teams to identify manual or repetitive activities that can be safely automated or augmented using AI. * Develop testing and validation processes to measure the accuracy and effectiveness of AI\-generated security findings. **Cloud, Development \& DevSecOps Integration** * Support integration of AI\-enabled security capabilities into AWS environments and software development workflows. * Work with Development and DevSecOps teams to incorporate AI\-assisted security analysis into CI/CD pipelines. * Build integrations with source code repositories, vulnerability management platforms, cloud security tools, and other approved enterprise technologies. * Support secure deployment and operation of AI capabilities within controlled enterprise environments. **AI Security \& Governance** * Implement technical controls supporting secure AI use, including access controls, logging, data protection, tool permissions, testing, and validation. * Maintain documentation of AI workflows, integrations, architectures, and operating procedures. * Support security, risk, audit, and governance reviews of AI\-enabled capabilities. Help ensure AI implementations operate within established enterprise security and AI governance requirements. * **Qualifications Required** * 1\-5 years of experience in software engineering, cybersecurity engineering, cloud engineering, DevSecOps, AI/ML engineering, or a related technical field. * Hands\-on programming or automation experience, preferably using **Python** . * Experience working with APIs and integrating different technology platforms and data sources. * Experience with cloud environments, preferably **AWS** . * Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, including vulnerabilities, access controls, secure development, logging, and security monitoring. * Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to independently prototype and test new technical solutions. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. **Preferred** * Hands\-on experience with **large language models (LLMs), AI agents, model APIs, or AI orchestration/harness technologies** . * Experience with platforms such as **Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, or comparable enterprise AI platforms** . * Familiarity with **agentic workflows, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and model evaluation** . * Experience with security technologies such as vulnerability management platforms, SIEM/XDR, endpoint security, application security tools, or cloud security platforms. * Experience with **Git, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins or similar automation platforms, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code** . * Familiarity with secure coding, vulnerability analysis, threat modeling, or attack\-path analysis. * Familiarity with NIST and other cybersecurity or AI risk management frameworks. **Role Characteristics** * Individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. * **Hands\-on engineering role with an expectation to build, test, and operate AI\-enabled security capabilities.** * Combines AI/software engineering with practical cybersecurity problem solving. * Comfortable experimenting with emerging technologies while working within established security and governance controls. * Operates with defined objectives and moderate autonomy. Works closely across Information Security, Cloud, Infrastructure, and Application Development teams. * **Physical Demands and Work Environment:** The working environment is generally favorable. Lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous or unpleasant conditions caused by noise, dust, etc. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available. Travel may be required. Candidates will report to the office three days each week. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer (Python / Embedded Linux)
jobs.description: #### **About Torus** Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000\-square\-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. **We are** **the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.** We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end\-to\-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last. Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** *Embedded Systems and Firmware @ Torus* We’re building energy storage and management solutions that help: * Commercial and industrial businesses reduce their operating costs while increasing reliability. * Grid operators keep the electricity grid stable and cost efficient. Torus is hiring a **Firmware Engineer** to be an individual contributor on our firmware team, working in close partnership with our Firmware Architect. This is a hands\-on role where you'll translate architectural direction into well\-engineered, production\-grade firmware. #### **Our Tech Stack** Our firmware application layer is Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto)—not C, not C\+\+. This was a deliberate architectural choice: Python gives us speed\-to\-market, flexibility to respond to changing grid program requirements, and a clean separation between hardware and application logic. Our comms are primarily RS\-485, so Python runtime overhead is seldom the limiting factor. *If you've been writing Python to control hardware over serial protocols—in energy, robotics, industrial IoT, or test \& measurement—you'll feel immediately at home here. If you've spent your career in C/C\+\+ and are looking for that, this probably isn't the right fit.* Each Torus device generates over a million data points per day and integrates with our cloud platform via MQTT/AWS IoT. Our systems also participate in Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs, responding to real\-time dispatch signals from utilities—which means our firmware decisions have direct, measurable impact on grid operations. #### **What You’ll Do** In this role, you will report to our Head of Embedded Systems and will be responsible for: * **Developing firmware** features across our energy storage product lines: telemetry, control loops, cloud connectivity, and hardware abstraction layers. * **Owning system integration**—working closely with hardware, data, and software teams to ensure seamless interoperability across the full stack. * **Driving quality** through design reviews, automated testing, and documentation. (We believe engineers own their own QA.) * **Debugging and optimizing** real\-time embedded applications and serial communication interfaces in the field and in the lab. * **Supporting scaling operations**—deployment tooling, remote monitoring, and root\-cause analysis of field issues across a growing fleet. * **Participate in on\-call rotation** for escalated technical issues. #### **Who Thrives Here** * You're a systems thinker who's comfortable owning a problem end\-to\-end—from a register on a Modbus device to a graph in a customer dashboard. You care about code quality without letting it become a bottleneck. You're energized by the fact that the firmware you write shows up in real buildings, on real grids, doing real work. * You don't need to be an energy domain expert on day one—but you're curious about how the grid works and motivated by the idea that good engineering here has an outsized impact on creating sustainable communities. * You're also comfortable in a structure where a Firmware Architect sets system\-level direction and you're the person who makes it real—bringing deep implementation judgment, surfacing tradeoffs, and pushing back when something won't work in practice. #### **Required Experience** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\-5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing commercial embedded software or firmware applications. * Strong Python proficiency and real production experience running Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto or similar). * Solid understanding of serial communication protocols—RS\-485, Modbus, I²C, CAN, Ethernet. * Experience with real\-time embedded systems: multi\-threading, inter\-process communication, timing constraints. * Ability to read schematics and PCB layouts to troubleshoot hardware integration issues. #### **Preferred Experience** * Experience with IoT device management at scale (fleet OTA, remote diagnostics). * Familiarity with AWS IoT, MQTT, or data telemetry pipelines. * Exposure to energy storage systems, inverters, or grid\-connected hardware. * Knowledge of VPP programs, demand response, or utility interconnection standards (IEEE 1547, UL 1741\). * Experience with containerized embedded deployments (Docker/Balena on Linux targets). * CI/CD practices in embedded or hardware\-adjacent environments. #### **Additional Details** **Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check. **Location \+ Travel** Remote U.S.\-based role with occasional onsite work in Salt Lake City and surrounding area locations (air\-conditioned and non\-air\-conditioned). Must be available during MT business hours. **Compensation** $135,000 \- 180,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse. * Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color\-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. * When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet. * When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. #### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Osez\-vous regarder les défis mondiaux et y voir des opportunités porteuses d’impact ? Souhaitez\-vous contribuer à bâtir un avenir meilleur ? Le vendredi, choisissez votre lieu de travail, en tenant compte des exigences de votre activité. **Job Summary** Trane Technologies is seeking an Engineering Data \& Intelligence Strategy Architect to advance the strategy, governance, and adoption of engineering data and knowledge capabilities supporting Engineering IQ, advanced analytics, and artificial intelligence. This senior individual contributor role, with no direct reports, will connect Engineering business priorities with the data foundations, standards, and organizational capabilities necessary to make information trusted, accessible, and reusable. Working across Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Product Management, Service, and IT, the selected candidate will establish strategic priorities, guide data governance and stewardship, and partner with technical specialists to enable scalable solutions. The role will support engineering data domains including laboratory data, product lifecycle information, parts and materials, engineering documents, product configuration, and supplier data. The position will also help advance engineering taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic capabilities that enable Engineering IQ, digital\-thread initiatives, and AI\-driven engineering workflows. **Responsibilities** * Develop and advance Engineering's data and intelligence strategy, aligning priorities with Engineering IQ, business objectives, and enterprise data and technology standards. * Establish roadmaps and priorities for improving the accessibility, quality, governance, and reuse of critical engineering information. * Partner with Engineering leaders and subject matter experts to identify business needs, define information requirements, and prioritize opportunities for analytics, data science, and AI. * Establish and guide an Engineering data governance and stewardship operating model, including ownership, accountability, decision\-making, and escalation processes. * Partner with data owners, stewards, and technical architects to define and adopt common data definitions, classification standards, quality expectations, and ownership frameworks. * Guide the development of engineering taxonomies, ontologies, and semantic standards supporting knowledge graphs, digital\-thread capabilities, and AI initiatives. * Collaborate with data architects, engineers, and IT teams to establish scalable, governed data foundations across engineering systems, including PLM, ERP, laboratory, and knowledge repositories. * Identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI\-assisted data engineering, classification, and stewardship to accelerate delivery and reduce costs. * Facilitate cross\-functional alignment and lead organizational change to promote adoption of common standards, processes, and data\-driven ways of working. * Partner with technical teams to identify and address data quality issues, integration challenges, and barriers to information accessibility. * Establish measures of business value, adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency to evaluate progress and guide continuous improvement. Build partnerships across Engineering, business functions, and enterprise technology teams to promote reusable capabilities, shared accountability, and sustainable solutions. * **Ideal Qualifications and Competencies** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, data science, information systems, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least eight years of experience in data and analytics, business strategy, technology, or digital transformation, including experience leading cross\-functional initiatives. * Demonstrated experience developing data and analytics strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks, or operating models. * Strong understanding of data management, analytics, data architecture principles, and the organizational capabilities required to support scalable data solutions. * Experience translating business objectives into data, analytics, and technology priorities that deliver measurable value. * Ability to lead through influence, build cross\-functional partnerships, and align stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organization. * Experience driving organizational change, stakeholder engagement, and adoption of new technologies or ways of working. * Strong understanding of business intelligence, advanced analytics, data science, and emerging AI capabilities. * Excellent communication, facilitation, problem\-solving, and strategic planning skills. * Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and drive progress through collaboration and influence. * Experience in manufacturing, engineering, or industrial environments is preferred. * Familiarity with master data management, data governance, data quality, and stewardship practices is preferred. * Familiarity with cloud data platforms, semantic models, taxonomies, ontologies, or knowledge graphs is preferred. * Advanced degree in Data Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. La rémunération effective dépendra notamment de l’ancienneté, du mérite, de la localisation géographique, du niveau d’études, de l’expérience, des exigences en matière de déplacements et de l’appartenance syndicale. Par ailleurs, les avantages peuvent varier en fonction de la région, de l’organisation de l’entreprise, de l’implication syndicale et du statut de l’employé. **Épanouissez\-vous au travail comme à la maison :** * Les avantages sociaux sont accessibles DÈS LE PREMIER JOUR pour vous et votre famille, notamment l’assurance santé et des programmes de bien\-être global offrant de généreuses mesures incitatives – NOUS OSONS PRENDRE SOIN DE VOUS ! * Les avantages liés à la fondation d’une famille comprennent la prise en charge des traitements de fertilité ainsi qu’une aide à l’adoption et à la gestation pour autrui. * Les congés payés comprennent jusqu’à 15 jours de congés, des jours fériés payés, des congés maladie et d’autres options pour soutenir le bénévolat et les congés parentaux. * Abondement au 401K, possibilités de formation et de développement grâce aux programmes de l’entreprise, ainsi qu’une aide aux frais de scolarité et au remboursement de la dette étudiante. Ce poste est considéré comme sensible à la sécurité : Nous offrons une rémunération compétitive ainsi que des avantages et des programmes complets. jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Senior Robotics Software (San Francisco, CA)
jobs.description: ### **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end\-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. ### **The Role** Are you tired of writing incremental code for massive CRUD web apps? Do you want to architect and build systems from the ground up that affect change in the physical world, not just the digital one? At Tutor, we are motivated by atoms not electrons: every line of code you write impacts the foundation of the global economy, solving the core technical challenges in robotics and automation at scale. Lever As a **Member of Technical Staff**, you will lead design and implementation of critical robotics software across motion planning, real\-time control, perception and optimization systems, tooling, and robot infrastructure. You will influence technical direction, mentor other engineers, drive system architecture across the stack from embedded to cloud, and champion best practices in software and robotics engineering. ### **Requirements** * Exceptional programming skills with deep experience across multiple languages and systems. * Track record of designing and owning large, complex software systems. * Experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineers. * Comfortable working across the stack from low\-level robot control to cloud services. * Natural collaborator, strong communicator, and excited to solve hard problems that bridge software and robotics. ### **Nice to haves (zero or more)** * Proven experience with Python and prior experience programming robots (e.g. with ROS or other robotics frameworks) * Experience with manipulation, motion planning, optimization, or perception. * Experience with infra/dev tools (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD. * Background in hardware/software integration and real\-time systems. * Experience scaling robotics systems in production environments. ### **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. ### **Benefits** We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get: * Fully employer\-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium. * A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future. * Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * Regular in\-office meals and team social events throughout the year. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Vynyl's technologists, designers and product strategists are experts at system modernization, new product development, and rescuing projects in distress. We use the best cloud\-native and AI\-enabled tools, and apply a battle\-tested combination of Agile, Lean, and design thinking to collaboratively solve our client's most pressing challenges \- and do it right the first time. We often work in regulated industries, such as healthcare, financial services, government and education. Our work helps detect diseases, identify kids who need special educational support, applies AI to support complex legal settlements, helps people access mental health services, and so much more. **The Role** ============ As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key leader across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptual design to deployment and monitoring. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable backend services using Python and AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge), developing event\-sourced systems that provide complete state history and auditability. A critical component of this role is a demonstrated fluency with modern AI/ML development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, agentic coding tools, large language models). We are looking for candidates who not only use these tools daily but can articulate a clear, thoughtful perspective on their limitations, security implications, and the strategic opportunities they create for the engineering profession. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Design** **and implement** highly scalable, cost\-efficient backend services using Python and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge). * **Architect and build** event\-sourced systems and event\-driven pipelines, ensuring reliable message processing, idempotency, and eventual consistency across distributed services. * **Collaborate** with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical designs and shippable code. * **Implement** best practices for security, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation). * **Perform** rigorous code reviews, mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and drive technical excellence across the team. * **Actively research, propose, and integrate** new technologies and patterns, with a focus on optimizing development velocity and system performance. * **Clearly articulate** a professional point of view on how to effectively, securely, and ethically integrate AI tools into the software development lifecycle. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * **5\+ years** of professional experience in full\-stack software development. * **Expert\-level proficiency** in Python for backend development (including Django). * **Strong** working proficiency with Vue.js (and typescript). * **Deep practical experience** designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and managed services). * **Proficiency** with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * **Solid understanding** of event sourcing and event\-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kinesis). * **Experience** with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * **Demonstrated Fluency in AI\-Assisted Development**: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands\-on experience using AI\-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, IP concerns). **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Experience** with advanced AWS services (e.g., Step Functions, Kinesis, SageMaker). * **Experience** working in a regulated or compliance\-focused environment. * **A Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science or a related technical field. **AI and the Evolution of Software Engineering \& Ops** ======================================================= All candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview process: * **Practical AI Tool Usage:** Specific examples of AI tools used in professional or personal projects to enhance productivity, solve complex problems, or accelerate development. If you have a preferred agentic tool setup, please share! * **Understanding of AI Limitations:** A clear understanding and articulation of the current technical, ethical, and accuracy limitations of modern AI tools in the engineering context. * **Strategic AI Opportunity:** A viewpoint on how AI tools create new opportunities for software engineering, such as shifting focus from boilerplate code to complex problem\-solving or architectural design. * **Evolution of the Engineering Role:** A well\-articulated point of view on how your role has already changed (e.g., new workflows, skills, ways of collaborating) due to the introduction of AI and how you expect the role to evolve in the coming years based on your assessment of coming advancements in AI tools and technologies. **Application Process** ======================= To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter. Your cover letter should be informed by the "AI and Forward\-Looking Requirements" section above. The hiring process includes: * **Initial** **screening email** * **Technical** **Assessment Interview** * **A Panel Interview** **Salary Range $140,000 \- $175,000** ===================================== **Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** Excellent health, dental, vision, and life insurance Excellent 401(k) plan with annual employer match of 4%

jobs.title: Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management
jobs.description: ### **Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!** Vaxcyte is a clinical\-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high\-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well\-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance. **WHAT** we do is every bit as important as **HOW** we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values: * RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re\-innovate the way vaccines are delivered. * AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind. * LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness\-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives. * MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making. ### **Summary:** As we grow, we are seeking a strategic and collaborative Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management to ensure the integrity, accessibility, and effective use of data and knowledge assets across the organization. This role will execute component\-level analysis, utilizing data and knowledge resources critical to our process development, regulatory, and operational activities. The Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management is instrumental in ensuring scientific data integrity, regulatory readiness, and the preservation of institutional knowledge in a dynamic, fast\-paced clinical environment. ### **Essential Functions:** **Engineering Analytics \& Process Insights:** * Assess process trends and discrepancies using engineering knowledge, and evaluate the technical rationale and potential impact of proposed process improvements * Apply chemical and biochemical engineering principles to evaluate relationships between process parameters, unit operation performance, and product quality attributes * Partner with data science team to drive data visualization, reporting, and insights. * Support the use of AI/ML and automation for improved data analysis and knowledge extraction. **Manufacturing Process Data Management \& Governance:** * Acquire, integrate, and technically evaluate manufacturing process data from internal teams and contract manufacturing sites to support process monitoring, continuous improvement, and CMC regulatory submissions. * Develop data management and verification workflows that preserve the accuracy, integrity, and traceability of manufacturing process data. * Lead and own data verification for all commercial regulatory submissions. **Process Knowledge Management:** * Develop structured systems and workflows to capture and retain organizational knowledge, including protocols, study results, lessons learned, and decision rationales. * Develop tools and processes that enable technical teams to access, share, and apply process knowledge to support manufacturing and process improvement. * Champion a knowledge\-sharing culture across technical, scientific and operational functions. **Collaboration \& Technical Leadership:** * Partner with regulatory, quality, R\&D, IT and contract manufacturing teams to understand technical needs and develop appropriate solutions. **Compliance \& Risk Management:** * Ensure compliance with data protection and clinical trial regulations, including GDPR, HIPAA, and 21 CFR Part 11\. * Identify and mitigate risks related to data security, access, and retention. ### **Requirements:** Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required. 8\+ years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical process engineering, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), process development, manufacturing technical support, or related engineering work, including at least 3 years in the life sciences or biotechnology industry. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered. * Experience interpreting manufacturing process data and applying engineering and statistical methods to evaluate process performance. * Proven experience leading enterprise data governance and knowledge sharing initiatives in a highly regulated environment. * Strong technical communication, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, scientific, and manufacturing teams. * Experience with tools like SharePoint, Veeva Vault, Confluence, Tableau, and SQL is highly desirable. **Preferred:** * Experience supporting clinical trials and regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, BLA). * Background in immunology, vaccines, or infectious disease R\&D. * Experience in scaling systems and processes in a high\-growth, early\- to mid\-stage. **Reports to:** Senior Director, Process Validation, Global MSAT **Location:** United States **Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy):** Remote **Compensation:** The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component. **Salary Range:** $121,000 \- $142,000 **Relocation:** This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.**Equal Opportunity** *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.* **Recruitment Fraud Notice** *Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. Vaxcyte has an established recruitment process for all positions prior to issuing an offer for employment and we will never extend unsolicited employment offers or ask candidates to provide financial or sensitive personal information as part of the application process. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at* *vaxcyte.com/careers**.*

jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Connect Sales Engineering
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. Every AI model trained, every GPU cluster lit, and every inference workload served depends on physical fiber: dark fiber, long\-haul routes, and metro rings that connect campuses, power\-advantaged regions, and cloud on\-ramps. Hyperscalers and neoclouds are committing billions to this build\-out, and they will choose the partner that can design it right and deliver it on time. Verizon is building AI Connect to be the intelligent fabric of the AI economy. As an Associate Director, you will lead the experts who turn that ambition into signed, buildable, and profitable designs for our largest strategic customers. **About the Role** You will lead the sales engineers who design dark fiber, ultra\-long\-haul, metro and campus interconnect solutions for hyperscalers and neoclouds. Your team shapes route strategy, fiber count, diversity, latency and cost inputs before a deal is won, and makes sure what we quote can be built. **The Team You Will Lead** You will lead some of the most experienced people in the industry, typically with 15\-25 years in the field. Many have: * Come up through outside plant (OSP) planning and engineering design, and know what a route costs, how long it takes and where it breaks. * Led ultra\-long\-haul and metro fiber programs from engineering through construction and delivery. * Built cost studies and facility designs that balance customer needs against margin. * Worked inside carriers, fiber builders and construction firms, so they understand every hand\-off from the sales call to the splice. They don't need managing. They need a leader who is technically credible, drives innovation and standardization, clears obstacles, sets direction and makes them more valuable to the customer and to the company. **What You Will Do** * **Set the vision.** Build and execute the strategy for dark fiber and AI Connect design engineering so customers reach AI\-forward outcomes. * **Lead the design team.** Guide sales engineers supporting Verizon's top strategic AI Connect customers across a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio, driving bookings and revenue growth. * **Direct world\-class designs.** Own solutions for GPU campus interconnect, data center interconnect, long\-haul and intercity routes, metro rings, and cloud on\-ramps. * **Set design standards.** Define standards for ultra\-high\-count fiber, route diversity, latency budgets, splice and handhole strategy, ILA/regen siting and phased growth for multi\-stage AI builds. * **Bring commercial rigor.** Evaluate build, IRU, lease and swap options with Finance and Product, and build ROI and cost models for every large pursuit. * **Connect design to delivery.** Partner with Network Planning, Construction, Right\-of\-Way, Legal and Operations so quoted routes are constructible, on schedule and on budget. * **Differentiate Verizon.** Equip the team to articulate Verizon's advantages across AI Connect, Dark Fiber, Lit Fiber/Wave and Edge Data Centers, and to be recognized as thought leaders. * **Raise efficiency.** Introduce automation and off\-load low\-value work so senior engineers spend time on customer\-facing design. * **Develop talent.** Hire, coach and retain top engineers, maintain certifications and build a succession bench. * **Build a public presence.** Represent Verizon at industry events, in thought leadership and on customer advisory boards. **What We're Looking For** **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or directly related equivalent experience. * 10\+ years in engineering and architecting telecom, IT or network infrastructure, with deep expertise in dark fiber and the intersection of physical assets with AI/ML digital transformation. * 3\+ years leading senior technical talent, including workforce planning, coaching and performance management. * Proven record designing and winning large, multi\-year infrastructure deals, including technical qualification, pricing and contract negotiation. * Experience engaging senior executives and delivering effective customer presentations. * Demonstrated financial analysis skills: P\&L, ROI, cost analysis and business\-case development. **Even better if you have:** * MS or MBA. * Direct experience with hyperscalers or neoclouds. * OSP engineering, construction or delivery background, including ULH or metro fiber programs, permitting and right\-of\-way, and contractor management. * Knowledge of AI and GPU cluster networking, including scale\-out and scale\-across topologies and their requirements on the fiber layer. * Familiarity with power\-driven site selection and its effect on network routes. * Experience with IRUs, swaps, anchor\-tenant builds, SLAs and MSAs. * Relevant certifications (for example CCIE/CCNP, optical vendor or FOA CFOS). **Why This Role** * **Real scale and authority.** A multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio and the mandate to set design standards, hiring and operating model. * **A team worth leading.** Work with deeply experienced fiber, OSP and network design professionals. * **A front\-row seat to the AI build\-out.** Your team's designs connect the campuses where the next generation of models is trained and served. * **Competitive rewards.** Base salary, annual incentive, long\-term incentive, and comprehensive health and retirement benefits. **How to Apply** Apply through the Verizon careers site with your resume, and include a brief note on the largest infrastructure design or pursuit you have led and the team you built around it. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this mobile role, you'll primarily work from customer or field location(s), with occasional visits to a Verizon location for in\-person training and meetings.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is a commission based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $130,000\.00 \- $248,000\.00\. The annual salary range for the New York location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $142,500\.00 \- $248,000\.00\.
