jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you'll be doing...** As a Senior AI/ML Engineer \- AI Live Operations, you will apply your advanced technical expertise in data science, system orchestration, and software engineering to maintain the stability, safety, and efficiency of our deployed artificial intelligence models. You will be a key individual contributor within the Live Operations team, taking responsibility for the health of machine learning systems once they are exposed to real\-world datasets and production traffic. At Verizon, we are on a multi\-year journey to industrialize our data science and AI capabilities. Very simply, this means that AI will fuel decisions and business processes across the company. At over one hundred thirty billion dollars in annual revenue, this is a pioneering opportunity to build and scale production AI systems in the telecommunications industry. With our leadership in bringing 5G network nationwide, you will help us transition from millions of automated predictions to trillions of real\-time inferences. In this role, your responsibilities will include: * Building and maintaining real\-time monitoring and observability pipelines to track system throughput, latency, and token consumption costs for large language models. * Monitoring production model behavior to identify data drift and model degradation, ensuring our systems maintain high predictive accuracy over time. * Implementing automated continuous evaluation loops that capture user feedback and ground\-truth telemetry to dynamically assess performance. * Deploying real\-time safety filters, system guardrails, and input/output moderators to mitigate model hallucinations and prevent inappropriate content generation. * Integrating robust fallback systems, including routing failures to traditional rule\-based software systems or human queues, to preserve end\-user experience. * Developing automated continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines to retrain, validate, and seamlessly release updated models without downtime. * Resolving production model incidents as a senior escalation contact, diagnosing issues with live models, and shipping immediate hotfixes or prompt adjustments. * Collaborating with platform architects and core data science teams to scale backend architectures across cloud, on\-premises, and edge network infrastructures. * Partnering with peer engineering and development teams to foster technical alignment, conduct code reviews, and champion secure, ethical AI standards. **What we're looking for...** You are a highly skilled engineer who excels in the intersection of data science, software development, and operations. You understand that machine learning models are not static, and you thrive on solving the complex, real\-time challenges that occur once algorithms meet actual users. You are a self\-starter who values precision, system resilience, and clean, scalable code. You enjoy mentoring junior team members and sharing technical knowledge across the larger engineering community. You'll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * Master’s degree in computer science, data science, electrical engineering, mathematics, or another highly technical discipline. * Extensive hands\-on experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging complex machine learning or deep learning models in large\-scale production environments. * Practical familiarity with MLOps frameworks and automated pipeline tools, including Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow. * Advanced programming expertise in Python, Java, or C\+\+, with a strong grasp of data structures and cloud systems such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. * Deep experience developing safety guardrail middleware, system monitoring dashboards, and telemetry systems for Generative AI applications. * Knowledge of distributed compute architectures, database design, and real\-time streaming technologies such as Kafka or Spark. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every even better qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $111,500\.00 \- $194,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Network Engineer (Remote Opportunity)
jobs.description: We are seeking a skilled **Network Engineer** to support enterprise infrastructure and networking operations for a large federal healthcare program. The Network Engineer will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure and resilient network solutions that ensure high availability, performance, and scalability. This role will work closely with infrastructure, cloud, and security teams to integrate on\-premise and cloud environments, supporting mission\-critical applications and services. The candidate must reside within the continental US. Location: Remote (with occasional travel as required) **Responsibilities:** * Design, configure, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and load balancers. * Support WAN, LAN, and wireless networking solutions across hybrid on\-premise and cloud environments. * Implement and optimize network security controls, including firewall rules, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and segmentation strategies. * Manage F5 and other load balancing platforms to ensure high availability and application delivery. * Perform network monitoring, traffic analysis, and root cause investigations using tools such as SolarWinds, Nagios, and Wireshark. * Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with federal standards, including NIST and Zero Trust principles. * Support network upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives, including cloud\-based networking in Azure and hybrid environments. * Create and maintain detailed network diagrams, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. * Provide Tier III escalation support, troubleshoot performance bottlenecks, and resolve incidents across enterprise environments. * Participate in change control processes, risk assessments, and disaster recovery planning. * Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to team members. **Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, electronics engineering, or another engineering or technical discipline. Eight (8\) years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for the degree. * 5\+ years of experience. * Hands\-on experience as a Network Engineer supporting enterprise\-scale environments. * Expertise in configuring and managing Cisco and Juniper routers/switches. * Strong experience with firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Checkpoint, Cisco ASA) and VPN solutions. * Proficiency in load balancing technologies, including F5 LTM/GTM/DNS, with the ability to troubleshoot persistence, SSL offload, and traffic steering. * Knowledge of WAN optimization, MPLS, QoS, and advanced routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP). * Familiarity with cloud networking (Azure, AWS, or similar), hybrid connectivity, and software\-defined networking. * Strong understanding of network security principles, including Zero Trust, encryption, and segmentation. * Experience with network monitoring and analysis tools such as SolarWinds, Nagios, and Wireshark. * Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex network issues. * Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and present technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. **Additional Qualifications:** * Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, JNCIE, PCNSE, or F5\-CTS. * Experience supporting healthcare IT systems, EHR platforms, or large\-scale federal data environments. * Familiarity with VA systems, policies, and compliance frameworks. * Experience using AI\-assisted tools (for example, GitHub Copilot) to write and maintain network automation scripts and configuration templates (for example, Python or Ansible), including reviewing and validating AI\-generated configurations in a lab or test environment before deployment. * Experience using AI\-driven monitoring and AIOps capabilities to detect anomalies, correlate events, and speed root cause analysis across network monitoring data. * Experience using AI tools to analyze logs, packet captures, and traffic data during troubleshooting, with the engineer confirming findings before acting on them. * Experience using AI tools to draft and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, runbooks, and standard operating procedures. * Understanding of the network and security requirements for hosting and accessing AI services, such as secure connectivity to cloud AI endpoints, data egress controls, and segmentation. * Familiarity with secure and responsible AI use in federal environments, including using only agency\-approved AI tools, never entering network configurations, credentials, or PHI/PII into unapproved tools, and following VA and federal AI guidance. **Benefits:** * Medical/Dental/Vision * 401k with Matching * Corporate Laptop * PTO \+ Federal Holidays * Training opportunities * Remote opportunity **Note:** Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status. Sorry, we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay\- Visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200\+ countries. As a Software Development Engineer on the Product Reliability Engineering (PRE) team, you won’t just watch those systems run\- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them. PRE is not a traditional ops team. We are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. You’ll write Python, build agentic AI tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real\-time transactions. From day one, you are an engineer\- and from day one, your work matters. If you are endlessly curious about how large\-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you. **Build Automation That Scales** * Design and ship end\-to\-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves. * Write clean, production\-grade Python (and Go or Bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self\-managing. * Develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle. **Manage \& Evolve Data Platforms** * Support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure. * Gain exposure to real\-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale * Perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier\-1 production databases. * Optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, CPU usage, and replication latency. * Automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like Ansible and Liquibase, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines that govern schema changes through TEST and PROD environments safely. * Build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents. **Ship Agentic AI \& ML\-Powered Tools** * Build GenAI\-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management. * Integrate LLMs into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, AI\-driven intelligence. * Contribute to prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position PRE as one of the most AI\-forward reliability organizations in financial technology. **Own Observability \& Platform Health** * Build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK that give engineers real\-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems. * Analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur. * Contribute to self\-healing and auto\-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention. **Engineer for Reliability \& Security** * Ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud\-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale. * Support zero\-downtime deployment strategies and high\-availability architectures that Visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock. * Participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first\-class engineering concern. **Collaborate, Learn \& Grow Fast** * Embed within Agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global PRE peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions. * Document runbooks, SOPs, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time. * Participate in on\-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers. Visa will accept applications for this role until at least November 6th, 2026\. **Visa is not offering relocation assistance for this role.** **Visa is not supporting immigration support for this role.** **Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; December 2025 graduates welcome). * Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design \-you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes. * Proficiency in Python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (Go, Java, or Bash). * Foundational understanding of relational databases (RDBMS): SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and meaningful command\-line fluency. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of CI/CD principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained. * Genuine curiosity about GenAI platforms and agentic systems (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, or similar)\- hands\-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must. **Bonus Points:** * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools: Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi \-even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship. * Experience with database CI/CD tooling, particularly Liquibase for schema change management across environments. * Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or Datadog. * Database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring. * Familiarity with Git workflows and modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). * Academic or project experience with ML frameworks: scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain / LangGraph. * Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, service mesh, or TCP/IP. * A GitHub profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open\-source contribution that shows us how you think and build. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. **Information for US Applicants** Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: At VyStar, we offer competitive pay, an excellent benefit package that includes a 401(k) Plan, an extensive paid technical and on\-the\-job training program, and tuition reimbursement\-available to all full and part time employees. Part time positions start at a minimum of 30 hours per week. We encourage you to become a part of VyStar Credit Union's family of employees. Senior Cloud Engineer ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT: The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback. This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi\-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on\-call support rotation.**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Responsible for day\-to\-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud\-based systems. * Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on\-call rotation with other cloud engineers. * Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates. * Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers. * Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on\-premises operations. * Maintain documentation of infrastructures design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other guidance. * Other duties as assigned by the supervisor * All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. To enhance a healthy risk culture and support our growth for good pillar, employees will maintain vigilance in safeguarding our operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance. Incumbent is expected to demonstrate each of the following VyStar Excellence behaviors in performing the duties and responsibilities of their job: * Focus \- Focus your full attention by carefully listening to and observing client or member. * Connect \- Consistently be friendly and approachable. Demonstrate your care. * Understand \- Listen empathetically and ask questions (70%/30% rule). * Counsel \- Recommend solutions based on your member’s needs and objectives. * Advance \- Ensure that member’s expectations were exceeded. * Verify necessary follow\-up actions. **JOB QUALIFICATIONS** ====================== **Education** * This position requires a 4\-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related academic area and a minimum of 5 years’ experience as a systems engineer or in a related position. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education. **Experience** * 5 \- 7 years of Enterprise level work experience in Systems Engineering or in a related position with physical and virtual Microsoft\-based systems; ideally in a financial services organization (or related industry). * 3\+ years of experience managing a production Azure cloud environment * Experience with establishing technology guidelines based on best practices in enterprise level systems engineering. * Demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives from beginning to end. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills are required. * Understanding of IT, software development, and DevOps best practices * Expert knowledge of multiple Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022/2025\). * Knowledge and experience in Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud or AWS (Amazon Cloud Services) a plus. * Experience with automation technologies and the ability to streamline processes * Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. * Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) a plus. * Experience with bash, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting language. * Experience with version control tools such as Git a plus. * Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Azure DevOps * Advanced troubleshooting abilities across multiple technologies and vendors. Able to calmly provide support on bridge lines during outages. * Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and VPN. * Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and data protection mechanisms in the cloud. * A solid understanding of the financial services industry and the laws and regulations that govern and/or impact the credit union is a plus. * A high level of interpersonal skills and social sensitivity are required. The candidate encounters employees on all levels of the organization. The candidate is a resource to the organization and must be an effective listener and communicator. The candidate must set the example in attitude, behavior, and work ethic within multiple teams. **DISCLAIMERS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** Nothing in this position description is an implied contract for employment. The position description is intended to be an accurate account of the essential functions. The functions are not all encompassing and are subject to change at any time by management. The work environment characteristics described are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. As required or requested, may exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. **VyStar Credit Union is not seeking outside assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or search firms for employment or contractor opportunities. Any resumes submitted by an outside vendor to any employee at VyStar via e\-mail, internet, or directly to hiring managers without a valid written search agreement with the Talent Acquisition / HR department will be deemed the sole property of VyStar Credit Union.** **No placement fee will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result of the referral, or through other means.** Thank you for your inquiry regarding our current job opening. Your resume will be carefully reviewed against the position requirements. Should your experience and skills match, you will be contacted by one of our Human Resources department staff members. Thank you again for your interest in this position! *VyStar Credit Union Human Resources*

jobs.title: Software Controls Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Join us as our newest Software Engineer II and make code that even our telescopes admire!** Are you someone who genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays?” Do you ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego? Do you communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something? Do you appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome? If so, apply to be our newest Software Engineer II! **What the Software Engineer II Does:** The Software Engineer II spends their days turning ideas into clean, reliable, scalable software—preferably without summoning any new and exciting bugs. They work with friendly humans across multiple engineering disciplines to transform napkin sketches and ambitious brainstorms into real, working features. They review code (theirs and others’) in a way that is constructive, kind, and ideally free of passive\-aggressive comments. They have room to stretch into new areas, experiment with tools they’re curious about, and grow their technical and professional chops along the way. They may also use previous robotics or control systems experiences to understand what design tradeoffs that may exist when updating our software systems implemented in EPICS (Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System). Tapping into any knowledge or previous experiences with motors and electric drives, embedded systems, or DFx would also help out greatly. In this role the Software Engineer II genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays.” They ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego. On a daily basis they communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something. They appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome.### **Why Choose W. M. Keck Observatory:** * Competitive starting salary * Generous benefits package, including 4 weeks of annual paid vacation * A robust 8% 403(b) employer contribution (with a 4% employee contribution) * Tuition assistance for dependent children grades K\-12 attending private school on Hawai’i Island * Comprehensive, employer provided health insurance * We offer relocation support for candidates moving from outside the area. * Be a part of a dedicated team working on the frontiers of astronomy. ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or other relevant engineering or science field * 3\-7 years of experience in developing code used for observing tools, data tools, and/or general software development * Practical experience creating software applications with Python * Software applications with hardware interfaces * Practical experience of change control, build and release management processes * Unix/Linux shell scripting * Experience with communication protocols (RS\-232/485/422, SPI, I2C) * Broad knowledge of modern software engineering practices, especially in areas of re\-use and testability * Good knowledge of database design * TCP/IP networking * Fundamental operating system administration * Competency in C/C\+\+, Python, databases * User interface development with Java, Qt, React, or other GUI toolkits * Competency using O\-O paradigm and design patterns ### **About W. M. Keck Observatory** At the W. M. Keck Observatory, we approach our work with wonder about the mysteries of the universe and with deep respect and care for Maunakea – a mountain revered in Hawaiʻi and unlike any other in the world. For more than three decades, astronomers using Keck Observatory’s twin 10\-meter telescopes have vastly expanded our understanding of the cosmos through astonishing findings about our solar system, exoplanets, supermassive black holes, the evolution of the universe, and more. We are dedicated to the values of service and stewardship, while advancing the frontiers of astronomy, sharing our discoveries, and inspiring the imagination of all.

jobs.title: Integrated Solutions Release & Configuration Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Summary:** The Integrated Solutions Release \& Configuration Engineer serves as the subject matter expert for release and configuration management across integrated Digital Intelligence solutions. This role is responsible for defining, maintaining, and improving the processes, controls, and technical baselines that govern software, specifications, interfaces, requirements, and deployment artifacts across multiple constituent systems. Working independently and leading through influence, the position partners with Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Quality, Cybersecurity, DevOps, and Field Services to ensure integrated solutions are released with traceability, consistency, and operational readiness. The role provides technical leadership on release planning, configuration integrity, audit readiness, and lifecycle governance while driving continuous process improvement and best practices across the organization. **Experience \& Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical discipline. * Typically 8\+ years of experience in release management, configuration management, systems engineering, DevOps, product lifecycle management, or a related technical discipline. * Demonstrated experience managing software and documentation baselines throughout an engineering lifecycle. * Experience coordinating complex, multi\-product releases across cross\-functional engineering organizations. * Working knowledge of configuration management standards and practices, including SAE EIA\-649, ISO 10007, IEEE 828, or equivalent frameworks. * Experience with requirements and lifecycle management tools such as IBM Engineering Lifecycle Management (DOORS Next), Polarion, Jama Connect, or similar platforms. * Experience with source control, build, and release tools including Git, Azure DevOps, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, Jenkins, Artifactory, Nexus, or equivalent solutions. * Experience with PLM, document control, and service management platforms such as Teamcenter, Windchill, SharePoint, or ServiceNow. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across a matrixed environment. * Demonstrated ability to drive process improvements, establish best practices, and lead initiatives with limited guidance. * Experience in transportation, industrial automation, safety\-critical systems, or other regulated industries preferred. * Advanced degree and/or certifications such as PMP, INCOSE CSEP, CMII, ASQ CQE, ITIL, or SAFe preferred. **Responsibilities:** * Lead the execution and continuous improvement of release and configuration management processes for integrated solutions spanning multiple products and systems. * Establish and maintain configuration identification and baseline definitions for software, requirements, specifications, interfaces, architecture artifacts, test assets, deployment packages, and supporting documentation. * Maintain traceability across requirements, constituent\-system versions, interface revisions, change records, verification evidence, and deployed configurations. * Facilitate solution\-level change control and release readiness activities, ensuring technical impacts, dependencies, risks, and deployment considerations are appropriately evaluated. * Develop and coordinate integrated release plans that align delivery schedules, dependencies, version compatibility requirements, and deployment readiness across participating product teams. * Manage controlled release and distribution of technical specifications, requirements, interface definitions, architecture documentation, verification artifacts, and release records. * Partner with engineering, quality, cybersecurity, and testing teams to verify release candidates satisfy established technical, quality, and compliance requirements. * Publish and maintain authoritative release manifests, solution Bills of Materials (BOMs), compatibility matrices, configuration records, and deployment documentation. * Conduct configuration status accounting, audit preparation, and configuration verification activities to ensure released solutions align with approved baselines. * Support deployment readiness, release authorization activities, rollback planning, post\-release validation, and reconciliation of field changes into controlled baselines. * Analyze release, deployment, and configuration issues; lead root\-cause investigations; and drive corrective actions to improve release quality and configuration integrity. * Mentor project teams on configuration management, release management, traceability, and lifecycle best practices while promoting automation and process standardization across the organization. You may also be asked to perform other duties outside of your function or trade, for which adequate training will be provided if necessary. Relocation assistance may be provided if eligibility requirements are met. \#LI\-AM1 **Additional Information** Our job titles may span more than one career level. The salary rate for this role is currently $104800\-149300 The actual salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, education, business needs, market demands and work location. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. More information on offered benefits, which include health, welfare, and retirement, are available at mywabtecbenefits.com. Other benefit offerings for this role may include annual bonus, if eligible. **What could you accomplish in a place that puts People First?** At Wabtec, it’s not just about a job \- it’s about the impact you make. When our people come together, we’re Expanding the Possible by continuously improving what we do and how we do it \- for our clients and each other. If you’re ready to revolutionize how the world moves for future generations, Wabtec is the place for you. **Who are we?** Wabtec is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for the freight and transit rail sectors. Drawing on more than 150 years of experience, we are leading the way in safety, efficiency, reliability, innovation, and productivity. Whether it’s freight, transit, ports, logistics, mining, industrial, or marine, our expertise, technologies, and people together – are accelerating the future of transportation. With roots that date back to George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison, and Louis Faiveley, Wabtec has always built technologies and implemented solutions for a variety of sectors that are critical to meeting the needs of customers and governments alike. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Ideal Candidate** We are looking for a AI/ML Engineer who wants to leverage cutting\-edge artificial intelligence —including Generative AI, LLMs, and modern Agentic frameworks—to fix a broken healthcare system. The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in production machine learning, deep experience with cloud\-native GenAI architectures (specifically on AWS), and a proven track record of working with sensitive healthcare data. You thrive in a high\-impact, collaborative environment where you will design and deploy scalable AI\-driven solutions that automate complex billing workflows, detect fraud, extract insight from unstructured claims, and power our next generation of AI products. This role is eligible for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Candidates located near the company office may be expected to work onsite up to 2 days per week. Remote employees may be required to travel to an office location based on business needs. This role reports to the Vice President of Artificial Intelligence. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and orchestrate Machine Learning, GenAI, and Agentic AI applications leveraging foundational models (via AWS Bedrock, SageMaker) for automated billing, cost prediction, and document intelligence. * Design and build production\-grade, scalable Machine Learning (ML) pipelines integrating Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic decision\-making workflows to process complex medical claims and unstructured data. * Establish end\-to\-end MLOps standards, automated model testing, and robust CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and release cycles of both ML models and AI services. * Define, provision, and maintain secure cloud environments for AI/ML services using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as AWS CDK or Terraform. * Leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Kiro) to accelerate code generation, optimize Python queries, auto\-generate documentation, and maintain high engineering standards. * Develop APIs and microservices to enable seamless integration of ML/AI models into existing business applications. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (product, technology, operations, etc.) to align AI solutions with business goals. * Implement techniques to improve transparency in AI decision\-making, ensuring traceability and model explainability. * Ensure compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, etc.). **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's (preferred) degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production ML, GenAI, and Agentic solutions enterprise\-wide for business applications. * Deep practical knowledge of combining OCR engines (e.g., AWS Textract) with NLP, LLMs, VLMs, and AI foundational models to parse, structure, and query complex healthcare documents. * Proven expertise within the AWS ecosystem (AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS) and proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and modern GenAI and Agentic frameworks (e.g., Strands Agents, AgentCore, Kiro, etc.). * Strong foundation in algorithm design, data structures, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and ability to deploy ML models as scalable APIs using Flask, FastAPI, or similar frameworks. * Strong hands\-on experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like AWS CDK or Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure, paired with practical experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc). * Experience working with healthcare data structures (e.g., insurance claims, EHRs, medical billing coding like CPT/ICD, or EDI 837/835 feeds). * Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance, data masking, secure prompt/data handling, and AI safety guardrails. * You are intellectually curious, obsessed with measurable business impact, and naturally inclined to build better solutions. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently. * Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future company sponsorship. **How to Apply** To be considered, apply through our official Career Site by clicking the **Apply** button and completing the full application. Only applications submitted through our Career Site will be considered. Applications submitted through other channels or third\-party platforms will not be reviewed.

The team designs production\-grade AI applications (including standalone bertha™), agent\-based workflows, Technology Bricks and user interfaces for Westinghouse and its customers. Contribute application requirements and feedback, and raise application\-driven architecture and technology needs to them. Scale the team as demand grows by defining hiring needs, leading recruitment and onboarding, and engaging contractors and third\-party companies when needed, while keeping critical knowledge and intellectual property within Westinghouse. **People leadership and development:** Lead the team, overseeing goal setting, performance management, recognition and succession. Mentor team members through coaching, mentoring, career plans and upskilling or reskilling in AI engineering, so that software engineers grow into AI engineering roles. ### **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering or a related discipline required. Data: working knowledge of databases and data platforms, including MongoDB, Databricks and lakehouse architectures. We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $130,400 to $163,000 per year. \#LI\-Hybrid **Why Westinghouse?** **Our benefits package is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our employees, while also promoting wellness and career growth. The following are representative of what we offer:** * Comprehensive Medical benefits which could include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage and Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions options * Wellness Programs designed to support employees in maintaining their health and well\-being including Employee Assistance Program providing support for our employees and their household members * 401(k) with Company Match Contributions to support employees' retirement * Paid Vacations and Company Holidays * Opportunities for Flexible Work Arrangements to promote work\-life balance * Educational Reimbursement and Comprehensive Career Programs to help employees grow in their careers * Global Recognition and Service Programs to celebrate employee accomplishments and service * Employee Referral Program **Westinghouse Electric Company is the global nuclear energy industry's first choice for safe, clean, and efficient energy solutions. We enable our delivery of this vision by living our value system:** * Safety and Quality * Integrity and Trust * Customer Focus and Innovation * Speed and Passion to Win * Teamwork and Accountability **While our Global Headquarters are located in Cranberry Township, PA, we have over 11,000 employees working at locations in 19 different countries. You can learn more by visiting** http://www.westinghousenuclear.com. Westinghouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Agent Factory is where Workday’s next chapter gets built. We’re forming small, senior, cross\-functional AI teams that bring together product leaders, AI engineers, and full\-stack builders to create intelligent agents used by millions of people every day. This is production\-grade AI—deeply embedded into Workday’s platform—not research experiments or maintenance work. Teams own problems end to end, collaborate tightly across disciplines, and use the right tools to solve real customer challenges at global scale. You’ll work at the intersection of AI, platform architecture, and human workflows, with the autonomy to shape how agents reason, act, and scale responsibly. High trust, high expectations, and real impact. Engineering, but brighter. **About the Role** As a Senior AI Engineer in Agent Factory, you will drive the end\-to\-end system design, implementation, and product integration for a core domain of Workday’s next generation of intelligent agents. While our ML Engineers focus on building, training, and optimizing foundational algorithms, your mission is intelligence orchestration and product delivery—connecting the brain to the product. Sitting at the intersection of AI capabilities, enterprise platforms, and human workflows, you will develop and integrate foundational models safely and reliably into functional, production\-grade software. You will be hands\-on in the design, experimentation, and orchestration of complex agentic workflows, translating cutting\-edge AI capabilities into scalable business value. Because these agents interact with sensitive financial data at a global scale, you will be a key contributor to Responsible and Governed AI—implementing strict guardrails for data privacy, predictability, and explainability within your pod. This role requires a balance of domain\-level system architecture and rigorous execution, solving critical product constraints like latency, cost, and reliability. Your responsibilities * Design and deliver effective agentic AI experiences for Workday Financials customers * Set the strategy for evaluating agent performance * Collaborate in an iterative, team\-first environment that values strong engineering practices and continuous learning * Share knowledge, mentor teammates, and help raise the technical bar across the team **About You** **Basic Qualifications:** * 8\+ years experience in software engineering * 2\+ years experience integrating large models (LLMs, Foundation Models) and modern AI APIs into user\-facing products 1\+ years experience in agent evaluations * **Other Qualifications:** * Experience designing evaluation datasets, test suites, and automated metrics tied to product requirements (e.g. golden sets, production traces, synthetic data) * Experience evaluating multi\-step agent behavior (e.g. tool use, task completion, trajectories) * Experience with production evaluation frameworks (e.g. LangSmith, Langfuse) * Knowledge of software development best practices (DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability) * High sense of agency to drive work forward independently * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non\-technical partners * Comfortable working with ambiguity and translating complex problems into clear, thoughtful solutions * Committed to fostering an inclusive, team\-oriented environment and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement * Track record of technical leadership and mentoring engineers Understanding of governance, guardrails, and security practices when deploying agents over sensitive enterprise data * **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits in Canada, please click here . For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits in the US, please click here . Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **The Enterprise** **Solutions** **Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for translating enterprise architecture direction into working technical capabilities, reusable engineering patterns, and time\-boxed proofs of concept. The position partners across Enterprise Architecture, IT Delivery, Cloud Operations, Data and Enterprise Platforms, Information Security, and business\-aligned technology teams to improve how WPCU designs, builds, tests, deploys, integrates, and operates technology solutions.** **This position requires broad technical fluency, learning agility, and strong engineering judgment; it does not require deep specialization in every platform, tool, or technology domain referenced in this description. The role works closely with Enterprise Architects to test architectural direction through practical implementation, identify constraints or delivery friction, and turn approved patterns into reusable assets that delivery teams can adopt.** **The role does not serve as the long\-term product owner, application development team, or operator of infrastructure and technology platforms. It proves feasibility, develops reusable enablement assets, accelerates difficult technical work, and transfers production ownership to the accountable delivery or operations team.** 1\) Enterprise Engineering Capabilities (30%) a) Design, build, and evolve reusable engineering capabilities that improve software delivery, with an initial emphasis on CI/CD, automated testing, deployment automation, release evidence, secure delivery controls, and environment promotion. b) Create shared templates, scripts, reference implementations, documentation, and adoption guidance that can be used across multiple technology delivery domains. c) Partner with platform owners so enterprise patterns use supported WPCU platforms without assuming ongoing operational ownership of those platforms. d) Measure adoption and outcomes, identify friction, and improve the engineering capabilities based on delivery\-team feedback. 2\) Technical Prototyping and Proofs of Concept (25%) a) Rapidly assess business and technology opportunities and build time\-boxed proofs of concept to determine feasibility, constraints, security considerations, integration requirements, and likely production approach. b) Develop working code, integrations, deployment patterns, or technical demonstrations for use cases involving APIs, workflow automation, vendor platforms, cloud services, data movement, and emerging technologies. c) Document findings, decisions, assumptions, risks, costs, and recommended next steps in a form that enables leadership and delivery teams to make informed decisions. d) Establish explicit entry, exit, and handoff criteria so proofs of concept do not become unsupported production solutions. 3\) Architecture Enablement and Reference Implementation (20%) a) Partner with Enterprise Architects to validate target\-state patterns through working implementations rather than documentation alone. b) Create reference implementations for integration, API\-centered design, application decomposition, telemetry, resiliency, security, and other enterprise standards. c) Provide hands\-on technical guidance to delivery teams adopting approved patterns and help resolve difficult implementation issues. d) Identify where architecture standards are impractical, incomplete, or creating unnecessary delivery friction and recommend improvements. 4\) Application Modernization and Delivery Acceleration (15%) a) Assess legacy and vendor\-constrained deployment patterns and identify opportunities for full or partial automation, repeatability, auditability, and risk reduction. b) Help teams establish practical modernization approaches, including API enablement, modular decomposition, automated deployment, database change automation, and improved testability. c) Facilitate short technical spikes that reduce uncertainty before major investments or implementation commitments are made. d) Support knowledge transfer, pairing, and mentoring so delivery teams can independently sustain the resulting approach. 5\) Governance, Risk, and Operational Readiness (10%) a) Embed security, risk, SSDLC, change control, and audit\-evidence requirements into reusable engineering patterns wherever practical. b) Ensure experimental work uses appropriate controls, approved environments, representative non\-production data, and clearly documented limitations. c) Coordinate with accountable teams to define production support, monitoring, service ownership, recovery, and lifecycle responsibilities before handoff. d) Ensure proper policies, procedures, risk mitigation activities and operating controls are followed. Report gaps in policies, procedures, operating controls and impacts to member experience to leadership to ensure that member impact and risk is mitigated. Required Skills 1\) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred. Candidates with an equivalent combination of formal training and relevant experience may also be considered. 2\) Typically requires 7 or more years of progressive experience in software engineering, systems integration, DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or a closely related technical field. 3\) Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn unfamiliar technologies and create working proofs of concept. 4\) Hands\-on experience with source control, build/release practices, deployment automation, or CI/CD platforms. 5\) Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, with the ability to read and work across multiple technology stacks. 6\) Ability to distinguish prototypes from production solutions and to design appropriate handoff, support, documentation, security, and lifecycle requirements. 7\) Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex engineering tradeoffs to architects, delivery teams, operations teams, vendors, and leadership. 8\) Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a motor vehicle. 9\) Ability to pass background checks required for access to WPCU facilities or supported third\-party locations, where applicable. **Preferred qualifications** 10\) Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable CI/CD platforms, including build automation, artifact management, approvals, testing, security scanning, and deployment orchestration. 11\) Experience designing or consuming REST APIs, webhooks, event\-based integrations, authentication mechanisms, or secure system\-to\-system integrations. 12\) Working knowledge of SQL databases and database delivery practices. 13\) Experience with automated testing, secure software development practices, secrets management, configuration management, or infrastructure/configuration as code. 14\) Working knowledge of observability and reliability concepts, including logs, metrics, traces, health checks, alerting, and operational readiness. 15\) Experience in a regulated industry or with auditable technology controls.

jobs.title: Field Engineer
jobs.description: Field Engineer The Field Engineer supports network deployments, structured cabling and data center connectivity construction projects. Working with clients, operations teams and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role plans, designs, migrates and troubleshoots installations, provides subject matter expertise, and manages client expectations and contractual commitments. The role drives implementation milestones throughout the project lifecycle to deliver solutions on schedule and meet technical, business, operational and service\-level requirements. **Position Details** ==================== * **Location:** Abilene, TX * **Travel:** Up to 15% * **Standard site hours:** Two shifts, six days per week: 6 a.m.–6 p.m. and 6 p.m.–6 a.m. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Engineering and Deployment** ------------------------------ * Provide post\-sales implementation services for geographically distributed hardware and software network solutions, including requirements definition, implementation planning, end\-to\-end system design, equipment staging, configuration development, testing and deployment. * Assess solution specifications as customer needs evolve and recommend changes that improve value for clients and the organization. * Explain product architecture, functionality, system and data requirements, service delivery and integration with enterprise applications. * Lead field validation of telecom designs and proactively identify conflicts, gaps and installation issues. * Prepare system design and configuration documentation for internal and external clients, maintain current redlines throughout the build lifecycle, and compile closeout documentation. * Validate test results, including OTDR and power meter results, and support quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) requirements. **Project and Client Coordination** ----------------------------------- * Monitor implementation milestones, participate in client status calls and coordinate across departments to keep projects aligned with scope, schedule and contractual obligations. * Build productive relationships with clients, internet service providers (ISPs), carrier services, hardware and software vendors, and other project contributors to ensure reliable delivery. * Participate in requests for information and proposals (RFI/RFP) and bid processes; review contracts, work orders and purchase orders. * Own change management: identify scope impacts, communicate promptly with stakeholders and drive resolution to maintain schedule and project alignment. * Oversee electronic tracking systems and custom dashboards; use established escalation and exception processes to report performance, resolve issues and recommend improvements. * Anticipate, detect and resolve client issues; remove service barriers and document issues, action plans and outcomes promptly. Meet client satisfaction objectives and internal and external service\-level agreements (SLAs). **Operational Excellence** -------------------------- * Meet financial objectives and leadership\-established key performance indicator (KPI) targets for the role; take corrective action when needed. * Improve, simplify and automate deployment methodologies, processes and day\-to\-day service delivery to strengthen quality, efficiency and the client experience. * Research technology, market and industry trends, benchmarking and relevant analytics to identify and implement best practices. * Continuously develop technical and nontechnical skills, including knowledge of supported operating systems, networking infrastructure, products and services. * Apply safety protocols, processes and procedures, and perform other duties assigned by management. **Qualifications** ================== **Education and Experience** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Management Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * At least 5 years of engineering deployment experience in the technology services industry, including post\-sales network engineering, complex client requirements assessment, solution design and implementation. Experience in a managed service provider environment is preferred. * At least 5 years of construction industry experience in a similar role, including large structured cabling projects and/or data center connectivity construction projects. **Technical Skills and Certifications** --------------------------------------- * Strong Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking skills, including cabling, LAN, WAN, telecommunications access methods, DNS\-based Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB) theory, legacy networking technologies and system interdependencies. Cloud and virtualization experience is preferred. * Production experience directly managing routers, switches, global and local load balancing, SSL acceleration, HTTP compression/caching and DNS in high\-availability environments. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio), SharePoint, ERP systems, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Procore, Textura, service delivery management tools and related cloud\-based systems. * Knowledge of telecom design validation, cabling test results, redlines, closeout documentation, QA/QC and construction safety requirements. * OSHA\-30 Hour certification is required. If not held at hire, it must be obtained within the first six (6\) months of the assignment. * CCNP, CCNA, CCIE, Microsoft System Engineer (MCSE) or related certifications are preferred. **Core Competencies** --------------------- * **Accountability:** Take ownership of results, connect individual responsibilities to organizational goals and identify improvements beyond the immediate role. * **Customer focus:** Understand internal and external client needs, anticipate emerging requirements and develop creative service improvements that increase efficiency and reduce cost. * **Business acumen:** Make cost\-effective decisions aligned with organizational strategy, use technology to support decision\-making and strengthen cooperation across departments. * **Decision\-making and problem\-solving:** Use analysis, experience and judgment to identify root causes, resolve immediate issues and implement lasting solutions, including during crises. Document outcomes and measure effectiveness. * **Results and continuous improvement:** Maintain high performance standards, meet or exceed service expectations and apply current technology and industry best practices. * **Process and collaboration skills:** Think end to end, design business processes and workflows, and work effectively across functional groups to optimize offerings, deliver a seamless client experience and resolve issues accurately and on time.

jobs.title: Process Integration Engineer
jobs.description: The Process Integration and Technology Development Engineer defines, develops, and implements silicon process technology for the manufacture of integrated silicon devices. The successful candidate will be responsible for unit/process module development, process flow implementation, design rule definition, device architecture, electrical characterization, and technology qualification. These tasks support new silicon technology developments and transfers of existing technologies in and out of the resident fab. Experience related to semiconductor processing in BCD, Discretes, and hybrid Smart Power technologies and knowledge of semiconductor device functions is required. Responsibilities **Process Integration and Technology Development** * Lead the development of unit processes and process modules for CMOS, BCD, Discretes, and hybrid Smart Power technologies. * Define and assess process module characterization to ensure robustness, manufacturability, and scalability. * Develop and maintain end\-to\-end technology process flows with detailed process specifications. * Define physical design rules and test structures for characterization. * Drive process and device optimization to meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. * Design and analyze statistical experiments using DOE, regression, and AI\-assisted methods to optimize device architecture and process modules. * Support intrinsic reliability studies, including gate oxide integrity, TDDB, HCI, EM, and stress migration, using both physics\-based and data\-driven approaches. **Manufacturing, Yield \& Technology Transfer** * Facilitate process improvements and corrective actions for yield, reliability, and manufacturability issues using root\-cause analysis and data mining and analysis. * Support Process Engineering and Yield Engineering teams to improve process quality and yield for technologies released to manufacturing. Enable smooth technology transfers into and out of the fab by using data\-driven monitoring, excursion detection, and learning systems. * Qualifications **Required** * MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related technical field. * Minimum of 10 years’ experience in semiconductor manufacturing or process development or process integration in a semiconductor manufacturing environment. * Knowledge of semiconductor processes such as oxidation, implant, deposition (CVD, PECVD, etc.), RIE, CMP, Lithography used in FEOL and BEOL wafer fabrication. * Experience applying DOE, statistical analysis, and data analytics to semiconductor development. * Understanding of semiconductor device physics and construction, including CMOS, DMOS, Bipolar, and Trench FET devices. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly. * Proven problem\-solving ability and strong collaboration skills in cross\-functional teams. **Preferred** * Experience with 180 nm through 40 nm technologies. * Knowledge of intrinsic reliability testing methodologies, including GOI, VRamp, TDDB, HCI, EM, and SM. * Hands\-on experience with process and device TCAD simulations. * Experience designing and evaluating physical and electrical design rule test structures. * Familiarity with AI/ML techniques, data mining, or statistical modeling applied to semiconductor process or device data. * Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python, MATLAB, JMP, or equivalent) for data analysis, automation, or model development. About Us **onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end\-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. jobs.description: Code Coach / Computer Science Instructor **The Coder School Short Hills \| Short Hills, NJ \| Part\-Time \| In\-Person** Job Summary The Coder School Short Hills is looking for enthusiastic, technically skilled Code Coaches to help students ages 7–18 develop programming, problem\-solving, and critical\-thinking skills. Our approach emphasizes personalized, project\-based learning. Coaches work closely with students in small groups and semi\-private or private sessions, helping them explore their interests, build real projects, and develop confidence in their technical abilities. We're looking for individuals who enjoy programming, communicate clearly, and are excited about sharing their knowledge with the next generation of developers, engineers, and problem\-solvers. Responsibilities * Teach programming and computer science concepts through hands\-on projects. * Provide personalized instruction in private, semi\-private, and small\-group sessions. * Guide projects involving game development, web development, robotics, AI, and other technologies. * Adapt instruction to students' ages, experience levels, and interests. * Encourage independent problem\-solving, creativity, and critical thinking. * Develop engaging projects and learn new technologies when needed. * Track student progress and maintain clear lesson notes. * Collaborate with fellow coaches and school leadership to support student development. Qualifications * Strong understanding of programming fundamentals and computer science concepts. * **Proficiency in Python is required.** Knowledge of another language, such as Java, JavaScript, C\+\+, or C\#, is strongly preferred. * Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar programming tools and platforms, including Scratch. * Creativity and initiative in developing engaging, age\-appropriate projects. * Strong communication skills, patience, reliability, and enthusiasm for working with young learners. * Current enrollment in or completion of a computer science, engineering, mathematics, or related degree program is preferred. * Previous teaching, tutoring, or mentoring experience is a plus, but not required. **Additional experience with Scratch, Roblox Studio, Unity, robotics, web development, cybersecurity, geospatial technologies/ArcGIS, cloud\-based server deployment, or AI/ML is a plus.** We don't expect coaches to know every technology from day one. Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn are essential. Schedule \& Work Environment This is a **part\-time, in\-person position** at our Short Hills, NJ location. Classes run during weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends. We value consistency and aim to establish recurring weekly schedules for our coaches and students. Why Join Us? **Build your technical skills while helping others develop theirs.** At The Coder School Short Hills, coaching is more than a traditional tutoring job. It's an opportunity to strengthen your computer science fundamentals, gain hands\-on experience, and develop skills that translate directly into professional technology careers. Our coaches work with students on projects involving Python, game development, robotics, AI, and emerging technologies. You'll regularly revisit core programming concepts, explore unfamiliar tools, troubleshoot problems, and help bring creative ideas to life. Beyond technical development, you'll build valuable communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills. Explaining complex concepts, adapting to different learners, and guiding projects from start to finish are experiences that carry into software engineering, technical consulting, product development, and beyond. **We've seen former coaches use the experience they've gained here to help launch successful careers at major technology companies.** We take pride in creating an environment where our staff can grow professionally alongside their students. What you'll gain: * **Hands\-on technical experience:** Apply and reinforce programming fundamentals through real projects. * **Professional development:** Strengthen communication, leadership, teaching, and problem\-solving skills. * **Creative freedom:** Develop projects around student interests and bring your own ideas into the classroom. * **Continuous learning:** Explore new languages, frameworks, and emerging technologies. * **Collaborative environment:** Work alongside fellow programmers, CS students, and educators. * **Flexible, consistent scheduling:** Build professional experience while balancing academic or other commitments. Whether you're pursuing a computer science degree, preparing to enter the technology industry, or looking to apply your existing skills, we want this position to help you grow. **Our goal is to develop stronger programmers and problem\-solvers—both in our students and in our coaches.** Pay: $17\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour Expected hours: 5\.0 – 25\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Professional development assistance Ability to Commute: * Short Hills, NJ 07078 (Preferred) Work Location: In person
